job.description:
Overview

Job Title: Reporter

 

Department: News

 

Reporting To: Assistant Brand Manager

 

Employment Type: Part-Time 

 

Location: Los Angeles, CA

 

Work Arrangement: On-Site

 

Pay Transparency: This position's anticipated starting hourly wage range is $33.38-$38.70. This is a part-time, non-exempt position. Pay will be determined by the education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities, and location of the applicant, as well as internal and external equity.

 

Overview:

KNX News 97.1 FM, Southern California’s agenda-setting multimedia newsroom, is looking for an intrepid, forward-thinking reporter with a positive attitude and impressive work ethic.  You must be a strong writer, have a compelling on-air delivery, be a proficient news gatherer, and understand that great storytelling and creative use of sound make for a captivating news product and a fulfilling listening experience.  

Responsibilities

What You'll Do:

  • Report from the field or newsroom
  • Conceptualize, pitch, produce, and record news segments
  • Gather, write, record, edit, and deliver news content, including providing live coverage in breaking news situations
  • Interview newsmakers
  • Write scripts and ad-lib material for stories
  • Use social media–including but not limited to X (formerly Twitter), Instagram, Facebook, TikTok–to connect with listeners, promote upcoming stories and interviews, highlight station content, and search for story ideas and developments.
  • Contribute content–including but not limited to audio, video, and written format–to the station’s digital assets
  • Propose story ideas and contribute to daily and long-term coverage plans
  • Develop and research potential news stories
  • Collaborate with editors, producers, anchors, news production assistants, and management to craft compelling stories
  • Protect the station’s FCC license
  • Other duties as required by management

Qualifications

Required & Preferred:

  • The right person for the job is an aggressive, energetic, enthusiastic, and creative team player and self-starter. 
  • Must work well with others and interact well with the public. 
  • Prior major-market reporting experience required.  
  • Strong multi-tasking skills required. 
  • Strong computer and social media skills required.   
  • Must be cool under pressure and able to project urgency while staying calm and in control during major breaking news.
  • Must be detail-oriented and very comfortable with working under tight deadlines in a fast-paced newsroom or field environment.
  • Must be available to work all hours–overnights, weekends and holidays–and be amenable to schedule changes.  This may include last-minute changes, as well as long-term adjustments.
  • Must be familiar with Southern California, especially Los Angeles and Orange counties (i.e. politics, geography, lifestyle, culture etc.). 
  • Must join SAG-AFTRA.
  • A valid driver’s license, satisfactory completion of a motor vehicle record check, and, if the position requires use of the applicant's own vehicle, proof of insurance is required.

Please be aware that Audacy will never ask you to send money at any point during the hiring process. job.description:
Overview

Job Title: Sales Assistant

 

Department: Sales

 

Reporting To: SVP Sales

 

Employment Type: Full-Time

 

Work Arrangement: In Office

 

 

Job Description:

 

Audacy is seeking a dynamic, detail-oriented, and driven Sales Assistant to support our growing media and sales team. This is an ideal role for someone looking to build a career in media sales. You will work closely with Account Executives to ensure flawless execution of advertising campaigns across multiple platforms including radio, digital, social, podcast, and streaming and more.

You will play a key role in supporting strategic planning, media proposals, and account management to help deliver and drive new business growth.

 

Audacy offers full time employees with a comprehensive benefits package to include:  health care coordinator, medical, dental, vision, telemedicine, flexible spending accounts, health savings account, disability, life insurance, critical illness, hospital indemnity, accident insurance, paid time off (sick, vacation, personal, parental, volunteer), 401(k) retirement plan, discounted employee stock purchase, student loan payment assistance program, legal assistance, life assistance program, identity theft protection, discounted home and auto insurance, and pet insurance.

 

Responsibilities

What You'll Do:

 

Key Responsibilities:

Sales Support & Campaign Execution:

 

  • Research target companies, industry news, and business trends to uncover insights that support sales outreach.
  • Develop value-based research(VBR) points that align with prospect needs and position our solutions effectively.
  • Assist Account Executives in preparing proposals and building strategic media plans
  • Track emerging industry themes and competitor activity to keep the sales team apprised of market developments.
  • Maintain organized research notes within Salesforce/CRM to ensure insights are actionable and easily accessible.

Client Communication & Relationship Management:

  • Serve as a liaison between clients and internal departments to ensure campaign objectives and timelines are met.
  • Help manage day-to-day communication and support requests from clients and internal departments such as marketing, and brand managers.
  • Coordinate with the Traffic Department on creative assets, instructions, and troubleshooting.

 Administrative & Reporting Tasks:

  • Create and update sales presentations, media kits, and one-sheets.
  • Consolidate and analyze campaign data to support strategic recommendations and reporting.
  • Maintain organized research notes within Salesforce/CRM to ensure insights are actionable and easily accessible.

Team Collaboration & Learning:

  • Participate in sales meetings, trainings, and client events as needed.
  • Stay up to date on new media products including podcasting, streaming, OTT, email, SEO/SEM, and social advertising.
  • Proactively identify opportunities to enhance processes and client offerings.

Qualifications

Desired Skills & Qualifications:

Required:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or related field.
  • 1–3 years of experience in media, advertising, marketing, or sales support.
  • Familiarity with paid social platforms (Meta, LinkedIn, TikTok) and digital marketing best practices.
  • Strong organizational, multitasking, and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong research and analytical skills with attention to detail.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, Google Workspace, and CRM tools (e.g., Salesforce).
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Ability to translate business news and trends into meaningful sales insights.
  • Self-starter with curiosity about industries, companies, and market drivers. 
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.

 

Preferred:

  • Experience with campaign management or ad operations tools (e.g., Wide Orbit, Salesforce).
  • Radio or audio industry background a bonus.

Important Notes:

Please be aware that Audacy will never ask you to send money at any point during the hiring process. Communication from legitimate Audacy representatives will only come from email addresses ending in @audacy.com. If you receive any suspicious requests or communications, please verify their authenticity before responding.

Sales Development & Training

job.title: Search Engine Marketing (SEM) Account Manager
job.description:
Overview

Job Title: Search Engine Marketing Account Manager

 

Department: Digital

 

Reporting To: SEM Product Manager

 

Employment Type: Full-Time

 

Location(s): Any of Audacy's 48 markets

 

Work Arrangement: Remote

 

Pay Transparency:

 

The anticipated starting salary range for individuals expressing interest in this position is $55,000.00/Yr. - $65,000/Yr. 

Salary to be determined by the education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities and location of the applicant, as well as internal and external equity.

 

Audacy offers employees who are eligible for benefits with a comprehensive benefits package which includes: a health care coordinator, medical, dental, vision, mental health, telemedicine, flexible spending accounts, health savings account, disability, life insurance, critical illness, hospital indemnity, accident insurance, paid time off (sick, flex-time away/vacation days, personal, parental, volunteer), 401(k) retirement plan, student loan payment assistance program, legal assistance, life assistance program, identity theft protection, discounted home and auto insurance, and pet insurance.

 

Overview:

 

The Search Engine Marketing (SEM) Account Manager, reporting to the SEM Product Manager, is an integral member of Audacy’s centralized Revenue Operations Search team. This individual is responsible for building, managing, monitoring and analyzing client Google Ads campaigns while serving as the primary SEM contact for sales teams and external vendors.

 

The Account Manager will proactively optimize campaigns in accordance with Audacy SEM best practices and provide strategic recommendations to support campaign performance and client success. This individual must be comfortable adapting to evolving platforms, processes and priorities while remaining receptive to direction and established team standards. Day-to-day guidance and support will be provided by the SEM Product Manager.

 

This position is eligible for remote work in any of Audacy’s 48 markets.

Responsibilities

What You'll Do:

  • Use forecasting and research tools to provide sales teams with accurate estimates of campaign potential for prospective clients
  • Build and launch Google Ads campaigns, including campaign structures, keyword strategies, ad copy, targeting, budgets and supporting assets
  • Complete required pre-launch and post-launch quality checks to ensure campaigns are accurate and aligned with approved strategies
  • Proactively monitor and optimize campaigns using performance data, industry standards and established Audacy SEM best practices
  • Regularly review search terms, keywords, ads, bidding strategies and conversion data to identify opportunities to improve performance
  • Manage campaign budgets and pacing to support accurate monthly spending and full delivery over the life of each campaign
  • Review conversion tracking and reporting for accuracy, troubleshoot concerns and coordinate with internal teams or vendors when additional support is needed
  • Analyze campaign performance and clearly communicate results, recommendations, required actions and potential growth opportunities to sales teams
  • Manage multiple accounts, requests and deadlines while maintaining accurate documentation and proactively communicating priorities, concerns or potential delays
  • Identify and escalate performance, tracking, policy, billing or fulfillment concerns before they negatively affect a campaign or client
  • Stay current with evolving advertising platforms, SEM products and internal processes, applying new team guidance and Audacy SEM best practices as directed
  • Collaborate with sales teams, internal partners and external vendors to support accurate campaign execution and a positive client experience

Qualifications

Required & Preferred:

  • BS/BA degree or relevant experience
  • Paid search or digital media advertising experience preferred
  • Experience with keyword research tools and ability to use these tools to setup/expand SEM campaigns
  • Working knowledge of Google Ads, Bing Ads, or other PPC platforms 
  • Proficient in Microsoft office suite and Google Workspace

With an emphasis on supporting and amplifying Audacy’s programming and talent, the Social Content Strategy Manager will focus on working closely with our local markets to translate the energy and immediacy of our content (sports broadcasts, show analysis, personalities, podcasts, pop culture and fan moments) into compelling, social-first storytelling that drives engagement and builds community. Tired of the LA hustle? Thinking about moving to Las Vegas? You'll be in good company—plenty of Californians have already made the move. If you're looking for a fresh start and a great career opportunity, we'd love to hear from you!  

We are seeking a creative, high-energy, and multi-talented Social Media Producer & Graphic Designer to join our media team. This dual-focused role is perfect for a digital storyteller who can seamlessly blend community management with striking visual design.

In this role, you will be the creative force behind five of our distinct radio station brands, driving audience engagement through dynamic social content (video, graphics and written content). Additionally, you will serve as the go-to visual designer for our digital sales team, crafting high-impact marketing collateral, client pitch decks, and digital advertisements that drive revenue.

job.description:
Overview

Job Title: Regional Staff Engineer

Department: Technical

Reporting To: Regional Director, Technical Operations 

Employment Type: Full-Time

Overview:

Audacy is seeking a talented Regional Staff Engineer to join our Houston-based engineering team. This hands-on role is ideal for a proactive professional with robust radio broadcast engineering skills and the flexibility to provide support and travel to multiple markets.

Responsibilities

What You'll Do:

  • Maintain, inspect, and repair all broadcast radio station equipment, including high power FM + HD, AM, digital audio & audio streaming, studio equipment, automation systems, remote control equipment, remote broadcast equipment, satellite downlinks, network infrastructure, generators, backup power systems, and related equipment in keeping with good engineering practices.
  • Support studio operations by managing AOIP networks, studio hardware, UPS systems, remote control equipment, and VOIP/telephone systems.
  • Ensure regulatory compliance by reviewing weekly transmitter and studio logs, EAS tests, and tower lighting requirements per F.C.C. regulations.
  • Install and troubleshoot broadcast IT systems, including WideOrbit and Axia, at both studio and transmitter sites.
  • Oversee critical infrastructure maintenance, including generator testing, fueling, and UPS system supervision.
  • Collaborate with the Corporate Networking Team and vendors to manage ISP/Networking circuits and service calls.
  • Assist in the technical planning and development of facilities, including data networks and backup power systems.
  • Develop instructional materials and provide training for operators on technical equipment and systems.
  • Provide 24/7 emergency support for equipment failures, including availability for weekends and holidays as required.
  • Maintain broadcast IT systems at studios and transmitter sites, such as WideOrbit and Axia 
  • Assist in planning and development of all aspects of technical facilities including studios, transmitters, AOIP, VOIP, satellite, STL, computers and data networks
  • Create instructional materials and teach operators to use technical equipment and systems
  • Handle ISP/Networking problems and service calls. Work with Corp Networking Team, Vendor Technicians to install and troubleshoot circuits.  
  • Generator testing, fueling and supervision of Generator maintenance.
  • UPS testing and supervision of maintenance.
  • Effectively communicate and partner with programming staff as well as outside partners.
  • Additional duties and responsibilities may be assigned as necessary.

Qualifications

More About You:

 

Required:

  • Minimum 5 years broadcast engineering experience.
  • Associate’s degree in electronics preferred.
  • IT networking skills preferred.
  • Knowledge of FCC rules and regulations.
  • Ability to provide support 24/7 in case of equipment failure; available to work various hours/days, including weekends and holidays.
  • FCC General Class License or SBE Certifications are a plus.
  • A valid driver’s license, satisfactory completion of a motor vehicle record check, and, if the position requires use of applicant’s own vehicle, proof of insurance, is required.

The New York Audacy TWIN Traffic Gathering Operation is looking for a dynamic and talented professional to work as a part-time Traffic Producer for Audacy’s team of Traffic reporters broadcasting Traffic reports across the cluster of Audacy stations in New York. The job will be based out of Audacy’s NY Hudson St. facilities. Duties include: Gather, write, produce and deliver real-time actionable Traffic information using company collaboration tools, platforms and other assets.  Producer will compose Traffic stories and all material for use on-air, on-line, and on social media platforms in an often demanding, deadline driven and challenging environment. Duties also include the continuous monitoring of all traffic operations assets in the production, writing and presentation of traffic reports & digital content. The Traffic producer works in collaboration with in-studio Traffic reporters to convey and format meaningful Traffic info for broadcast across Audacy NY radio stations.  Must plan and prepare for upcoming traffic coverage for planned traffic events as well as unplanned traffic events.

Overview:

Audacy’s San Francisco/Northwest Region’s TWIN Division has a rare, full time Traffic/Weather Producer/Reporter position, based at All-News KCBS Radio in San Francisco, the Bay Area’s number one news station. Are you an audacious and tech-savvy broadcast journalist with a positive attitude and impressive work ethic ready to join an elite news radio team? Are you a storyteller with a compelling on-air delivery? Can you translate dispatcher-speak into a language everyone can understand? Can you voice a weather report that doesn’t require a meteorology degree to follow?

 

You should have an expertise and high-comfort level with all things IT, a second-nature social media proficiency (Instagram, Tik Tok) with a natural curiosity and desire to touch the listener in as many ways as imaginable. You are expected to work under tight deadlines in a fast-paced newsroom. We are seeking a broadcast journalist who collaborates with editors and producers. You will be expected to actively participate on various social media channels and contribute content to the Audacy’s digital platforms. You must be passionate, committed, self-motivated and agreeable to a flexible work schedule, which may include evenings, overnights and/or weekends. Excellent written and verbal communication skills are required, and candidates must be able to take a detail-oriented approach to work while meeting tight deadlines. This is not a job for a beginner. Experience in a major market is a plus.

Responsibilities

What You'll Do:

  • Report from the Newsroom over the course of multiple hours on KCBS Radio and other Audacy and non-Audacy stations
  • Gather, write, record, edit and deliver traffic/weather/news content inclusive of providing live coverage
  • Conceptualize, pitch, produce and voice live and/or recorded traffic/weather segments
  • Interview traffic/weather news makers
  • Write scripts and ad-lib material for stories
  • Use social media - including but not limited to Instagram and Tik Tok - during the course of your shift to connect with listeners, promote upcoming stories and interviews, and to highlight station content

  • Develop and research potential traffic/weather stories

  • Make station appearances as required

  • Other duties as required by management

Required & Preferred:

  • Minimum 2-year traffic/weather/sports/news reporting for broadcast media

job.title: Analytics Engineer
job.description:
1 big thing: Axios is a growth-focused media company dedicated to helping people get smarter, faster on what matters. As we continue to scale, data plays a critical role in how we drive that mission forward.

Why it matters: As an Analytics Engineer at Axios, you’ll serve as the primary interface for delivering insights to the business. You’ll design and maintain the curated layers of our data platform (Silver and Gold), and also own the dashboards and visualizations that translate those data products into actionable insights. By combining engineering rigor with business context and storytelling, you’ll ensure decision-making is faster, clearer, and aligned with Axios’ mission.

In partnership with data engineers, data scientists, and product managers, you’ll transform raw and complex source data into well-structured data products, certified dashboards, and compelling visualizations that underpin reporting, experimentation, and advanced analytics.

Responsibilities:

  • Own the Silver and Gold layers of the medallion architecture: define, version, and maintain business metrics and semantic models.
  • Build and maintain executive dashboards and visualizations that communicate key insights effectively.
  • Define and enforce best practices for data visualization, storytelling, and stakeholder adoption.
  • Build and maintain data marts and semantic layers that serve multiple domains across Axios.
  • Review and certify dashboards for accuracy, consistency, and adherence to standards.
  • Collaborate with data engineering to ensure Silver layer tables meet business needs.
  • Implement data quality tests, documentation, and lineage tracking to ensure trust in analytics outputs.
  • Serve as a bridge to data science, ensuring feature stores and model outputs are well-documented and reusable.
  • Contribute to the hub-and-spoke model: rotate through responsibilities such as intake, quality assurance, and participation in the analytics hub, while serving as a strategic partner to stakeholders, helping them shape the right questions and identify the decisions their data should inform.

Skills:

  • 2-5+ years of experience in analytics engineering, BI development, or data visualization roles.
  • Strong proficiency in SQL and experience with dbt or similar transformation frameworks.
  • Expertise in BI and visualization tools (Looker, Tableau, Power BI, Mode, etc.).
  • Familiarity with modern data stack (Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, or equivalent).
  • Experience designing and modeling curated datasets, semantic layers or metric stores, and data marts that drive consistent and reliable decisions.
  • Understanding of medallion architecture and data governance best practices.
  • Solid grasp of versioning, testing, and CI/CD practices for data pipelines.
  • Strong data storytelling and presentation skills; ability to communicate complex concepts clearly.
  • Comfort working in a hub-and-spoke model, balancing central standards with domain-specific consulting.

What success looks like:

  • Business users rely on analytics engineers for both accurate data models and clear, actionable dashboards.
  • Stakeholders see insights delivered through compelling visualizations that drive decisions.
  • Data engineers know what to build in Silver because requirements are clearly defined upstream.
  • Data scientists can discover and reuse well-documented features and model inputs.
  • Leadership sees fewer instances of unreliable or inconsistent dashboards and more decisions influenced by consistent, well-visualized data.
  • You help establish analytics engineering as the cornerstone of the data-to-decisions lifecycle at Axios.

job.title: Associate, Axios Live - Talent Pool
job.description:

As our events portfolio and initiatives grow, we regularly assess and expand the team with Associates who can support event execution, manage logistics, coordinate cross-functional partners, and ensure operational excellence. Maintaining this posting allows us to proactively connect with strong candidates and move quickly as opportunities arise.

We encourage interested applicants to submit their materials for consideration. Candidates whose experience aligns with upcoming needs will be contacted as hiring plans progress.

The big picture: Axios is a media company dedicated to providing trustworthy, award-winning news content in an audience-first format. The Associate, Axios Live role supports the day-to-day logistics for the events execution team for our rapidly expanding events business.

Why it matters: Associates manage event materials, client-facing documents, and multiple front-of-house and back-of-house tasks on-site at events and in a virtual environment. They collaborate across the events team to research and build highly curated guest lists, track event analytics, support the creative team with creation and design of event elements (including signage creation, deck creation, etc), draft and send event attendee communications, and perform relevant administrative tasks

Go deeper: This role has operational responsibilities and will often work on multiple, concurrent in-person events while moving at a fast pace. Key responsibilities include:

Event Support & Execution

  • Assist in the planning and execution of live, virtual, and hybrid events—including setup, breakdown, and onsite guest check-in support.
  • Prepare and maintain detailed event documentation such as seating charts, packing lists, and event deliverables.
  • Support the team in real-time problem-solving and coordination during live events.

Guest List & Research

  • Help manage RSVPs, guest confirmations, and check-in tools.
  • Partner with editorial and marketing teams to ensure strategic guest outreach and an excellent pre and post-event audience experience.

Project & Task Coordination

  • Help coordinate deliverables across internal and external stakeholders, such as vendors, designers, and content teams
  • Manage multiple competing priorities, providing timely updates and flagging any risks to deadlines or details.
  • Track administrative follow-ups such as invoicing, shipping logistics, and deliverable collection.

Administrative & Logistical Support

  • Book photographers, travel, and accommodations; submit invoices and process expense reports.
  • Maintain updated records of contracts, agreements, and documentation for vendors
  • Organize and ship event materials (signage, swag, collateral) as needed.
  • Develop and maintain registration pages, ensuring details and accuracy at all times.

Worthy of your time: Ideal candidates will embody an entrepreneurial spirit, a passion for Axios’ mission, and have the following skills:

  • 1–3+ years of experience in events, marketing, project coordination, executive support, or a related field.
  • Exceptional attention to detail, organizational skills, and multitasking ability.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Experience in events is required

job.title: Editor, Axios Local
job.description:
The big picture: Axios is dedicated to providing trustworthy, award-winning news in an audience-first format. We now publish daily newsletters in 39 cities across America — and counting. We're hiring an editor to work with our teams in the Mountain/West region, especially focusing on our expansion in the Phoenix area.

Why it matters: You'll work with reporters in multiple cities, helping them get their local readers smarter, faster on the news, events and local folkways that matter most to them.

Go deeper: You care deeply about the future of local news and are obsessed with cooking up innovative ways to reimagine it. You take a people-first approach to management. You're comfortable guiding expert reporters in a remote-first environment. And you're skilled at delivering consistent, clear, constructive feedback.

Primary responsibilities include:

  • Managing and supporting reporters through editorial brainstorming and execution.
  • Owning the company's vision and communicating it clearly to your teams.
  • Experimenting with and leveraging AI to drive workflow efficiencies.
  • Story and newsletter editing in our Smart Brevity style.
  • Write stories and newsletter items when needed.

Worthy of your time: Ideal candidates will operate with a startup mentality and an entrepreneurial spirit, and have the following skills and qualities:

  • Preferably is located in the Phoenix area and/or has a deep familiarity with it.
  • Experience in a fast-paced newsroom. (Experience editing daily newsletters is a plus.)
  • A deep understanding of the greater Phoenix area and what topics are important to the people who live there.
  • Sharp story framing skills, and the ability to help reporters craft conceptual scoops.

  • Confidence working in a remote-first environment.
  • Experience managing reporters at varying levels of seniority.
  • A belief in Smart Brevity.

job.title: Growth Marketing Manager, National
job.description:
The big picture: Axios is looking for a Manager of National & SME Growth to lead subscriber acquisition and audience growth across our national newsletter portfolio and a new SME audience growth initiative.

This is a highly visible growth role focused on scaling Axios’s flagship national newsletters while helping build and validate a new SME audience acquisition strategy.

Go deeper: The Manager of National & SME Growth is a strategic, data-driven growth leader responsible for acquisition strategy, experimentation, channel diversification, and audience expansion. In this role, you will:

National Subscriber Growth

  • Own subscriber growth targets across Axios’s national newsletter portfolio
  • Execute acquisition strategies across paid, owned, and earned channels
  • Monitor audience composition, growth performance, and acquisition efficiency
  • Contribute insights and recommendations to weekly growth reporting

Paid Media & Channel Diversification

  • Lead paid acquisition strategy across Meta, Google, LinkedIn, and emerging platforms
  • Drive diversification away from concentrated acquisition channels
  • Establish and optimize CAC and conversion benchmarks by audience segment
  • Partner with Creative on campaign messaging and assets

SME Audience Growth Pilot

  • Build and validate a new SME audience acquisition model
  • Run experiments around audience-product fit and conversion economics
  • Partner cross-functionally with Editorial, Product, Revenue, and PDT teams
  • Make data-driven recommendations on what to scale, refine, or retire

Distribution, Retention & Operations

  • Support national audience expansion through distribution partnerships
  • Partner with Lifecycle Marketing on onboarding, engagement, and retention initiatives
  • Use AI-enabled workflows to improve experimentation, analysis, and campaign execution

Skills:

  • 6+ years in growth marketing, audience acquisition, subscription, or lifecycle marketing
  • Proven experience growing subscription, membership, or first-party audience businesses
  • Deep paid media expertise across Meta, Google, LinkedIn, and emerging channels
  • Strong analytical skills across CAC, LTV, attribution, and funnel optimization
  • Experience with modern martech and analytics tools (Braze, Segment, Sigma, Piano, etc.)
  • Experience launching or scaling new growth initiatives or audience programs

What success looks like:

  • Driving measurable national subscriber growth
  • Improving acquisition diversification and efficiency
  • Successfully validating and scaling the SME audience initiative
  • Supporting audience and revenue growth through strategic experimentation and partnerships

job.title: Local Advertising Account Executive - Denver
job.description:
The big picture: Axios is a media company dedicated to delivering trustworthy, award-winning news in an audience-first format. We are building a new category of local revenue generation and are hiring Local Market Builders to help scale Axios Local across key markets.

This is not a traditional Account Executive role. This is a foundational, in-market revenue leader responsible for building Axios’ local advertising business from the ground up.

Why it matters: The Local Market Builder is the face of Axios in their city or region—responsible for developing deep relationships with local business leaders and converting those relationships into long-term advertising partnerships.

This role is critical to unlocking hyperlocal revenue and proving a scalable model for Axios Local expansion.

Go deeper: Local Market Builders are highly entrepreneurial sellers focused on building a book of business through their existing network and local market presence. In this role, you will:

  • Build and own a book of business from day one, leveraging existing relationships with local decision-makers
  • Prospect, pitch, and close new local advertisers (restaurants, healthcare systems, law firms, real estate, financial services, dealerships, and more)
  • Develop repeatable revenue streams through renewals and long-term partnerships
  • Serve as the Axios brand ambassador in-market, attending events, building community presence, and collaborating with editorial teams
  • Create and manage a high-volume pipeline of deals (typical deal size: $5K–$15K)
  • Operate with a founder mindset—owning outcomes, testing approaches, and building momentum in-market

Yes, but: This is not a traditional AE role with inbound leads or established accounts.

  • No house accounts or inherited book — you are expected to bring and build your own
  • Heavy reliance on your existing network to accelerate early revenue
  • In-market presence is essential — this is a relationship-driven role
  • Higher deal volume, shorter cycles, and community-based selling
  • Success is driven by reputation, trust, and consistency, not just pipeline coverage

Worthy of your time: Ideal candidates will embody a collaborative spirit, revenue mindset, and passion for the Axios mission. This position requires the following:

  • 5–8+ years in sales, digital media, advertising, or related field
  • Be deeply connected in your market and know how to turn relationships into revenue.
  • Proven ability to build and monetize a book of business
  • Demonstrated success in closing new business and generating revenue from personal network
  • Strong relationships with local advertisers, agencies, or business leaders in your market

Core Traits

  • Entrepreneurial and self-starting — comfortable building from zero
  • Highly networked in your local market
  • Strong hunter mentality with a bias toward action
  • Comfortable with ambiguity and longer ramp periods
  • Excellent communicator and relationship builder
  • Deep curiosity about local businesses and community dynamics

What Success Looks Like

  • Rapid activation of your existing network into revenue-generating clients
  • Consistent pipeline of new local advertisers
  • Strong renewal rates and repeat business
  • Established presence as a trusted partner in your market

This role is designed for highly motivated, network-driven sellers who want significant upside tied to performance.

  • Competitive base salary + strong variable commission structure
  • Uncapped earnings potential tied to revenue generation
  • Early ramp support (non-recoverable draw)
  • Additional incentives for new logo acquisition and early market traction

This remote position offers a $60,000 annual base salary plus an uncapped commission structure with on-target earnings (OTE) up to $150,000+ designed to reward performance and significant upside potential for top performers. We will also provide a guaranteed additional $5,000 per month for the first 4 months of employment.

job.title: Local Memberships Marketing Coordinator (Part-time Temporary)
job.description:
1 big thing: Axios is a modern media company dedicated to providing trustworthy, award-winning news content in an audience-first format. We are looking for a part-time, temporary Local Memberships Marketing Coordinator to run and help scale member giveaways across our Local markets.

Why it matters: Giveaways have proven to be a strong acquisition and engagement tactic. Five recent campaigns generated an overall 4x positive ROI across every market tested. We now want to test whether this can become a repeatable growth program across all Axios Local markets.

The opportunity is significant, but execution is highly manual. This individual will own the day-to-day coordination and execution of the program so the Membership team can increase campaign volume, test performance across markets, and determine whether giveaways should become a standing acquisition channel.

Go deeper: In this role you will manage Local member giveaways end to end, including:

  • Build and maintain the giveaway calendar across Local markets, targeting roughly four campaigns per week.
  • Coordinate with local journalists to identify restaurants, businesses and institutions that make each giveaway feel authentically local.
  • Draft campaign copy, including member announcements, acquisition emails and last-chance messaging.
  • Draft newsletter callouts for local editors and newsletter writers.
  • Coordinate campaign setup and launch across internal teams and tools.
  • Pull eligible member lists, randomly select winners and manage winner outreach.
  • Purchase and digitally deliver gift cards.
  • Track results by campaign, including members acquired, revenue generated and prize cost.
  • Maintain a simple performance tracker and surface patterns in what is working.
  • Help improve the underlying process by documenting repeatable workflows, templates and opportunities to reduce manual work.

Skills:

  • Strong project management and organizational skills; you can manage multiple campaigns and deadlines at once without losing details.
  • Strong writing and editing skills, particularly for concise promotional and email copy.
  • Comfort working independently and coordinating across multiple teams.
  • High attention to detail, especially around campaign eligibility, winner selection and fulfillment.
  • Comfort working with spreadsheets and basic performance metrics.
  • A test-and-learn mindset: you are interested not just in executing campaigns, but in identifying ways to make them more effective and easier to scale.

Experience in membership, lifecycle marketing, media, subscriptions or consumer growth is a plus, but not required.

What success looks like:

  • Giveaways run consistently and accurately across a growing number of Local markets.
  • The program reaches a sustainable cadence without creating significant additional workload for the core Membership team.
  • Campaign performance is tracked consistently enough to compare results across markets, timing, messaging and prize selection.
  • Strong-performing tactics are identified and incorporated into a reusable giveaway playbook.
  • We have a clear data-backed recommendation on whether and how to scale the program longer term.

How you'll work

  • Target engagement period: 6 months
  • Approximately 15 hours per week.
  • Work closely with the Director, Membership & Community and the broader Membership team.
  • Coordinate regularly with Axios Local journalists and editors.
  • Operate with significant independence once the process and campaign calendar are established.
  • Bring issues and opportunities forward early; the goal is to improve the system while running it, not simply execute a checklist.

Starting salary for this role is in the range of $40 - $45 per hour and is dependent on numerous factors, including but not limited to location, work experience, and skills. job.title: Production Manager, Axios Live (Part-time Temporary)
job.description:
The big picture: Axios is a media company dedicated to providing trustworthy, award-winning news content in an audience-first format. Axios Live brings our journalism to life through dynamic, high-quality live experiences that spark meaningful conversations across business, politics, technology, and culture.

We’re looking for a part-time, temporary Production Manager to join our team, a hands-on technical producer who ensures flawless, high-caliber event execution across Axios’s public and branded experiences.

Why It Matters: This role is central to delivering Axios’s smart, efficient, and creative approach to live events. As Production Manager, Axios Live, you’ll lead technical production and on-site execution for mainstage programs, filmed receptions, and other editorially driven events. You’ll serve as the connective tissue between creative vision and real-world production — translating concepts into precise, high-quality experiences that reflect Axios’s standards of excellence.

Go Deeper: This is a part-time role requiring approximately 15 - 20 hours per week for 8 weeks with the potential to extend the term. The Production Manager will manage technical planning, vendor execution, and on-site operations. This role requires an agile, solutions-oriented producer who thrives in live, fast-paced environments and balances technical precision with editorial sensitivity. Core responsibilities include:

Technical Production & On-Site Execution

  • Lead on-site technical execution for Axios Live events, including audiovisual systems, lighting, staging, livestream, and broadcast operations.
  • Create graphics with Adobe After Effects.
  • Serve as show-caller and stage manager for various Axios Live event products.
  • Coordinate site-specific builds, talent rehearsals, and technical run-throughs.
  • Oversee vendor setup, show cues, asset management, and technical execution to ensure seamless, brand-aligned experiences.
  • Support rapid post-event wrap processes, including media clipping and delivery to editorial and marketing teams.

Vendor & Logistics Management

  • Manage all pre-event logistics, timelines, and technical deliverables across multiple concurrent projects.
  • Coordinate production vendors, venue teams, and freelance technicians to ensure Axios standards are met.
  • Create floor plans in collaboration with the operations team.

Worthy of your time: We’re looking for an experienced, technically skilled producer who embodies a calm, solution-oriented presence and thrives under pressure.

  • 6-8 years of experience in event production, with a focus on A/V systems, livestream, and show execution.
  • Strong understanding of live event and technical workflows, including rigging, lighting, comms, and streaming platforms.
  • Hands-on experience with show-calling, stage management, and backstage coordination.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple events simultaneously while maintaining precision, extreme attention to detail, and quality deliverables.
  • A “can do” and team-centered attitude with a positive approach to quality work.
  • Strong ability to work independently on specific projects.
  • Excellent communication and time-management skills.
  • Comfort working in fast-paced environments and solving technical issues in real time.
  • Knowledgeable in production documentation (Run of Show , Tech Flows, Shoflo, Asset management)
  • Familiarity with project management tools (e.g., Wrike, Airtable)
  • Experience in Adobe products, specifically Adobe Premiere & After Effects.
  • Willingness to travel regularly and work early mornings, evenings, or weekends when required.

Contract details:

  • Target engagement period: 8 weeks with the potential to extend.
  • Compensation:
    • Pre-Production Hourly -$38.50-$44.00/hour (15-20 hours per week)
    • On-Site Flat Rate - $1,500/day (12-hour day)

job.title: Salesforce Business Analyst
job.description:
The big picture: Axios is a modern media company dedicated to providing trustworthy, award-winning news content in an audience-first format. We are hiring a Salesforce Business Analyst to help build and scale our CRM, reporting, and analytics capabilities, as part of our Revenue Operations team.

Why it matters: This role owns and administers our Salesforce Media Cloud instance, ensuring the platform supports the needs of our revenue organization and serves as a trusted source of data. Beyond day-to-day Salesforce administration, this role will develop reporting, analytics, and insights that turn revenue data into meaningful business intelligence. This role will report to the Senior Director of Revenue Strategy and Operations.

Go deeper: This is an opportunity for someone early in their Salesforce and Revenue Operations career who wants hands-on ownership while expanding their skills across systems, processes, and analytics. You’ll partner closely with Revenue Enablement, Client Partnerships, Client Experience, and Business Development teams to solve business challenges, improve revenue processes, and help teams use Salesforce and data more effectively. Responsibilities include:

  • Serve as the day-to-day administrator for Salesforce Media Cloud, managing users, permissions, page layouts, flows, reports, dashboards, validation rules, and automation.
  • Partner with Revenue Strategy & Enablement, Revenue Operations, and sales leadership to translate business needs into scalable Salesforce solutions and operational improvements.
  • Build and optimize a Salesforce environment that supports Axios’ evolving revenue organization, sales processes, and go-to-market strategy.
  • Develop and maintain reports, dashboards, and recurring analyses that give executives, sales leadership, and cross-functional partners actionable visibility into business performance, sales metrics, and KPIs.
  • Support data migration and ongoing data management efforts, ensuring data quality, integrity, consistency, and governance across Salesforce.
  • Identify opportunities to automate manual workflows, streamline processes, and improve operational efficiency across the revenue organization.
  • Support sales planning and performance management, including sales goals, conversion and segment analysis, Quarterly Business Reviews, and weekly, monthly, and quarterly reporting.
  • Troubleshoot user and system issues, recommend scalable solutions, and support testing, deployment, and change management for Salesforce releases and enhancements.
  • Create and maintain documentation, best practices, and training materials while supporting user adoption of Salesforce functionality, reporting tools, and revenue processes.

Worthy of your time: Ideal candidates will embody an entrepreneurial spirit, have a passion for the Axios mission, and the following skills and experience:

  • 1–2 years of Salesforce Administrator experience.
  • 1–2 years of experience in sales operations or sales analytics.
  • Salesforce Administrator Certification (ADM-201) or plans to obtain certification within the first year.
  • Experience helping build or significantly expand a Salesforce organization from the ground up, or participating in a major Salesforce implementation.
  • Experience building flows, reports, dashboards, validation rules, and custom objects.
  • Strong understanding of Salesforce security, profiles, permission sets, and data management best practices.
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with strong attention to detail.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong communication skills and a customer-service mindset when supporting end users.
  • Experience working with cross-functional stakeholders to gather requirements and improve business processes.

Bonus points if you have:

  • Experience with Salesforce Media Cloud.
  • Experience integrating Salesforce with third-party applications.
  • Experience supporting a Salesforce data migration from one CRM or Salesforce org to another.
  • Experience working in the media industry.

Within your first year, you'll help establish a scalable Salesforce foundation that supports Axios' revenue organization by:

  • Delivering a stable, well-governed Salesforce environment that users trust.
  • Successfully supporting the migration from our legacy CRM while maintaining data quality.
  • Improving automation and reducing manual administrative work across revenue teams.
  • Increasing Salesforce adoption through thoughtful training, documentation, and user support.
  • Partnering with cross-functional teams to improve how they leverage data and analytics to understand their business.

job.description:

Why it matters: In this role, you will join the Client Success team, leading post-sale account management for new and existing growth accounts, delivering best-in-class, turnkey client experiences from kickoff to wrap. This role requires a competent level of expertise, including the ability to apply skills independently in common situations, understand the broader business context, and contribute effectively with occasional support. A revenue mindset is key, as you will help drive client retention, identify growth opportunities, and support media planning efforts to maximize long-term value for both the client and Axios.

Go deeper: This role will serve as a trusted partner to many clients who are new to Axios, ensuring they feel confident and supported from day one. The ideal candidate will have the ability to quickly learn and articulate how Axios’ products work, guiding clients and agency partners through each stage of the post-sale process. They will work closely with stakeholders, providing clear communication, proactive solutions, and a high-touch service experience every step of the way.

Working closely with multiple cross-functional teams (Client Partnerships, Smart Brevity Studio, Events, Brand Journalism, and Ad Operations), you will develop and execute a wide range of campaigns across the Axios product suite. You’ll also work with your Client Partnerships colleagues to support media planning, proposals, and renewal activities.

Worthy of your time: Ideal candidates will possess a growth mindset with a drive to learn, embody an entrepreneurial spirit, and have a passion for the Axios mission. They will also be a team player who operates with integrity, practices radical candor, and fosters a culture of collaboration, kindness, and support for colleagues.

job.description:

job.title: Software Engineer
job.description:
1 big thing: Axios is a growth-focused media company dedicated to helping people get smarter, faster on what matters. We’re looking for a Software Engineer to help scale the systems that power Axios’ core products.

Why it matters: At Axios, we deliver news that’s clinical, trustworthy, and informative — reaching millions of readers every day. As a Software Engineer, you’ll help power the services, APIs, and data flows that make our audience-facing products fast, reliable, and scalable. You’ll work closely with product managers, designers, and engineers across disciplines to build resilient systems that embody Axios’ commitment to clarity and make our readers smarter.

Responsibilities:

As a Software Engineer, you’ll develop high-quality, reliable services in a Golang and Python codebase, ensuring performance and stability across Axios’ publishing and delivery platforms. Key responsibilities include:

  • API development: Design, implement, and maintain scalable REST APIs to power Axios products.
  • Service reliability: Build and optimize backend services using Golang and Python, ensuring they are resilient, performant, and maintainable.
  • Data modeling: Design and evolve database schemas and performant queries to support new features and business requirements.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with front-end engineers, quality engineers, designers, and product managers to deliver end-to-end features.
  • Testing & quality: Write unit, integration, and end-to-end tests; contribute to Axios’ quality efforts by ensuring backend systems are covered with automated tests.
  • Performance & observability: Monitor system health, contribute to our logging/metrics implementation, and proactively improve performance and scalability.
  • AI fluency: Leverage AI tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, or other assistants to accelerate development, improve code quality, and explore creative solutions.
  • Continuous improvement: Participate in code reviews, propose improvements to architecture and practices, and stay up to date with evolving backend technologies.

Skills:

The ideal candidate is a thoughtful engineer who cares about reliability, scalability, and writing clean, maintainable code. You should have:

  • Experience: 2–5+ years in backend or full-stack development, with hands-on experience in Golang and/or Python.
  • API expertise: Strong understanding of designing and consuming RESTful APIs.
  • Databases: Familiarity with relational databases (e.g., Postgres, MySQL) and ORMs (e.g., Gin, Django)
  • Testing: Experience with unit and integration testing in Golang and/or Python, and a mindset of embedding quality into development.
  • Performance & scalability: Awareness of common patterns for scaling backend services and optimizing performance.
  • AI tooling: Comfort using tools like GitHub Copilot or Claude Clode as part of your day-to-day workflow.
  • Collaboration: Excellent communication skills and the ability to work cross-functionally in an agile environment.

We’ll be even more excited if you have:

  • Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, or similar).
  • Experience with gRPC services.
  • Familiarity with containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Experience working with observability and monitoring tools (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, Honeycomb).
  • Knowledge of authentication, authorization, and security best practices.
  • Experience with performance testing or load testing of backend services.

What success looks like:

  • Reliable systems: You build services that are stable, scalable, and meet the needs of Axios’ products and readers.
  • Quality code: You write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code that reduces defects and simplifies future development.
  • Collaboration: You work closely with teammates across front-end, product, and QE to deliver features efficiently and effectively.
  • AI-driven efficiency: You integrate AI tools into your workflow to accelerate development, improve code quality, and continuously learn.
  • Performance focus: You monitor and improve backend performance, ensuring services are fast and resilient.
  • Continuous growth: You sharpen your skills, share knowledge with teammates, and contribute to improving Axios’ engineering practices.

As a key member of the Architecture and Strategic Development (Media System Architecture) team, you will design and plan CBC/Radio-Canada’s future technology infrastructure. Our mission is to transform our disparate media workflows by integrating hybrid agents, video understanding systems and advanced artificial intelligence architectures operating 24/7. Mentor and elevate the organization’s engineers and data scientists in large-scale ML system design and performance engineering. Develop robust MLOps/LLMOps pipelines with a constant focus on observability, performance profiling and automated testing. Summarize and explain technological innovations to make them understandable to decision-makers and production teams and influence our strategic investments. Featured Technology Environment Inference Modelling and Optimization: PyTorch, vLLM, DeepSpeed, Accelerate, KV caching architectures, quantization techniques. Infrastructure, Cloud and Compute: internal GPU clusters, distributed architectures, AWS, Azure, GCP, containers, Kubernetes. Orchestration and Agents: Open WebUI, integration protocols (MCP, A2A), LiteLLM, LangChain, LangGraph, Strands. Demonstrated experience working with language models and designing solutions optimized for cost efficiency and scale. Availability to travel for short periods when required. Unposting Date: 2026-10-01 11:59 PM CBC News is seeking an experienced, thoughtful journalist to serve as our Middle East Correspondent, to lead our on-the-ground coverage of a region defined by far-reaching complexity, history, and global impact. In the Middle East conflict and shifting peace agreements continue to affect the lives of millions, while reshaping the global economy and alliances. In this role, you will go beyond the immediate news cycle to bring nuanced, contextualized storytelling to life — illuminating human experiences, geopolitical realities, and the diverse perspectives shaping the region. The successful candidate will be an exceptional journalist, with a broad range of social media, video, audio and text storytelling skills aimed at mobile and streaming audiences. You bring a deep knowledge of the Middle East - its history, its politics, its economics and how this all ties into Canada's shifting role on the global stage. You thrive in a demanding daily news environment meeting multiple deadlines. You understand how stories work across platforms and on any given day you could be filing to one or more platforms including social and digital, video and audio. You are adept at delivering live analysis and context, often on short notice, just as easily as you’re able to deliver social-first video and packaged reports. All of your journalism adheres to the CBC News Journalistic Standards and Practices. In this position, you will work closely with a video producer based in Jerusalem, as well as colleagues from Radio-Canada also working in the bureau. You will be supported by the World News team in Toronto, including the Senior Producer who will assign Middle East coverage. The minimum assignment length for this position is two years and, if agreed to by both parties, may be extended for up to an additional two years. Key Responsibilities: Generate and execute compelling journalism that explores a variety of voices and perspectives, from daily news to short- and long-form features. Go live on any platform whenever a story requires it. Produce original content while also responding to breaking news and emerging stories in a fast-paced environment. Pitch and cover stories that resonate with our national audience, with an ability to find the significance in world events for a Canadian audience. Research and analyze complex issues using specialized sources to ensure our audience gets a deep, nuanced understanding of important topics. Quickly identify significant issues and respond strategically to ensure they are covered accurately and effectively. Develop and maintain a strong network of contacts with a wide range of sources. What is required: You are a journalist with a minimum of 8 years of comparable experience, including significant reporting experience at a network/national level. Your extensive experience demonstrates that you can pivot quickly when a story changes, you remain respectful to colleagues when there are competing deadlines and content demands, and be open to social-centric presenting / hosting. Exceptional storytelling skills, with a proven ability to produce memorable social, written, audio and visual content Exceptional critical thinking skills, with an ability to breakdown complex issues and explain them clearly to audiences Demonstrated ability to produce compelling social video content. Strong on-air presence and skill with live reporting. Extensive knowledge of world news and current affairs issues A collaborative team player with strong communication and interpersonal skills. Proven ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and willingness to work long and flexible hours, including overtime, evenings and weekends as needed. Excellent interpersonal skills combined with a successful track record of working as part of a small team Strong grasp of CBC News Journalistic Standards and Practices , with an ability to understand how they apply in your daily storytelling. A university degree in journalism or an equivalent combination of education and experience is preferred. Technology & Infrastructure (T&I) is the backbone and the future-forward arm of CBC/Radio-Canada. Our purpose is to constantly innovate to evolve and maintain the Corporation’s technology and infrastructure. We are the people that make stuff work. We make connections between media content, systems, people and places. We are the space in between. A place with purpose. CBC/Radio-Canada has always been a highly regarded pioneer of media technology — not just in Canada but around the world. While we uphold high standards, we prioritize pragmatism by building flexible frameworks that offer clear structure without adding unnecessary bureaucracy. We encourage continuous experimentation and refinement to drive steady, incremental progress. Our day-to-day work is driven by data, open communication and shared ideas — demystifying complex issues so everyone can move forward with clarity. Transparency is at our core, and the impact of your work is visible across the entire organization. If you prefer rigid, unchanging processes, our culture of continuous experimentation and agility will challenge your comfort zone. Your Role As Senior Advisor, Portfolio Intelligence and Value Realization, you will be a trusted partner responsible for optimizing value flow and portfolio performance within Technology & Infrastructure (T&I). In this role, you will bridge strategy and execution by translating enterprise value-optimization principles into actionable, measurable practices. Working closely with your manager, you will foster a data-driven culture that makes the value generated by T&I (ROI, productivity gains, risk reduction, etc.) tangible and visible to leadership and decision-makers. Key Responsibilities Portfolio and Data Intelligence Design, build and maintain the value dashboard (initiatives, value, capacity, risks and decisions) in collaboration with the team to provide real-time visibility into investments. Develop portfolio reports to guide resource allocation and prioritization during leadership meetings, presenting findings to governance committees as needed. Delivery, Value Monitoring and Coaching Establish and facilitate operational and tactical governance forums across value streams, guiding departments toward optimal delivery practices. Advise teams, managers and delivery leads on adaptive planning, value-stream management optimization and results-focused delivery. Identify potential roadblocks to portfolio optimization, working collaboratively with teams to strategize and execute effective solutions. Maintain thorough tracking and documentation of strategic directions, decisions and changes affecting the portfolio. Cultivate a culture where teams iterate quickly, measure impact and adapt using real-time delivery data and feedback. Exceptional analytical thinking with a proven ability to synthesize complex data into clear insights for diverse audiences. Influential leadership: Demonstrated ability to influence without direct authority and collaborate effectively across operational and executive levels. In-depth knowledge of modern delivery models and methodologies (Lean, Value Stream Management, Agile, hybrid and traditional). Proficiency in portfolio management, analytics and dashboarding tools. Key personal attributes: Continuous learner and mentor, comfortable with ambiguity, empathetic, authentic, collaborative, transparent and solution-focused. We are seeking a high-caliber early-career analyst (fresh graduate in Business Management, Technology, or Futuresight-related disciplines) who possesses relentless intellectual curiosity and an appetite to explore the complex intersections that others overlook. In this role, you will analyze the media ecosystem end-to-end—spanning commercial advertising models, digital distribution mechanics, subscription economics, and emerging tech stacks. You will be expected to thrive in uncertainty, challenge assumptions, and produce rigorous, evidence-backed insights to guide executive decision-making. KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES & RESPONSIBILITIES Ecosystem & Vendor Intelligence: Deliver comprehensive vendor dossiers and category analyses within tight timelines, evaluating category fit, integration feasibility, exit costs, vendor viability, and clear decision confidence levels. End-to-End Media Economics Research: Map and analyze the overlapping dependencies between commercial ad mechanics, audience measurement, first-party data strategies, social tech platforms, and subscription revenue streams. Structured Research & Synthesis: Exceptional writing and analytical skills with a disciplined focus on writing for executive decision-making rather than word count. Exceptional Technical Documentation: Expertise in translating complex technical parameters and multi-dimensional tech transformations into clear, visual, and highly structured business summaries (such as matrices and process maps). job.title: Application Support Specialist
job.description: At Corus Entertainment, we’re shaping the future of media in Canada—home to the country’s biggest hits, most trusted news, and greatest value. Our mission is simple: to create engaging content, connect with audiences wherever they are, and drive meaningful growth. Guided by our values—Think Boldly, Make a Positive Impact, Win as a Team, and Own the Outcome—we bring creativity and collaboration to everything we do. If you’re ready to make an impact, there’s a place for you at Corus. Division: Shared Services, Business Systems Work Status: Full-Time Location: Corus Quay - Toronto, ON (Hybrid) About The Role Corus Entertainment is seeking an Application Support Specialist to provide primary and secondary support for business applications across on-premises and cloud environments. Reporting to the Manager, Business Systems, you will troubleshoot and resolve issues, coordinate testing and system changes, maintain documentation, and support business-critical applications.You will take ownership of your application portfolio by developing a strong understanding of system functionality, integrations, business processes, and operational impact. You'll help ensure applications remain secure, stable, and current through access administration, maintenance activities, audits, and application upgrades, while following Corus' IT General Controls and ITIL/ITSM best practices. Working closely with business stakeholders and technology teams, you will leverage tools such as Power BI and Excel to provide operational insights and support informed decision-making. This role offers the opportunity to support a diverse enterprise application environment, solve complex technical challenges, and expand your expertise across cloud, data, integration, and business systems. This is a hybrid role based at Corus Quay, with an expectation to work onsite one to two days per week, or as required based on business and team needs. You will contribute by: • Provide primary and secondary support for business applications, building expertise in their functionality, configuration, dependencies, and business use. • Coordinate with vendors, technical teams, and business users to manage ongoing support, updates, and patches. • Work independently to investigate incidents, identify root causes, troubleshoot urgent production issues, and drive issues through to resolution while keeping stakeholders informed • Maintain secure, reliable applications by completing scheduled operational and audit activities, reviewing vendor releases, assessing risks, and coordinating updates, patches, testing, user validation, and approved changes across hybrid on-premises and cloud environments. • Support application maintenance, modification, and enhancement through problem solving, data analysis, testing, documentation, and coordination with business stakeholders • Create, maintain, and analyze reports, dashboards, and operational insights using Power BI, Excel, and SQL to support business processes, issue analysis, and decision-making • Conduct business application security administration in accordance with policies, procedures, and internal control requirements • Communicate regularly with senior managers and business stakeholders, translating technical findings and solution options into clear, practical business terms • Use empathy and sound judgement when working with stakeholders, particularly during incidents, changes, and competing business priorities. • Recommend practical solutions that balance business priorities, user impact, technical constraints, and long-term supportability. • Use incident trends, process gaps, and operational data to identify root causes, automate repeatable work, streamline support processes, and deliver measurable improvements in reliability and team effectiveness. • Participate in compensated after-hours support for planned maintenance, major changes, upgrades, and urgent production incidents. Planned work will be scheduled in advance where possible; urgent incident support may be required with limited notice. The expected frequency and whether support follow a formal rotation will be confirmed during the recruitment process. Skills and experience you will bring: • Post-secondary degree or diploma in information technology, computer science, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education, certifications, and relevant experience. • Minimum of five years of progressive experience in information technology, application support, business systems, or a related enterprise support environment. • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to identify root causes, interpret operational data, create reports and dashboards using Power BI, Excel, and SQL, and recommend practical solutions. • Ability to work independently, organize competing priorities, adapt to changing needs, and make sound decisions in a fast-paced support environment. • Strong product ownership mindset, including curiosity and initiative to learn application functionality, dependencies, and business usage • Familiarity with ERP, OMS and CRM platforms such as Great Plains, Dynamics 365, S4M, WideOrbit and Salesforce or similar systems • Working knowledge of hybrid Windows environments, including Windows Server, Azure, enterprise applications, and ITIL/ITSM practices for incident, problem, change, and service management. • Experience installing, updating, and supporting Windows applications and related components in an enterprise environment • Strong written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills, with confidence, empathy, and sound judgement to work effectively with senior managers, technical teams, vendors, and end users and translate technical concepts into practical business language. • Demonstrated experience supporting enterprise applications and integrations across hybrid cloud and on-premises environments, including ERP, OMS, or CRM platforms such as Great Plains, S4M, WideOrbit, Dynamics 365, Salesforce, or similar systems. • Proven ability to take ownership of supported applications, understand business processes, translate user needs into practical improvements, and independently resolve technical and business-process issues through root-cause analysis and stakeholder communication. • Hands-on experience installing, upgrading, patching, testing, and supporting Windows-based enterprise applications, including reviewing release documentation, assessing risks, and recommending implementation approaches. • Working knowledge of ITIL standards and ITSM processes, including incident response, change management, and service support • Strong record of communicating with business stakeholders and senior management in a clear, professional, and solution-oriented manner • Hands-on scripting or automation capability using PowerShell, Python, SQL, or a comparable language is strongly preferred; familiarity with additional languages such as VBA, .NET, JQL, or Java is an asset. • Additional qualifications that would be beneficial include media industry knowledge, and experience working on an Agile product team Application Deadline: September job.title: Account Executive - KIRO TV Seattle
job.description: Location: WA-Seattle Job Title: Account Executive - KIRO TV Seattle Position Overview Cox Media Group (CMG) is seeking Account Executives for outside sales positions selling to new clients and servicing established accounts. This position is located in Seattle, WA at CMG’s local CBS and Telemundo affiliate, KIRO 7. We’re looking for talented, enthusiastic, motivated, and goal-oriented individuals who thrive in a fast-paced working environment. As an Account Executive, you will work closely with our clients as a trusted advisor to deeply understand their unique business goals and then help them achieve those goals. In this field-based role, you will collaborate with local sales managers and will have industry-leading tools and resources at your fingertips to create solutions that help clients reach their target audiences. This role specializes in creating new and incremental television and digital revenue. The primary job responsibility is to identify new prospects and present customized multi-platform advertising solutions focused on the customer’s return on investment. The Account Executive is also responsible for retaining and growing their developed accounts through insight proposals, proof of performance, and maximizing all station assets. To be successful; you need to be driven, resourceful, organized, customer-focused, and analytical. You also need to have effective communication skills and the ability to cultivate client relationships. The ideal candidate should also possess strong presentation and time management skills, along with the ability to generate new business. In return, we offer a unique career opportunity - one where you are given a challenging mission, world-class tools to help you succeed, and the chance to realize your full potential as a sale’s professional. This position offers an opportunity to grow your income through a rewarding commission structure. You’ll also become part of a team that with the mission and purpose of making a positive impact on those we serve. CMG annually generates tens of millions of dollars in economic value for our communities. Essential Duties and Responsibilities Identifies and assesses sales opportunities and apply resources and strategies appropriately. Solicits new business through prospecting and cold calling. Consistently works target accounts in the pipeline. Generates revenue through the development of new accounts and growth of existing accounts. Develops advertising solutions for new customers that deliver results to their customers. Provides information to sales management to ensure generation of tracking reports regarding pending deals, forecasts, advertiser, contact and prospect lists. Conducts a need analysis and account reviews to uncover the customer’s most essential needs. Develops effective marketing plans to meet clients’ needs and objectives. Creates compelling and persuasive presentations that facilitate new or additional business. Effectively negotiates advertising rates. Is able to demonstrate product knowledge and value to customers. Matches available station sponsorships with the needs of prospects and clients and persuasively present and sell those sponsorships. Works with internal departments to manage account stewardship throughout the process. Utilizes CRM (HubSpot) to manage day to day activity, build a pipeline and ensure execution along with providing weekly projections and reporting. Upsells current customers by providing proof of performance and solid results. Collaborates with Account Manager to provide timely and accurate traffic instructions; conducts account maintenance including make-goods posts, and aging/collections. Attends sales meetings, training sessions and client remote meetings. Minimum Qualifications Minimum of 2 years of new business development and prospecting experience in media sales or related role. Proven record of driving revenue growth through successful campaigns. Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and people skills. Ability to multi-task and work in a high pressured, fast paced environment with tight deadlines. Strong marketing, presentation and closing skills. Excellent attention to detail and organizational skills. Has effectively negotiate with customers to meet a winning return on investment. Has experience prospecting for new clients and sell services to them along with maintaining and upselling existing clients. Proficient with Microsoft Office, PowerPoint, and CRM tools, such as HubSpot. Valid driver's license with an acceptable driving record. Preferred Qualifications BA/BS degree with a minimum of three years of media sales, account management or buying experience. Proven history of digital and TV sales success in a local media setting Fluent in Spanish This position is 100% commission basis. Commission rates range from 1% - 12%. Final compensation for the role will be determined by a variety of factors such as skills, certifications, and relevant work experience. Benefits for this role include: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance available to the employee and employee’s family (i.e. child, spouse, domestic partner). Flexible Spending Accounts (healthcare and dependent care) and Health Savings Accounts Short-term and long-term disability and life insurance (supplemental and accidental, death, and dismemberment) Participation in CMG’s 401(k) plan with generous company match and both pre-tax and Roth options Paid flexible vacation and up to four weeks (160 hours) of paid wellness time, inclusive of paid sick and safe time under applicable law. Up to eight (8) paid holidays throughout calendar year 2026 Up to two (2) weeks of paid parental leave Employee assistance program All other benefits required by applicable law. About Cox Media Group CMG Media Corporation (d/b/a Cox Media Group) is an industry-leading media company with unparalleled brands, award-winning content, and exceptional team members. CMG provides valuable local and national journalism and entertainment content to the people and communities it serves. The company's businesses encompass 17 high-quality, market-leading television brands in 9 markets; 45 top-performing radio stations delivering multiple genres of content in 9 markets; and numerous streaming and digital platforms. CMG's TV portfolio includes multiple primary affiliates of ABC, CBS, FOX, NBC, Telemundo and MyNetworkTV, as well as several valuable news and independent stations. For more information about CMG, visit www.coxmediagroup.com Req #: 1853 #LI-Onsite

job.description: Location: GA-Atlanta Job Title: Executive Business Partner - CMG Position Overview The Executive Business Partner plays a critical role in helping executive leaders operate effectively in a fast-paced, highly collaborative environment. By providing proactive support, coordinating priorities, managing critical communications, and ensuring follow-through on key activities, the Executive Business Partner acts as a force multiplier for executive leadership, creating the capacity for leaders to focus on strategic objectives and business results. This role goes beyond traditional administrative support by serving as a highly organized coordinator, relationship builder, and problem solver who helps create structure, streamline processes, and improve efficiency across the executive's areas of responsibility. Success in this role requires sound judgment, initiative, adaptability, strong communication skills, and a commitment to excellence. Coordinates internal and external meetings, executive events, leadership forums, off-sites, and other business-related activities, including agendas, logistics, materials, and follow-up.
