job.title: Senior Manager, Global Trade Risk, Audit & Finance
job.description: About the Role: The Senior Manager, Global Trade Risk, Audit & Finance drives the evaluation, design, and execution of regulatory and operational control frameworks alongside trade finance workflows for the import footprint. This position is strategically balanced across three core execution lanes: control design and automation strategy (30%), risk assessment and transactional audit (40%), and trade finance transaction matching and payment approval (30%). The primary mandate of this leader is the design and implementation of control activities, vendor payment and Customs declaration accuracy, and corporate regulatory risk mitigation. Rather than pursuing commercial value-generation programs (such as duty drawback optimization, foreign trade zones, or preferential trade agreements), this role focuses 60% of its scope on control activities (process mapping, systematic rules configuration, trade payment verification) and 40% on the control environment (risk assessment, reporting, and governance reviews). The successful candidate will manage specialized trade automation technology integrated with core ERP environments to accelerate exception resolution and eliminate financial leakage. What Will You Do: Global Trade Auditing & Control Verification (40% Time Spent) Import Integrity Assurance: Design and oversee post-entry audits, classification testing, and process-validation for physical cargo entries, verifying the defensibility of customs valuation, HTS classification, and country-of-origin declarations. Root-Cause and Corrective Action: Investigate compliance failures, determine the root cause, and implement corrective actions to prevent recurrence. Risk Assessment & Reporting: Advise on high-level risk segmentation. Oversee transaction sampling and post-entry review framework to detect data inaccuracies and prevent fines and penalties. Trade Finance & Payment Authorization (30% Time Spent) Merchandise Payment Sign-Off: Act as the functional approver for vendor merchandise invoices and customs brokerage fees, ensuring invoices are reviewed and approved before payment release. Three-Way Match Governance: Manage automated matching rules engines that validate and reconcile purchase orders, receiving warehouse logs, and product commercial invoices back to official customs declarations. Set systemic parameters to capture, flag, and resolve billing errors, duplicate invoicing, and over-billing. Systems Strategy & Control Automation (30% Time Spent) Automated Workflow Architecture: Lead the configuration of electronic exception filters and screening logic within internal/external trade management software. Analytical Visualization Delivery: Supervise the development of compliance and financial dashboards (leveraging Tableau, PowerBI, or equivalent systems) to track critical compliance metrics and communicate to senior leadership. Cross-Functional Guardrails & Systems Authority: Technology Framework and Systems Governance Roadmap and Architecture Ownership: Inform the creation and development of the long-term technical roadmap, platform selection, and solution deployment strategy for trade finance and customs compliance systems. Change Management: Function as the primary advisor for upstream and downstream enterprise technology, config updates, and technology integrations; review and evaluate updates before deployment to guarantee 99% uptime for trade finance compliance workflows. Guardrails & Executive Communication Executive Visibility: Possesses the executive presence required to present compliance reviews, technical risk mappings, and audit dashboards directly at high-level staff and compliance review meetings. Government and Escalation Protocol: Responsible for identifying declaration errors and directing Post-Summary Corrections (PSC) and/or protests. Customs communications and self-disclosure filings are escalated through the Director level and internal Trade Counsel. Leadership & Supervisory Scope Functional Management: Provide leadership, direction, and strategic oversight across two distinct operational workstreams: one dedicated to traditional customs compliance and regulatory risk assessment and auditing, and the other focused on trade finance, automated invoice matching, and vendor payment approvals. Talent Development: Directly supervise and develop a team of compliance analysts and transaction specialists, coaching personnel on technical internal controls, corrective action, and scalable solutions. Qualifications & Skills: Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, International Business, Supply Chain Management, or a related analytical discipline or equivalent experience Minimum of 7 or more years of progressive experience in international trade compliance, corporate internal audit, or global trade finance workflows within a matrixed multi-tier retail or consumer products company or equivalent experience Proven experience in a technical build-style senior role—demonstrating a record of designing and deploying automated workflows. Functional experience leveraging automated visibility suites (such as Centric PLM and Infor Nexus or industry standard software counterparts) integrated directly into central ERP environments. Preferred Qualifications Licensed Customs Broker (LCB) professional credential strongly preferred. Financial credentials (e.g., CPA ) considered a value-add for risk and audit management. The hiring range for this position in Florida is $145,900.00 to $195,600.00 per year. The base pay actually offered will take into account internal equity and also may vary depending on the candidate’s geographic region, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience among other factors. A bonus and/or long-term incentive units may be provided as part of the compensation package, in addition to the full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits, dependent on the level and position offered.

job.description: |Current USA TODAY Co. Employees- Please ensure you are using our abbreviated process on the internal Careers site by logging into Dayforce through MyApps| USA TODAY Co., Inc. is a diversified media company with expansive reach at the national and local level dedicated to empowering and enriching communities. We seek to inspire, inform, and connect audiences as a sustainable, growth focused media and digital marketing solutions company. Through our trusted brands, including the USA TODAY NETWORK, comprised of the national publication, USA TODAY, and local media organizations, including our network of local properties, in the United States, and Newsquest, a wholly-owned subsidiary operating in the United Kingdom, we provide essential journalism, local content, and digital experiences to audiences and businesses. We deliver high-quality, trusted content with a commitment to balanced, unbiased journalism, where and when consumers want to engage. Our digital marketing solutions brand, LocaliQ, supports small and medium-sized businesses with innovative digital marketing products and solutions. USA TODAY Co. open roles are featured on various external job boards. When applying to a position at USA TODAY Co., you should be completing an application on USA TODAY Co. Careers via Dayforce. Job postings directing you to complete an application on other external sites may not be valid. If you are a California resident, you acknowledge that by applying for a job with us, this California Job Applicant Privacy Notice will apply to our collection, use, and disclosure of your personal information. To connect with us, visit www.usatodayco.com USA TODAY Executive Editor of Audience and Digital Production Role summary USA TODAY is seeking a visionary, highly accomplished Executive Editor, Audience & Digital Production to serve as key driver of USA TODAY’s digital audience strategy and the executive owner of newsroom digital production across platforms. In one of the most critical leadership roles in our organization, this editor will set the agenda for how USA TODAY’s journalism is transformed into signature digital experiences that grow reach, deepen engagement, and build enduring reader loyalty. Reporting directly to the SVP of USA TODAY, the Executive Editor, Audience & Digital Production will own and evolve the operating model for audience and production bringing together dedicated digital content pillar teams, platform owners, and a 24/7 central digital production desk into a cohesive, high performing system. They will oversee a sophisticated organization that spans our core editorial pillars, enterprise level planning, and experts across web, apps, newsletters, video, social and emerging platforms, ensuring that every major story and franchise is executed with clarity, speed and impact. This executive will be accountable for portfolio wide digital performance, including growth in loyal users, repeat visitation, engagement depth, and conversion into newsletters and other owned channels. They will work as a true peer and strategic partner to pillar leaders across News/Life, Opinion, Sports and Entertainment shaping digital growth priorities, championing big bet projects, and making data driven decisions about where, when and how USA TODAY shows up for its audiences. Central to the role is building a modern, scalable operating system for digital journalism. The Executive Editor will design and continuously refine workflows that make our coverage data informed, visually distinctive and relentlessly aligned to USA TODAY’s brand promise and enterprise priorities. They will lead a disciplined culture of experimentation standing up formal testing programs for formats, distribution strategies and audience journeys, and integrating responsible AI assisted tools into daily production in ways that strengthen quality, speed and efficiency. As a senior newsroom executive, this editor will lead, inspire and develop a high caliber team of managers, editors, producers and platform specialists. They will be expected to set a clear vision, translate it into concrete operating standards, and build an inclusive, performance driven culture grounded in candor, coaching and accountability. This leader will ensure that audience insight, platform intelligence and journalistic ambition come together in a unified strategy. The ideal candidate will bring a track record of leading complex digital news operations at scale, deep fluency in audience analytics and platform dynamics, and a demonstrated ability to drive change in fast moving environments. They will combine urgency and creativity with sound judgment and integrity and will be energized by the opportunity to build a flagship audience and digital production organization that positions USA TODAY to win the next decade of digital news. This role must be based out of Washington, DC or NYC. Responsibilities: Own the audience strategy across platforms • Set and communicate the audience and distribution strategy for USA TODAY’s digital portfolio, with a birds-eye view of business needs and growth targets. • Ensure the structure intentionally integrates newsletters, social discovery, video/visuals distribution, search, and AI support across all pillars. Accountable for performance, KPIs, and division goals • Monitor performance against key metrics (pageviews, unique visits, return visits, loyalty, platform growth) and be accountable for hitting audience and engagement goals. • Close the loop between data and editorial decisions by ensuring platform owners and pod leads act on live analytics and audience insights. Leadership of the Compass operating model • Lead and oversee the full Audience & Digital Production structure: digital content pillar team owners, platform owners, and central desk, under one unified model. • Maintain a cohesive view of the entire portfolio and resolve conflicts or prioritization questions between pillars, platforms, and central desk. • Serve as key advisor to executive leadership on audience strategy and digital production capacity. To connect with us, visit www.usatodayco.com About the role USA TODAY is seeking a Sr Director - Enterprise Data Architect to lead the strategy and hands-on delivery of a next-generation Advertiser Intelligence Platform. This leader will build the trusted data and AI foundation that enables unified advertiser profiles, peer benchmarking, opportunity intelligence, predictive insights, and workflow integration across sales, customer success, and operations. This is a high-impact leadership role for a builder who can define the strategy and also execute. The platform vision is rooted in creating trusted identity and data capabilities that power advertising, subscriptions, commerce and loyalty, personalization, experiences, and stronger monetization across a connected platform. What you’ll do • Define the enterprise architecture and phased roadmap for the Advertiser Intelligence Platform. • Build the golden advertiser profile strategy and canonical data model. • Architect AI enrichment, opportunity scoring, similarity matching, and predictive intelligence capabilities. • Partner with engineering and product teams to deliver MVP through scale. • Integrate insights into CRM, BI, and business workflows. • Establish governance for data quality, privacy, lineage, explainability, and cost control. • Work directly with GTM and operations leaders to ensure the platform delivers measurable business results. What you bring • Deep enterprise data architecture experience in complex, cross-functional environments. • Proven success building production-grade data and intelligence platforms. • Strong background in cloud data ecosystems, modern analytics, and AI/ML-enabled architecture. • Ability to lead at executive altitude and execute at implementation depth. • Strong communication, influence, and operating discipline. Core responsibilities Platform strategy and target architecture • Define the end-to-end architecture for USA TODAY’s Advertiser Intelligence Platform, aligned to the business goal of turning advertiser data into revenue growth, retention improvement, and faster decision-making. • Establish the multi-phase architecture spanning golden advertiser profiles, AI enrichment, similarity matching, intelligence UI, predictive analytics, and AI as a central integration layer. • Translate business goals into a pragmatic implementation roadmap that starts small, validates core mechanics, and scales responsibly. • Create architectural standards for trust, lineage, freshness, transparency, explainability, privacy, and operational resilience. Data architecture and modeling • Design the canonical advertiser domain model and golden profile architecture across identifiers, business profile, lifecycle stage, seasonality, product portfolio, financial metrics, performance metrics, creative intelligence, engagement history, geographic footprint, competitive positioning, and data freshness metadata. • Define normalized schemas and data products for advertiser core profile, products, financial metrics, platform performance, temporal metrics, lifecycle history, seasonality profiles, creative inventory, freshness indicators, opportunity packs, and churn-risk signals. • Architect data ingestion, harmonization, identity resolution, deduplication, quality controls, and lineage patterns across the data lake and operational platforms. • Ensure the platform supports lifecycle-normalized and seasonality-normalized comparisons so commercial teams can trust the intelligence surfaced to them. AI, ML, and intelligence architecture • Lead the design of AI-enriched advertiser intelligence, including profile health scoring, opportunity scoring, tiered enrichment, online presence research, competitive intelligence, and evidence-pack generation. • Architect vectorized advertiser representations and peer matching patterns using embedding features such as vertical, spend trajectory, product mix, campaign mix, creative diversity, geography, performance, seasonality, and lifecycle stage. • Partner with data science and engineering teams to define prediction and recommendation patterns for churn, expansion, product adoption, and ROI impact modeling, with clear confidence labeling and non-causal positioning where appropriate. • Ensure AI is implemented as a decision-support capability for business teams, not as an uncontrolled automation layer. Delivery and execution • Lead discovery, architecture definition, MVP design, phased delivery, and production rollout for the platform. • Personally review and contribute to schemas, interface contracts, orchestration logic, data quality rules, and implementation plans. • Guide teams through pilot execution, manual validation with sales teams, feedback loop instrumentation, and post-MVP expansion. • Drive integration of platform insights into operational tools such as CRM, BI, email workflows, and collaboration channels. Governance and operating model • Establish governance for enrichment costs, token and API budgets, cooldown rules, privacy compliance, source transparency, and quarterly ROI reviews. • Define controls for data quality, misleading peer comparisons, confidence labeling, and research-source compliance. • Build an operating model for continuous improvement using user feedback, closed-loop outcomes, and weekly or daily data refresh patterns. • Act as the senior technical voice across executives, product, engineering, commercial operations, and GTM stakeholders. Required experience • 15+ years in enterprise data architecture, data platform engineering, analytics architecture, or closely related leadership roles, including ownership of complex cross-functional data programs. • Proven experience designing enterprise-scale data architectures that unify data from multiple operational and platform systems into trusted, governed, and production-ready domain models. • Demonstrated success building or modernizing advertiser, customer, identity, martech, adtech, subscription, or revenue intelligence platforms. • Strong experience with cloud data platforms and large-scale analytical ecosystems, ideally including BigQuery, modern orchestration patterns, semantic modeling, and near-real-time or daily refresh pipelines. • Practical experience designing AI/ML-enabled data products, including feature design, scoring frameworks, recommender patterns, similarity matching, vector search, or predictive analytics capabilities. • Experience translating ambiguous business goals into phased roadmaps, MVPs, architecture standards, and shipped capabilities adopted by business users. • Experience partnering directly with sales, customer success, operations, finance, and product leaders to convert data strategy into business impact. • Track record leading hands-on architecture reviews, mentoring engineers and architects, and unblocking execution in delivery-critical moments. #LI-REMOTE #LI-NR2 The annualized base salary for this role will range between $170,000 and $180,000. job.title: Broadcast Operations Technician
job.description: WTAE-TV, the ABC affiliate in Pittsburgh, PA, is seeking an experienced Broadcast Operations Technician to join our Engineering team. This position is responsible for delivering and monitoring the station’s on-air signals from content acquisition through distribution. The successful candidate will support both in-studio and remote production operations and report directly to the Assistant Chief Engineer . Responsibilities Operate and manage file-based broadcast workflows, including media preparation, playlist management, recording schedules, and robotic camera shot recall. Provide creative input and work with newscast producers and production crew. Staff the master control room to operate and monitor studio and transmission equipment, including: Broadcast automation systems Robotic cameras Satellite downlinks HD video servers Ensure the accurate execution of on-air playlists, commercial breaks, and programming. Perform floor directing duties during live and recorded productions, communicating effectively with anchors, reporters, and other on-air talent to ensure seamless coordination between the production control room and the studio. Operate and monitor news automation systems to ensure clean technical execution of the newscast. Monitor video and audio quality using waveform monitors, vectorscopes, and other quality control equipment to ensure broadcast standards are met. Quickly identify technical issues and communicate equipment problems promptly to Engineering staff to minimize operational disruptions. Support station operations during live broadcasts, special events, and remote productions. Qualifications Ability to work independently with minimal supervision while maintaining exceptional attention to detail. Strong decision-making skills with the ability to troubleshoot issues and respond effectively under time-sensitive conditions. Highly proficient with computers and comfortable learning new software and broadcast technologies. Understanding of newsroom ENPS and video playback systems. Technical know-how to resolve existing issues and to work around problems that arise during live newscasts. Experience with file-based media workflows and modern broadcast automation systems is strongly preferred. Reliable, punctual, and able to work a flexible schedule, including evenings, weekends, and holidays as needed. Valid Pennsylvania driver’s license and dependable transportation. Able to stand for long periods of time. Able to lift and carry 50 lbs. Preferred Experience Television control room and studio operations experience. Education or training in Broadcast Communications, Electronics, or a related technical field. Technical School degree, Electronics Certification, and/or Society of Broadcast Engineers (SBE) Certification. Military technical experience is welcomed and will be considered. Responsibilities Shoot and edit VOs, VO-SOTs, and packages for broadcast, digital, and streaming platforms Create and adapt content for multi-platform distribution, including TV, web, app, and social media Serve as show editor, cutting and attaching video content into a newscast rundown (ENPS proficiency is a bonus) Produce vertical and mobile-first video optimized for platforms like Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts Collaborate with the Assignment Desk, reporters, and producers to cover stories and meet deadlines Work with producers to bring editorial vision to life through strong visuals, sequencing, and natural sound Identify opportunities for real-time social content and behind-the-scenes storytelling in the field Ensure all content meets journalistic, ethical, and brand standards across platforms Requirements Experience with non-linear editing systems (Adobe Premiere preferred) Understanding of multi-platform storytelling, including broadcast and social/digital video formats Previous newsroom experience preferred; military experience strongly considered Ability to carry up to 50 pounds of equipment Comfortable working in all weather conditions Valid driver’s license with a strong driving record; ability to operate large vehicles Proficiency with mobile journalism tools and emerging video technologies Strong organizational, time-management, and problem-solving skills Ability to work under pressure and make quick editorial decisions Strong interpersonal and communication skills A proactive, self-starter mindset with a “go-getter” attitude Equivalent military training (DINFOS) and related experience highly valued In-person attendance is required Values in Action At Hearst Television we tell stories every day. job.title: 2027 Hearst Developer Fellowship Program
job.description: Hearst Journalism Fellowship Program, Newsroom AI Development The Hearst Fellowship for Newsroom AI Development is a one-year program focused on building tools for journalists and experiences for readers with the cutting-edge technology. The successful candidate will embed on the DevHub, Hearst’s San Francisco-based editorial innovation team, and they will work on AI-assisted projects, tools and news products with our core product and engineering teams and our top metro newsrooms: San Francisco Chronicle, Houston Chronicle, Dallas Morning News, Austin American-Statesman, San Antonio Express-News, (Albany) Times Union and our Hearst Connecticut newsrooms. Fellows will receive training, mentorship and real-world experience alongside top journalist-programmers who build interactive experiences and automation tools focused on building connections to the local communities we cover. Hearst Fellows are full-time employees with competitive salary and benefits, including health insurance, relocation allowance and a housing stipend. What the DevHub does The Hearst DevHub is a team of editorial engineers, AI developers, data journalists, interactive designers and content strategists who collaborate with local newsrooms to create best-in-class digital experiences. We make things like election results pages, AI tools, searchable databases, severe weather trackers, elegantly designed alternative story forms and whatever else you can dream up. You can learn more about the DevHub here . What this fellowship could mean for your future Our goal for the program is for Fellows to earn full-time employment at the end of the yearlong term. We want to train our next builders, and then continue supporting them as they grow into our future leaders. While participation in the program is not a guarantee of future employment, our goal is to recruit candidates who eventually will join our full-time professional staff. All of us here have an investment in your future and in the future of Hearst Newspapers. What the successful candidate will do on the DevHub Create AI tools for newsrooms and experiences for readers that adhere to our strict editorial standards and company policies. Work with newsrooms on best practices for AI usage. Enrich existing tools and interactives with fresh approaches to workflows, data analysis and visualization. Innovate with new technology to benefit journalists and the communities we cover. Hearst Fellowships jump-start great journalism careers The experience you gain as a Hearst Fellow is the start of a strong foundation for your journalism career. Our objective is to recruit, train and retain journalists who have experience with AI, data journalism and programming. Candidates should be college graduates with interest, experience or background in journalism and AI. How Fellows are selected Hearst DevHub team members will conduct multiple interviews and test the top candidates. If you are offered and accept a position, you will be assigned a mentor, and we’ll help you develop relationships with seasoned professionals throughout Hearst Newspapers and beyond. Requirements and Information Please see our Fellows website at https://hearstfellowships.com . In addition, candidates must be willing to relocate to the San Francisco Bay Area and work a hybrid in-office schedule. To be considered you must submit in all required documents in PDF format: One-page resume that includes past journalistic experience, academic major and minor, date or expected date of graduation, permanent and current addresses, email, website, and social media addresses (if applicable). Reference page that includes three work references including titles, email addresses and phone numbers. Page with links to portfolio or digital work samples. Deadline to apply for the Fellowship program is Jan. 4, 2027. #LI-DH1 #LI-Hybrid

job.title: 2027 National Hearst Journalism Fellowship Program
job.description: Hearst Newspapers Journalism Fellowship Duration: 2 Years Location: Rotations in San Francisco, Houston, San Antonio, Albany, or Connecticut Deadline to Apply: January 4, 2027 Are you ready to launch your journalism career with one of the most respected names in media? The Hearst Journalism Fellowship is a prestigious, full-time, two-year opportunity designed to catapult the next generation of journalists into impactful careers in today’s fast-changing digital landscape. This isn’t just a foot in the door, it’s a front-row seat to the future of journalism. What You’ll Experience Two immersive, 12-month rotations at leading Hearst newspapers—including the San Francisco Chronicle , Houston Chronicle , San Antonio Express-News , Albany Times Union , or one of our respected publications in Connecticut. Work alongside Pulitzer-winning journalists and newsroom leaders who are telling powerful stories with data, video, and AI-driven tools . Receive hands-on mentoring from seasoned editors and specialists who are invested in your growth. Access cutting-edge newsroom tech and training in digital reporting, investigative journalism, breaking news, and audience engagement . What’s in It for You Full-time employment with a competitive salary and benefits from day one Health insurance, relocation allowance, and housing stipend (depending on location) Personalized career development plans , mentorship, and peer networking across our national newsroom network The opportunity to turn your Fellowship into a long-term journalism career with Hearst Newspapers (many of our Fellows do!) Who We’re Looking For We’re seeking bold, curious, and digitally savvy storytellers with a passion for public service journalism. You might be a reporter, digital producer, data journalist, visual storyteller, or multimedia creator. Ideal candidates will: Be recent college grads or early-career journalists Have a background or demonstrated interest in journalism or related fields Be eager to relocate and take on new beats in multiple cities Bring a hunger to learn, create, and lead in a modern newsroom environment How to Apply Please submit the following in PDF format : Resume (1 page) – Include major/minor, graduation date, contact info, and social handles Work Samples (1 page with clickable links) Cover Letter (max 2 pages) – Tell us why you should be our next Fellow Three Professional References – Names, titles, emails, and phone numbers Two Letters of Recommendation – Sent directly to: fellowships@hearstnp.com Applicants must be authorized to work in the U.S. for the full two-year duration. We are unable to sponsor work visas for this program. Deadline to Apply: January 4, 2027 About Hearst Newspapers With 24 daily and 52 weekly newspapers across the U.S.—including the San Francisco Chronicle , Houston Chronicle , and Albany Times Union — Hearst Newspapers is one of the nation’s most influential media networks. We are investing boldly in the future of news—through digital innovation, community journalism, and the talent of storytellers like you. This is more than a fellowship. It’s your launchpad. Join us and shape the future of journalism. Learn more at hearstfellowships.com #LI-DH1 #LI-Hybrid

job.title: Director, Programmatic Ad Sales
job.description: Position Summary Hearst News is Hearst’s unified programmatic team across Hearst Newspapers and Television, bringing premium local news, lifestyle, sports, entertainment, and video supply across Web, App, and CTV together in a single omnichannel marketplace. As Director, Programmatic Ad Sales, you will help define and execute the commercial strategy for this growing business, translating the scale and quality of our owned-and-operated inventory into meaningful outcomes for agencies, brands, and trading desks. This is a senior sales leadership role for a modern programmatic seller who can move fluidly between strategy and execution. You will build trusted relationships with senior agency and brand stakeholders, create demand for Hearst News’ differentiated supply, develop direct and curated opportunities, and help clients understand how our premium content, first-party signals, addressability, contextual intelligence, and cross-screen reach can work together in a cohesive activation. You will also lead and develop a sales team, with a focus on coaching, operational excellence, accountability, and building lasting customer trust. Reporting to the SVP, Programmatic Strategy, you will collaborate across Sales, Strategy & Operations, Technical Ad Management, Analytics, Product, Data, and Marketing. You will bring a strong point of view to the market, create clarity for internal partners, and translate customer insight into scalable commercial opportunities. This is an opportunity to help shape the next phase of Hearst News’ growth and define how advertisers access premium, omnichannel supply at scale. What You'll Do Commercial Strategy & Revenue Growth Own and execute a growth strategy across national agencies, brands, holding-company trading desks, and programmatic buying teams. Develop new business and expand existing relationships through programmatic direct, private marketplace (PMP), preferred, programmatic guaranteed, and curated deal opportunities. Position Hearst News as one premium, omnichannel marketplace spanning local and national audiences across Web, App, and CTV. Build a disciplined pipeline with clear account priorities, business hypotheses, revenue potential, and next steps. Agency, Advertiser & Partner Leadership Build trusted relationships with agency investment teams, programmatic leads, data and activation teams, and senior brand stakeholders. Lead consultative conversations that connect client objectives to Hearst News' inventory, audience, data, and measurement capabilities. Create compelling solutions that combine display, video, and CTV supply with addressable audiences, contextual signals, suitability controls, and first-party data where appropriate. Represent customer needs internally and ensure that opportunities move from discovery to proposal, activation, optimization, and renewal with strong ownership throughout. Omnichannel Product & Market Expertise Stay current on the programmatic ecosystem, including DSP and SSP dynamics, identity, privacy, CTV, data collaboration, supply-path efficiency, measurement, and evolving buyer expectations. Translate Hearst News' capabilities into clear, differentiated narratives for sellers and buyers, including our premium O&O supply, audience scale, addressability, contextual and suitability solutions, and cross-divisional packages. Partner with Strategy & Operations, Technical Ad Management, Analytics, Product, and Data to align pricing, packaging, inventory allocation, deal execution, and performance insights. Bring the voice of the customer into product development and help identify the next opportunities to improve our commercial proposition. Cross-Functional Leadership Collaborate across Hearst News and broader Hearst teams to create larger, more integrated opportunities for advertisers. Work closely with technical and operational partners to troubleshoot issues, improve the buyer experience, and protect campaign performance. Coach and develop junior sellers, establish strong sales operating habits, and contribute to a culture of accountability, curiosity, and shared ownership. What You'll Bring Significant experience in programmatic advertising, digital media, publisher sales, ad technology, or a related commercial role, ideally 5+ years in a selling role. A strong understanding of programmatic buying and selling, including PMPs, curated supply, direct deals, audience activation, and the agency decision-making process. A proven record of building senior agency and advertiser relationships and converting those relationships into durable revenue. The ability to sell both the strategic story and the operational details, from market positioning and packaging through deal setup, delivery, and optimization. Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, and organizational skills, with a bias toward action and follow-through. A collaborative leadership style and the ability to create momentum across teams in a changing, cross-divisional environment. A deeper understanding of CTV inventory is also a plus. Why Hearst News? You will join a team building a more connected, data-informed, and buyer-friendly way to access Hearst's premium owned-and-operated news supply. Hearst News combines the trust and local relevance of Hearst Newspapers with the reach and premium video capabilities of Hearst Television, giving advertisers a differentiated omnichannel platform with meaningful scale and quality. This role offers the opportunity to shape the commercial strategy, influence product direction, and help define what modern programmatic advertising looks like at Hearst. Our Benefits: At Hearst Newspapers we not only support our employees through personal and professional development, but we also believe in promoting each individual’s physical, financial and emotional wellbeing (and that of their family). Our industry-leading benefits include: Physical Wellbeing: Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage to keep you and your family healthy. Paid Parental Leave: Support for growing families, with paid leave for new parents. Monthly Child & Dependent Care Reimbursement: Financial support for the care of your loved ones. job.title: Account Executive
job.description: iHeartMedia Markets Current employees and contingent workers click here to apply and search by the Job Posting Title. The audio revolution is here – and iHeart is leading it! iHeartMedia, the number one audio company in America , reaches 90% of Americans every month -- a monthly audience that’s twice the size of any other audio company – almost three times the size of the largest TV network – and almost 4 times the size of the largest ad-supported music streaming service. And we were just recognized as one of the Top Media Sales Organizations by The Myers Report! In fact, iHeart has: More #1 rated markets than the next two largest radio companies combined; We’re the largest podcast publisher , with more monthly downloads than the second- and third-largest podcast publishers combined. Podcasting, the fastest-growing new media, today has more monthly users than streaming music services or Netflix; iHeart is the home of many of the country’s most popular and trusted on-air personalities and podcast influencers , who build important connections with hundreds of communities across America; We create and produce some of the most popular and well-known branded live music events in America, including the iHeartRadio Music Festival, the iHeartRadio Music Awards, the iHeartCountry Festival, iHeartRadio Fiesta Latina and the iHeartRadio Jingle Ball Tour; iHeartRadio is the #1 streaming radio digital service in America; Our social media footprint is 7 times larger than the next largest audio service; and We have the only complete audio ad technology stack in the industry for all forms of audio , from on demand to broadcast radio, digital streaming radio and podcasting, which bring data, targeting and attribution to all forms of audio at an unparalleled scale. As a result, we’re able to combine our strong leadership position in audience reach, usage and ad tech with powerful tools and insights for our sales organizations to help them build success for their clients at a more efficient cost than any other option. Because we reach almost every community in America, we’re committed to providing a range of programming that reflects the diversity of the many communities we serve – and our company reflects that same kind of diversity. Our company values stress collaboration, curiosity, welcoming dissent, accepting mistakes in the pursuit of new ideas, and respect for everyone. Only one company in America has the #1 position in everything audio: iHeartMedia! If you’re excited about this role but don’t feel your experience aligns perfectly with the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. At iHeartMedia we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace and are looking for teammates passionate about what we do! What We Need: Looking for a new challenge? Join us as an Account Executive and leverage your proven goal-driven mindset, fast-paced work ethic, and exceptional client service skills. The ideal candidate is ready to hit the ground running and will successfully take advantage of all iHeart’s platforms to exceed their clients’ expectations. What You'll Do: As an Account Executive at iHeart, you'll learn the ins and outs of our Broadcast + Digital Marketing Products, identify and develop new business opportunities through in-person meetings with clients and research, consistent daily cold-calling, and cultivate existing business using our full suite of products. You will collaborate with internal partners to drive revenue, create effective marketing campaigns, and use your storytelling skills to deliver compelling sales presentations fueled by data to best meet your clients’ expectations. What You'll Need: You should be self-motivated (a very “go-getter” attitude!), have excellent relationship-building and problem-solving skills, and communicate persuasively. When people describe you, goal-oriented, expert negotiator and proactive should be at the top of the list. You should be able to plan and multi-task in a fast-paced environment . Comfortable with cold-calling and initiating outreach to prospective clients as part of lead generation efforts. A valid driver's license, auto insurance, and a High School Diploma (College Degree preferred) are required. The audio revolution is here – and iHeart is leading it! iHeartMedia, the number one audio company in America , reaches 90% of Americans every month -- a monthly audience that’s twice the size of any other audio company – almost three times the size of the largest TV network – and almost 4 times the size of the largest ad-supported music streaming service. And we were just recognized as one of the Top Media Sales Organizations by The Myers Report! In fact, iHeart has: More #1 rated markets than the next two largest radio companies combined; We’re the largest podcast publisher , with more monthly downloads than the second- and third-largest podcast publishers combined. Podcasting, the fastest-growing new media, today has more monthly users than streaming music services or Netflix; iHeart is the home of many of the country’s most popular and trusted on-air personalities and podcast influencers , who build important connections with hundreds of communities across America; We create and produce some of the most popular and well-known branded live music events in America, including the iHeartRadio Music Festival, the iHeartRadio Music Awards, the iHeartCountry Festival, iHeartRadio Fiesta Latina and the iHeartRadio Jingle Ball Tour; iHeartRadio is the #1 streaming radio digital service in America; Our social media footprint is 7 times larger than the next largest audio service; and We have the only complete audio ad technology stack in the industry for all forms of audio , from on demand to broadcast radio, digital streaming radio and podcasting, which bring data, targeting and attribution to all forms of audio at an unparalleled scale. As a result, we’re able to combine our strong leadership position in audience reach, usage and ad tech with powerful tools and insights for our sales organizations to help them build success for their clients at a more efficient cost than any other option. Because we reach almost every community in America, we’re committed to providing a range of programming that reflects the diversity of the many communities we serve – and our company reflects that same kind of diversity. Our company values stress collaboration, curiosity, welcoming dissent, accepting mistakes in the pursuit of new ideas, and respect for everyone. Only one company in America has the #1 position in everything audio: iHeartMedia! If you’re excited about this role but don’t feel your experience aligns perfectly with the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. At iHeartMedia we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace and are looking for teammates passionate about what we do! What We Need: Looking for a new challenge? Join us as a Multi-Market Account Executive and leverage your proven goal-driven mindset, fast-paced work ethic, and exceptional client service skills. The ideal candidate is ready to hit the ground running and will successfully take advantage of all iHeart’s platforms to exceed their clients’ expectations. What You'll Do: As an Multi-Market Account Executive at iHeart, you'll learn the ins and outs of our Broadcast + Digital Marketing Products, identify and develop new business opportunities through in-person meetings with clients and research, consistent daily cold-calling, and cultivate existing business using our full suite of products. You will collaborate with internal partners to drive revenue, create effective marketing campaigns, and use your storytelling skills to deliver compelling sales presentations fueled by data to best meet your clients’ expectations. What You'll Need: You should be self-motivated (a very “go-getter” attitude!), have excellent relationship-building and problem-solving skills, and communicate persuasively. When people describe you, goal-oriented, expert negotiator and proactive should be at the top of the list. You should be able to plan and multi-task in a fast-paced environment . Comfortable with cold-calling and initiating outreach to prospective clients as part of lead generation efforts. A valid driver's license, auto insurance, and a High School Diploma (College Degree preferred) are required. You should also be skilled in Salesforce, Microsoft Office and social networking platforms. Strong problem-solving skills; by exercising these skills, you help business grow to the fullest potential. Digital/Media Sales experience are a plus but not required. The natural ability to organize and prioritize day-to-day depending on where the biggest priorities may be Additional nice-to-haves include experience managing complex, multi-platform campaigns , analytics experience, iHeart and/or audio advertising background, and are well-connected in the market. What you’ll get You'll have the opportunity for uncapped commission , and the ability to grow business across all categories on a local, regional, and national level no matter where you live A 7-week onboarding program to immerse you in the suite of tools and products available to you The potential to be recognized in our annual iHeartMedia CEO’s Club a nd iHeartMedia President’s Club programs Access to competitive benefits including paid vacation and sick time , paid company holidays , a Spirit day to encourage the opportunity to more easily volunteer in their communities, company-paid mental health and financial education resources, 401(k) matching , learning and development resources, and career navigation support. Access to additional perks include pet (they’re part of the family!), disaster , and legal insurance, student loan refinancing , and discounts on merchandise, tickets to events, and more. The support of fellow team members invested in your success. Envision your first 30 days Week 1: Complete our onboarding journey for a deep understanding of our company, job-specific trainings and spend time with your team. Week 2: Spend more time with your manager to ensure you are aligned on work and communication styles, priorities, and any other expectations. Week 3: Start “owning” your role and leaning into the real day-to-day, of course with your manager’s support and advocacy! Week 4: Prioritize a 30-day check-in to see what else you might need to be most successful in your new role. Interested in learning more about iHeart and our platforms? Visit us at www.iHeartMedia.com to learn more about our company, www.iHeartRadio.com to access all your favorite music, radio, and podcasts, and download the free iHeartRadio app! What You'll Bring: Respect for others and a strong belief that others should do this in return General understanding of business principles and sales environment Interest in developing knowledge of business operations and sales concepts and techniques Individual accountability and understanding of when to seek guidance Skills managing assigned projects to completion Understanding to resolve problems using established guidelines and professional judgement Ability to communicate information about iHeart products in a digestible manner and to apply active listening skills to validate understanding of customer needs Understanding of impact of your own decisions Goal orientation and the ability to focus and prioritize Location: New Orleans, LA: 1100 Poydras St, Suite 1050, 70163 Position Type: Regular Time Type: Full time Pay Type: Salaried Benefits: iHeartMedia’s benefits offering is flexible and offers a variety of choices to meet the diverse needs of our changing workforce, including the following: Employer sponsored medical, dental and vision with a variety of coverage options Company provided and supplemental life insurance Paid vacation and sick time Paid company holidays A Spirit day to encourage and allow our employees to more easily volunteer in their community A 401K plan Employee Assistance Program (EAP) at no cost – services include telephonic counseling sessions, consultation on legal and financial matters, emotional well-being, family and caregiving ​A range of additional voluntary programs, such as spending accounts, student loan refinancing, accident insurance and more! We are accepting applications for this role on an ongoing basis. The Company is an equal opportunity employer and will not tolerate discrimination in employment on the basis of race, color, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, religion, disability, ethnicity, national origin, marital status, protected veteran status, genetic information, or any other legally protected classification or status. Non-Compete will be required for certain positions and as allowed by law. Our organization participates in E-Verify. Click here to learn about E-Verify.

What We Need: We are seeking a highly motivated Payroll Operations & Payroll Tax Specialist to join our payroll team. This unique role will split responsibilities between Payroll Operations and Payroll Tax, providing support across both functions daily. The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, adaptable, and eager to learn established processes while working collaboratively with a tenured team. This position requires someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment, is comfortable managing changing priorities, and values accuracy, teamwork, and continuous learning. This role requires an individual who can effectively balance responsibilities across Payroll Operations and Payroll Tax throughout the day. The successful candidate must be comfortable shifting between payroll processing, employee support, tax compliance activities, vendor coordination, and issue resolution while maintaining accuracy and meeting deadlines. Success in this role begins with understanding and executing current processes, building strong relationships, and becoming a trusted member of the team. This role offers opportunities for professional growth and expanded responsibilities as business needs evolve. What You'll Do: Payroll Operations Support end-to-end payroll processing activities. Review payroll data for accuracy and compliance. Audit payroll reports and resolve discrepancies. Process adjustments, corrections, and off-cycle payroll requests. Assist with payroll inquiries from employees and internal partners. Support payroll balancing and reconciliation activities. Maintain payroll documentation and process controls. Payroll Tax: Support payroll tax compliance activities across federal, state, and local jurisdictions in a multi-state, multi-FEIN environment. Research and respond to payroll tax notices and agency inquiries. Partner with the payroll tax vendor to support accurate and timely tax filings, payments, and account maintenance. Review payroll tax data and filings for accuracy and assist in resolving discrepancies when identified. Assist with year-end payroll tax activities, including W-2 review and validation processes. Research payroll tax issues and partner with internal and external stakeholders to resolve concerns. Maintain payroll tax records, registrations, and supporting documentation. Monitor regulatory changes and communicate potential impacts to payroll processes and compliance requirements. What You'll Need: Strong knowledge of payroll processing principles and payroll tax regulations. Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy. Excellent organizational and time-management skills. Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines. Strong problem-solving and analytical skills. Proficiency with payroll systems and Microsoft Excel. Workday experience is a plus. Strong verbal and written communication skills. Multi-state payroll experience preferred. Experience supporting payroll processes in a multi-FEIN environment preferred. Experience working with a third-party payroll tax vendor preferred. Experience working in a corporate environment is preferred. CPP certification is a plus. The successful candidate will: Demonstrate a willingness to learn and understand existing processes and procedures. Respect established practices while building knowledge and credibility within the team. Develop positive working relationships with an experienced and tenured group of payroll professionals. Remain flexible and productive when priorities shift or unexpected challenges arise. Demonstrate ownership and accountability while leveraging the knowledge and expertise of team members when needed. Contribute to a collaborative, supportive, and positive team culture. Exhibit adaptability and a willingness to jump in wherever needed to support the team and business. Thrive in an environment where change is constant and the ability to stay calm, organized, and solutions-focused is critical. Demonstrate the ability to quickly shift priorities and seamlessly pivot between Payroll Operations and Payroll Tax responsibilities throughout the day, balancing competing demands while maintaining accuracy, compliance, and excellent customer service. Take initiative, demonstrate sound judgment, and consistently deliver high-quality results. Show a commitment to continuous learning, professional development, and process improvement. Enjoy being hands-on in payroll operations and payroll tax activities. Demonstrate a strong customer-service mindset and commitment to supporting employees and business partners. Demonstrate the ability to manage details and maintain accuracy across multiple entities, jurisdictions, and payroll tax requirements. Work effectively both independently and as part of a team. job.title: Part-Time/Relief On-Air Personality
job.description: JOB SUMMARY Legendary 95.5 KLOS is seeking an experienced and engaging Part-Time/Relief On-Air Personality to provide on-air coverage as needed. This position will primarily provide coverage for regularly scheduled on-air personalities due to vacations, holidays, illness, leaves of absence, and other programming or operational needs. The ideal candidate is a polished, versatile broadcaster who can step into various dayparts, connect authentically with the KLOS audience, and deliver compelling content consistent with the station's sound and brand. DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES Provide live or pre-recorded on-air coverage as assigned by the Program Director or station management. Deliver engaging, authentic, and entertaining on-air content consistent with the KLOS brand and programming direction. Prepare topical and relevant show content using current events, music, entertainment, online resources, and social media. Maintain a strong understanding of rock music, the KLOS audience, and relevant pop-culture and entertainment news. Operate the studio control console and station automation systems. Execute contests, promotions, station imaging, and other programming elements according to station specifications. Contribute content for digital, social media, and other station platforms as requested. Attend station events, remote broadcasts, promotional appearances, or client appearances when scheduled. Follow all FCC regulations, EAS requirements, station procedures, and Company policies. Work collaboratively and professionally with Programming, Promotions, Engineering, Digital, Sales, and other station personnel. Maintain a positive and cooperative attitude within the station and when representing KLOS in the community. Perform other job-related duties and on-air assignments as required. EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE Degree in mass communications, broadcasting, or a related field preferred, or equivalent professional broadcast experience. Previous professional on-air radio experience strongly preferred. Strong knowledge and understanding of rock music and its influence on entertainment and pop culture. Demonstrated ability to develop compelling, topical, and original on-air content. Experience operating radio automation systems, studio equipment, VoxPro, Adobe Audition, or similar broadcast software preferred. Experience creating content for social media and digital platforms. REQUIRED SKILLS & ABILITIES Dynamic, natural, and authentic on-air communication style. Strong oral and written communication skills. Ability to adapt quickly to different shifts, dayparts, and programming needs. Strong organizational skills and attention to detail. Ability to work independently with limited preparation time when necessary. Ability to perform effectively in a fast-paced, deadline-driven broadcast environment. Social media and digital content proficiency. Working knowledge of Microsoft Windows and Microsoft Office applications. SCHEDULE & AVAILABILITY This is a part-time/relief position. Assignments will be offered and scheduled on an as-needed basis based on station coverage and operational needs. Flexibility to accept assignments across various dayparts, including weekdays, weekends, holidays, early mornings, and evenings, is preferred. Reporting to the Game Production Lead, this role translates overall production strategy and editorial direction into consistent, high-quality game broadcasts, providing day-to-day production leadership from pre-production through live event execution and post-production review. Working closely with internal production teams, team and local broadcast partners, Studio Teams, Event Teams, Production Technology, Broadcast Engineering & Operations, Graphics, Programming, Distribution, Content Planning, and third-party vendors, the Game Production Supervisor ensures assigned productions meet established creative, editorial, technical, operational, and financial expectations. This role serves as a leader for assigned games and markets, with primary responsibility for editorial execution, production quality, budget and schedule oversight, and effective coordination among internal and external partners, while escalating broader strategic, stakeholder, or resource decisions to the Game Production Lead as appropriate. Execute production strategy and editorial priorities established by the Game Production Lead and Local Media leadership, translating direction into actionable game plans, rundowns, schedules, staffing needs, and production workflows. Provide editorial leadership for assigned productions, coordinating storylines, content priorities, talent needs, graphics, replay, sponsored elements, and other game presentation components with internal and external production teams. Lead day-to-day communication with studio teams and other production partners regarding content and talent availability, daily schedules, production requirements, and special requests. job.title: Technical Manager, Local Media
job.description: WORK OPTION: In Office _________________ Position Summary The Technical Manager, Local Media serves as the senior operational leader responsible for the execution, performance, and continuous improvement of production technology services supporting the NBA's Local Media ecosystem. Reporting to the Vice President, Production Technology, this role leads the day-to-day technical operations supporting Local Media league program facilitated game broadcasts, ensuring reliable, scalable, and consistent execution across NBA arenas and NBA Secaucus. Serving as an operational owner of the technical production service function for the Local Media team, the Technical Manager oversees production technology operations supporting broadcast contribution, routing, monitoring, transmission, master control, HSAN connectivity, and distribution workflows. This position provides leadership to freelance Technical Managers, establishes operational standards and best practices, drives continuous improvement initiatives, and partners closely with GPM Broadcast Engineering & Broadcast Operations, technical production operations vendors, NBA teams, and other cross-functional stakeholders to deliver best-in-class live broadcasts. The Technical Manager serves as the primary technical liaison between engineering, production, and broadcast operations, ensuring technical readiness, operational excellence, and seamless execution across all League-supported productions. This role partners closely with the Vice President, Production Technology to translate strategic technology initiatives into scalable operational capabilities while continuously improving the League's production technology service model. This position is based in the NBA Secaucus office and requires regular in-office attendance five (5) days per week. This role supports live NBA game productions and League events and requires flexibility to work evenings, weekends, holidays, and extended hours in accordance with the NBA game schedule and other League programming. Occasional domestic travel to NBA arenas and other League event locations may be required. Major Responsibilities Operational Leadership Lead the League's Technical Manager function, providing leadership, coaching, scheduling, onboarding, performance feedback, and operational oversight for freelance Technical Managers supporting NBA Local Media productions. Serve as the primary point of contact for the Local Media production operation working with the GPM Broadcast Engineering team on the HSAN connectivity platform, ensuring reliable contribution, routing, monitoring, transmission, and distribution of live NBA game broadcasts. Own, in conjunction with the NBA with Broadcast Engineering & Operations team, the operational performance, service delivery, and reliability of production technology services supporting League-produced broadcasts. Establish operational priorities, technical standards, service levels, governance processes, and best practices supporting production technology operations across League-supported productions. Oversee day-to-day production technology operations between NBA arenas, NBA Secaucus, Broadcast Engineering & Operations, production operations vendors, distribution, and participating NBA teams. Lead operational readiness planning for all supported productions, ensuring technical infrastructure, connectivity, transmission paths, communications systems, and production technologies are fully prepared prior to each event. Partner with the Vice President, Production Technology in developing the long-term operational roadmap for production technology services, ensuring operational readiness, scalability, and alignment with evolving business priorities. Support implementation and operational transition of new production technologies, workflows, and infrastructure initiatives developed by Production Technology leadership. Live Broadcast Operations Coordinate production technology, transmission, signal acquisition, routing, monitoring, master control, and broadcast distribution workflows supporting live NBA game productions. Serve as a primary technical escalation point during live productions, leading cross-functional troubleshooting efforts and coordinating rapid resolution of production technology issues. Lead technical incident response during live broadcasts, directing cross-functional teams to restore service while minimizing operational impact. Develop contingency plans, operational playbooks, and technical readiness procedures supporting mission-critical live productions. Provide operational leadership for preseason games, NBA All-Star, NBA Summer League, international games, and other League events. Participate in after-hours operational support and on-call rotations supporting live productions and critical production technology systems. Operational Excellence & Continuous Improvement Develop, maintain, and continuously improve standard operating procedures, engineering runbooks, technical documentation, and operational support workflows. Establish, monitor, and report on operational KPIs, service levels, incident trends, and system performance metrics to identify opportunities to improve reliability and efficiency. Lead post-event operational reviews, root cause analyses, corrective action planning, and lessons learned following technical incidents. Recommend workflow enhancements, automation opportunities, and operational improvements that improve service quality, scalability, resiliency, and production efficiency. Coordinate maintenance windows, software deployments, network changes, and system upgrades while minimizing operational impact to live productions. Ensure operational compliance with League technical standards, broadcast quality expectations, and established production technology procedures. Evaluate production technology operations and recommend process improvements that support long-term operational excellence and organizational scalability. Leadership & Cross-Functional Partnership Lead onboarding, mentoring, scheduling, performance management, and ongoing development of freelance Technical Managers and technical support personnel. Foster a culture of operational excellence, accountability, collaboration, customer service, innovation, and continuous improvement. Build and maintain strong partnerships with NBA teams, internal departments, broadcast partners, and key stakeholders to ensure consistent technical execution and exceptional service delivery. Provide subject matter expertise supporting new production workflows, operational planning, and League-wide production technology initiatives. Support annual operational planning, staffing strategies, resource allocation, budget forecasting, and production technology expense management. Represent Production Technology within cross-functional planning meetings and operational governance forums, ensuring alignment across engineering, production, operations, and distribution teams. Required Education / Professional Experience Bachelor's degree in Broadcast Engineering, Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, Media Production, or a related field preferred. 8â10+ years of progressively responsible experience supporting live broadcast production, production technology, broadcast engineering, or technical operations. Demonstrated leadership experience managing technical personnel supporting live sports broadcasts or large-scale broadcast operations. Experience supporting multi-venue production environments and mission-critical live event operations. Experience coordinating production technology operations across engineering, production, transmission, and broadcast operations teams. Demonstrated experience establishing operational standards, service delivery models, and technical governance processes. Experience leading technical incident response and troubleshooting complex broadcast technology environments. Professional sports or major live event production experience strongly preferred. Required Skills / Knowledge Attributes Expert knowledge of live broadcast production systems, workflows, and end-to-end signal flow. Strong understanding of IP-based broadcast infrastructure, contribution networks, transmission systems, and cloud-enabled production workflows. Experience supporting REMI, centralized production, master control operations, contribution networks, and broadcast distribution. Familiarity with SMPTE ST 2110, NMOS, SRT, NDI, JPEG XS, multicast networking, and other modern broadcast technologies preferred. Strong troubleshooting, analytical, incident management, and root cause analysis skills. Demonstrated leadership, coaching, mentoring, and team development capabilities. Excellent communication, collaboration, executive presence, and stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence across multiple functional groups. Strong organizational and project management skills with the ability to manage multiple concurrent productions and competing priorities. Proven ability to lead operational change, implement process improvements, establish governance, and drive continuous improvement initiatives. Ability to make sound technical and operational decisions in high-pressure, fast-paced live production environments. Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite and technical documentation platforms. Working Conditions This position is based in NBA Secaucus and requires regular in-office attendance five (5) days per week. Must be available to work evenings, weekends, holidays, and extended hours based on the NBA game schedule and other live production requirements. Must participate in on-call support rotations and respond to critical production technology issues outside of normal business hours as necessary. Requires occasional domestic travel to NBA arenas and other League event locations to support game productions, technical deployments, testing, and special events. Ability to work in fast-paced live broadcast environments where priorities may shift rapidly to support live productions. job.title: Account Executive (Local Ad Sales), The California Post
job.description: Job Description : California Post is a brand-new digital-first news organization backed by the trusted legacy of the New York Post. Our mission is to deliver breaking news, compelling storytelling, and innovative content to readers across the West Coast. This is an exciting opportunity to join a fast-growing team, shape the future of a newsroom, and help advertisers connect with a highly engaged audience. We are looking for a hungry, results-driven local Ad Sales Account Executive to join our Los Angeles team. This individual contributor role will be responsible for driving new business, managing client relationships, and delivering revenue growth for California Post , with a strong focus on local and regional advertisers. The ideal candidate has a proven track record in media sales, deep local market knowledge, and understands how to prospect, negotiate, and close deals in a competitive marketplace. Responsibilities: Develop and execute a sales strategy to drive revenue growth across digital advertising, sponsorships, and brand partnerships, with an emphasis on local and regional accounts. Identify, prospect, and secure new clients across key local verticals, including Tier 2 automotive, casinos and gaming, real estate, hospitals and healthcare systems, legal services, and other local service-based businesses. Build and maintain strong relationships with local advertisers, agencies, and key regional stakeholders. Collaborate with internal teams, including marketing and editorial, to craft integrated, custom advertising solutions tailored to local market needs. Manage the full sales cycle, including prospecting, RFP responses, contract negotiations, and post-sale account management. Maintain accurate sales forecasts, pipelines, and CRM data. Stay up to date on industry trends, competitors, and emerging opportunities to effectively advise clients and position California Post as a trusted local media partner. Requirements: Minimum of 5 years of advertising sales experience, preferably within media or digital news organizations. Demonstrated success selling to local or regional advertisers, ideally across verticals such as automotive, gaming, real estate, healthcare, or professional services. Proven ability to prospect, close deals, and consistently exceed revenue targets. Strong network of media and advertising contacts in the Los Angeles market. Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills. Self-motivated, goal-oriented, and comfortable working in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment. Ability to manage multiple clients and projects simultaneously with strong attention to detail. Ability and willingness to travel as needed. Note: This role is primarily based in our Los Angeles office. Occasional remote work may be permitted, with the expectation of on-site presence for core team collaboration and client-facing activities, excluding external sales meetings or required travel. Compensation : $100,000 - $125,000 Base + commission/sales bonus plan. job.title: Associate Commerce Editor
job.description: Job Description : About The Post: The New York Post delivers the best in news, sports, entertainment, pop culture and shopping, with wit, irreverence and authority across print, digital, video, audio, app and commerce. The Role: We’re hiring an Associate Commerce Editor for the revenue-generating commerce team. This is not a business reporting role. In this dynamic, expanded position, you will balance daily writing with foundational editing responsibilities, serving as a critical bridge between our reporting and editing desks. You will be responsible for writing a minimum of two short-form deal stories per day, continuing to publish fast, useful shopping stories that drive revenue and taking ownership of editing daily deals, updating evergreen posts and stepping up to manage larger packages when needed. This role is ideal for a prolific commerce reporter ready to hone their editorial judgment, refine their packaging skills and take on emerging leadership responsibilities across the New York Post Digital Network. What You’ll Do: ● Write a baseline of 2–3 commerce stories per shift (deals, explainers, how-tos and buyer’s guides) that drive conversions, ensuring consistent daily revenue-generating output. ● Edit 15+ fast-turn deals and standard shopping content daily from reporters. Move copy from draft to live with speed, ensuring clean formatting, airtight affiliate linking and FTC compliance. ● Take point on executing sponsored content and flat-fee product placements, seamlessly weaving revenue-driven partnerships into daily coverage while maintaining reader trust and the iconic Post voice. ● Step in to report, write or co-edit larger, high-priority features and tentpole packages (Prime Day, Black Friday, Cyber Week) as assigned by leadership. ● Share ownership of the evergreen strategy. Audit and update top-performing posts for price, stock and SEO/AEO/GEO optimization to maximize long-tail revenue. ● Write sharp, on-brand headlines (providing 3-5 variants for testing). Begin providing actionable, constructive feedback to reporters to maintain voice and standards. ● Monitor performance dashboards to iterate headlines, framing and placement. Pitch high-intent stories based on search data, real-time signals and competitor coverage. How We Measure Success: ● Output Balance: Consistent daily writing output (2–3 stories) combined with reliable, rapid editing of assigned copy and on-time handoffs. ● Quality & Accuracy: Clean copy (both written and edited), rigorous fact-checking, zero avoidable corrections and strict link hygiene. ● Impact: Measurable lift in CTR, conversion rates, revenue per session and search visibility for both authored and edited pieces. ● Ownership: Demonstrated progress in editorial decision-making, proactive pitching and the ability to seamlessly pivot between writing and editing mindsets. Nice to Have ● Hands-on familiarity with affiliate dashboards and networks (Amazon Associates, Skimlinks or similar), project management platforms and SEO tools. ● Experience jumping between categories and services that help shoppers protect value. ● Deeper understanding of AEO, GEO and AI overviews. ● Newsletter experience. Note: The New York Post adheres to an on-site work model. This role will be expected to report into the office 5 days per week. job.description: Job Description : The New York Post is the nation’s oldest newspaper with the youngest, most ambitious video department. We want to make our mark in digital video and create memorable work and new watching habits among our audience. The legacy of the great headlines conveys the attributes of our videos: bold, irreverent, judgmental, confident and clever. We want to make videos that surprise viewers. These clips will help drive in tune-in and be content worth watching. The candidate we seek has deep knowledge of and interest in a wide range of sports, including NFL, MLB, NBA/WNBA, College Sports, NHL, emerging sports, gambling, fantasy, and current New York/California sports news. job.description: Job Description : The California Post is seeking an Audience Development Specialist to help execute our audience optimization strategy as we expand to California. The Post’s Editorial Page is where bold ideas meet razor-sharp commentary.
