job.title: Lifestyle Trending News Editor
job.description: Job Description : The New York Post delivers news, sports, pop culture and entertainment with unmatched speed, attitude and authority, reaching more than 90 million unique viewers each month. With a 225 year legacy and a fast moving digital first newsroom, the Post operates across print, digital, video, audio, app, television and commerce, and continues to define the city’s most talked about stories. We are seeking an experienced and audience driven Lifestyle Trending News Editor (Tuesday-Saturday) to direct our daily lifestyle news content — working across verticals including sex & relationships, fashion, real estate, parenting, travel, food & drink, science & technology and general interest. The successful candidate will be audience and SEO obsessed, have an innate ability to identify the topics everyone wants to read and talk about, and have proven experience in using data and insights platforms to maximize traffic. They will have proven skills at crafting audience and editorial strategy, be obsessed with setting the lifestyle news agenda, driving traffic across multiple sources, and know how to write a sparkling headline that everyone wants to click on. The candidate will also be able to produce and edit content in The Post’s uniquely irreverent tone of voice, at high speed. The role requires a confident editorial leader, who will manage writers across multiple verticals including consumer lifestyle, science, tech, and viral trends. It reports to the Lifestyle Editor. Note: the shift for this role is Tuesday-Saturday. Responsibilities: ● Generating an endless font of innovative and agenda-setting daily trending and exclusive ideas. ● Assigning and editing trending daily stories, at high speed. ● Creating a short and long term strategy for the lifestyle news department, leveraging audience insights platforms, to meet the department’s goals. ● Overseeing the production of a number of daily stories — from writing headlines in the Post’s signature wit to ensuring SEO best practices to coordinating photo shoots and imagery. ● Constantly analyzing web traffic and referral metrics to drive audience engagement and traffic. ● Monitoring the news to look for opportunities to add depth to our headlines through original reporting, first-person perspectives and expert explainers. ● Managing the lifestyle news reporters and editors on the team. ● Coordinating closely with other departments such as photo, video, and audience development. Requirements: ● At least 5 years of editing experience in a news or fast moving magazine environment, preferably in a lifestyle or culture department. ● Excellent news judgement and the sharpest editing and writing prowess. ● Your finger on the pulse of the topics and trends of interest to the Post audience. ● Proven understanding of what makes a story successful across digital platforms - from headlines to visuals and optimization. ● Proficiency in WordPress or similar CMS. ● Strong organizational and time management skills with the ability to manage multiple stories, writers, and deadlines simultaneously. ● Comfortable making fast, decisive editorial calls in a breaking news environment. ● Proven team leader who is skilled at managing and developing writers and can work across departments including visuals, social, and audience development. ● Expertise with analytics tools and performance metrics to help guide coverage and strategy. ● A deep understanding of referral traffic, particularly, social, search and Discover. ● Proven experience in driving and retaining audiences, with deeper, engagement-focused content. job.title: Page Six Video Lead Editor
job.description: Job Description : The New York Post provides readers with the best in News, Sports, Pop Culture, Fashion and Entertainment – with signature wit, irreverence and authority averaging 90 million unique viewers a month. Over the past 224 years, The Post has evolved into a multi-platform media company spanning print, digital, video, audio, app, television and commerce. The Page Six video team is seeking a Lead Video Editor who will help us make existing series and compelling, shareable videos about celebrities, and fashion - subjects that are the mainstay of the nation’s most iconic gossip column. You should love celebrity journalism and possess deep knowledge about the latest celebrity gossip, trends, feuds, and hookups. You should live and breathe celebrity lifestyle, fashion and social media, with your fingers on the pulse. You’ll work in an extremely fast-paced environment enabling producers to hit production targets and goals. You’ll be the lead editor for the most important Page Six video series, both the audience favorites and the branded content as well. You’ll help create sizzles and other marketing assets as needed. You’ll supervise the rest of the editors, giving them creative notes, video editing workflow best practices, troubleshooting problems and overall quality control. You’ll coordinate media backups with our production management team. And work with our team and creative director to have graphic guidelines as well as create custom graphics and thumbnails to help click through rates. You must edit fast and with a flourish. Expertise with key products in Adobe Creative Suite (Premiere, Photoshop, After Effects) as well as Adobe graphic templates. You’ll edit videos for digital platforms using a mix of original footage, stock footage and social media content. Along with editing digitally-native video, you will help generate our content, pitching video ideas daily and contributing to the team brainstorming. We seek a candidate who is excited about new types of multimedia storytelling and has a track record of creating digital video in a fast-paced news organization. Must be aware of the latest formats and trends in digital video as a distinct form of content versus television. This is a fast-paced job that requires a love of all things celebrity, a strong editorial sense and the ability to stay organized while multitasking. Like us, you believe news doesn’t have to be boring and you appreciate the odd and unconventional stories as well as important ones. This is an opportunity to work with an iconic media brand as it experiences exponential digital growth. New York Post and Page Six videos have received more than a billion views in the past few years. Responsibilities: ● Lead the editing and post-production of high-priority Page Six video series, branded content, and celebrity-focused digital features optimized for social and web platforms. ● Supervise and mentor video editors by providing creative direction, workflow guidance, troubleshooting support, and overall quality control in a fast-paced newsroom environment. ● Edit compelling, digitally native videos using original footage, stock assets, and social media content while maintaining Page Six’s signature voice, tone, and style. ● Collaborate with producers, creative leadership, and production management to develop graphics packages, thumbnails, sizzle reels, and promotional assets that drive audience engagement and click-through rates. ● Pitch timely celebrity, fashion, and entertainment video concepts daily, contributing innovative storytelling ideas aligned with trending topics and audience interests. ● Manage multiple projects simultaneously under tight deadlines, ensuring efficient turnaround, media organization, backups, and adherence to production schedules. ● Apply advanced post-production techniques including color correction, audio mixing, multi-cam editing, and vertical video formatting using Adobe Creative Suite tools such as Premiere Pro, After Effects, and Photoshop. The ideal candidate will have: ● 5-10 years experience editing celebrity videos for digital outlets ● Expertise with Adobe Creative Suite, specifically Premiere ● Knowledge of studio and control room operations ● Ability to color correct and mix audio. ● Ability to create vertical videos for various social platforms ● Be able to work very quickly under pressure ● Pitch video ideas daily and contribute to team brainstorming. ● Experience with multicam editing ● Motion graphics experience a plus as is simple animation, but not necessary ● Ability to select and use music to match the tone and style of the story ● Must be organized, work well in a fast-paced environment and be a team-player. ● Can-do attitude is key: someone who believes news doesn’t have to be boring and who appreciates the odd and unconventional stories as well as important ones. ● Open to working evenings and weekends, on rare cases if required ● Experience working autonomously in a fast-paced newsroom environment on weekly deadlines Note: This role is expected to be on-site in the New York metro area five days per week. job.title: Senior Reporter (Courts & Crime), California Post
job.description: Job Description : As part of our bold expansion, we are seeking a driven Senior Reporter (Courts & Crime Focus) to join the California Post team. Reporting to the Deputy News Editor, this reporter will react quickly to major breaking news across the San Francisco Bay Area while bringing a strong background in courts, crime, and public safety. This role requires flexibility, sharp instincts, and a high-velocity reporting style—whether you’re covering a high-profile trial, responding to an emergency scene, or breaking down a rapidly developing regional story. You will be on the front lines of one of the nation’s most dynamic news environments, turning fast-moving events into clear, authoritative reporting. Responsibilities: Cover real-time breaking events across the San Francisco Bay Area with speed, accuracy, and urgency for the California Post . Lead coverage on major criminal and civil court cases, law enforcement agency accountability, and high-impact crime trends shaping the region. Pivot seamlessly between spot news, trending digital stories, public safety incidents, and broader regional enterprise assignments as news breaks. Spot local stories with viral potential or national resonance and deliver exclusive angles before the competition. Cultivate strong relationships across law enforcement, city agencies, legal communities, emergency services, and local neighborhoods. File rapid updates across web, mobile, social media, and video platforms, continuously updating developing stories in real time. Actively monitor court filings, police blotters, public records, and social media feeds to spot scoops and emerging trends. Travel regularly to courthouses across the Bay Area to cover hearings, arraignments, trials, and major verdict announcements in person. Requirements: 5+ years of experience reporting for a fast-paced digital or print newsroom, with a strong background in general assignment, breaking news, or public safety beats. Superior news judgment with a proven ability to write fast, clean, and compelling copy on tight deadlines while managing multiple assignments. Strong familiarity with legal documents, court filings, and police operations, with the ability to translate complex legal jargon into clear, accessible prose. A relentless approach to newsgathering and a track record of building trusted sources across public safety and municipal agencies. Proficiency with CMS platforms (e.g., WordPress), SEO best practices, and social media distribution tools. Strong preference for candidates comfortable discussing their stories on camera or presenting short-form video updates for digital platforms. A desire to be first and best on major breaking stories while maintaining the highest standards of journalistic integrity and accuracy. Preferred Qualifications: Spanish or secondary language fluency. An established social media presence or professional digital following. Note: This role is expected to be based remotely in the San Francisco Bay Area. All work arrangements are subject to change based on business needs. job.description: Job Description : Page Six provides readers with the best in Pop Culture and Entertainment – with signature wit, irreverence and authority averaging 25 million unique viewers a month. You’ll work in an extremely fast-paced environment enabling producers to hit production targets and goals. You will assist on dozens of videos throughout the day, taking lead from the producers and studio technical director. Responsibilities: Edit high quality, engaging short form videos focused on celebrity news, reality television, entertainment, and pop culture for digital and social media platforms. Transform original footage, stock footage, archival assets, and social media content into compelling, shareable video content. Collaborate closely with producers and the Studio Technical Director to execute a high volume of daily video productions while consistently meeting tight deadlines. Maintain exceptional speed and accuracy in video editing without compromising creativity or editorial quality. Create visually dynamic content using Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, Photoshop, and Adobe Motion Graphics templates. Generate and pitch fresh video concepts daily that align with trending celebrity news, reality TV, and audience interests. Participate in editorial meetings and brainstorming sessions to develop innovative multimedia storytelling ideas. Monitor celebrity news, entertainment, reality television, fashion, social media, and digital trends to identify timely content opportunities. Ensure all content aligns with Page Six's editorial voice, brand standards, and quality expectations. Stay current on emerging digital video formats, platform best practices, and audience engagement trends to continuously improve content performance. Manage multiple editing projects simultaneously while remaining highly organized in a fast paced newsroom environment. Collaborate with cross functional editorial and production teams to deliver timely, accurate, and engaging video content. Contribute to production goals by supporting the efficient execution of daily publishing schedules across digital platforms. Exercise strong editorial judgment when selecting footage, pacing stories, and crafting narratives that resonate with digital audiences. Help evolve existing video franchises while identifying opportunities to develop new recurring series and formats. Requirements: Proven experience editing high volume, digital first video content in a fast paced newsroom, entertainment, or media environment. Advanced proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite, particularly Premiere Pro. Experience with After Effects and Photoshop strongly preferred. Experience editing with a combination of original footage, stock footage, archival assets, and social media content. Ability to create engaging horizontal and vertical videos optimized for Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Facebook, X, and other digital platforms. Strong understanding of platform specific video formats, audience behaviors, and emerging digital video trends. Deep knowledge of celebrity news, reality television, pop culture, entertainment, and social media, with the ability to identify timely content opportunities. Ability to edit quickly and efficiently while maintaining exceptional editorial judgment, creativity, and attention to detail under tight deadlines. Experience with multicamera editing, color correction, audio mixing, and pacing content for maximum audience engagement. Motion graphics, basic animation, and experience using Adobe Motion Graphics templates are a plus. Strong instinct for selecting music and sound design that enhances storytelling and complements the tone of each video. Ability to generate, pitch, and develop fresh video concepts daily while contributing meaningfully to editorial brainstorming sessions. Excellent communication skills with the ability to collaborate closely with Executive Producers, Producers, Studio Technical Directors, social teams, and cross functional newsroom partners. job.description: Excited to grow your career? Shoots video for Sports and News coverage Confers with other personnel to discuss assignments, logistics and shot requirements Sets up, composes, and executes broadcast quality video Maintains all assigned equipment Edits video for television broadcasts, streaming platform and web and social content Operates live microwave and satellite trucks Partners with reporters to develop creative, visually appealing & impactful stories Works efficiently and effectively under extremely tight deadlines Good judgment skills are a must. job.description: NewsNation is a national news cable network currently reaching 75 million television households across the United States. The network is owned and operated by Nexstar Media Group (NXST). NewsNation is currently seeking a creative, experienced and proactive part-time Stagehand to join our team at its studios in Chicago. Call up cues to be used during daily shows, as well as any special projects, including the installation and focusing such lighting to attain the desired effect. Move, install, place, handle and maintain all sets, scenery and props. Function as scenic carpenters. Specialists may also perform rigging functions. job.title: Studio Technician
job.description: The Studio Technician is an essential member of our production team, helping bring live newscasts and special productions to air each day. This hands-on role supports all aspects of studio operations, from operating production equipment and preparing the set to assisting guests and talent. Team members are expected to become proficient in multiple areas of production, including studio camera operation, floor directing, audio operation, lighting sets, guest coordination, and special segment/event setup. The ideal candidate is dependable, detail-oriented, comfortable in a fast-paced environment, and enjoys being part of a collaborative team that delivers high-quality television every day. Essential Duties & Responsibilities Operate studio production equipment during live newscasts and other productions, including cameras, audio systems, lighting, microphones, and related broadcast technology. Collaborate with directors, producers, on-air talent, and fellow crew members to ensure seamless execution of live and recorded productions. Monitor changing production needs and respond quickly and effectively in a fast-paced, live television environment. Set up and break down studio elements for daily broadcasts and special segments, including microphones, band equipment, special lighting, furniture, props, and other production materials. Welcome and assist guests appearing on-air by providing basic instructions, fitting microphones, and helping create a positive studio experience. Participate in ongoing cross-training and demonstrate the ability to work in multiple production roles, including camera operation, audio support, studio setup, guest assistance, and special event production. Maintain a clean, organized, and production-ready studio and workspace. What We're Looking For Someone Who... is dependable, punctual, and committed to being a positive and adaptable member of our team. can maintain a strong attention to detail and the ability to work effectively while staying calm and focused in a fast-paced environment. will bring a positive attitude, adaptability, and willingness to learn and teach others. has an eagerness to cross-train and develop proficiency in multiple production roles. will be available to work a flexible schedule, including occasional evenings, weekends, holidays, and extended hours as needed. EEO Statement: Equal Opportunity Employer Minorities/Women/Veterans/Disabled

job.title: Technical Director I
job.description: The Technical Director is responsible for the technical execution and visual presentation of newscasts and special productions. This role collaborates with producers, operations staff, and newsroom personnel to ensure accurate, engaging, and seamless broadcasts while maintaining high production standards. Job Duties Direct live and recorded newscasts and special programs using automated production control systems. Coordinate closely with producers to execute editorial and creative vision to deliver clean, high-energy newscasts. Monitor automated production elements including cameras, graphics, audio, video servers, and switcher functions. Troubleshoot technical issues during live broadcasts. Collaborate with meteorologists, anchors, reporters, and technical staff to ensure smooth execution of broadcasts. Maintain broadcast quality standards and compliance with FCC regulations and company policies. Performs other duties as assigned. Requirements and Skills Fluency in English. Ability to make quick decisions in a fast-paced live news environment and remain focused under significant deadline pressure. Ability to communicate and document effectively and concisely to the rest of the team. Flexibility to work any shift across our schedule, including early mornings, evenings, weekends, holidays, and breaking news situations. Ability to work independently and in a collaborative environment. Understanding of video production, switchers, graphics systems, audio boards, and newsroom computer systems is a plus.

job.title: Temporary Part-time Studio Technician
job.description: The Studio Technician operates various equipment (camera, audio, visual, graphics, lighting, or digital) used for production and/or transmission. Collaborate with the director and studio staff to coordinate the action in the studio or while out on location Use signal acquisition technologies, Electronic News Gathering (ENG), TVU, satellite receivers, PC (Zoom) to obtain signals to be used for news broadcasts. Operate studio prompting equipment and cue talent. Assist and prepare guests for on-air news segments. Use software such as Adobe Premier to edit and record promos, weather elements for broadcast. Provide camera, and audio/lighting production support as needed. Move, adjust studio set pieces and furniture. Maintains and stores equipment and studio maintenance. Salary Range - $19.00 - $20.00 hourly Requirements & Skills : High School Diploma Required Experience in television, film or post production preferred Must be able to interact well with video journalists, anchors, videographers, news managers, production and engineering staff Detail oriented Excellent communication and organization skills Basic computer knowledge including Photoshop Ability to handle high stress environment with deadline pressures

job.title: Unpaid Intern
job.description: It's fun to work in a company where people truly believe in what they are doing! WWLP is the news leader on air and online, is proud to offer internship opportunities to current college students. Internships are offered in Community Affairs, Lifestyle, News, Production and Marketing. WWLP is committed to developing interest in the broadcasting industry and cultivating talent. An internship at WWLP will provide an opportunity to get hands on experience in learning more about broadcasting, gaining practical work experience and meeting academic goals. Interns will experience and engage in production department broadcasts, projects, events and station initiatives. job.title: Weekend Anchor/Multimedia Journalist
job.description: WCIA 3 is looking for a full-time Weekend Anchor / Multimedia Journalist to work for the top station in this market. Our new weekend anchor will produce and anchor weekend newscasts; CTV to Linear on Saturdays, Sunday news, and will report three days a week. This position will also be first in line to fill-in anchor our other primary newscasts. We`re seeking a candidate who is passionate about storytelling, able to connect with viewers, and craft memorable moments that bring stories and newscasts to life. The candidate should have strong anchor skills, producing experience, leadership qualities, proven enterprising skills, solid news judgment, and the ability to multi-task. This position REQUIRES working weekends. Essential Duties: Produce content for multiple platforms, including TV, internet, mobile, etc. Work with management to enterprise and develop stories daily Demonstrate compelling storytelling using dynamic live shots and stand-ups, creative graphics, and use of digital and social media platforms Organize material, determine angle or emphasis, and write story according to prescribed editorial style and format standards Gather and verify information regarding stories through interview, observation and research. Build network of sources who supply information that allows the Company to stay ahead of its competitors Performs special projects and other duties as assigned Requirements & Skills : Bachelor’s degree in Communication/Journalism or related degree required (equivalent years of experience may substitute for education Two (2) years television anchoring or reporting experience required Solid vocal delivery, camera presence, and clear enunciation Strong reporting skills Understand importance of social media Excellent reading, writing, spelling, grammar and organizational skills Promotes teamwork and maintains attitude of cooperation with all station personnel Operate newsroom computer systems NON-UNION FULL-TIME HOURLY Compensation: $18 to $19 per hour - commensurate with applicant's experience and skill level​ Benefits: Our comprehensive benefits package includes, but not limited to, medical (with multiple plan options), dental, and vision insurance, paid time off, a 401(k) with company matching contributions, Paid Parental leave, life insurance and more. #LI-onsite #WCIA3

This role will support the NFL’s departmental leads (three Senior Vice Presidents) with a focus on daily administrative and core operational support across these core functions of the League, in order to drive efficiency and optimize the productivity of these teams and leaders.

General Administrative Support:

  • Coordinate and schedule meetings and conference calls
  • Manager calendars across different time zones
  • Create and distribute agendas
  • Answer and route telephone calls and incoming mail

  • Prepare meeting materials and presentations

  • Processing staffing and credential needs for events and meetings

job.title: Associate, Hotels & Meetings (External Agency Staff)
job.description:
The NFL Live Events team is responsible for the planning and execution of the league’s tentpole events and International Games. The Associate position plays an integral role in supporting the Events team with the execution of all tentpole events and executive meetings with a focus on hotel management, meeting planning and execution.

Responsibilities:

  • Manage the execution of 100+ hotel contracts for future Super Bowl and Draft bids and assist with onboarding process through our supplier portal.
  • Assist with the RFP process and hotel sourcing strategy for NFL International Games, which includes identifying and securing staff, vendor, and headquarters hotel accommodations while managing contract negotiations, and working with Finance on budget considerations.
  • Support the Super Bowl hotel assignment process by working closely with departments and partners assigning 20,000 rooms.
  • Manage hotel reservations for 800+ attendees at all tentpole events which include Super Bowl, Pro Bowl, Combine, Draft, Flag Championships, Hall of Fame, Kickoff, International games and meetings.
  • Execute Super Bowl headquarter hotel operations that include contract management, hotel reservations, meeting space logistics, food & beverage, signage, and vendor coordination.
  • Coordinate planning meetings across all tentpole events for current year and future. This entails sourcing hotels through our RFP platform and tracking proposals.
  • Lead effort for on-site event management for Owners Meetings and department meetings including room block management, client check-in, credential distribution, and registration.
  • Attend all planning meetings, as needed for current and future tentpole events and outline goals and objectives for each trip.
  • Work cross functionally with various internal departments on meetings throughout the year.
  • Reconcile budgets and invoices with finance team on for all tentpole events and meetings.
  • Support the team in various capacities including contract management, updating the special events calendar and tracking budgets.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree
  • Minimum 2 years of hotel with a focus on room management and function room operations
  • Adept at contract negotiations and proven experience working with hotel contracts
  • Hotel and venue management with a focus on room block build/management, attrition mitigation, function room costing and management
  • Ability to manage multiple projects in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment
  • Ability to lead others and collaborate with a variety of groups at different levels
  • Strong organizational and presentation skills
  • Strong writing and communications skills
  • Proactive self-starter who works well within a team, strong interpersonal skills

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with hotel contracts, negotiating, and meeting planning
  • Experience with Meeting Evolution, Cvent or other event registration sites
  • Strong Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint skills
  • C level/VIP management and service
  • Knowledge in RFP creation and process

Other Key Attributes / Talent Characteristics:

  • Team player with positive attitude
  • High energy
  • Entrepreneurial spirit
  • Strong work ethic

Physical Demands:

This is a Special Events hotel and VIP management role, at times may require physicality. This could involve lifting, long hours of standing and physical movement during an event and extensive travel requirements.

Travel:

Significant domestic and international travel required, including some weekends, up to 50%. Several weeks on the road during event delivery.

job.title: Associate, HR Operations (External Agency Staff)
job.description:
Overview:

We are looking for a proactive and detail-oriented HR Operations Coordinator to join our Shared Services team. This role is helping to enhance the NFL employee experience and scale our HR capabilities. You will have an immediate impact on the overall NFL employee experience as the first point of contact for many employees, ensuring timely and accurate support throughout the employee lifecycle. You will manage HR tickets, process transactions in Oracle HCM. In this highly collaborative role, you will maintain strong working relationships with cross-functional teams, including HR, Payroll, Finance, Compliance, Security, and IT.

Responsibilities:

  • Case Management:
    Manage and resolve tier-1 HR inquiries through ServiceNow, ensuring timely, accurate, and professional responses all questions and issues regarding HR related policies, procedures, and systems, including but not limited to Onboarding, Benefits, Compensation, Learning, Performance, and Offboarding.
  • Process HR transactions including new hires, rehires, transfers, leaves of absence, terminations, personal data changes, and other complicated system transactions
  • Support the talent acquisition processes by posting job requisitions, managing the candidate experience, extending offers, and facilitating onboarding activities.
  • HR Systems Support:
    Enter and maintain employee data in Oracle HCM Cloud, ServiceNow, and UGK, supporting lifecycle transactions and identifying opportunities to streamline or automate recurring processes.
  • Maintain positive working relationships with cross-functional teams as necessary, including Payroll, Finance, Compliance, Security, and IT.

Required Qualifications:

  • Experience:
    2–4+ years in HR Operations, Shared Services, HRIS, or an HR support role. Experience with ServiceNow (or similar ticketing system), Oracle HCM Cloud and UGK preferred.
  • Soft Skills:
    • Positive attitude and strong work ethic.
    • Customer-first mindset with a pleasant, team-oriented demeanor.
    • Eagerness to learn and grow in both HR operations and analytics.
    • Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.
    • Clear and concise communication skills to collaborate across functions.

Other Key Attributes / Talent Characteristics:

You are driven to improve processes, deliver excellent employee support, and ensure data accuracy. You thrive in collaborative, cross-functional environments and are excited to shape the future of HR Shared Services.

Why Join Us?

You'll be part of a growing HR Operations team that's focused on efficiency, innovation, and elevating the employee experience. This is a great opportunity for someone early in their HR career who wants to grow in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

job.title: Associate, Super Bowl Suite Sales & Service
job.description:
The NFL Club Business Development department is responsible for the full management of Super Bowl Suites each year. This role will support that process across all phases, including, but not limited to: inventory management, sales, service, administration, and service.

Responsibilities

  • Develop new and support the management of existing Super Bowl Suites pipeline
  • Manage the upkeep of master sales tracking data file
  • Provide consultative ideas to team leadership on pricing and inventory strategy
  • Identify and share best practices with leadership from around the industry
  • Manage and collaborate with Super Bowl Suites sales agents to support their sales efforts
  • Support administrative process across contracting, invoicing, and ticketing fulfillment
  • Support the team across all phases of the Super Bowl Suites process with a “no task to small” attitude

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree
  • 5+ years of experience in Sports Business Development
  • Existing relationships and book of business to support new pipeline development

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics

  • Excellent communication, project management, and interpersonal skills
  • Self-starter who can think critically and individually find solutions
  • Expertise in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint
  • Problem solving and issue resolution skills, strong ability to “keep the ball moving forward”
  • Ability to navigate successfully a matrixed, cross-organizational landscape, fostering strong relationships along the way
  • Unwavering commitment to honest and ethical business interactions
  • Ability to handle multiple tasks, good time management and organizational skills

job.title: Director, Broadcast Engineering
job.description:
The Director, Broadcast Engineering is responsible for leading the strategy, operation, modernization, and reliability of mission-critical broadcast engineering systems that support live production, studio operations, transmission, post-production, digital media, and multi-platform content delivery. This role manages a team of engineers, technicians, specialists, and vendor partners while bridging traditional broadcast workflows with IP-based, virtualized, and cloud-enabled media infrastructure. The Director will provide technical leadership, staff development, operational discipline, and long-range planning to ensure high-quality, resilient, and scalable production services.

Responsibilities

Staff Leadership and Management

  • Lead, manage, mentor, and develop a multidisciplinary broadcast engineering team responsible for live production, technical operations, maintenance, system support, and engineering projects.
  • Define team priorities, assign resources, manage schedules, establish performance objectives, and conduct regular performance reviews.
  • Build a culture of accountability, collaboration, operational readiness, documentation, continuous improvement, and inclusive leadership.
  • Develop career paths, training plans, succession plans, and cross-training programs to strengthen technical depth and leadership bench strength.
  • Partner with production, operations, IT, transmission, digital media, security, procurement, finance, and executive stakeholders to align staffing and engineering priorities with business objectives.

Broadcast Infrastructure and Operations

  • Oversee the design, deployment, maintenance, and lifecycle management of studios, control rooms, routing, intercom, audio, video, replay, graphics, monitoring, transmission, post-production, and media asset systems.
  • Ensure reliable operation of live broadcast environments through preventive maintenance, system monitoring, incident response, disaster recovery planning, and root-cause analysis.
  • Establish engineering standards, documentation practices, escalation procedures, commissioning processes, and operational readiness checklists.
  • Maintain compliance with applicable broadcast, safety, security, accessibility, and regulatory requirements.

IP, Cloud, and Emerging Technology Strategy

  • Lead the transition from traditional SDI and hardware-centric workflows toward IP-based, software-defined, virtualized, and cloud-connected media infrastructure.
  • Evaluate and implement technologies such as SMPTE ST 2110, PTP timing, NMOS discovery and control, AES67, Dante, JPEG XS, SRT, NDI, bonded contribution, REMI production, virtualization, containerization, cloud playout, cloud production, remote monitoring, and observability platforms.
  • Develop hybrid architectures that connect on-premises broadcast facilities with digital media platforms, OTT distribution, FAST channels, content supply chains, and cloud-based production workflows.
  • Partner with IT, cybersecurity, network engineering, and cloud architecture teams to ensure media systems meet requirements for latency, timing, resiliency, security, scalability, and operational support.
  • Create roadmaps that balance current broadcast reliability requirements with future-facing digital media, automation, AI-assisted workflows, metadata, and cloud-native capabilities.

Project, Budget, and Vendor Management

  • Lead capital and operational engineering projects from concept through design, procurement, implementation, testing, training, handoff, and ongoing support.
  • Develop budgets, forecasts, business cases, technical requirements, scopes of work, risk assessments, and implementation schedules.
  • Manage vendor relationships, integrators, managed service providers, service contracts, support agreements, and equipment lifecycle planning.

Operational Support and Incident Management

  • Provide senior technical leadership during live events, critical outages, major launches, and high-priority production support scenarios.
  • Lead troubleshooting efforts across broadcast, IP network, storage, compute, cloud, audio, video, and application layers.
  • Develop incident reports, postmortems, lessons learned, corrective actions, and preventative controls.
  • Ensure teams are prepared for 24/7 operations, live-event support, escalation coverage, and business continuity requirements.

Communication and Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Translate complex technical concepts into clear recommendations for executive, operational, production, and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Facilitate collaboration between engineering, production, digital media, IT, security, facilities, vendors, and business leadership.
  • Represent broadcast engineering in strategic planning, technology evaluation, roadmap development, standards alignment, and operational governance.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, broadcast engineering, computer science, information technology, media technology, or a related discipline; equivalent professional experience may be considered.
  • 10+ years of progressive experience in broadcast engineering, media systems engineering, technical operations, or live production technology, including leadership of complex broadcast facilities or production environments.
  • 5+ years of people-management experience leading engineers, technicians, managers, project teams, vendors, or managed service providers.
  • Demonstrated experience managing live production environments where reliability, speed, operational discipline, and incident response are critical.
  • Strong knowledge of broadcast signal flow, studio systems, production control rooms, intercom, audio, video, routing, replay, graphics, transmission, post-production, monitoring, and media asset workflows.
  • Working knowledge of IP media standards and systems, including SMPTE ST 2110, SMPTE 2022-6/7, PTP/IEEE 1588, NMOS IS-04/IS-05, AES67, Dante, multicast networking, QoS, and media-over-IP troubleshooting.
  • Experience with cloud, virtualization, digital media, or software-defined infrastructure, including hybrid workflows that connect broadcast operations with cloud production, streaming, OTT, FAST, remote production, or digital distribution platforms.
  • Familiarity with compute, storage, networking, cybersecurity, automation, orchestration, APIs, monitoring, observability, and DevOps-style support practices as they apply to media systems.
  • Proven ability to lead technical strategy, capital projects, budgets, vendor negotiations, RFPs, scopes of work, implementation plans, and lifecycle management.
  • Excellent communication, documentation, stakeholder management, and executive presentation skills.
  • Ability to work flexible hours as needed to support live events, urgent technical issues, launches, maintenance windows, and business-critical operations.

Qualifications

  • Experience with ST 2110 facility design, IP fabric architecture, timing design, boundary clocks, grandmaster redundancy, multicast routing, and vendor interoperability testing.
  • Experience with media supply chain platforms, MAM/DAM systems, storage orchestration, transcoding, cloud-based playout, streaming workflows, and metadata-driven content operations.
  • Experience leading engineering teams through organizational change, facility transformation, SDI-to-IP migration, cloud adoption, or major technology refresh initiatives.
  • Knowledge of AI-assisted media workflows, automation, quality control, captioning, accessibility, rights-aware distribution, and digital content monetization platforms.

Salary / Pay Range

The NFL expects to hire for this position near the middle of the range. Only in truly rare and exceptional circumstances, where an external candidate has experience, credentials or expertise that far exceed those required or expected for the position, would the NFL consider paying a salary or rate near the higher end of the range.

job.title: Director, Communications - Flag Football
job.description:
The NFL is seeking a Director, Communications – Flag Football to lead strategic communications for one of the fastest growing areas of the sport. This role will help grow awareness, credibility, and participation in flag football in the U.S. and internationally, while supporting the NFL’s leadership through NFL FLAG and the broader flag football ecosystem.

The Director will shape the narrative for flag football by elevating stories around access, inclusion, athlete pathways, youth and scholastic participation, community impact, and elite competition. This leader will develop integrated media, content, executive visibility, and thought-leadership strategies tied to major growth moments, including NFL tentpole events, flag-specific events, international activations, and the LA28 Olympic Games.

Responsibilities:

  • Develop and execute a multi-year communications strategy that advances flag football growth across youth, scholastic, community, elite, and international levels.
  • Lead storytelling, media relations, executive visibility, and issues preparedness tied to LA28, Brisbane 2032, and long-term Olympic inclusion.
  • Create communications and advocacy materials that support NFHS and state association sanctioning efforts, including stakeholder messaging, announcement plans, and media materials.
  • Drive proactive press strategy across national, local, youth/scholastic, community, lifestyle, sports business, and international media.
  • Partner with Football Operations, International, Marketing, Social, Player Engagement, Legends, Clubs, and external partners across the flag football ecosystem.
  • Lead communications planning and on-site media operations for flag-specific showcases, championships, clinics, activations, and relevant NFL tentpole events.
  • Develop message guides, press materials, briefing documents, FAQs, social/content inputs, and partner-facing assets aligned with league style and terminology.
  • Establish communications KPIs, track performance, report progress, and maintain talking points, holding statements, Q&As, and response plans for flag-related issues.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in communications, Public Relations, Journalism, Marketing, or a related field.
  • Minimum 10 years of experience in communications, public relations, media relations, corporate communications, brand communications, or sports communications.
  • Proven success in developing communications strategies that drive awareness, engagement, participation, reputation, or business outcomes.
  • Strong media relationships and experience with narrative development, message development, executive communications, and spokesperson preparation.
  • Experience leading communications planning, press operations, and on-site media execution at major events.
  • Ability to translate research, participation trends, insights, and performance metrics into clear, compelling stories.
  • Sound judgment, discretion, and composure in fast-paced, high-visibility environments.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in sports, youth/scholastic programming, community impact, grassroots participation, international communications, or major events.
  • Familiarity with schools, state associations, community organizations, clubs, leagues, federations, or governing bodies.
  • Passion for growing youth sports participation and expanding access, inclusion, and pathways for athletes.

Other Key Attributes / Talent Characteristics:

  • Builds trusted relationships and collaborates effectively across teams, partners, and senior stakeholders.
  • Communicates with clarity, confidence, and composure in high-pressure situations.
  • Solves problems, removes barriers, and keeps workstreams moving.
  • Motivates teams and partners to innovate and deliver measurable impact.
  • Supports the growth and development of colleagues, agencies, and partners.

Travel:

  • On-site presence and travel as needed for NFL tentpole events, flag-specific events, and activations throughout the season.

job.title: Director, Fan Engagement Marketing – International Club CRM & Performance Marketing
job.description:
The National Football League (NFL) is seeking an experienced international marketing leader to play a key role in operating and scaling its International 1:1 Club Managed Services function.

This role leads day-to-day execution and operational delivery of a centralized, internal agency model that enables all 32 Clubs to execute compliant, high-quality, localized 1:1 fan engagement across more than 20 international markets.

The Director ensures Clubs receive reliable, scalable support across email, SMS, mobile app, web, and emerging channels by operationalizing league data, platforms, and best practices. Success is measured by execution quality, operational reliability, campaign performance, regulatory adherence, and Club satisfaction, while enabling sustained international fan development.

Responsibilities:

  • International Club Managed Services Execution
    • Support the Senior Director in operating the International 1:1 Club Managed Services model as an internal agency serving all 32 Clubs.
    • Execute against the defined service offering, engagement model, SLAs, intake processes, and prioritization frameworks.
    • Ensure consistent, high-quality delivery across markets, time zones, and languages.
  • Global Operations & Workforce Enablement
    • Manage day-to-day operations of a distributed global workforce (including contingent associates across multiple regions).
    • Implement operating rhythms, workflows, training standards, and QA processes to support high-volume international execution.
    • Support capacity planning and workload balancing to meet Club demand while maintaining quality and compliance.
  • International 1:1 Marketing Delivery
    • Oversee execution of Club-led, league-enabled 1:1 campaigns across email, SMS, push, in-app, and web.
    • Ensure campaigns appropriately leverage behavioral, transactional, and engagement signals within market-specific constraints.
    • Apply testing frameworks and performance insights to drive continuous improvement at scale.
  • Data Privacy, Governance & Compliance Support
    • Execute established data governance and compliance standards for international fan data and PII usage.
    • Partner closely with Legal, Data & Analytics, and MarTech teams to ensure campaign execution aligns with GDPR and local market regulations.
    • Translate regulatory requirements into clear, executable guidelines for managed service teams and Clubs.
  • Club Enablement & Relationship Support
    • Act as a primary operational point of contact for Clubs on international 1:1 campaign execution and best practices.
    • Support Club adoption by delivering reliable service, clear communication, and timely issue resolution.
    • Escalate risks, constraints, and opportunities to the Senior Director with recommended solutions.
  • Cross-Functional Coordination & Reporting
    • Partner with International, Marketing, Data & Analytics, and MarTech teams to align execution with league priorities.
    • Support quarterly planning cycles by translating demand forecasts into execution plans.
    • Contribute to performance reporting, operational insights, and recommendations for scaling impact.

Required Qualifications:

  • 8-10+ years' of experience in CRM, lifecycle marketing, or performance-driven engagement, with international exposure
  • Experience operating within managed services, agency, or shared-services models, ideally in global environments
  • Working knowledge of international data privacy and marketing regulations and their executional implications
  • Demonstrated experience managing distributed teams or partners across regions and time zones
  • Strong executional fluency with MarTech platforms (CDPs, journey orchestration, messaging platforms)
  • Ability to manage high-volume, deadline-driven workflows with consistency and accuracy
  • Background in sports, entertainment, or global consumer brands

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience supporting or scaling internal agency or managed services models in complex organizations
  • Strong operational instincts with the ability to translate strategy into repeatable execution
  • Comfortable working in matrixed environments with multiple stakeholders and dependencies
  • Experience partnering with Legal, Data, and Technology teams in regulated markets
  • Global mindset with sensitivity to cultural and regional differences in fan engagement

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics:

  • Execution-focused operator who takes pride in reliable delivery and operational excellence
  • Service-oriented mindset with a strong commitment to supporting Clubs as internal clients
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple concurrent workstreams
  • Clear, proactive communicator who escalates issues early and constructively
  • Comfortable operating under pressure in high-volume, time-sensitive environments
  • Influence-driven collaborator who builds trust without relying on formal authority
  • Curious, adaptable, and motivated to continuously improve processes, tools, and outcomes
  • Passion for sports – and the NFL in particular – with an appreciation for the role Clubs play in global fan growth

Travel:

  • Up to 25% domestic and international travel required

Terms / Expected Hours of Work

  • NFL employees are expected to work 40 hours per week, with flexibility to support global operations across international time zones
  • This role requires availability outside of standard business hours, including early mornings, evenings, and occasional weekends, to support international markets and Club needs
  • Due to the global nature of the role, the position carries an on-call responsibility to address time-sensitive issues, campaign execution, or operational needs as they arise across regions

job.title: Director, Professional & Adult Competitive Flag Football
job.description:
The NFL is accelerating the growth of flag football as one of the world's fastest-growing sports and a cornerstone of the future of football. With flag football set to debut at the Los Angeles 2028 Olympic Games, expanding international competition through the International Federation of American Football (IFAF), and the launch of a new professional flag football league in partnership with TMRW Sports, the NFL is making unprecedented investments in the sport's competitive ecosystem worldwide.

The Director, Professional & Adult Competitive Flag Football will help lead the NFL's efforts to strengthen and expand the global competitive flag football landscape. This role will be responsible for managing strategic relationships, developing competition-focused initiatives, and supporting the growth of domestic and international flag football across professional, national team, club, tournament, and recreational environments.

The ideal candidate combines a deep understanding of the competitive flag football ecosystem with strong business acumen, stakeholder management capabilities, and experience operating within complex sports environments. This individual will serve as a key leader in building relationships and aligning stakeholders across leagues, federations, governing bodies, tournament operators, clubs, and other partners to support the long-term growth of flag football globally.

Responsibilities

Competitive Ecosystem Strategy

  • Support the development and execution of the NFL's strategy to strengthen and expand competitive flag football globally.
  • Maintain a comprehensive understanding of the flag football ecosystem, including professional leagues, clubs, tournaments, governing bodies, athletes, coaches, officials, and administrators.
  • Monitor industry trends, competitive structures, and emerging opportunities across domestic and international markets.
  • Develop and manage a national database and intelligence platform tracking participation trends, organizations, competitions, and key stakeholders.
  • Identify opportunities to improve alignment, collaboration, and growth across key stakeholders within the sport.

Professional League & Competition Development

  • Serve as a primary NFL relationship manager with TMRW Sports, the Professional Flag League.
  • Support initiatives that strengthen the professional flag football ecosystem and elevate awareness, participation, and long-term sustainability.
  • Collaborate on strategic initiatives related to league operations, competition development, athlete engagement, and market growth.
  • Identify opportunities to connect professional flag football with broader participation and competition objectives.

International Federations & National Team Engagement

  • Serve as a key NFL liaison to IFAF, national federations, and national team stakeholders worldwide.
  • Support initiatives that strengthen the global national team ecosystem and advance international competition.
  • Support initiatives that advance competitive standards, governance best practices, and competition quality across the global flag football ecosystem.
  • Collaborate with federations and governing bodies to promote alignment on competition structures, calendars, officiating frameworks, and strategic growth initiatives.
  • Support the continued development and quality of IFAF-sanctioned competitions, including World Championships, Continental Championships, Olympic qualification events, and other international tournaments.

Olympic & International Competition Strategy

  • Support the NFL's strategic engagement with the Olympic flag football ecosystem, including LA28 stakeholders, IFAF, National Olympic Committees, and National Governing Bodies.
  • Monitor developments related to Olympic qualification, international competition structures, and future Olympic cycles.
  • Help align NFL priorities with the continued growth and success of flag football within the Olympic movement.

Competition & Event Development

  • Support the growth and visibility of competitive opportunities for both men's and women's flag football across domestic and international markets.
  • Support the growth and enhancement of competitive flag football opportunities across professional, amateur, and international levels.
  • Develop relationships with tournament operators, league operators, clubs, and event organizers.
  • Evaluate opportunities to expand competition offerings and improve the participant and fan experience.
  • Assist in the development of new events, competitions, and initiatives that support growth objectives.

Adult Participation & Recreational Growth

  • Support initiatives that drive participation and engagement in adult recreational flag football.
  • Collaborate with leagues, operators, and partners to identify opportunities to expand adult play opportunities.
  • Develop relationships with organizations that support recreational and amateur competition.
  • Help align adult participation strategies with broader NFL flag football growth objectives.

Strategic Partnerships & Stakeholder Management

  • Collaborate across NFL departments to align competition priorities with broader participation, international, football operations, marketing, and commercial objectives.
  • Identify new business, competition, and partnership opportunities that accelerate the growth of flag football globally.
  • Identify partnership opportunities that advance the NFL's strategic goals in flag football.
  • Support cross-functional initiatives involving internal and external stakeholders.

Industry Leadership & Representation

  • Serve as a subject matter expert on the competitive flag football landscape and stakeholder ecosystem.
  • Deliver strategic recommendations and presentations to NFL leadership and external partners.
  • Support thought leadership initiatives that position the NFL as a leader in the growth of flag football globally.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree required.
  • Minimum 10-12 years of experience in sports business, football operations, league operations, competition management, international sports, partnership management, or related fields.
  • Demonstrated experience managing strategic partnerships and stakeholder relationships across complex sports environments.
  • Strong understanding of the competitive flag football ecosystem, including leagues, tournaments, governing bodies, clubs, and national teams.
  • Experience working with professional sports leagues, national governing bodies, international federations, event operators, or comparable organizations preferred.
  • Proven ability to develop and execute strategic initiatives across multiple stakeholders.
  • Exceptional relationship-building, influencing, and communication skills.
  • Strong project management, organizational, and negotiation skills.
  • Experience managing cross-functional teams and external partners.
  • Public speaking and executive presentation experience required.

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics

  • Experience working within international sports ecosystems, national team programs, or governing bodies.
  • Familiarity with IFAF, Olympic competition structures, and international sports governance.
  • Experience working with professional sports leagues and emerging sports properties.
  • Global sports experience and demonstrated ability to work across diverse cultural and geographic markets.
  • Knowledge of adult participation and recreational sports programming.

Travel

  • Frequent attendance at international competitions, stakeholder meetings, and major events.
  • Flexibility to work nights, weekends, and non-traditional hours as business needs require.

job.title: Director, Stadium Network Architecture
job.description:
The National Football League (NFL) is looking for a Director, Stadium Network Architecture with a strong background in network design, engineering, architecture and operations as well as experience with Wireless Design & Spectrum Analysis to join an innovative team of solutions engineers and architects. The Senior Network Architect will be responsible for developing network architecture diagrams, defining technical requirements, and serving as the technical lead for football technology network infrastructure. We are looking for a candidate who can drive the implementation and maintenance of complex and specialized network services, ensuring the highest levels of reliability, performance, and uptime.

This hands-on senior stadium network architect will act as a leader of technical engineering for the Infrastructure Engineering Team across a wide range of areas including the production Football Technology Network, NFL temporary Fan Event Setups, sideline wireless technology and more.

This onsite role can be based out of our Manhattan or Mount Laurel, NJ offices, and requires 30% to 50% travel domestically and internationally.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the design and architecture of Football Technology network services considering performance, redundancy, scalability, and security.
    • Document standards and guidelines for best practice stadium network and wireless architecture as they align to industry standards and best practices.
    • Develop and present comprehensive network design proposals to stakeholders, addressing business requirements and technical specifications.
    • Assist in the research, design and documentation for upgrades and adoption of new network technologies.
    • Provide hands on configuration and escalation support for all stadium network technologies.
  • Responsible for the installation, operation, administration, and maintenance of wired and wireless networks at stadiums and corporate offices.
    • Provide dedicated support for on-site stadium network and Wi-Fi technicians during NFL game days throughout the NFL season.
    • Responsible for managing and maintaining network diagrams, configurations, support, and training documentation.
  • Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams including operations, security, Events, and others to align network strategies with business goals.
    • Responds to technical escalations for wired and wireless service issues, working with product support teams, IT staff and business groups to ensure resolution.
    • Provide reports for network KPIs to show service levels, capacity analysis, performance, troubleshooting, and areas for improvement in network infrastructure.
    • Provide technical support to various activities and internal infrastructure within the Football Technology segment.
    • Responsible for effectively engaging with IT project management and reporting project status.
    • Establish and adhere to set project plans and release dates.
  • Mentor and provide guidance to junior network engineers, sharing expertise and knowledge.
  • Remain on the cutting edge by studying state-of-the-art network technologies, participating in educational opportunities; reading professional publications; maintaining personal networks; participating in professional organizations
  • Maintain and publish Football Stadium DAS and Wi-Fi Guidelines
    • Review and plan DAS and Wi-Fi updates for NFL Tentpole Events.
    • Lead audits of Cellular and DAS Performance around NFL stadiums to adhere to NFL guidelines.
    • Collaborate with Cellular Vendors on stadium enhancements, and testing.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information technology, or related field preferred, with 10+ years of experience or equivalent military service.
  • Extensive hands-on experience exceeding 10 years in network implementation, troubleshooting, and lifecycle maintenance.
  • Demonstrated leadership with over 5 years in network architecture roles.
  • 5+ years’ experience in wireless design, implementation, and support for large networks, including spectrum analysis and stadium DAS design.
  • Proficient in network administration, particularly Cisco products, with expertise in controllers, access points, routers, and switches.
  • Advanced knowledge of networking protocols (TCP/IP, UDP, DHCP, DNS, STP, NAT, IPSEC, GRE, VPC/VSS, etc.)
  • Advanced understanding of networking concepts and principles, including but not limited to routing static/dynamic (RIP, EIGRP, OSPF, & BGP) and multi-layer switching (standard and private VLANs, VTP, Spanning Tree, etc.)

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics

  • Strong grasp of network best practices, security principles, design architecture, and analysis with use of tools such as Wireshark, etc.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills with the ability to analyze and troubleshoot complex network issues.
  • Experience in troubleshooting networking device drivers and client system issues.
  • Experience in troubleshooting video and voice performance over wired and wireless networks.
  • Capability to research and evaluate new network technologies.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills for technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Skilled in creating and updating detailed infrastructure topologies using MS Visio, Excel, and Word.
  • CCNP, CCIE, JNCIP, or equivalent
  • Familiarity with Cisco Identity Services Engine and DNA.

Travel

30% - 50%, domestic and international.

Salary
$185,000—$215,000 USD

To learn more about our comprehensive benefits offerings, please visit: NFL BENEFITS

job.description:

The NFL Management Council is the division of the NFL legal department that negotiates and advises NFL clubs regarding the NFL Collective Bargaining Agreement and represents them in grievance arbitrations against the NFL Players Association.

Management Council Law Clerks are required to commit to approximately 20 hours/week assisting attorneys with various labor relations matters, which may include:

job.title: Manager, Corporate Partnerships
job.description:
Reporting to the Head of Commercial Corporate Partnerships for NFL Canada, the Manager, Corporate Partnerships is accountable to support and enable each of our corporate sponsors’ activations in a given season.

Towards our goal of being our sponsors most strategic partner in Canada, this role requires superior relationship management capabilities for both external and internal stakeholders, combined with a solid strategic foundation and functional understanding, of all elements of the marketing mix. Candidate will demonstrate a strong working knowledge of the Canadian sponsorship industry and strategic planning process.

This is a full-time, 18-month fixed-term contract position (40 hours per week), with the possibility of renewal.

Responsibilities:

  • Accountable, in collaboration with our partners, for the successful development, approval, activation and where appropriate, analysis, of each of our NFL Canada partner activations on and off season.
  • Through a deep understanding of each of our partner contracts, will ensure that their programs can and will be approved internally, consistent with their contractual rights.
  • Work with partners to develop NFL centric content that meets partner and league objectives
  • Work with player relations to identify and recommend players for partner executions (content, virtual, in-person)
  • Work with partners on measures of success and track throughout the season
  • Develop digital media campaigns for league partners to maximize partner investments
  • Work with our corporate partners, at a strategic business level, to identify key challenges and opportunities that the NFL can support on, to meet their business needs. This will be done in collaboration with other functional teams (marketing, fan centric marketing, consumer products, etc.)
  • Accountable for identifying incremental revenue opportunities across each partner, and working to provide them with new ideas, that will deliver net new revenue to NFL Canada. content, assets, media.
  • Work with legal and other relevant NFL stakeholders to develop and manage contracts for new partners
  • Work with NFL Canada marketing team to identify opportunities to collaborate with partners on initiatives that support business objectives in the market
  • Identify and lead, required research projects, to help deliver short and long term goals.
  • Accountable for evaluating our annual performance with our partners, using an agreed upon methodology and metrics.
  • Responsible for managing digital inventory across all NFL Canada corporate partners, including trafficking ads with our digital agency
  • Responsible for providing monthly reporting and analysis of our NFL owned and operated media executions
  • Responsible for leading our NFL Canada events including NFL Road Trips, annual Corporate Partner Summit and Partner Gifting program
  • Responsible for supporting our event calendar initiatives tied to our tentpole events: Kickoff, Super Bowl, Pro Bowl and Draft

Required Education and Experience:

  • University or equivalent college diploma – marketing or business administration degree an asset
  • Experience with Account Management an asset
  • Experience working in sponsorship, either on client, agency or property side
  • Working with a sports property and or sports betting operator an asset
  • A minimum of 5-7 years of progressively expanding experience in sponsorship/partnership activation or client account management in the marketing function is preferred

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics:

  • Digital media planning or buying experience an asset
  • Experience developing and executing digital content an asset
  • Highly organized with the ability to manage the needs of multiple partners simultaneously
  • Strong inter-personal and effective communication skills
  • Creative problem solver with an optimistic approach to business challenges
  • Consistently pushes for better results for the team and partners
  • Effective knowledge and use of Microsoft PowerPoint, Excel and research tools
  • Self-starter with the ability to network within NFL International and Domestic offices to conduct day to day business

Travel:

  • Position requires some flexibility of travel during the NFL season (approximately 10% of the year). Valid Passport for international travel required.

Requirements:

  • NFL Canada offers a hybrid work schedule consisting of a four day in office presence (Toronto) with one day work from home
  • This is a full-time, 18-month fixed-term contract position (40 hours per week), with the possibility of renewal.

job.title: Manager, Digital Strategy and Business Development
job.description:
The Manager, Digital Strategy and Business Development plays a critical role in the development of NFL Digital Media platforms short- and long-term strategic approach. The role will require a deep understanding of user data, competitive analysis, and the NFL ecosystem to create actionable strategic direction for the broader organization. The role will also directly support partnership strategy across sourcing, deal negotiation, and operational execution.

Responsibilities

  • Define near- and long-term strategy for the NFL’s digital media business, creating vision and prioritization framework to drive growth across NFL+, NFL App, and NFL.com experiences
  • Independently identify, evaluate, and recommend new growth opportunities across product features, promotional strategies, distribution models, and strategic partnerships through financial modeling, market analysis, and unlocking insights from unstructured data sets
  • Lead cross-functional strategic initiatives from concept through execution, partnering with Product, Marketing, Growth, Content, Finance, Legal, Sponsorship, and Ad Sales to align stakeholders and deliver business outcomes
  • Develops strategic evaluations and decision frameworks that enable leadership to assess, prioritize, and make informed decisions on business initiatives.
  • Source, negotiate, and manage strategic partnerships that expand audience reach, drive incremental revenue, and advance NFL’s digital media strategy
  • Create executive-level communications and strategic planning materials to support decision-making by NFL senior leadership
  • Presents data-driven findings and strategic recommendations to executive leadership, influencing key business decisions and organizational priorities.
  • Serve as a strategic thought partner to NFL Media leadership, providing analytical rigor and executive support on high-priority initiatives and business-critical decisions.

Required Qualifications

  • A four-year undergraduate degree from an accredited college or university is required.
  • 5-7+ years of work experience in strategy, consulting, business development, or related fields -- experience in sports, media, or digital products preferred
  • Strong understanding of digital media ecosystems, including streaming platforms, distribution models, and direct-to-consumer (DTC) business models
  • Advanced analytical and quantitative skills, including financial modeling, scenario analysis, and business case development
  • Demonstrated experience developing strategic frameworks and translating data and market insights into actionable business recommendations
  • Exercises a high degree of discretion, judgment, and professionalism in handling highly confidential, sensitive, and business-critical information. Experience working cross-functionally and influencing stakeholders across product, marketing, finance, and other business units
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with ability to distill complex concepts into clear, easy-to-understand presentations

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics

  • Ability to manage multiple simultaneous projects with several deliverables under tight deadlines
  • High level of integrity, work ethic, and deep intellectual curiosity
  • Strong interpersonal skills with a collaborative DNA

Travel

job.title: Manager, Flag Football
job.description:
The NFL is seeking a Manager, Flag Football to play a key role in driving the growth of youth flag football. This individual will be responsible for growing global youth participation, with a focus on the U.S., and is a critical member of the Flag integrated team, collaborating across the League, 32 NFL Clubs, and the broader flag football ecosystem to accelerate the growth of flag football.

This is a key leadership role that, in partnership with internal and external stakeholders, will play a formative role in the development of the youth flag football ecosystem during a period of exciting growth. This role requires strategic thinking, operational prowess, and strong partnership management skills. The Manager will serve as the point of contact for key strategic partnerships and will work closely with leaders across the League (including in Football Operations, International, Marketing, Comms, Events, Club Business Development, and Social Responsibility) to operationalize these partnerships and other key initiatives in the flag space. This position reports to the VP, Flag Football and offers significant exposure to senior NFL executives and an opportunity to shape the future of flag football at a national and global level.

Responsibilities

  • Develop & Execute Growth Strategy – Lead initiatives to expand youth flag football participation, driving engagement among key audiences, including players, parents, coaches, officials, and administrators.
  • Manage Strategic Partnerships – Serve as the primary liaison for key partners on flag football, including RCX Sports, GENYOUth, other youth organizations, and federations, ensuring operational alignment and maximizing impact.
  • Lead & Execute Flag Football Events – Serve as Flag lead for all youth- focused flag activations, including NFL FLAG Championships. Lead strategy and drive collaboration across internal & external stakeholders, ensuring seamless execution and maximal impact.
  • Awareness & Engagement – Oversee all phases of the participation funnel, from increasing awareness to enhancing player development through innovative programs and resources.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration – Work closely with internal teams such as Marketing, Events, Sponsorship, and Broadcasting to integrate flag football initiatives into broader NFL priorities.
  • Lead Meetings & Stakeholder Engagement – Organize and lead meetings with League, Club, and external partners, operating as a strategic project manager driving agendas and actionable outcomes.
  • Support International Growth – Partner with the International Flag team to share best practices and assist with global event execution where needed.
  • Strategic Planning & Execution – Support the VP, Flag Football in continuing to build out and evolve long-term strategy and for youth flag football within the broader framework of the Global Flag Football team

Required Qualifications

  • B.A/B.S. required
  • Minimum 5+ years of professional experience, with a focus in partnership management, flag/youth football, sports events/operations, or consulting
  • Proven ability to lead and influence complex cross-functional teams and manage external partnerships. Experience working with marketing, media, and event teams is a plus
  • Exceptional project management skills with strong attention to detail
  • Proficiency in PowerPoint and presentation development
  • Strong oral and written communication skills, with the ability to navigate high-level discussions with discretion and sound judgment
  • Deep understanding of the NFL and football ecosystem

Key Attributes & Skills

  • Ability to work collaboratively across departments and with external partners
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects in high-pressure environments
  • Experience with data analysis, reporting tools/dashboards, and consumer insights is a plus
  • Experience operating youth sports events is a plus
  • Experience working internationally is a plus

Physical Demands

  • Ability to attend and work key Flag events and meetings

Travel

  • Travel 20%

Terms / Expected Hours of Work

  • NFL employees are required to work 40 hours per week in the office. This role may often require hours on nights and/or weekends as well.
