job.title: Manager, Hospitality (UK-External Agency Position)
job.description:
The Manager, Hospitality (UK) will play a key role in the planning, delivery, and execution of NFL Premium and VIP Hospitality programs for the NFL's international games and events. This individual will oversee guest experiences, ensuring best-in-class service for NFL partners, clients, and fans while helping deliver exceptional hospitality experiences that reflect the NFL brand.

Working closely with internal stakeholders and external partners, the Hospitality Manager will lead and support hospitality initiatives before, during, and after international events throughout the year. The role requires strong organizational, project management, and communication skills, along with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

The successful candidate will be proactive, detail-oriented, and solutions-focused, with a passion for creating memorable experiences and a willingness to go above and beyond to deliver outstanding results.

This job posting is for a position with one of the NFL’s third-party agency partners that provides services to the NFL. The individual selected for this role will be an employee of that third-party agency and not the NFL. All compensation, benefits, and other terms and conditions of employment are handled by the agency. The assignment to provide services to the NFL will be limited in duration but may be extended for an additional period by agreement between the NFL and the agency.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design and planning of all hospitality areas including suites, shared spaces, and NFL VIP for international games
  • Manage sales and event agencies to deliver a high-end hospitality program
  • Work collaboratively with participating teams in their hospitality delivery
  • Assist in the branding and design for all hospitality and customer facing areas
  • Conduit between contractors and NFL Creative
  • Day-to-day lead for stadium catering; assist in the creation of menus for GA/Hospitality areas
  • May include external events
  • Entertainment programming
  • Cross department guest list management alongside NFL Ticketing and Global Hospitality sales team
  • Working closely with the NFL’s Elite Service, management of internal clients, teams, NFL Executives and team ownership
  • Support in the execution of and delivery of the NFL international games
  • Lead or support in external partner events throughout the year

Technical Experience and Role Requirements:

  • Minimum of 5 years’ working within sports and event industry
  • Working within stadiums is highly desired
  • Experience in managing and executing multiple events
  • Outstanding stakeholder management
  • Excellent time management, problem solving and organisational skills
  • Proficiency in MD Office (PPT, Word, Excell etc.) and excellent email management skill required
  • Strong communication, interpersonal, and conflict resolution skills
  • Ability to handle multiple tasks simultaneously and work well under pressure to meet deadlines
  • Proactive mindset and professional manner to align with business objectives, customer expectations and brand values
  • Proficiency in English required, other languages encouraged
  • Awareness of cultural differences and inclusion
  • Willingness and availability to travel to local and international games (primarily Europe)

Personal Attributes:

  • A genuine passion for delivering exceptional customer service and experiences
  • Excellent attention to detail
  • Willingness to travel, work long hours and weekends when required
  • Interest in sports recommended

Terms / Expected Hours of Work

  • Requires extensive travel to event locations across the UK and Europe.
  • Requires flexibility to work evenings, weekends and holidays, particularly during event and game weeks.

job.title: Manager, Sponsorship New Business
job.description:
The Manager, Sponsorship New Business, is a key member of the Business Development team responsible for generating revenue by developing and selling integrated marketing partnerships for the NFL globally.

This position will work collaboratively across the NFL to identify partnerships that support key initiatives such as NFL FLAG, International growth, audience growth across youth, multicultural and women, and game innovation.

Given the new business focus of this position, we are seeking candidates with a demonstrated track record of independently sourcing, negotiating, and closing sponsorship or partnership deals, and who can quickly contribute to revenue growth.

Responsibilities:

  • Responsible for developing a global pipeline and executing partnerships with blue-chip brands to reach Sponsorship revenue goals
  • Cultivate global and local market category prospects through category analysis and market research, with a focus on international markets without a dedicated new business resource
  • Establish and build relationships with key external contacts (e.g., corporate decision makers at Fortune 500 companies and influencers in the sports marketing and agency world)
  • Pursue prospects through contact strategy, development, and delivery of sales presentations, negotiation, and contract execution
  • Actively contribute innovative thinking and fresh ideas that help lead to new revenue-generating sponsorship opportunities and contribute to cross-functional working groups consisting of key internal stakeholders (e.g., Media, IT, Football Operations, Social Responsibility, etc.) to develop customized marketing platforms that align with prospective partner objectives
  • Develop and write strategic, customized presentations and partnership proposals for prospects
  • Effectively maintain sales pipeline and reporting documents, as well as other duties as directed
  • Help manage Sponsorship Business Development Senior Coordinator contributions to the team in partnership with the Senior Director

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's Degree
  • 5+ years of direct sponsorship sales experience at league, team, agency and/or company
  • Hands-on experience leading the full new-business sales cycle, from prospecting through deal execution, required

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Excellent written and verbal communicator; ability to build trusted relationships and influence across all levels both internally and externally
  • Proficient with MS Word, Excel and PowerPoint

Other Key Attributes / Talent Characteristics:

  • Energetic, self-starter with a passion for uncovering synergies between Fortune 500 brands and the NFL
  • Strong knowledge of sports marketing and/or sponsorship landscape
  • Proficient in conducting industry research, prospecting, outreach, pitch ideation, and proposal development
  • Excellent written and verbal communicator
  • Ability to build trusted relationships and influence across all levels, both internally and externally
  • Experienced in leveraging your network to initiate and develop relationships with senior-level marketing executives

Physical Demands:

job.title: Part-Time Digital Programming Coordinator
job.description:
The NFL Digital Media Group is seeking a part-time Digital Media Programming Coordinator to work with the Digital Programming team on selecting, prioritizing and programming content for the NFL's digital platforms, including NFL+.

Responsibilities

  • Identify, prioritize and promote content of all types (articles, VODs, live shows, etc.), always with the intention of meeting the goals of NFL Media’s owned and operated platforms (NFL+, NFL App, NFL.com and Connected TV)
  • Specialize in packaging of content, making day-to-day decisions about what content best serves the NFL Digital Media audience and best fulfills stated goals for presentation, consumption and generation of revenue
  • Monitor and track trends in consumption to make informed decisions about what content is resonating with fans and subscribers
  • Write dynamic headlines and alert copy in a fast-paced, deadline environment
  • Work to identify new and exciting ways to support league-wide NFL initiatives
  • Collaborate with photo editors to create eye-catching visuals that drive traffic to our digital media platforms
  • Monitor internal email communication, social media and other outside sources to ensure that the latest NFL news is represented on our platforms and in our alerts
  • Ensure that all content is grammatically correct and factually accurate and that writing style is consistent with NFL Digital Media’s editorial policies
  • Work with the 32 club sites to bring in relevant content to feature on NFL Digital Media platforms

Required Qualifications

  • Editorial experience, preferably in online mediums and in the sports industry

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in journalism or related field
  • Familiarity with Direct to Consumer content environment

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics

  • Strong organizational and prioritization skills
  • Team-first contributor who strives to help create an inclusive, equitable work environment
  • Data-driven decision maker who understands the importance of analytics-based insights
  • Creative thinker who can identify storylines and represent them in an interesting way
  • Detail-oriented individual who executes for success

job.title: Part-Time Lead DAI Operator
job.description:
The NFL Digital Media Team is seeking an individual passionate about professional sports to lead the team responsible for Digital Ad Insertion for live football games. The Lead DAI Operator will be responsible for coordination and game day supervision of the team responsible for monitoring live game feeds from start to finish and inserting ad cues during commercial breaks. This is a hands-on lead position that will on occasion be responsible for performing DAI Operator responsibilities such as inserting ads into live games or other live video programing.

The role includes performing as a DAI Operator, inserting breaks and monitoring performance of ad delivery using a variety of visual and data reporting sources. The team’s focus is on continuous improvement in their ability to understand and measure the overall effectiveness of the ad delivery system, through evolving tools, processes and capabilities.

Responsibilities

As DAI Lead Operator:

  • Schedule DAI Operators for Live Game Coverage.
  • Distribute Game Format Sheets and other assignment information.
  • Address any Operator-specific equipment, logistics or access issues.
  • Supervise all aspects of ad delivery performance, including accuracy, analytics generation and performance metric reporting.
  • Lead Operator conference calls.
  • Supervise break assignments, schedule changes and other real-time events during game windows.
  • Communicate any issues to appropriate parties.
  • Direct and perform application and system testing of ad delivery as directed.

As DAI Operator:

  • Monitor Live Game Video for commercial breaks and compare broadcast feed to digital distribution.
  • Perform as a either a primary operator or as a backup.
  • Monitor listen-only lines for commercial break instructions.
  • Follow Ad Break program guides and calculate break durations and break insertion points.
  • Report any issues to appropriate NFL management via established procedures.
  • As directed, monitor and generate ad delivery performance metrics and provide immediate notification of any delivery anomalies detected.
  • Perform application and system testing of ad delivery as directed.
  • In a lead capacity, monitor and generate ad delivery performance metrics and provide immediate notification of any delivery anomalies detected.

Required Qualifications

  • Must have high school diploma; GED or equivalency (Some college, no degree required)
  • Proven experience working with computers in an office environment.
  • Experience working in a Lead role and/or supervisory capacity.
  • Basic working knowledge of Microsoft Windows Applications (Word, Excel, PP, Outlook) in PC or MAC.
  • Working knowledge of email, slack and web browsers in PC or MAC
  • Strong communication and analysis skills
  • Must be extremely organized and detail-oriented with the ability to follow through on multi-step instructions.
  • General availability for Sunday and other peak event Game Days during the NFL Football season – refer to nfl.com/schedule for specific dates.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelors, or Associate degree preferred
  • Prior experience working for the NFL.
  • Previous experience working in live TV/broadcast environments (production, stage, etc.) is preferred.
  • Management experience is a plus.
  • Familiarity with Ad insertion
  • Availability on non-Game Days a consideration.
  • Availability for occasional in-office work is a consideration.

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics

  • Must possess a strong work ethic, positive workplace approach and work well with others.
  • Passionate sports-fan, knowledgeable about football (preferred not required).
  • Punctuality is must in this position.

Terms / Expected Hours of Work

  • This is a remote position
  • Up to 7 months of employment based on business needs
  • Part-time - Must be available for 4 hour (min) to 8 hour (max) shifts on NFL Gamedays (Monday, Thursday, Sunday) and holidays where schedule applies (Thanksgiving, etc.)
  • Occasional overtime as needed and approved.

job.title: Part-Time Media Design Group Designer/Animator
job.description:
The NFL Media Design Group is seeking a Designer/Animator to create high-quality graphics, motion design, and visual storytelling assets that support shows, live events, special programming, and emerging platforms. This role combines concept development, design execution, and animation, requiring creativity, technical expertise, and a strong attention to detail.

Working closely with Art Directors and Creative Producers, the Designer/Animator will develop original concepts, iterate on creative solutions, and deliver polished motion graphics that meet the highest production standards.

Responsibilities

  • Conceptualize, design, and animate high-production-value graphics for a variety of NFL Media projects.
  • Create original visual concepts and translate them into compelling motion design solutions.
  • Collaborate closely with Art Directors to ensure creative alignment and execution excellence.
  • Develop scalable, repeatable animation systems and templates that can be shared across internal teams, editors, and external vendors.
  • Maintain organized project files and adhere to established workflows and production standards.
  • Partner with Creative Producers to establish realistic timelines and manage design, revision, and delivery schedules.
  • Balance multiple assignments while maintaining quality and meeting deadlines.
  • Execute projects efficiently, including those with accelerated turnaround times, by leveraging existing toolkits, templates, and custom assets.

Required Qualifications

  • 3+ years of professional experience in design, motion graphics, or animation.
  • Expert-level proficiency in Adobe After Effects (including Scripting and Mogrts), Photoshop, and Illustrator.
  • Experience using Figma, UI/UX design
  • Knowledge of Cinema 4D (C4D)
  • Ability to develop custom designs and animations from original concepts, style guides, existing graphic packages, and creative references.
  • Strong understanding of motion design principles, visual storytelling, and production workflows.
  • Ability to follow established file naming conventions, organizational standards, and production processes.

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics

  • Proactive, detail oriented, organized, and accountable, with the ability to perform in a highly collaborative setting.
  • Confidence in a fast-paced environment
  • Flexibility when faced with new information, needs or challenges
  • Ability to ask questions and communicate with art directors and creative producers when uncertain a current assignment or when ready for the next one.
  • Willingness to invest in understanding the business of the NFL to better support and enhance how the League serves our clubs and engages our fans.

Terms / Expected Hours of Work

  • Part-time, up to 29 hours per week
  • Flexibility to work non-standard hours, including early mornings, evenings, weekends, and holidays, as production schedules require.

job.title: Seasonal Ad Operations Coordinator
job.description:
The NFL Digital Media Technical Operations team is seeking a seasonal coordinator to support the team with ad campaign management, analytical, creative design, and technical tasks. The coordinator will be expected to develop a deep understanding of NFL digital products and serve as a central communication point for all gameday operational activities. This person should have strong communication skills and confidence in a fast-paced environment. This position will communicate with club media contacts, third-party vendors, product management, technology, and business development.

Responsibilities

  • Follow best ad trafficking practices and procedures using Google Ad Manager and AdBook platforms in campaign delivery and management.
  • Execute ad trafficking updates such as ad campaign optimization, delivery schedule, creative rotation, and key-value targeting.
  • Document and maintain department processes and best practices.
  • Troubleshoot ad trafficking issues, ensuring campaigns deliver in full and track any abnormalities.
  • Update and maintain an online digital ad informational site that provides technical support and best practices for ad campaign management.
  • Help the Ad Operations team manage workload and support clubs and other Digital Media teams for all issues related to ad serving.
  • Provide technical support to the League’s clubs during game days and around League events (i.e., NFL Draft, Combine).
  • Communicating with club contacts during game days to provide a forum for updates, questions, and insight.
  • Other responsibilities as assigned.

Required Qualifications

  • 2+ years of experience working in online advertising.
  • Knowledge of data collection and site analytics platforms.
  • Well-organized; ability to manage multiple tasks and prioritize in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills.
  • Excellent problem-solving ability; highly motivated to drive positive change.
  • Solid understanding of ad campaign measurement metrics associated with online advertising.
  • Strong knowledge of sports and digital sports products.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor of Science or Arts degree in business, marketing, communications, computer science, or related field is preferred.
  • Ad server experience in Google Ad Manager is a plus.

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics

  • Ability to understand and document business rules
  • Ability to quickly learn new systems and programs
  • Attention to detail and excellent organizational skills
  • Avid interest and knowledge of NFL football
  • Excels collaborating with team

Terms / Expected Hours of Work

  • 40 hours per week
  • Seasonal, 7-month role
  • Must be flexible to work weekends (specifically Sundays in-season)

job.title: Seasonal Customer Support Operations Coordinator
job.description:
The NFL Digital Media group is seeking a coordinator to assist with supporting various platforms at NFL Media with a focus on customer support for NFL+ and NFL owned and operated apps. This person will be expected to immerse themselves in the details of all digital products and become a communication hub for operational activities. This person should have strong communication skills and confidence in a fast-paced environment. This position communicates with product management, technology, marketing, and sales departments. The Seasonal role will report directly to the Senior Product Operations Manager.

The Customer Support Operations Coordinator will play a crucial role in ensuring the efficient and seamless operation of customer support channels for NFL+ streaming service and NFL owned and operated products. This individual will collaborate with customer service partners to optimize processes for Chat, Messaging, Live Chat, Voice, and Email support. They will be responsible for maintaining and updating FAQ content, driving operational efficiency, and ensuring a high-quality customer support experience across all touchpoints. Coordinate and support Tier-1 and Tier-2 requests from fans and direct-to-consumer subscribers. Report any trends seen while managing tickets. Use several databases, portals, and consoles to perform several account functions.

Responsibilities

  • Support Channel Optimization:
    • Work closely with customer service partners to identify, assess, and implement improvements in support channels including Chat, Messaging, Live Chat, Voice, and Email.
  • Process Improvement:
    • Analyze customer service workflows and recommend process improvements to enhance efficiency and customer satisfaction.
  • FAQ Content Management:
    • Regularly update and manage the FAQ content for accuracy and relevance, ensuring it reflects the most up-to-date information for NFL+ streaming and other NFL products.
  • Zendesk Management:
    • Utilize Zendesk to monitor, track, and manage customer inquiries, ensuring that tickets are handled efficiently and effectively.
  • System Proficiency:
    • Leverage tools such as Chatbot AI, Voice AI, Postman, NFL apps, and social media platforms to provide seamless support for both internal teams and customers.
  • Social Media Monitoring:
    • Monitor and engage with customer feedback, questions, and issues across social media platforms (Twitter, Facebook, Instagram, etc.) to ensure a timely response and resolution of concerns. Identify trends and recurring issues from social media to inform customer service strategies.
  • Cross-functional Collaboration:
    • Collaborate with various departments (Product, Marketing, IT, etc.) to ensure customer support needs are met and product updates are effectively communicated to support teams.
  • Performance Tracking:
    • Monitor and report on key metrics to assess the effectiveness of customer support channels, identifying areas for improvement and ensuring KPIs are met.
  • Training and Support:
    • Assist in training new agents and supporting existing team members by providing updates and ensuring they are equipped with the necessary resources to handle customer issues.
  • Customer Feedback Analysis:
    • Collect and analyze customer feedback from multiple channels (including social media) to identify recurring issues and work with internal teams to implement solutions.
  • Others

    • Clearly explain auto-renewal, billing cycles, and eligibility; ensure alignment with NFL+ policies
    • Produce weekly support reports (ticket trends, CSAT, SLA, contact drivers, AI deflection, escalations, live event insights)

  • Strong interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills
  • Excellent problem-solving ability; highly motivated to drive positive change

  • Excellent communication and problem-solving skills.

  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to track and report on support performance metrics.

job.title: Seasonal FAST Video Systems Operator
job.description:
The National Football League Digital Media Group is looking for a Seasonal FAST Video Systems Operator that is highly motivated and able to work in a fast-paced environment. The role will require an individual with a flexible schedule that is punctual and dependable. He or she will be expected to operate, monitor, and configure software relative to digital video distribution for the NFL’s FAST Channel. This position is based in Inglewood, CA and does not offer relocation or remote work.

Responsibilities

  • Support live streaming of games, weekly shows, and tent-pole events.
  • Document, escalate, and manage video distribution incidents to resolution.
  • Create and update operational runbooks for live on air workflows.
  • Maintain documentation of video acquisition scheduling and live event programing.
  • Setup and operate digital video environment in Digital Master Control (DMC).
  • Provide live event support during all live operation workflows including holidays, nights, early operation windows and/or weekends.
  • Perform quality control tasks for video streaming distribution.
  • Perform digital ad insertion operations on FAST live games.
  • Setup and maintain electronic programming guide (EPG) metadata for live game broadcasts.
  • Manage video routes for international game channels.
  • Collaborate with department initiatives to automate SCTE-35 insertion for DAI.

Required Qualifications

  • BS degree and/or equivalent experience.
  • Direct sports broadcast production and/or production operations experience (TV studio/truck experience, stadium broadcast operations) preferred
  • Experience monitoring and responding to live streaming service health metrics, alarms, and operational incidents in a 24/7 broadcast, streaming, or FAST channel environment.
  • Knowledge of digital protocols such as TCP/IP, UDP, HTTP, HLS, SRT, RTMP, SSH.
  • Demonstrate exceptional attention to detail and the ability to follow instructions precisely with minimal supervision.
  • Execute SCTE-35 cue insertion for live and recorded programming, following AD commands and established operational procedures to ensure seamless break triggering and ad insertion.
  • Effective communicator with the ability to collaborate across control room and production teams
  • Highly organized and able to manage multiple priorities simultaneously
  • Flexible and adaptable, with the ability to respond quickly to changing production needs
  • Strong technical aptitude with the ability to troubleshoot audio/video and playout issues
  • Ability to effectively communicate technical information to internal and external stakeholders through well-organized maintenance notices, incident reports, outage summaries, and status updates

Qualifications

  • A minimum of 2-years of experience in a Technical Support role (i.e. IT Service Desk, TOC/NOC Operations, etc.)
  • Knowledge of Content Distribution Networks.
  • Knowledge of 2110 Broadcast Networks
  • Knowledge of Linux and/or Windows web servers.
  • Knowledge of Cloud Video Distribution platforms
  • Experience with Multi-Viewer Systems
  • Working knowledge and experience with FAST distribution systems
  • AI automation experience
  • Knowledge of encoding standards, including H.264, AAC, GOP structure, I-P-B frame schemes, profiles, bitrates, and aspect ratios.
  • Solid troubleshooting experience in Linux/Mac/Windows environments.

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics

  • Must be a Team Player, Initiative, Resourceful.
  • Exceptional composure and accuracy in high-pressure, live broadcast environments
  • Strong attention to detail with a commitment to on-air quality and precision

Physical Demands

  • Ability to lift and carry video equipment weighing less than 40lbs.

Travel

  • 0 - 10%

Terms / Expected Hours of Work

  • On-call position working less than 40 hours per week based on production needs
  • Must be available for early mornings, evenings, overnights, weekends, holidays, and remote production support as required
  • Seasonal employment up to 7 months

job.title: Seasonal Live Digital Media Specialist 2
job.description:
NFL Media is seeking a Seasonal Live Digital Media Specialist 2 to work on live & taped streaming shows that are distributed across all NFL platforms. This person will contribute to daily live productions with the ability to troubleshoot and maintain equipment in on-air environments as well as be proficient in the Adobe Creative Cloud Suite and edit with creativity and speed. The ideal candidate is a creative thinker with strong knowledge of the NFL and hands-on experience operating a wide range of technical equipment for both studio and field shoots, from pre-production through post.

Responsibilities

  • Technical Direct with vMix Live Video Streaming Software and Sony Hardware Switchers
  • Operate Audio Mixers, Yamaha QL5, System T S300 SSL, Zoom LiveTrak L-12, set up various microphones and IFBs, mic talent
  • Control and operate various robotic and ENG cameras, Panasonic AW-RP120, BirdDog MAKI
  • Work with producers and researchers to create, proof and run live on-screen graphics including breaking news, current NFL topics and stats related to show content
  • Edit high-end video material including player highlight packages, podcasts, creative features, long-form shows and social clips
  • Assist with field shoots utilizing DSLR cameras and various supplemental equipment
  • Contribute to developing new segments within live shows

Required Qualifications

  • Extensive knowledge of live studio-related production technologies, multi-platform workflows and equipment
  • Experience in multi-platform live & VOD shows in studio and remote settings
  • Demonstrate ability to lead a control room during live productions
  • 5+ years experience with Adobe Creative Cloud, fluent in entire Adobe Creative Cloud Suite specifically Premiere Pro, Photoshop, After Effects
  • Comfortable in live production environments
  • Strong attention to detail/organizational skills
  • Knowledge of the National Football League, including its clubs, players and history

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Film/TV, Communications, Journalism or related field
  • Knowledge of social media platforms, including audience demographics and competitive landscape
  • Detailed technical knowledge of multi-platform production processes
  • Problem-Solving: Excellent problem-solving skills, with the ability to troubleshoot technical issues
  • Communication: Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Project Management: Proven ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously, work independently as well as collaboratively, meet deadlines and deliver high-quality results
  • Sports/field production experience is a plus

Physical Demands:

  • Lifting, carrying and transportation of equipment

Travel:

  • Minimal – Travel to certain local or NFL events may be required

Terms/Expected Hours of Work:

  • Average of 40 hours/week
  • Overtime may be required during the busiest times of the season
  • Early mornings, late nights, weekends, holidays are commonly expected
  • Seasonal - up to 7-month seasonal employment

job.title: Seasonal Part-Time Broadcast Audio 1
job.description:
NFL Media Technical Operations is seeking an experienced Audio 1 (A1) to lead audio production for live and recorded programming across NFL Media platforms. This position serves as the primary audio lead responsible for the planning, execution, mixing, and overall quality of audio elements supporting studio, remote, and special event productions.

The ideal candidate possesses extensive live broadcast audio experience, strong technical expertise in modern IP-based audio environments, and a proven ability to perform in fast-paced, high-profile sports production settings. Production services will be based at NFL Media's state-of-the-art broadcast facility in Inglewood, California.

Responsibilities

  • Serve as the lead audio mixer for live and recorded productions, ensuring the highest level of audio quality and operational excellence.
  • Design, configure, and execute complex audio workflows for studio shows, remote broadcasts, special events, and digital productions.
  • Operate and mix live productions utilizing broadcast audio consoles, playback systems, communication systems, and IP-based audio infrastructure.
  • Collaborate closely with producers, directors, technical directors, engineering teams, and production personnel to deliver consistent and impactful audio experiences.
  • Develop and maintain show-specific audio configurations, routing strategies, and operational workflows.
  • Lead audio planning for remote productions, transmission paths, venue integration, and signal management.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve technical audio issues in real time while maintaining on-air continuity.
  • Oversee proper setup, operation, and optimization of communications systems, including Riedel intercom platforms.
  • Ensure compliance with broadcast audio standards and best practices across stereo, surround sound, and emerging audio formats.
  • Provide guidance, mentorship, and operational direction to A2 and A3 personnel and freelance audio staff as needed.
  • Maintain proficiency in emerging broadcast technologies, IP networking standards, and audio production workflows.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Required Qualifications

  • 7+ years of professional broadcast audio experience, including significant experience mixing live sports and studio productions.
  • Proven experience serving as an Audio 1 (A1) or senior-level broadcast audio mixer in a professional television, streaming, or live event environment.
  • Advanced experience operating SSL audio consoles; experience with SSL System T and S500 platforms strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrated expertise in stereo, 5.1 surround, and multi-channel broadcast audio mixing.
  • Extensive knowledge of IP-based audio infrastructures, including AES67, Dante, SMPTE 2110, and related broadcast networking technologies.
  • Experience supporting complex remote productions, transmission workflows, and large-scale live event broadcasts.
  • Strong understanding of broadcast signal flow, routing, communications systems, and troubleshooting methodologies.
  • Proficiency with playback systems, audio servers, and broadcast production technologies.
  • Experience working with Riedel communications systems and networked intercom environments preferred.

Qualifications

  • Experience supporting national sports broadcasts and large-scale live events.
  • Dante Certification or equivalent IP audio networking credentials.
  • Experience with EVS audio workflows and replay systems.
  • Familiarity with cloud-based or remote production environments.
  • CTS, Dante, or other relevant industry certifications.

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics

  • Exceptional leadership, communication, and collaboration skills.
  • Ability to remain calm and make sound decisions in high-pressure live production environments.
  • Demonstrated attention to detail and commitment to operational excellence.
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving capabilities.
  • Ability to prioritize multiple competing demands while maintaining production quality.
  • Strong technical proficiency with broadcast systems, production software, and collaboration tools.

Terms / Expected Hours of Work

  • Availability to work flexible schedules, including evenings, weekends, holidays, and special events.
  • Ability to support remote productions and occasional travel as business needs require.
  • Seasonal employment up to 7 months.

job.title: Seasonal Part-Time Lighting Director
job.description:
NFL Media, Technical Operations is looking for a Lighting Director for shows produced at NFL Media in Inglewood, CA. Qualified candidates will have experience working in multi-camera studio environments and have a general knowledge of lighting studio talent for live sports and key show programming.

Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with show Directors, Producers, Scenic, and Video teams - implementing and maintaining the specific look of various productions between multiple stages and remote locations.
  • Support stage lighting designs in tandem with our Scenic and Integrations teams.
  • Operation of ETC EOS consoles to playback and modify existing lighting looks.
  • Monitor show productions from shading room and consult with video operator as necessary.
  • Perform tech checks at the beginning of each shift to check for burnouts, repositioning of equipment and overall stage & grid maintenance.
  • Conduct and perform routine and preventive maintenance of lighting fixtures and boards.
  • Report technical and/or equipment issues to Studio Operations and Engineering teams.

Required Qualifications

  • 5-10 years of experience working in a studio environment; live & recorded productions.
  • Have working knowledge of studio lighting equipment and studio light design. Including exterior staging and lighting requirements during all day parts.
  • Have a creative eye and can improvise on the fly.
  • Knowledge of ETC EOS family lightboard(s) and controllers required.
  • Knowledge and understanding of lighting data protocols and networks, DMX-512, SACN and ETC NET3.
  • Knowledge of moving light fixtures, High End Systems, GLP.
  • Knowledge of LED broadcast fixtures: ETC, Chauvet, Arri, Cineo, ChromaQ.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent.
  • Ability to draft, read, and interpret lighting plots for new or existing sets.
  • Auto-Cad, Vectorworks, ETC Concert and Lightwright experience.
  • Advanced ETC EOS programming training.
  • Advanced ETC NET3 Networking training.
  • Ability to program lighting consoles and Network management.

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics

  • Familiarity and experience working with 1080p, HDR, UHD, and 4k studio environments a plus.
  • Interpersonal communication and organizational skills.
  • Strong technical/computer skills (Microsoft, Apple.)
  • Ability to “multi-task” various duties as necessary.
  • Be a team player and excel under pressure.

Physical Demands

  • Ability to work high above the ground, on lifts and/or ladders.
  • Must be able to lift 75lbs for up to 30 minutes at a time.
  • Ability to handle multiple projects simultaneously.
  • Ability to work in fast paced, stressful environments.

Travel

  • Limited

Terms / Expected Hours of Work

  • Flexible schedule to include early mornings, late nights, weekends, and holidays.
  • Less than 29 hours/week when needed.

job.title: Seasonal Part-Time TOC Operator
job.description:
The TOC Operator will perform multiple job functions and ensure that all technical facility requests are met. Works closely with NFL Media Production team, Newsroom personnel, NFL Films Technical Operations, Encompass Atlanta Technical Operation, and members of all 32 NFL Clubs to ensure all video content is received and distributed to broadcast specifications. Works closely with Engineering to troubleshoot all issues that may occur with feeds or broadcast. Communicates with NFL Network Master Control during live broadcasts to ensure signal continuity. Works closely with Remote Operations team for the proper transmission and receipt of feeds for live remote network productions including NFL Network Games, Super Bowl, NFL Combine, NFL Draft, Hall of Fame Enshrinement, and any other NFL Network remote projects. Works closely with SVG team to provide content with captioning for our streaming platforms on NFL.com, NFL FAST Channel, and NFL +. The TOC operator is the first point of troubleshooting and escalation if an issue occurs and will be expected to communicate issues to Operations and Production Management in a timely and efficient manner.

Responsibilities

  • Demonstrate knowledge and operation of broadcast routing systems, including split routes as required.
  • Ability to read digital & analog waveform monitors and how to set up test bars.
  • Ability to read audio meters.
  • Must have strong understanding of analog, digital and SMPTE 2110 signal flows.
  • Must be able to perform Sync and Fax checks prior to live shows and events.
  • Ability to perform extensive transmission checks prior to live remote events.
  • Booking and goodnight procedures for The Switch, Lumen & AT&T Fiber and Satellite orders.
  • Strong understanding of common broadcast signal problems and how to rectify them, i.e. audio levels or distortion, sync issues, video issues.
  • Must possess above average writing skills to document on-air issues.
  • Requires strong oral and written skills, including excellent telephone etiquette.
  • Requires strong organizational skills to ensure high broadcast quality on multiple feeds.
  • Must be willing to adapt in a quickly changing environment.
  • Familiarity with EVS IP Director ingest server systems.
  • Responsible for the generation of broadcast reports as required.

Required Qualifications

  • A minimum of 5 years’ experience in a broadcast operations environment including 2110, HD/SD, ASI, JPEG and MPLS signals and the ability to troubleshoot those signal paths.
  • Possess a strong work ethic and positive attitude and leadership qualities.

Expected Hours of Work

  • Up to 29 hours per week up to 7 months based on business needs
  • Must be willing to work flexible schedules including nights, weekends and holidays.

job.title: Seasonal Part-Time Utility
job.description:
As a member of the stage crew the Utility position performs a wide range of tasks in support of the overall program production process. Under supervision of the Stage Manager, Director, and Operations team, Utilities work with technical staff to satisfy production needs for live, taped, and automated programming.

Responsibilities

  • Moving large set pieces and monitors during stage resets
  • Moving and arranging furniture pieces and props (set dressing)
  • Set talent marks on floor at the direction of Stage Manager and Director
  • Work with Stage Manager to support on-camera talent needs (i.e., bottled water, equipment, etc.)

  • Possess in-depth knowledge of all studio equipment
  • Support Camera Operators in the setup of studio cameras and over-under cable pulls

  • Ability to troubleshoot cameras on stage (tally, prompter etc.)
  • Ability to change camera lenses
  • Maintain continuity of all related camera equipment, including studio fax out and strike at end of day

  • Excellent interpersonal & communications skills required
  • Strong work ethic, positive workplace demeanor and strong leadership skills along with demonstrated ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities required

job.title: Seasonal Part-Time V1/Shading Operator
job.description:
NFL Media Technical Operations is seeking a part-time Video Operator to lead in-studio and remote camera shading for live and pre-recorded news and sports productions across all platforms. This role is responsible for ensuring consistent, high-quality visual output across all camera feeds by managing real-time shading, color correction, and signal integrity.

The Video Operator serves as a critical technical resource within the control room and engineering ecosystem, partnering with Technical Directors, Engineering, and production teams to deliver a seamless, broadcast-ready product in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment.

Responsibilities

  • Perform real-time shading of multiple camera sources during live and recorded productions, ensuring consistent color, exposure, and visual quality
  • Configure and manage camera shading systems, including Sony broadcast camera chains, CCUs, and RCPs
  • Adjust iris, gamma, black levels, and color balance across multiple camera feeds to maintain a cohesive on-air look
  • Color correct inbound video feeds using Selenio Network Processor Manager to ensure broadcast quality and consistency
  • Manage video signal routing for shading and production workflows using Imagine Magellan Control systems
  • Monitor and troubleshoot video signals using waveform monitors, vectorscopes, and diagnostic tools to maintain broadcast standards
  • Collaborate with Technical Directors, Engineering, and production staff to support the creative and technical execution of productions
  • Support setup, calibration, and testing of cameras, shading systems, and video infrastructure for studio and remote productions
  • Adjust shading dynamically based on changing lighting conditions, production requirements, or environmental factors
  • Operate effectively in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment, adapting quickly to real-time production changes and technical challenges
  • Support advanced production environments, including robotic camera systems (Panasonic, Telemetrics), Ultimatte systems, and OLED display integrations

Required Qualifications

  • 5–10+ years of experience in camera shading or broadcast video operations in studio and/or remote production environments
  • Extensive experience with Sony broadcast camera systems, including studio and ENG configurations
  • Experience shading, color correcting, and routing video using frame synchronizers and production systems (e.g., Imagine, Cobalt)
  • Strong understanding of broadcast video formats, including 1080p, 1080i, and 720p
  • Working knowledge of SMPTE 2110 or IP-based video workflows

Preferred Experience

  • Experience working in live sports or fast-paced broadcast production environments
  • Experience with automated and robotic camera systems (Panasonic, Telemetrics)
  • Familiarity with Ultimatte compositing systems and virtual production workflows
  • Experience working with OLED walls and large-format display environments
  • Knowledge of HDR and emerging broadcast technologies

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics

  • Exceptional attention to detail with a strong eye for color accuracy and visual consistency

job.title: Seasonal Product Operations Coordinator
job.description:
The NFL Digital Media group seeks a dynamic Product Operations Coordinator to provide crucial support across various platforms including NFL.com, the NFL app, NFL Fantasy, and Club Sites. This role will be integral in coordinating operational activities and ensuring seamless execution. Reporting directly to the Senior Product Operations Manager, the successful candidate will play a pivotal role in optimizing digital product performance.

Responsibilities

  • Support Product Operations projects across NFL.com, the NFL app, Club Sites, and other owned and operated digital platforms.
  • Assist with operational readiness for new products, features, and seasonal initiatives by helping create and maintain runbooks, training materials, documentation, workflows, and escalation paths.
  • Support digital content programming and site operations through approved administrative tools and content management systems.
  • Assist with tracking project deliverables, open issues, launch readiness items, stakeholder updates, and post-launch follow-up
  • Partner with Product Operations, Content Operations, Product Management, Engineering, and other cross-functional teams to support day-to-day digital platform operations.
  • Help document business rules, operational processes, and support procedures to improve team readiness and consistency.
  • Provide operational support for NFL-owned and operated digital platforms on NFL gamedays, preseason games, tentpole events, and other live event windows.
  • Assist with live streaming operations across applicable platforms, including web, mobile web, mobile app, tablet, and CTV.
  • Support live game and event monitoring by validating stream availability, content presentation, platform behavior, and user-facing experiences.
  • Report, prioritize, and escalate issues in real time to minimize disruption during live events.
  • Partner with Game Day Operations, Clubs, Engineering, Product, and Support teams to track issues through resolution.
  • Assist with post-event documentation, issue recaps, and follow-up items to improve future event coverage.

Required Qualifications

  • Rapid ability to learn new systems and programs.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and a proactive attitude towards driving positive change.
  • Excellent interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with teams.
  • Capacity to manage multiple tasks and prioritize effectively in a fast-paced environment.
  • Availability to work on all NFL Game Days, including Preseason, Regular Season, and Playoffs, in-office, as well as holidays such as Thanksgiving, Christmas Eve, Christmas, New Year's Eve, and New Year's.
  • Sound knowledge of sports and digital sports products.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor of Science or Arts degree in business, marketing, communications, computer science, or related field is preferred
  • 1-3 years’ experience coordinating and supporting digital products in a sports entertainment, digital, media or related industry
  • Prior experience with Live event support
  • Prior experience with Content Management Systems (CMS)
  • Prior experience in operational support of a web and mobile based applications

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics

  • Ability to comprehend and document business rules effectively.
  • Strong attention to detail and exceptional organizational skills.
  • Avid interest and knowledge of NFL football.

Terms / Expected Hours of Work

  • 40 hours per week
  • Seasonal, 7-month role
  • Must be flexible to work weekends (specifically Sundays in-season)
  • Must be able to work all NFL Game Days, including Preseason, Regular Season and Playoffs, in-office.
  • Must be able to work on holidays (e.g. Thanksgiving, Christmas Eve, Christmas, New Year's Eve, New Year's).
  • Required to work from Inglewood, CA office

job.title: Seasonal Production Coordinator II
job.description:
The Production Coordinator II oversees the full logistics of assigned on‑location shoots for NFL Films Productions. This role manages crew movements, equipment rentals, travel, permitting, and vendor communication from preproduction through wrap. The coordinator ensures all operational details are executed accurately and efficiently, serving as a key liaison between internal departments to keep shoots running smoothly and on schedule.

This is a 7-month seasonal position. Candidates are required to work 5 days week from our offices in Mt. Laurel, NJ.

Responsibilities

  • Oversee all logistics of on location shoots as assigned, from start to finish, specifically crew movements, equipment shipments, and vendor communication
  • Hire camera, audio & support crew for on location filming & ensure the onboarding process is complete prior to filming
  • Coordinate all crew travel, including booking flights, hotels & rental vehicles
  • Research & book local equipment rentals not provided by the NFL Films Camera & Audio departments
  • Research & book locations, oversee permitting & handle all administrative tasks associated with those responsibilities including securing vendor paperwork, releases & processing payment
  • Handle all shoot communication including updating the online shoot schedule, sending shoot emails & creating call sheets
  • Work closely with other departments to ensure budget considerations & crew assignments are communicated quickly & efficiently
  • Administrative tasks may include answering phones, requesting certificates of insurance, reviewing invoices & updating department tracking documents to ensure consistency & accuracy

Required Qualifications

  • Candidate should have 2–3+ years of experience coordinating on‑location shoots in film, television, or live event production, with demonstrated ability to independently manage logistics, travel, vendors, and shoot communication.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Strong working knowledge of TV/film production, including camera, audio, lighting, and grip equipment, as well as a clear understanding of crew roles, responsibilities, and on‑set workflows.
  • Familiarity with NFL and NFL Films programming, past and present, with the ability to support shoots that require historical context, archival awareness, or football specific operational needs.

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics

  • Possess strong organizational and time management skills and high-level attention to detail
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment and handling multiple projects simultaneously
  • Excellent communication skills

Physical Demands

  • Position involves coordinating productions on location

Travel

  • Shoot &/or event needs may require the coordinator to travel on location up to 30% of the time

Terms / Expected Hours of Work

  • NFL employees are required to work 40 hours per week. Production demands may include additional hours, nights, and weekends.
Salary
$2,000—$2,000 USD

job.title: Seasonal Project Coordinator
job.description:
Overview /Objective

The Seasonal Project Coordinator is a position to assist the Project Managers. This includes being an available resource to help with day-to-day operations of the department. The Project Coordinator will assist with actualizing, handle smaller projects, and handle other admin functions as needed.

Responsibilities

  • Work on smaller projects and communicate to all relevant departments in regards-to budgeting, production, post-production.
  • Review, Code, Authorize and submit to accounting all Invoices, Timecards and Expenses applicable to the coordinator’s projects.
  • Manage assigned projects through to final billing
  • Keep detailed records of assigned projects
  • Assist Project Managers with staying current with actualizing
  • Process paperwork and assist in the creation of a digital wrap binder
  • Be a resource to Project Managers on a day-to-day basis for any help required
  • Make sure paperwork and reports are filed and or disseminated to the appropriate PMs

Required Qualifications

  • College Degree-BA or BS in a Media related or business or Project Management program
  • 3-5 years professional office experience
  • Extremely proficient in MS Office products, especially Excel and Teams
  • Must have exceptional organizational, communication, judgment, and interpersonal skills
  • Experience with budgeting and planning/scheduling and managing of projects
  • Client handling experience
  • A strong ability to multi-task and detail oriented
  • Ability to maintain the highest level of confidentiality

Preferred Qualifications

  • 3-5 years of Production and Post-Production experience

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics

The candidate should be a self-starter with strong communication skills. The candidate should also be able to keep all relevant parties informed on the status of their project or tasks daily. The Project Coordinator will need to demonstrate extremely strong organizational skills and maintain meticulous records of all their projects and assist the Project Managers with their records. job.title: Seasonal Recruiter
job.description:
The Seasonal Recruiter will lead seasonal recruitment efforts for various NFL offices. In this role, you will be a talent advisor and build strong relationships with the senior management team. The successful candidate will play a pivotal role with senior management, hiring managers, compensation, finance, and HR Business Partners in driving hiring and employee retention efficiencies that support the NFL's vision, mission, and values.

Please note this role is in-person/office five days a week based in Inglewood, CA. Up to seven months of anticipated engagement (subject to change based on business needs).

Responsibilities

  • Manage 40 to 50+ open seasonal requisitions at once across multiple departments and locations during peak hiring periods
  • Execute full-cycle, high volume recruitment including screening, interviewing, and extending offers
  • Support Early Career recruitment efforts during non-peak seasonal hiring times
  • Build strong working relationships with HR and hiring managers to understand business needs, seasonal headcount planning, and job requirements
  • Identify, and recruit candidates for a wide range of temporary roles across media, production, and game operations
  • Maintain accurate and organized data in the applicant tracking system (Greenhouse) for all candidates and requisitions
  • Create and deliver regular search status updates to hiring managers and partners
  • Ensure equitable hiring processes in line with NFL standards and policies
  • Build and maintain talent pipelines to support recurring seasonal staffing needs
  • Represent the NFL at in person or virtual hiring events, job fairs, and recruiting programs as needed
  • Manage offer processes including recommendations, drafting and extending offers, and negotiations as permitted
  • Ensure onboarding requirements are completed, including background checks, offer letters, new hire paperwork, and start date coordination
  • Partner with HR teams to support smooth onboarding experiences
  • Ensure compliance with EEO, ADA, and all applicable federal and state employment laws

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree with 4+ years of high‑volume recruitment experience, or an equivalent combination of education and experience
  • Demonstrated ability to efficiently manage 40 to 50+ high‑volume requisitions simultaneously
  • Experience working with various recruitment platforms including, but not limited to Greenhouse, LinkedIn, and HireVue.
  • Strong working knowledge of federal and state employment law as well as corporate recruitment processes
  • Superior candidate management experience
  • Excellent project management skills

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics

  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment
  • Experience supporting large‑scale, fast‑turnaround staffing initiatives
  • Strong business acumen and the ability to quickly learn operational needs across multiple departments
  • Ability to work both collaboratively and independently with minimal supervision
  • Detail‑oriented with the ability to manage competing priorities and tight deadlines
  • Consistent follow‑through, strong initiative, and proactive problem‑solving skills

Terms /Expected Hours of Work

  • Up to seven months of anticipated engagement (subject to change based on business needs)
  • NFL employees are required to work 40 hours per week and at times, this role may require overtime (time worked in excess of 40 hours) and/or weekends in office.
  • FLSA non-exempt
  • Please note that this job posting is for a position with one of the NFL’s third-party agency partners that provides services to the NFL.

The NFL expects to hire for this position near the middle of the range. Only in truly rare and exceptional circumstances, where an external candidate has experience, credentials or expertise that far exceed those required or expected for the position, would the NFL consider paying a salary or rate near the higher end of the range.

job.title: Seasonal Rights & Clearances Coordinator
job.description:
Summary

The Rights & Clearances Coordinator is responsible for researching, sourcing, and securing third‑party materials for use in NFL Films programming. This role works closely with producers, post‑production, media management, business affairs, and project managers to fulfill content needs while ensuring all material is properly licensed according to deadlines, budgets, and legal requirements.

Essential Functions

  • Research, request, and acquire third‑party materials including—but not limited to—photos, footage, newspaper articles, social media posts, podcasts, and other intellectual property.
  • Navigate and research archival collections, stock footage libraries, and professional photo agencies to locate hard‑to‑find materials.
  • Screen down cuts/programs and create detailed clearance logs to document all third‑party material usage.
  • Secure licenses, permissions, and releases for all third‑party content used in NFL Films programming.
  • Serve as a resource for production teams regarding rights, usage restrictions, and clearance options at all stages of production.
  • Track, organize, and maintain accurate records for all research and clearance documentation including agreements, invoices, purchase orders, and correspondence.
  • Communicate with internal departments to move acquired materials through workflows and deliver them to producers.
  • Maintain strong administrative procedures and uphold departmental standards.
  • Learn and use internal rights/clearance tracking systems and screening tools.

Required Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent experience.
  • Minimum 2 years dedicated Rights & Clearances or Archival Producing experience.
  • Foundational understanding of third‑party rights, licensing, and clearances.

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Experience in post‑production or within a similar archival/rights/clearances environment.
  • Experience with AirTable or similar systems.
  • Experience navigating and interpreting EDLs.
  • Proven negotiation experience with major archives, stock footage/photo libraries, and independent rights holders

Key Attributes / Characteristics

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Exceptional organizational and time‑management skills.
  • Strong problem‑solving ability; resourceful and proactive.
  • Ability to manage sensitive or confidential information.
  • Flexibility to be on call for occasional weekend work.
  • Comfort working in deadline‑driven environments with shifting priorities.

Supervisory Responsibility

  • Assist with training and mentoring interns as needed.

Physical Demands

  • Occasional handling of physical archival materials such as footage reels, tapes, newspapers, and photo collections.

Travel

  • No regular travel expected.

job.title: Seasonal Vertical Video Editor
job.description:
The NFL is seeking a Seasonal Vertical Video editor and programmer to work with the Digital Video team on producing content for the NFL's YouTube and social channels, focusing on the ideation, curation, and execution of vertical video. The Digital Video team is responsible for distributing and programming content across the NFL’s digital ecosystem, reaching millions of NFL fans each day. The Vertical Video editor will play a key role in producing short form content for NFL Media digital platforms, as well as engaging fans on YouTube and social by programming engaging content for NFL’s broad fanbase leveraging content from games, NFL podcasts, NFL studio shows, NFL archive, and premiere NFL events such as Playoffs and Super Bowl.

Responsibilities

  • Upload videos daily in a timely manner to all NFL YouTube channels and NFL Media owned social platforms with a focus on the short form vertical format, ensuring that content, titles and descriptions meet NFL brand, legal and editorial requirements.
  • Select, edit, and reformat content across the NFL ecosystem including but not limited to podcasts, studio shows, social, etc to engage fans across NFL YouTube channels (e.g. NFL, NFL Flag, NFL Rush, NFL Pro, etc.).
  • Monitor consumption and performance of content with the analytics group, understanding algorithm trends and sharing key learnings and insights with colleagues, clubs, etc.
  • Attend production meetings and brainstorms providing expertise on how to position/package content for YouTube and helping to develop new concepts or extensions of content tailored for YouTube.
  • Collaborate with colleagues across social, marketing, programming, and production to ensure content from NFL podcasts, studio shows and long form content is optimized for vertical distribution across NFL YouTube Channels and NFL Media social platforms.
  • Research NFL history for pertinent projects.
  • Utilize the NFL robust library of shows and games to re-purpose segments from features into short form vertical video content

Required Qualifications

  • Must be willing and able to work flexible hours, including early mornings, late nights, weekends, Holidays, and special events/instances of breaking news
  • Strong knowledge of NFL football (Teams, Players, History, Major Storylines)
  • Strong Adobe Photoshop and Premiere skills and demonstrated ability in all aspects of video production.
  • 1-3 years of experience programming and creating vertical content for YouTube, TikTok, Instagram

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in journalism or related field preferred

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics

  • Ability to multi-task, manage deadlines and work in a busy environment
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Strong organizational and prioritization skills
  • Ability to collaborate with internal colleagues and external partners

Terms / Expected Hours of Work

  • Seasonal employment up to 7 months
  • 40 hours per week
  • Must be willing and able to work flexible hours, including early mornings, late nights, weekends, holidays, and special events/instances of breaking news

job.description:
The NFL Global Creative Marketing team is seeking a versatile seasonal video editor adept in the Adobe Creative Suite who will help bring to life imaginative video content. This position will be executing a variety of projects and campaigns, including support for owned & operated social channels, player social media support, original content series, marketing campaigns and more. Success in this position is reliant on being a self-starter with a willingness to learn and grow alongside the brand. The successful candidate is a creative thinker with a passion for storytelling, with a deep understanding of and experience with creating social video.

  • Thorough knowledge of the National Football League, associated events and storylines

job.description:
The primary function of this role is to support the financial planning and analysis activities for the Global Partnerships departments. This role leads forecasting, budgeting, and long-range planning deliverables, providing data-driven insights that inform leadership decisions across multiple corporate functions. The position ensures financial accuracy, consistency, and transparency with supported departments while partnering closely with leadership to align budgets and resources with organizational priorities.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead the preparation of monthly forecasts, annual budgets, and long-range plans for the Global Partnerships departments.
  • Deliver timely and accurate financial reporting, variance analyses, and insights that support executive reviews and decision-making.
  • Collaborate closely with the Global Controller’s team to understand variances across the period-end close cycles.
  • Partner with functional leaders to align departmental financial targets with enterprise objectives.
  • Develop financial models and scenario analyses to support operational and strategic initiatives across multiple functions.
  • Ensure consistency and accuracy in FP&A processes, templates, and reporting standards.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional partners in Finance, Global Accounting, and Global Shared Services to streamline planning, budgeting, and reporting workflows.

job.title: Senior Director, Creative
job.description:
The Senior Creative Director, NFL Brand Experience, shares in the leadership of the NFL’s in-house creative agency. The Brand Experience team is responsible for setting the creative foundation and story for nearly every expression of the National Football League’s brand. From global events like Super Bowl, Draft and a growing slate of International Games around the world, to the brands, identities and uniform designs of the 32 Clubs, to every cause or initiative, to apparel and fashion and beyond, the Brand Experience team is there, where the brand meets our fans. The Senior Creative Director is a mentor and culture-carrier, who is as passionate about how we work, as they are with the creative excellence of the work we produce.

Responsibilities

  • Reporting to the department head - VP, Head of Global Brand Experience in fostering a creative, supportive and inspiring team culture.
  • Leadership of multiple design teams overseeing the branding and creative strategy for global NFL events.
    • Mentorship and career development of creative talent and the future leadership of the team.
  • Representing the Brand Experience team with NFL Club ownership, internal executives, media, and host cities and communities around the world. A steward of the team, our reputation, and our ability to shine light on the cultures and stories wherever football takes us.
  • Work in collaboration with the Director of Project Management to oversee all team operations including the evaluation and refinement of the team’s workflow and creative processes
    • Managing the creative development and delivery calendar
    • Support the oversight of the department budget and budget planning
  • Oversee the documentation and promotion of the team’s output, including:
    • Managing the capture of our behind the scenes, process and artist collaborative content
    • Managing the yearly submission of work for industry recognition and promotion cross-organizationally

Required Qualifications

  • 10-15+ years of creative leadership experience
  • Insatiable curiosity and a truly unique creative point of view
    • Deep knowledge of NFL football is helpful, but not a requirement. Creative drive, fresh thinking, and extraordinary human-first leadership skills are essential. X’s and O’s are teachable.
  • Proven experience, excellence and innovation in the following areas of design and studio or agency leadership (but not limited to):
    • Large scale event and experiential design
    • Identity design and typography
    • Brand building, brief writing - an overall high level of communication savvy
    • Design for retail, fashion and consumer products
    • Video and motion design
    • Budget, workflow and timeline management
    • Photo/video shoot
    • Comfort and skill in presentation, public speaking and media
    • Meaningful engagement with and use of AI as not only a tool for efficiency, but creative empowerment and exploration

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics

  • Servant leadership approach to people, mentorship and collaboration.
  • A true culture-carrier. A catalyst for inspiration, engaged in the industry, in the world at large, and proactively bringing that inspiration and wider view to the team.
  • Outstanding presentation and communication. Flexibility and empathy. This team makes excellent work every day. That’s the easy part. Protecting how it feels to do that work together, and how it feels to interface with this team, is everything.

Preferred Qualifications

  • MFA in design or creative field
  • At least 7+ years of team leadership experience

Terms / Expected Hours of Work

NFL employees are required to work 40 hours per week. The role will require some weekend and extended time when on-site for events. This role is on-site at the NFL’s New York office.

Physical Demands

Be prepared for an active role on-site at our major events.

Travel

Approximately 35% travel

job.title: Senior Manager, Commercial Accounts (France)
job.description:
The Senior Manager, Commercial Accounts will be responsible for successfully managing all partners who have sponsorship rights in France to meet annual revenue targets.

The role will require someone who possesses strong leadership skills with experience of working cross functionally and championing partner programs internally. Results will be measured against team performance, sponsorship revenue, activation, and satisfaction, along with increased and improved fan engagement metrics.

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

Exceptional Partnership Management:

  • Develop relationships with existing NFL partners and be adept at resolving partner issues, thinking creatively and efficiently to reach solutions.
  • Identify and contact key decision makers at C-suite level.
  • Lead on local renewals process for Partners and support the team on upsells to meet revenue targets, collaborating closely with the global team to capitalize on available activation funds.

Support Revenue Growth through New Business

  • Support Global New Business by providing market perspectives, identifying relevant local targets / contacts, and recommending / prioritizing white space opportunities.
  • Collaborate closely with NFL Marketing and Consumer Products teams to develop integrated partnership solutions that align sponsor objectives with NFL fan growth and engagement priorities.
  • Proactively identify opportunities and revenue streams including exploitation of traditional inventory and digital opportunities
  • Analyze opportunities for growth in new areas to drive profitability and conduct regular analysis to mitigate any potential risks.
  • Provide support using key sponsorship and valuation metrics during contractual discussions.
  • Build innovative and tailored propositions that attract and convince potential sponsors to partner with the NFL.
  • Manage local sales agencies ensuring they execute their scope of work and provide support as needed.
  • Adopt a proactive approach to secure incremental revenue, working closely with the international team as well as Marketing and Consumer Products department.

Flawless In-Market Activation Execution

  • Work with the Global Sponsorship Team, to ensure a consistent look and feel is achieved and a joined-up approach, where relevant is adopted.
  • Manage local activation agencies to ensure they execute their respective scopes and provide support as needed.
  • Lead and oversee the activation and asset development of key League priorities including International Games, and in-market tentpole activations (e.g., Kickoff Watch Parties, Super Bowl watch parties)
  • Support Club Business Development with team activity and new partnerships, advising on local guidance based on local partner rights.

Serve as an In-Market Leader

  • Oversee the partnership delivery program to ensure assets are available and inventory is being carefully managed.
  • Actively provide feedback for continuous improvement based on market knowledge and executional requirements.
  • Maintain strong marketplace knowledge about industry trends and company spend in sponsorship/ marketing.
  • Act as a local expert on French consumer behavior, sports marketing trends, sponsorship innovation, and emerging fan engagement opportunities.
  • Champion a marketing-first approach to partnership development by identifying opportunities where brand storytelling, content, and experiences can drive greater commercial impact.

Collaborate with and Manage Internal Stakeholders

  • Provide updates to Country Manager, France, and US Global Sponsorship Team on day-to-day partner management matters, including efficient pipeline and status reporting.
  • Successfully navigate through a complex matrix business with poise and maturity, whilst ensuring the best interests of the team and commercial partners are protected.
  • Responsible for the discretionary commercial budget and reporting into, Country Manager, France, NFL Finance team and US Global Sponsorship Team regularly.
  • Align with the reporting process internationally to ensure that all internal departments are engaged with NFL Partners and provide the necessary support to deliver against Partner objectives, with constant communication and collaboration.
  • Foster the best possible professional relationships with Partners, agencies, internal stakeholders, and colleagues.
  • Collaborate with other departments, including finance, legal, public relations, and marketing, to ensure the successful contracting and sign-off of any new program.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree
  • 7 years’ experience in commercial, sales, partnerships or with agency
  • 3 years management experience
  • Fluent in French and English

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Sports background
  • Experience working within sports marketing, brand partnerships, consumer marketing, advertising agencies, media companies, or entertainment organizations
  • League or Club experience
  • Client management experience
  • Sales/Revenue generation
  • Additional language proficiency preferred.

Other Key Attributes / Talent Characteristics:

  • Commercial marketer, with strong business acumen who understands how to connect fan passion, brand objectives, and revenue generation
  • Communicates clearly and inspires the team through action
  • Excellent organizational skills, multi-tasker, and confident presenter
  • Proven evidence of planning, forecasting, and decision making
  • Adept with research, evaluation and industry analysis tools and methodologies
  • Self-reliant and able to work well unsupervised and demonstrate initiative, yet equally a team player who can follow instruction and support others
  • Effective management and delegation
  • Ability to develop direct reports’ skillsets and create career development paths.
  • Understanding of a multi-faceted business operation
  • Has a flexible and 'hands-on' approach
  • Ethical and diligent with a strong personal commitment to deliver at pace.
  • Works well under pressure adapting to tight deadlines and differing demands.
  • Possess good judgement and behavioral maturity.
  • Ambitious and hungry for opportunity
