job.title: Senior Manager, Event Operations, UK (External Agency Position)
job.description:
The NFL Event Operations team is seeking an experienced and highly organized Senior Manager of Event Operations to lead the planning, overlay and delivery of NFL International Games across the UK and Europe.

Reporting to the Director of Event Operations, this role will provide senior operational leadership from initial planning and stadium overlay through to Gameday delivery and post-event assessment. The role will lead an event operations team and work closely with stadium and city partners, NFL clubs, vendors and a broad range of stakeholders to deliver world-class NFL games in Europe. The successful candidate will bring a strong understanding of complex live-event environments, exceptional project management skills and the ability to lead confidently in a high-pressure, fast-paced environment. The role will be primarily based at the NFL UK offices in London, with relocation to host stadiums during game weeks. Frequent international travel, as well as evening and weekend work will be required.

This is an exciting opportunity to join a dynamic and growing team, with responsibility for high-profile International Games in Europe and opportunities to contribute to the wider portfolio of NFL League events.

This job posting is for a position with one of the NFL’s third-party agency partners that provides services to the NFL. The individual selected for this role will be an employee of that third-party agency and not the NFL. All compensation, benefits, and other terms and conditions of employment are handled by the agency. The assignment to provide services to the NFL will be limited in duration but may be extended for an additional period by agreement between the NFL and the agency.

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Serve as a senior operational lead on site, providing direction and making real-time decisions throughout planning, event build, Gameday and load out.
  • Lead the development and delivery of comprehensive operational overlay plans for NFL International Games at host stadiums.
  • Lead stadium transformation, construction and conversion planning, ensuring all requirements are delivered safely, efficiently and to the required NFL standard.
  • Develop and manage detailed operational plans, master schedules, construction timelines and event readiness documentation.
  • Lead coordination across all internal and external stakeholders, including stadium and city partners, Ticketing, Broadcast, Football Operations, Game Presentation, Security, Marketing, Partnerships and other relevant functions.
  • Lead the management and delivery of third-party vendors, including contract deliverables, operational requirements and on-site performance.
  • Manage the stadium operations budget, including forecasting, cost control, purchase orders and payments.
  • Provide clear operational leadership and decision-making throughout game week, proactively identifying and resolving issues and escalating critical matters where appropriate.
  • Support the planning and delivery of sponsor and partner activations within the wider event environment.
  • Ensure appropriate health, safety and operational compliance standards are maintained throughout planning, build and event delivery.
  • Work closely with relevant stakeholders to develop and implement contingency and risk-management plans.
  • Lead post-event debriefs, assessments and reporting, identifying lessons learned and opportunities for continuous improvement.
  • Contribute to the development of operational best practices, processes and standards for future International Games and wider NFL events.

Experience & Qualifications

  • Extensive knowledge and proven experience planning and delivering complex, large-scale live events.
  • Educated to degree or equivalent professional experience.
  • 8+ years' experience working within a stadium, venue, live events or comparable operational environment.
  • Demonstrated experience within professional sports, entertainment, major events or complex project planning and delivery.
  • Strong project and program management skills, with the ability to manage multiple workstreams, stakeholders and competing priorities.
  • Proven experience leading and developing an operational delivery team.
  • Experience managing external vendors, contractors and commercial partners.
  • Strong understanding of stadium operations, event overlay, event infrastructure and live-event logistics.
  • Experience operating in an international or multi-market environment is desirable.
  • Knowledge or understanding of American Football and the NFL is desirable.

Leadership Attributes

The successful candidate will demonstrate:

  • Exceptional organization and time management, with the ability to prioritize effectively and consistently deliver against critical deadlines.
  • Strong judgment and problem-solving skills, with the ability to anticipate issues, develop solutions and make confident decisions in high-pressure environments.
  • The ability to manage upwards, provide clear recommendations and communicate effectively with senior leaders.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build alignment and drive collaboration across multiple teams and functions.
  • Strong presentation skills, with the confidence to communicate operational plans, risks and key decisions to large audiences and senior stakeholders.
  • Adaptability and resilience, with the ability to remain calm, focused and solutions-oriented in a constantly changing live-event environment.
  • Exceptional stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence, negotiate and build trusted relationships with internal colleagues, stadium and city partners, vendors and other external stakeholders.
  • A collaborative leadership style, with the ability to motivate teams, create accountability and bring people together around a common goal.
  • High levels of integrity, professionalism and personal accountability.
  • An enthusiastic, proactive and positive approach, with a genuine commitment to delivering the highest standards of operational excellence.

People Management

  • Proven experience managing and leading a team of at least three direct reports or equivalent operational resources.
  • Ability to provide clear direction, priorities and communication throughout complex event planning and delivery.
  • Demonstrated track record of coaching, developing and supporting team members to achieve their full potential.
  • Ability to build a high-performing team culture based on accountability, collaboration and continuous improvement.

Terms / Expected Hours of Work

  • Requires extensive travel to host stadiums and other event locations across the UK and Europe.
  • Requires flexibility to work evenings, weekends and holidays, particularly during event and game weeks.

job.title: Senior Manager, Global Event Production
job.description:
The NFL is seeking a Senior Manager of Event Production to support the delivery and management of the NFL’s U.S.-based tentpole events as well as Latin America, Australia, and Asia, with a primary focus on fan experiences. This role will contribute to event planning, operational execution, and fan engagement initiatives, helping deliver high-quality experiences that align with broader business, commercial, marketing, and international market objectives.

Responsibilities

Event Management

  • Proven experience supporting the planning and delivery of both large and small-scale events across the U.S. and internationally
  • Operational experience across sport and fan/public events
  • Working knowledge of key event components, including security operations, health and safety, local authority coordination, programming, community engagement, scheduling, branding/creative, and procurement
  • Ability to create reporting to relevant stakeholders, including post mortems

Fan Event Delivery

  • Support the planning and execution of events supporting Super Bowl, Draft, Combine, NFL FLAG (domestic tentpole events)S, as well as year-round activities in collaboration with local international offices and key business functions
  • Assist in delivering gameday and non-gameday fan experiences, kickoff events, watch parties, local market activations internationally, NFL club activations, community initiatives, partner integration, and lead generation activities
  • Conduit to the NFL OnePass app (event companion app) content and engagement

Budgeting

  • Support the tracking and management of fan event budgets in the U.S. and internationally
  • Assist in monitoring costs to ensure delivery within agreed targets, highlighting risks and opportunities
  • Contribute to building event budgets in line with event plans and League procurement processes

Agency Management

  • Support the day-to-day management of event agencies across fan events
  • Assist with RFP processes and onboarding of vendors where required
  • Maintain strong working relationships with agency partners

Team & Stakeholder Collaboration

  • Collaborate with internal teams and external stakeholders to support successful event delivery
  • Contribute to cross-functional working groups globally
  • Assist in coordinating with external partners, including city/host authorities, local organizing committees, government sports bodies, and stadium/team partners

Required Qualifications

  • 7+ years’ experience in the events and/or hospitality industry
  • Some prior experience in team leadership or mentoring
  • Strong knowledge of delivering large-scale fan or public events
  • Experience managing or supporting event budgets
  • Experience working with multiple partners and agencies
  • Strong stakeholder management skills
  • Commercial awareness with the ability to support revenue-generating initiatives
  • Interest in or understanding of American Football is a plus

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics

  • Highly organized with strong time management skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities
  • Effective problem-solver with sound judgment and decision-making ability
  • Confident communicator with the ability to collaborate across teams
  • Strong presentation and interpersonal skills
  • Adaptable and resilient in a fast-paced, evolving environment
  • Builds positive working relationships with internal and external stakeholders
  • Proactive, enthusiastic, and committed to high standards

Management Expectations

  • Experience supporting or mentoring junior team members
  • Ability to contribute to a positive, collaborative team environment
  • Willingness to learn and develop management capabilities

Terms / Expected Hours of Work

  • Willingness to travel domestically and internationally (30%)
  • Flexibility to work evenings and weekends as required

job.title: Senior Manager, Global Sponsorship & New Business Development (UK - External Agency Position)
job.description:
The Senior Manager, Global Sponsorship & New Business Development is a key member of the NFL's Global Sponsorship Business Development team, responsible for driving revenue through the development and sale of integrated global marketing partnerships.

Working across the NFL's international business, this role will identify, develop, and secure strategic partnerships that support the league's key growth priorities, including NFL FLAG, international expansion, game innovation, and audience growth among youth, multicultural, and women’s audiences. The successful candidate will play a critical role in identifying new business opportunities, cultivating senior-level relationships, and delivering innovative partnership solutions that create value for both the NFL and its partners.

This position is with a third-party agency that provides services to the NFL. The selected candidate will be employed by the agency, not the NFL, and will be based at the NFL’s office in London, UK. The agency will be responsible for all compensation, benefits, and other terms and conditions of employment. The assignment supporting the NFL will be for a defined period and may be extended by mutual agreement between the NFL and the agency.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Build and manage a strong pipeline of prospective global and regional partners to achieve sponsorship revenue targets.
  • Identify and qualify new business opportunities through market research, category analysis, and strategic prospecting, with a particular focus on international markets where dedicated sales resources do not exist.
  • Develop and maintain relationships with senior marketing executives, Fortune 500 decision-makers, agency leaders, and other key influencers across the sports marketing landscape.
  • Lead the full sales process—from prospecting and outreach through pitch development, negotiation, and contract execution.
  • Collaborate across the NFL to develop creative, integrated partnership opportunities that align with prospective partners' business objectives while supporting the league's strategic priorities.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams, including Media, Technology, Football Operations, Social Responsibility, and other business units, to create customized sponsorship platforms that maximize commercial value.
  • Develop compelling sales presentations, proposals, and partnership strategies tailored to individual prospects.
  • Maintain accurate sales pipeline data, forecasts, and reporting while ensuring opportunities progress efficiently through the sales cycle.
  • Partner with the Director to support and manage the Sponsorship Business Development Coordinator and contribute to the team's overall success.
  • Contribute new ideas and commercial thinking that help unlock incremental sponsorship opportunities and drive long-term revenue growth.

Qualifications & Experience:

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Finance, Communications, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Minimum of seven years of relevant professional experience within a sports league, team, rights holder, agency, media company, or global brand, including experience in areas such as partnership activation, account management, sponsorship, or business development.
  • Demonstrated sponsorship sales and new business development experience, including prospecting, pitching, negotiation, and closing commercial partnerships.
  • Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with senior stakeholders.
  • Strong relationship-building and influencing skills, both internally and externally.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint, Excel, and Word.
  • Highly organized, with excellent project management, prioritization, and time management skills.
  • Valid passport and willingness to travel internationally as required.

Key Attributes:

  • Commercially driven, proactive, and motivated by opportunities to connect leading global brands with one of the world's most recognized sports properties.
  • Deep understanding of sponsorship, sports marketing, and partnership landscape.
  • Experience in prospecting, market research, outreach, pitch development, and strategic proposal creation.
  • Confident storyteller with the ability to translate insights into compelling commercial narratives.
  • Collaborative team player who thrives in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment and builds credibility with stakeholders at all levels.
  • Well-connected within the marketing and sponsorship industry, with experience developing relationships with senior marketing and brand leaders.

job.title: Senior Manager, International Data & Strategy
job.description:
We are seeking a highly motivated Senior Manager, International Data & Strategy, to lead and scale the NFL’s international managed model as part of a transformative enterprise initiative. In this role, you will partner closely with League and Club stakeholders to deliver high-quality, scalable data solutions and program operations that enable informed decision-making and drive business outcomes across global markets.

The ideal candidate brings 6 - 8+ years of experience with a demonstrated track record of delivering centralized, enterprise-scale initiatives. You will work hands-on across data strategy, technology, and program execution—owning delivery, driving cross-functional alignment, translating business needs into actionable requirements, and ensuring scalable, high-quality outputs.

This role is well-suited for a strategic yet hands-on leader who thrives in a fast-paced, evolving environment, excels at stakeholder management, and is passionate about leveraging data to unlock value and build scalable enterprise capabilities.

Responsibilities

  • Leadership: Drive cross-functional alignment and champion adoption of the International managed model through clear communication, best practices, and continuous improvement.
  • Program Management: Oversee day-to-day program operations for the international managed model, tracking progress across data onboarding, curation, fulfillment, reporting and insights.
  • Customer Partnership: Partner closely with clubs to drive adoption of the international managed model by capturing requirements and translating them into prioritized program initiatives.
  • Data Product Architecture: Translate business needs into scalable data and platform requirements to support segmentation, data access, and performance measurement.
  • Operational Excellence: Ensure efficient and consistent execution by establishing standardized processes and continuously optimizing workflows.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Engineering, or related field; advanced degree preferred.
  • 6 - 8+ years of progressive experience in data strategy, product management, data governance, or technology leadership roles, with demonstrated ownership of enterprise-scale initiatives.
  • Proven track record leading complex data and analytics programs, including cloud data platforms, data lakes, governance frameworks, and cross-functional transformation efforts.
  • Strong understanding of privacy, regulatory, and compliance requirements, including GDPR, CCPA, consent management, and responsible data practices.
  • Experience supporting fan, customer, or consumer-centric organizations, with knowledge of engagement strategies, audience development, and lifecycle marketing preferred.
  • Demonstrated experience leveraging enterprise data and marketing technology platforms, including AWS Redshift, Adobe Experience Platform (AEP), Adobe Experience Manager (AEM), Adobe Journey Optimizer (AJO), Power BI, Tableau, or similar technologies.
  • Exceptional executive communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence senior leaders, drive alignment across business and technology teams, and translate strategy into measurable outcomes.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead through ambiguity, drive organizational change, and scale processes, capabilities, and teams to support evolving business needs.
  • Strong strategic and operational mindset, with experience establishing governance models, prioritizing competing demands, managing risks, and delivering results in fast-paced environments.

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics

  • Master’s degree or higher in statistics, data science, computer science, or other data related fields preferred

  • Limited Travel

job.title: Senior Manager, New Business Development & Emerging Markets, Australia
job.description:
The Senior Manager, New Business Development & Emerging Markets, is a key part of the global consumer products team, responsible for identifying Consumer Products opportunities, setting the strategy for NFL emerging markets and accelerating revenue growth across international CP. This role will work closely with the international strategy team, local GMs, and cross functions across the organization to identify new market opportunities and drive long term brand expansion and fandom in key emerging regions around the world. The ideal candidate brings deep international licensing experience, strong commercial acumen, and a passion for growing sport globally.

Responsibilities:

  • Develop and execute NFL’s international licensing strategy across emerging markets, including, APAC and Middle East.
  • Build licensing agency strategy for key emerging markets. Identify best in class agency partners and manage these relationships.
  • Lead relationship with licensing agencies on record on expansion into key regions.
  • Identify, negotiate, and manage new licensing agreements with regional and local partners across apparel, accessories, and lifestyle products; partner with licensing agency where relevant.
  • Collaborate with international marketing teams to build programs and campaigns that drive revenue and support fan growth.
  • Analyze market trends, consumer behavior, and competitive landscape to inform licensing strategy and product portfolio.
  • Build locally relevant programs and story telling relevant to each market/region.
  • Partner with Events team on any local in-market fan events, developing event-based retail presence and execution.
  • Manage ongoing relationships with licensees, including business reviews, product approvals, assortment planning, etc.
  • Develop and manage key retailer relationships within each market/region.
  • Develop annual consumer products business plan for each region and update quarterly.
  • Partner with Sponsorship on identifying and executing joint commercial opportunities.
  • Own local city or stakeholder relationship from a licensing perspective.
  • Track KPIs, forecast revenue, and provide regular business reporting to senior leadership.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s Degree required, MBA preferred
  • 8+ years experience in sports licensing, with a strong emphasis on international expansion
  • Proven track record of negotiating and managing complex partner agreements across multiple regions, specifically APAC and MENA
  • Experience with licensing agency selection and management
  • Deep understanding of APAC and MENA retail landscapes, sports product distribution models, and building market entry strategies, including branded retail
  • Experience working with global sports brands
  • Experience executing experiential event retail at large scale tentpole events
  • Strong knowledge of American Football, specifically youth programs
  • Strong financial acumen, including forecasting, budgeting, and royalty modelling
  • Exceptional negotiation, communication, and partner management skills
  • Ability to operate in a fast paced, matrixed, global organization

job.title: Senior Manager, Player Engagement
job.description:
The Senior Manager, Player Engagement is responsible for serving, equipping and empowering NFL players and Club Heads of Player Engagement (HPE) within the five Player Engagement pillars (continuing education, financial empowerment, personal and professional development and HPE development). The Senior Manager supports a cluster of 8 club HPEs and serves as the lead for player mandatory education per the Collective Bargaining Agreement. In addition, the role will lead/support multiple Player Engagement initiatives and programs.

job.description:

As a key member of the Global Digital Fan Engagement leadership team, this executive will lead Product and Design functions responsible for creating world-class fan experiences across web, mobile, connected television (CTV), identity, subscription, and viewing platforms.

Working in close partnership with Strategy & Growth, Technology, Content, Marketing, Business Operations, and other key departments across the NFL, the VP, Product & Design will translate business priorities into product roadmaps and deliver experiences that deepen fan engagement, improve experience quality, and support the NFL's long-term strategic priorities.

This role requires an experienced and dynamic product executive capable of leading organizational evolution, establishing product management excellence, and building a high-performing team within a complex and highly visible media ecosystem.

  • Establish product management practices that improve prioritization, execution quality, and organizational alignment

  • Establish experience standards and design principles across content discovery, viewing, personalization, subscription, and engagement journeys
  • Ensure consistency and quality across all fan-facing experiences

  • Partner with Technology to align product roadmaps with technical feasibility, platform architecture, capacity management, and release planning
  • Partner with Strategy & Growth to translate agreed business objectives, priority fan segments, value propositions, and desired outcomes into product experiences

job.title: IT Network Manager
job.description:
OVERVIEW

A thriving, mission-driven multimedia organization, NPR produces award-winning news, information, and music programming in partnership with hundreds of independent public radio stations across the nation. The NPR audience values information, creativity, curiosity, and social responsibility – and our employees do too. We are innovators and leaders in diverse fields, from journalism and digital media to IT and development. Every day, our employees and member stations touch the lives of millions worldwide.

Across our organization, we’re building a workplace where collaboration is essential, diverse voices are heard, and inclusion is the key to our success. We are committed to doing the right thing in our journalism and in every role at NPR. This means that integrity, adherence to our ethical standards, and compliance with legal obligations are fundamental responsibilities for every employee at NPR.

Intro to Position

As our IT Network Manager, you will lead a dedicated team of network and voice engineers while bridging the gap between traditional enterprise networking and cutting-edge broadcast technology. We are looking for a people-first, Cisco-certified leader to guide, mentor, and empower an engineering team overseeing the lifecycle of our network infrastructure. Beyond technical mastery, you will cultivate a high-performing team culture centered on collaboration, continuous growth, high availability, and proactive security. If you thrive in inspiring technical talent within an 'always-on' environment and have a passion for seamless media delivery, this is your next challenge.

Responsibilities

  • Team Leadership & Talent Development: Build, lead, and mentor a high-performing team of network and voice engineers; establish clear goals, manage team performance, drive professional development, and champion a collaborative, supportive engineering culture.
  • Enterprise Architecture & Infrastructure Management: Oversee the design, implementation, and optimization of enterprise network, wireless, and Storage Area Networking (SAN) infrastructure across Cisco ACI, Catalyst/Nexus, Firepower (FTD), SD-WAN, and Meraki platforms.
  • Broadcast Network Alignment: Partner with broadcast engineering teams to guide your team in maintaining a high-availability IP broadcast network that carries low-latency, real-time audio and video traffic for NPR’s daily content production and live transmission.
  • Operational Excellence & Incident Leadership: Lead network operations, incident management, and root-cause analysis for complex issues; coach team members through high-pressure troubleshooting using monitoring tools like SolarWinds, Cisco Nexus Dashboard, and ThousandEyes.
  • Documentation & Standards: Develop and maintain network architecture documentation, standard operating procedures, and routing protocols (BGP, EIGRP), ensuring network reliability, scalability, security, and team operational best practices.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration & Executive Stakeholder Communication: Collaborate with Security, DevOps, Systems, and Enterprise Application teams, while effectively communicating network performance, risk analyses, incident reports, and strategic initiatives to senior leadership.

The above duties and responsibilities are not an exhaustive list of required responsibilities, duties and skills. Other duties may be assigned, and this job description can be modified at any time.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience in enterprise networking.
  • 3+ years directly managing and developing technical teams in a network leadership or manager role.
  • Proven track record of talent development, performance management, team building, and leading engineering teams through major operational projects.
  • Strong hands-on experience with at least two of the following:
    • Cisco Nexus (NX-OS)
    • Cisco Firepower (FTD)
    • Cisco Routing and Switching
    • Cisco ACI
    • Cisco SD-WAN
    • Cisco Meraki
    • Enterprise Wireless Networks
  • Strong expertise in routing and switching (BGP, EIGRP).
  • Experience with at least one of the following network management and observability platforms: SolarWinds, Cisco Nexus Dashboard, Cisco Intersight, or similar enterprise network monitoring and management tools .
  • Strong troubleshooting, communication, team leadership, and documentation skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead technical teams through critical production outages and high-pressure incident response, ensuring fast service recovery, effective team coordination, and business continuity.
  • Ability to translate complex broadcast requirements into scalable network architectures, overseeing robust business continuity planning, and fostering a team culture of technical excellence and psychological safety.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Cisco CCNP (Enterprise or Data Center).
  • lCisco CCIE certification.
  • Experience with ThousandEyes.
  • Experience with high-quality, real-time audio and video over IP networks, such as SMPTE ST 2110 and NDI, particularly in a IP broadcast environment.
  • Working knowledge of PTP, SMPTE ST 2110, multicast, and QoS.
  • Experience with large-scale or multi-site enterprise environments.
  • Experience with network automation / Infrastructure as Code.
  • Experience with managing on-prem and hosted Telephony and AV systems.
  • Experience supporting audio/video transmission or production workflows.

Work Location & Requirements

  • Hybrid Permitted: This is a hybrid permitted role. The employee will be required to be in the office at the Washington, D.C. location as assigned. On-site assignments are determined by a monthly rotation schedule. The employee must also reside in Washington, D.C. / Maryland / Virginia Metro Area.

Job Type

  • This is a full-time, exempt position.

Compensation

Salary Range: The U.S. based anticipated salary range for this opportunity is $158,500 - $180,000 plus benefits. The range displayed reflects the minimum and maximum salaries NPR expects to provide for new hires for the position across all US locations.

NPR Benefits: NPR offers access to comprehensive benefits for employees and dependents. Regular, full-time employees scheduled to work 30 hours or more per week are eligible to enroll in NPR’s benefits options. Benefits include access to health and wellness, paid time off, and financial well-being. Plan options include medical, dental, vision, life/ accidental death and dismemberment, long-term disability, short-term disability, and voluntary retirement savings to all eligible NPR employees.

As our Mobile Software Engineering Manager on the Audience Technology team, you will lead a highly collaborative team of mobile software engineers building, testing, and delivering award-winning features for NPR's flagship mobile applications. You will partner closely with our Product, Design, Data, and Editorial teams to identify priorities, architect new features, and continuously improve existing applications. In this role, you will act as a primary champion of team health, career progression, and technical excellence.

  • Talent Acquisition & Onboarding: Lead recruitment and hiring efforts for software engineering vacancies on your team, and manage the structured onboarding and training of new engineering staff.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with product managers, UX designers, data analysts, and editorial partners across all stages of the product development lifecycle.
  • Agile Delivery Management: Lead the technical planning, scoping, and execution of future software projects, facilitating Agile ceremonies (stand-ups, backlog refinements, sprint planning, and retrospectives) as needed.
  • Technical Quality & Code Review: Conduct thorough software design and code reviews, providing constructive and substantive feedback to maintain code health, architectural integrity, and security standards.
  • Continuous Process Improvement: Analyze, propose, and implement engineering workflow improvements to enhance the speed, safety, and quality of software delivery.
  • Developer Experience Automation: Identify common engineering blockers and pain points, writing helper tools or automation scripts to optimize team developer experience (DX).
  • Incident & Production Support: Oversee and coordinate the team's response to critical mobile production bugs or infrastructure incidents.
  • Vendor & Contributor Management: Coordinate workflows, code standards, and deliverables for external contributors and specialized development vendors.

The above duties and responsibilities are not an exhaustive list of required responsibilities, duties and skills. Other duties may be assigned, and this job description can be modified at any time.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 2+ years of experience directly managing, mentoring, or leading mobile software engineers within an agile organization.
  • Prior experience as an individual contributor in engineering, testing, and shipping robust code for at least one large-scale mobile application.
  • Hands-on proficiency in modern mobile platform languages, specifically Swift/Objective-C (iOS) or Kotlin/Java (Android).
  • Strong working knowledge of native mobile release infrastructures (such as Apple App Store Connect/provisioning profiles or Google Play Console/staged rollouts).
  • Hands-on experience working with modern version control systems (primarily Git).
  • Demonstrated experience collaborating within cross-functional Agile/Scrum product teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Professional experience managing both internal employees and external agency vendors/contractors.
  • Experience with native mobile media streaming frameworks (such as AVKit/AVFoundation for iOS, or Media3/ExoPlayer for Android).
  • Familiarity with modern responsive design architectures (SwiftUI/Combine or Jetpack Compose/Coroutines), design patterns (MVVM), and automotive platforms (CarPlay/Android Auto).

Required Skills/Competencies

  • Technical Design & Communication: Ability to translate complex technical concepts, system architectures, and engineering trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Inclusive Leadership: Demonstrated competency in fostering an equitable, supportive, and inclusive team culture.

Application submissions for Office of the General Counsel (Copyright) Externship

  • Summer 2027 will close on Sunday, October 18th at 11:59pm ET.

Legal externs are vital contributors to the work of the Office of the General Counsel (“OGC”). The OGC is responsible for providing high-quality, cost-efficient, legal and related services to our NPR clients to achieve its mission of service to the public.

NPR is looking for a 2L or 3L who has a strong interest in copyright law, has taken a course in copyright law, and has comprehensive knowledge of basic copyright principles and fair use. The externship will provide an excellent opportunity to gain a greater understanding of the many legal issues involved in fair use analysis, rights management, and the audio licensing process.

NPR offers legal externships throughout the year. Course credit may be obtained by arrangement with individual law schools. During the summer, law clerks are expected to work full-time, 40 hours per week for 12 weeks. Fall and Spring externships can be on a part-time schedule (usually 15-20 hours per week) or a full-time schedule. Fall and Spring externships must be for course credit.

Responsibilities

The extern will gain practical experience working on issues related to copyright, fair use, and audio licensing, which will include assisting senior counsel with the following tasks:

  • Evaluating copyright issues in audio content (and occasional video content).
  • Researching copyright issues.
  • Making fair use determinations.
  • Drafting and/or organizing permissions agreements and otherwise assessing legal aspects of proposed licensing agreements.
  • Assisting with Rights Management issues.

The above duties and responsibilities are not an exhaustive list of required responsibilities, duties and skills. Other duties may be assigned, and this job description can be modified at any time.

  • Fair Use Law experience and/or familiarity.
  • Intellectual Property experience and/or familiarity.
  • Prior experience with licensing issues is preferred but not required

  • Candidates must have taken a course in copyright law or equivalent and be well-versed in the principles of fair use. .

Course Credit: This externship is designed to be a learning experience for law students for which school credit must be obtained. Applicants must be able to comply with their school’s requirements for academic credit.

School-sponsored Stipends: During the summer, this externship may alternately be compensated through a program in which the student receives a stipend from their school for non-profit work.

Legal externs are vital contributors to the work of the Office of the General Counsel (“OGC”). The OGC is responsible for providing high-quality, cost-efficient, legal and related services to our NPR clients to achieve its mission of service to the public.

The legal team at NPR supports divisions across the organization on issues such as commercial and contract law; nonprofit tax; governance; technology (including software licensing, satellite distribution, and artificial intelligence); intellectual property (including music rights, content licensing, copyright, and trademark); FCC and other regulatory matters; First Amendment; and employment and labor (including Title VII, labor relations and employment law).

NPR offers legal externships throughout the year. Course credit may be obtained by arrangement with individual law schools. job.description:
OVERVIEW

A thriving, mission-driven multimedia organization, NPR produces award-winning news, information, and music programming in partnership with hundreds of independent public radio stations across the nation. The NPR audience values information, creativity, curiosity, and social responsibility – and our employees do too. Application Deadline: Please submit your application materials by 11:59 pm EST Sunday September 13th, 2026

Intro to Position

We are seeking a data-driven and highly creative marketing strategist to grow our audience for NPR’s owned platforms, with a focus on The NPR app. You will act as a guiding force behind NPR’s mobile growth, leveraging data and insights to inform strategies and tactics that migrate audiences to the core digital experience that will define NPR for years to come.

You will manage a dedicated advertising budget, and will also be expected to make the most of NPR’s own channels like our podcasts, broadcast, website, and of course the NPR app’s messaging and UX. You will work closely with the app and web product teams, the audience insights and analytics teams, the content teams and the Network growth teams, and many others while you seek to find loyal users, keep them engaged, and transform this platform into an indispensable daily habit that sustains our journalism and mission.

You will lead test-and-learn campaigns, making data-informed decisions on where we should invest our resources next. Your goal is to understand our audience’s needs, deepen their engagement with our content, and identify exactly where NPR’s app stands out in a crowded landscape, ultimately shaping how public media thrives in a mobile-first world.

This is a union-represented role covered under the terms of a collective bargaining agreement with: NABET-CWA DMU.

Responsibilities

  • Execute Marketing Campaigns: Plan the strategy and messaging for campaigns that give people a clear, compelling reason to download and use the NPR app, translating our trusted journalism into a dynamic, modern mobile experience.
  • Manage Paid and Free/Owned Media: Run ads across social media, search, and video platforms, while also creating promotions for NPR's own radio broadcasts, podcasts, and newsletters to ensure our public service journalism reaches audiences wherever they are.
  • Manage the Budget: Decide how to spend our advertising money effectively to get the best return on investment and the lowest cost per download, helping build a sustainable, digital-first growth engine for the network.
  • Lead Across Teams: Bring together people from the product, analytics, content, and broadcast teams in order to execute campaigns that feel cohesive and true to NPR.
  • Keep Users Coming Back: Build plans (using tools like push notifications, in-app-messages, and emails) to turn first-time downloaders into dedicated returning users, elevating our listeners’ daily routines by making the app an indispensable companion.
  • Understand Our Audience: Research the app landscape to see trends, what others are doing right, figure out where NPR stands out, and make sure our marketing speaks directly to what our audience needs.
  • Test and Improve: Always approach projects with a testing mindset and determine what strategies drive new installs and deeper engagement.
  • Track Success: Track conversions in actionable ways that can help drive near and long-term marketing decisions. You will work closely with our Audience Insights and Product teams to track all your promotional strategies, but especially digital ads and even terrestrial radio promo.

The above duties and responsibilities are not an exhaustive list of required responsibilities, duties and skills. Other duties may be assigned, and this job description can be modified at any time.

  • Ability to turn complex numbers into clear, simple stories that inform leadership decisions.
  • A talent for competitive analysis and a deep curiosity about audience behavior.

  • Proven ability to manage paid advertising budgets efficiently, especially for mobile app growth.
  • Experience using tracking software, pixels, UTMs, etc. to identify which specific promotions lead to new app users.
  • Substantial experience & comfort building campaigns for a wide variety of marketing messaging channels including but not limited to: email, social media, in-app messaging, display, audio, push notifications, SMS, web notification/pop-ups, in-product UX, etc. (experience with enterprise level cross-channel messaging tools like Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Braze, Iterable, or Adobe Campaign/Marketo is a plus)

job.description:
OVERVIEW

A thriving, mission-driven multimedia organization, NPR produces award-winning news, information, and music programming in partnership with hundreds of independent public radio stations across the nation. The NPR audience values information, creativity, curiosity, and social responsibility – and our employees do too. Application Deadline: Please submit your application by 11:59 pm EST September 14th, 2026

About the Position

Wild Card with Rachel Martin is an interview show that serves as an antidote to the cynicism and chaos of modern life. Rachel’s soulful conversations with some of the most influential and thoughtful minds of our generation reminds people of the things that matter most.

In 2025, Wild Card launched as NPR’s first-ever video podcast. Since then, Rachel’s interviews with everyone from Oprah to Michelle Obama have reached millions of views on YouTube and clips from the show regularly go viral on Instagram. NPR is looking for an experienced video editor to help Wild Card further develop its video presence and reach new audiences.

We’re looking for a creative and organized video editor with experience booking, producing and editing longform interviews. You’ll produce, edit, and publish long- and short-form video for Wild Card. You have a strong understanding of how distribution and virality works on platforms like Spotify, YouTube and Instagram. You will support showrunners, podcast hosts, and work closely with NPR’s Visuals team. You will innovate new formats and design approaches to help Wild Card reach bigger audiences.

This is a union-represented role covered under the terms of a collective bargaining agreement with SAG-AFTRA.

This is an NPR editorial role covered under the terms of the NPR Ethics Handbook. All editorial staff are bound by this guidance. Editorial staff are defined as staff members who play a role in shaping the journalistic or creative direction of NPR's content, including events.

Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with producers and editors on Wild Card to conceive, generate, edit and publish video podcast episodes and short-form vertical video.
  • Collaborate with Wild Card editors on managing Instagram, YouTube and other visual platforms.
  • Manage production schedule for multiple video editors working on weekly Wild Card video deliverables.
  • Produce, edit and publish audio deliverables for radio and other audio-only platforms
  • Direct remote and in-person Wild Card tapings
  • Pitch and book guests who have the right mix of thoughtfulness, vulnerability and humor to match Wild Card’s tone.
  • Take responsibility for video tasks, including multiple layers of coordination, logistics, creativity and sensitivity in the storytelling.
  • Work with the Wild Card and visuals teams to figure out new formats for Wild Card content that will help reach new audiences.
  • Help refine Wild Card’s presentation on major video platforms, including thumbnails, titles, landing pages, etc.
  • Excel at directing and executing visual storytelling forms such as cinematography, photography and lighting, as well as be proficient at executing motion graphics, where applicable.
  • Clearly communicate the vision, project goals, narrative scope and timeline for each production.
  • Function as a key decision maker on the shape and look of regular content and important projects.
  • Maintain NPR editorial and ethical guidelines in all production.

The above duties and responsibilities are not an exhaustive list of required responsibilities, duties and skills. Other duties may be assigned, and this job description can be modified at any time.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years video production experience, preferably with a major network or newsroom, studio or creative agency.
  • Mastery of Riverside, Descript, Premiere, and other programs related to video, photo and design, including Canva.
  • Experience producing video interviews
  • Experience with social media engagement is a plus.
  • Demonstrated commitment to increasing audience diversity.
  • Be well-versed in copyright and ethical journalism practices.
  • Excellent communication and writing skills.
  • Strong editing skills.
  • Must be able to lift video equipment weighing up to 30 pounds.
  • Ability to contribute to and carry out a comprehensive, cross-platform social strategy.
  • Ability to handle multiple and complex projects simultaneously under tight deadlines and changing priorities/conditions.
  • Proven ability to communicate clearly and to consistently work well with others and as part of a team, demonstrating at all times respect for the diverse constituencies at NPR and within the public radio system.
  • Ability and willingness to work varied shifts.

Education Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and experience.

Contribuir para a qualidade operacional dos processos de captação, produção, distribuição e exibição de conteúdos no Brasil e no exterior, oferecendo suporte administrativo e orientações aos artistas e clientes. Executar atividades operacionais e administrativas, garantindo a eficiência e a continuidade dos processos da área. Atuar em conformidade com as políticas internas, normas de compliance e regulamentações aplicáveis à empresa. job.title: 403(g) Maintenance Technician
job.description: #WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in? We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team of passionate people who not only recognize the power of content but also enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture. In This Role You'll: Paramount Tech is hiring a 403g Maintenance Technician responsible for maintenance and support of production and broadcast systems for the CBS Network and affiliated production units, providing critical 24x7 support for on-air and production infrastructure. This role covers hands-on troubleshooting and repair of routing systems, audio/video transport and IP media infrastructure (SDI and SMPTE 2110), production switchers, audio consoles, media file transfer and storage systems, video acquisition and playback servers, non-linear postproduction systems, production intercom, cameras, prompters, and other studio production systems, working to mitigate impact to production and on-air deadlines. This is a shift-based role covering rotating shifts including nights, weekends, and holidays, with on-call/callback responsibilities per the applicable collective bargaining agreement. Basic Qualifications You Bring: • 3+ years' experience working with professional television broadcast equipment, with demonstrated ability to troubleshoot to the component/system level under time pressure, in a live production environment. • Hands-on experience with broadcast test equipment (waveform monitors, vector-scopes, audio analyzers, cable/fiber test sets) and cable/fiber termination and testing. • In-depth knowledge in of the following: Video, Audio, Cameras, Control/Data Systems, RF, Fiber-Optics, and IP media distribution (SMPTE 2110/2059). • Working knowledge of IP networking fundamentals — VLANs, subnetting, multicast, and basic switch/router configuration — sufficient to troubleshoot IP-based media infrastructure. • Strong understanding of broadcast media systems design and signal flow; ability to read and work from schematics and as-built documentation. • Experience with Windows, Linux, and macOS workstation/server environments as used in broadcast and postproduction facilities. • Ability to communicate technical root-cause and status updates clearly to non-technical production staff (directors, TDs, producers) during live troubleshooting. • Ability to perform physical work associated with rack and machine room environments, including lifting equipment and working in confined or elevated spaces. Bonus Skills: • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Broadcast Engineering, or IT preferred. • Direct experience with SMPTE ST 2110 (2110-20/30/40) and ST 2059 PTP timing in a production environment. • Scripting/automation experience (Python, JSON) for diagnostics, monitoring, or system integration. • Experience with virtualized and cloud-based media systems, including container management. • Familiarity with NMOS control/discovery frameworks in an IP media environment. • Familiarity with Evertz, Grass Valley routing systems; RTS intercom, Sony switchers and cameras, EVS, Grass Valley AMPP video playout/record servers a plus. #LI-TG1 Paramount Skydance Corporation (NASDAQ: PSKY) is a leading global media and entertainment company that creates premium content and experiences for audiences worldwide. Driven by iconic studios, networks and streaming services, Paramount's portfolio of consumer brands includes CBS, Showtime Networks, Paramount Pictures, Nickelodeon, MTV, Comedy Central, BET, Paramount+, and Pluto TV, among others. Paramount delivers the largest share of the U.S. television audience and boasts one of the industry's most important and extensive libraries of TV and film titles. In addition to offering innovative streaming services and digital video products, the company provides powerful capabilities in production, distribution and advertising solutions. ADDITIONAL INFORMATION Hiring Salary Range: $31.10 - 65.52. The hiring salary range for this position applies to New York City, California, Colorado, Washington state, and most other geographies. Starting pay for the successful applicant depends on a variety of job-related factors, including but not limited to geographic location, market demands, experience, training, and education. The benefits available for this position include medical, dental, vision, 401(k) plan, life insurance coverage, disability benefits, tuition assistance program and PTO or, if applicable, as otherwise dictated by the appropriate Collective Bargaining Agreement. job.title: Account Executive
job.description: #WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in? We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team of passionate people who not only recognize the power of content but also enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture. THE OPPORTUNITY: This is not a maintenance role. This is a growth role built for a broadcast-experienced seller who can do it all — someone who has spent time in local TV knows how to maximize opportunities, and is hungry to excel as a multi-screen, multi-market powerhouse. As an Account Executive on the Local Ad Sales team at CBS, you will sell across our full O&O footprint — with the ability to close multi-market broadcast deals that span from coast to coast. Layered on top of that is the opportunity to sell Paramount+ and Pluto TV streaming inventory, giving clients a truly end-to-end screen solution backed by one of the most recognized brands in media. You will bring new business to the table. You will build client relationships that outlast any single campaign. And you will deliver results. WHAT YOU'LL DO: Hunt — hard. Prospect relentlessly across local, regional, and national categories. New-to-station and non-traditional revenue is your primary mandate. You don't wait for the phone to ring. Sell all screens. Drive revenue across CBS O&O broadcast, Paramount+ and Pluto TV — in a single, integrated pitch. Think multi-market. Leverage the full 17-market CBS O&O footprint to bring advertisers a scaled broadcast solution to reach audiences across any & all markets. Build don't inherit. Develop direct client and agency relationships from the ground up. Own your pipeline and your outcomes. Be a marketer first. Package custom solutions — tentpole programs, sports integrations, streaming packages, sponsorships — tailored to client business goals, not just available inventory. Own your numbers. Manage quarterly and annual account plans, forecast accurately, and hit your monthly and quarterly revenue goals. Stay ahead of the market. Know the linear and streaming landscape. Understand where categories are investing and why. Bring category intelligence into every client conversation. Collaborate to win. Partner with Integrated Marketing, Account Management, Traffic, and deliver seamless, high-impact campaigns from pre-sale through post-recap. Stay sharp. Keep a pulse on marketplace trends, category dynamics, and the evolving linear and streaming landscape. Represent CBS Pittsburgh at client meetings, presentations, and station events. WHAT YOU BRING Required: 2+ years of local broadcast experience, multi-platform, or local media advertising sales with a verifiable history of hitting or exceeding revenue goals. Real hunger—you prospect, you pitch, you close. You don’t wait for business to come to you. Strong consultative selling skills with the ability to build lasting client partnerships. Experience working with both advertising agencies and direct clients. Outstanding presentation, negotiation, and closing skills. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Ability to manage a high-volume, fast-paced book of business with professionalism and precision. Valid Drivers License Preferred: Experience selling streaming, digital, or OTT inventory in addition to linear television. Familiarity with Paramount+, Pluto TV, or FAST/AVOD platform sales. Experience selling multi-market or national broadcast packages. Bachelor's degree preferred. Proficient in Wide Orbit, Strata, Salesforce, and Microsoft Excel. CBS News and Stations, brings together the power of CBS News, 28 owned television stations in 17 major U.S. markets, the CBS News Streaming Network, CBS News Streaming local platforms, local websites and cbsnews.com, under one umbrella. CBS News and Stations is home to the nation’s #1 news program 60 MINUTES, the CBS News Streaming Network, the first 24/7 digital streaming news network, the award-winning broadcasts CBS MORNINGS, CBS SATURDAY MORNING, the CBS EVENING NEWS, CBS SUNDAY MORNING, CBS WEEKEND EVENING NEWS, 48 HOURS and FACE THE NATION WITH MARGARET BRENNAN. CBS News and Stations provides news and information for the CBS Television Network, CBSNews.com, CBS News Radio and podcasts, Paramount +, all digital platforms, and the CBS News Streaming Network, the premier 24/7 anchored streaming news service that is available free to everyone with access to the internet. The CBS News Streaming Network is the destination for breaking news, live events, original reporting and storytelling, and programs from CBS News and Stations’ top anchors and correspondents working locally, nationally and around the globe. CBS News’ streaming services, across national and local, amassed more than 1.01 billion streams in 2021. Launched in November 2014 as CBSN, the CBS News Streaming Network is available on 30 digital platforms and apps, as well as CBSNews.com and Paramount+. The service is available live in 91 countries. CBS News and Stations is dedicated to providing the highest quality journalism under standards it pioneered and continues to set in today’s digital age. CBS News earns more prestigious journalism awards than any other broadcast news division. What We Offer: Attractive compensation and comprehensive benefits packages. We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team of passionate people who not only recognize the power of content but also enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture. Overview: The Account Executive, Sports role is tasked with maintaining, building, and exceeding advertising revenue goals across both the linear and digital sports portfolio. Successful candidates will also demonstrate the ability to work in a team environment within a dynamic setting to achieve results and overcome industry challenges. This is an onsite position, based out of our New York, NY office. Responsibilities include but not limited to: Develop, maintain, and nourish client relationships with both media buying community and media clients by conducting a high volume of calls and meetings. Manage existing and identify new business within a specific Holdco. Develop account and Holdco strategies for long-term development and revenue growth. Act as a sports business specialist on behalf of your clients, strategically developing convergent media solutions tailored to their objectives. Prioritize and lead efforts to ensure precise account management both internally and externally. Collaborate with Holdco counterparts to develop strategic roadmaps and generate revenue across the portfolio. Establish oneself as a thought leader within the sports community and speak on Paramount’s unique position within the sports marketplace. Ensure that you stay ahead of marketplace trends related to clients as well as in the sports business industry. Manage, train, and develop the dedicated IPG account manager, sales planner, and sales associate to help them flourish in their roles and continue to be impactful contributors to team the sports team. Travel as necessary to support client relationships, meetings, and business needs. Basic Qualifications: 5+ years proven advertising sports sales experience. Additional Qualifications: Sales professional with an entrepreneurial spirit who thrives in a team-oriented environment. Have a deep desire to win and grow as a convergent media sales professional. Remarkable communication and organizational skills. Well-developed presentation skills. Extraordinary time management skills to meet deadlines. Have great balancing and coping skills while prioritizing multiple account challenges simultaneously. BS/BA degree, or equivalent training and experience. Must be extremely detailed oriented. Proficient in Microsoft Suite, G Suite and Salesforce. Paramount Skydance Corporation (NASDAQ: PSKY) is a leading global media and entertainment company that creates premium content and experiences for audiences worldwide. Driven by iconic studios, networks and streaming services, Paramount's portfolio of consumer brands includes CBS, Showtime Networks, Paramount Pictures, Nickelodeon, MTV, Comedy Central, BET, Paramount+, and Pluto TV, among others. Paramount delivers the largest share of the U.S. television audience and boasts one of the industry's most important and extensive libraries of TV and film titles. In addition to offering innovative streaming services and digital video products, the company provides powerful capabilities in production, distribution and advertising solutions. The Account Manager (AM) is a developmental sales-focused role responsible for supporting day-to-day revenue efforts while developing the skills and experience needed to become a future Account Executive. This role touches all facets of the sales process—from proposal development and client support to campaign execution and stewardship—while partnering closely with Account Executives and internal teams. job.title: Analyst TandE
job.description: Are you detail-oriented, analytical and interested in working with Travel & Expense processes in an international environment? As a T&E Analyst / Auditor , you will play an important role in reviewing and analyzing employee expense reports processed through Concur Travel & Expense and Oracle Fusion Expenses. You will help ensure that expenses are accurate, compliant with company policies and properly supported, while also identifying opportunities to strengthen controls and improve the overall expense management process. The role combines audit, analysis, stakeholder communication and process improvement, making it a great opportunity for someone who enjoys working with data while also supporting employees and business stakeholders. This is a fixed term position. What you'll do Review and audit employee travel and expense reports to ensure compliance with company policies and procedures Verify the accuracy, completeness and validity of expense claims and supporting documentation Identify and investigate non-compliant, duplicate, fraudulent or excessive expense claims Assess risks and prioritize audit findings and exceptions Ensure expenses comply with internal controls, accounting standards, tax regulations and corporate guidelines Process expense reports within agreed service levels and quality standards Communicate audit findings and policy violations to employees, managers and relevant stakeholders Work directly with employees to explain T&E policies and help prevent future policy violations Provide guidance and support to employees using Concur and Oracle Fusion Expenses Monitor high-risk transactions and spending trends to identify potential control weaknesses and improvement opportunities Prepare management reporting on T&E policy findings, compliance issues and trends Analyze expense data to identify spending patterns, cost-saving opportunities and areas for improvement Support internal and external audits by providing documentation and responding to audit requests Maintain accurate audit records and ensure appropriate documentation retention Recommend and implement process improvements to increase efficiency, compliance and user experience Support expense management system administration, testing and process enhancements Escalate exceptions, potential fraud cases and control breaches to management Prepare ad hoc reports and analyses for Concur and Oracle Fusion Expenses Participate in special projects and other initiatives as required What we're looking for 2+ years of experience with Concur or Oracle, with experience in Oracle Fusion Expenses being an advantage Strong written and verbal English communication skills Advanced proficiency in Concur, Oracle Fusion Expenses, Microsoft Word and Excel Strong analytical skills and excellent attention to detail Excellent documentation and organizational skills A solutions-oriented, proactive and self-motivated approach Ability to communicate quantitative and qualitative information clearly to stakeholders at different levels of the organization Strong internal customer focus and a service-oriented mindset Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment Strong communication and interpersonal skills Ability to interact confidently with employees and stakeholders at all levels It would be a plus if you have Experience working with SAP, Oracle Fusion or other ERP systems Knowledge of finance, procurement/sourcing or information technology processes Experience managing multiple projects simultaneously Experience working in cross-functional teams throughout a project lifecycle Strong data analysis and problem-solving skills Experience identifying process improvement and control enhancement opportunities Why join us? We believe you will enjoy working with us because: Our private health insurance program provides access to private clinics with a screening package Our monthly cafeteria package includes SZÉP card, nursery, and home loan support We have a dog-friendly office, so you can bring your furry friend to work Every week, we offer fresh fruit days for our employees We provide eyewear support to help with the cost of glasses After the probation period, you can take advantage of language courses Paramount Networks International, is comprised of many of the world's most popular multimedia entertainment brands, including MTV, MTV LIVE HD, Nickelodeon, Nick Jr., Comedy Central, Paramount Channel, BET and more. Paramount brands reach more than 3.8 billion cumulative subscribers in 180+ countries and territories via more than 200 locally programmed and operated TV channels and more than 550 digital media and mobile TV properties, in 40 languages. Local newsrooms and sports journalism are evolving rapidly, and this role is built for the modern era of media. The ideal candidate will be an anchor and multi-platform storyteller who actively drives engagement across digital channels, social media, and our 24/7 streaming network. Beyond the studio anchor desk, you will host key sports specials, anchor and report live remotely from major events, and enterprise compelling stories that connect with Chicago’s passionate sports community. We are looking for an engaging, relatable personality and insightful expert who looks far beyond basic scores and stats and must be an exceptional writer capable of scripting concise, creative, and platform-tailored content for linear television, streaming broadcasts, and digital platforms. Chicago is one of the greatest, most intense sports towns in the world. From legendary professional franchises to regional college sports and historic high school programs, our audience demands deep market knowledge, authentic connection, and modern storytelling that meets viewers wherever they consume news. job.title: Associate Researcher - CBS Sports (Freelance)
job.description: #WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in? We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team of passionate people who not only recognize the power of content but also enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture. CBS Sports is looking for an enthusiastic, detail-oriented sports fan to join our team of Researchers. The Associate Researcher will help create and deliver materials that provide in-depth, creative, and accurate information to inform coverage across studio and game broadcasts, as well as other CBS Sports departments. The ideal candidate will use deep sports knowledge, insatiable curiosity, and sound news judgment to provide statistical, analytical, biographical, and other information that supports timely, relevant, and innovative storytelling. They will also partner with teammates to develop ideas for graphics and other visual presentations across the CBS Sports portfolio, including—but not limited to—the NFL, college football and basketball, golf, and soccer. This is an on-site freelance position based in our New York City office. Candidates must be available to work 40+ hours per week in the office. The pay range is $21.63–$26.44 per hour, equivalent to approximately $45,000–$55,000 annually. RESPONSIBILITIES Use deep sports knowledge along with strong research techniques to generate and support ideas based on live sporting events, breaking news and other developments in the sports world. Contribute to the development of informational packets that include data about our games; statistical nuggets and analytical context; storylines ranging from matchups to profiles to features to columns; and ideas for on-screen elements. Conduct a variety of searches using statistical tools and databases, school/team websites, social media, other media outlets, and other sources to support storytelling and coverage for all game and studio productions Build relationships with producers, on-air talent, and graphics and video associates, to ensure the highest quality and depth of information Maintain files of milestones, historical records, trends and developing themes, as well as releases, story ideas, scheduled events, and other relevant information about the sports, conferences, teams, coaches and players covered on CBS Sports platforms In partnership with Research teammates, respond to relevant trends, developing storylines and noteworthy performances prior to and during live game action. Communicate in a timely and effective manner with content creators to provide thorough, creative and accurate statistical and storytelling information that will support and enhance productions. Under limited supervision, deliver real-time reactions to notable performances, significant plays, and developing on-field storylines from live games. Chart out information that will be turned into graphics by presenting complex information in an easy-to-digest manner. Must have a keen eye to detail, an emphasis on accuracy and a focus on highlighting the priority storylines. Prepare general background/research material for other entities as needed. Assist Researchers and Senior Researchers with organizational tasks. BASIC QUALIFICATIONS 0-3 years of experience Bachelor’s degree or equivalent preferred; current college students will be considered Relevant educational or work experience in journalism, communications or production fields is preferred. Experience working with numbers in any field, including your field of study Experience in sports studio/broadcast environments, or other sports media fields, a plus. Excellent working knowledge of and interest in multiple sports, especially NFL, college football, college basketball, golf and soccer. A resourceful ability to conduct research with limited supervision and a passion for discovering and sharing new knowledge is a must. Must be able to thrive in a team-oriented environment Excellent interpersonal and multi-tasking skills, as well as a keen attention to detail, are required. Must demonstrate ability and desire to work in a fast-paced environment under deadline, to prioritize assignments and ensure accuracy Must be able to work nights, weekends and flexible hours. Must demonstrate ability to communicate ideas effectively and efficiently. Must be a self-starter with demonstrated initiative CBS Sports, a year-round leader in cross-platform sports coverage, broadcasts a portfolio of events on the CBS Television Network, including THE NFL ON CBS; college football, including the Big Ten ON CBS; college basketball, including the NCAA Division I Men's Basketball Championship; golf, including The Masters®, PGA Championship and PGA TOUR; soccer, including the UEFA Champions League and NWSL; and CBS SPORTS SPECTACULAR. In addition, the division includes CBS SPORTS NETWORK, the 24-hour cable home of CBS Sports which televises live sports programming throughout the year, including college football and basketball games, UEFA Champions League and Europa League action, Italy's Serie A matches, Concacaf national team competitions, as well as a full slate of original programming and studio coverage. CBS Sports also delivers an extensive lineup of global soccer coverage on Paramount+, including every UEFA club competition match, all Serie A matches as well as Concacaf national team competitions, and produces INSIDE THE NFL for Paramount+. CBS Sports Digital's multi-platform offerings include CBSSports.com and the CBS Sports apps for mobile and connected TV devices; the 24/7 streaming sports news network CBS Sports HQ; 247Sports; MaxPreps; CBS Sports fantasy games; and SportsLine. Track fulfilment/deliveries through internal tracking/scheduling systems for processing and delivery. Identify and advise on global efficiencies around operational procedures. Oversee and uphold the highest of quality standards on all deliverables. Maintain accurate and up-to-date documentation. Provide operational support and input around departmental global projects and manage the on boarding of new clients. (VOD, OTT, Apps, Mobile, Websites.) Knowledge of Adobe Suites. Fluent in English (other languages are a plus). Ability to follow instructions and work independently as well as part of a Global team. Ability to troubleshoot minor operational problems. Excellent problem-solving abilities with experience in process and quality analysis. Proactive self-starter and team player, with the ability to prioritise workload. The content producer will work with a digital team to manage, optimize, and time live and on-demand video content for mobile, desktop and OTT platforms. The content producer works in coordination with News Managers and Broadcast Line Producers during live news programs, and takes on other responsibilities such as writing headlines, publishing and updating articles, editing and publishing video, conducting interviews, and optimizing SEO, discoverability and shareability of all content. RESPONSIBILITIES INCLUDE, BUT ARE NOT LIMITED, TO: · Leading all aspects of content on CBS News Minnesota by building show rundowns and segments, editing video and scripts whenever needed. · Aggressively manage and publish updated news stories and video segments, concentrating on developing stories and breaking news. · Tracking news and events; coordinating coverage with managers and line producers. · Constantly updating news content in the stream and producing breaking news and other updates as they happen instead of waiting for a scheduled newscast. · Anticipating the needs of CBS News Minnesota for video, graphics, scripts and other elements. · Coding/stacking rundown content regarding video, graphics, scripts and other elements. · Writing memorable headlines, scripts and segments. Optimize headlines, captions, and video titles for in-platform search (TikTok, YouTube, Instagram) in addition to traditional web SEO. · Working with managers and the entire digital team to develop and produce special content applying the resources and storytelling of the entire WCCO Newsroom. · Conducting interviews in the field or over web camera, shooting video, producing content, and editing video for audiences on digital and social media platforms. · Demonstrating expertise in timing in a control room environment. · Build videos for multiple platforms, including WCCO.com, YouTube, and WCCO’s social media channels, with an emphasis on verticals and social reels. · Other duties as assigned. REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS: · Multiplatform fluency, with day-to-day focus on managing and timing live video opportunities, but able to flex into social content, web publishing, and broadcast/linear producing support. · Proven experience in crafting and publishing digital news stories and video content. · Proven success operating in a fast-paced news environment, a field that often requires pivots to new technological realities and tools. · Ability to prioritize multiple tasks under tight deadlines to write headlines, publish articles, and edit video for live digital publishing/broadcast. · Familiarity with non-linear editing systems such as Edius/Stratus, Final Cut, Adobe Premiere required. · Familiarity with iNews and Crispin Rapid Play preferred. · Available for early mornings, nights, weekends, and holidays. · Strong ability to write accurate and compelling copy for both broadcast and web. · Knowledge of Associated Press style and journalism ethics and standards. · Knowledge of social media and the competitive digital news environment. · Understanding of multi-platform discovery — Google Discover, AI Overviews, and in-platform search on TikTok/YouTube/Instagram — in addition to traditional SEO and Google Trends. job.description: #WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in? We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU!
