About this Role

Semafor Live Journalism brings together world leaders, innovators, and newsmakers for high-stakes, agenda-setting conversations. As our Events Coordinator, you will serve as the operational engine room behind these flagship convenings—working directly alongside our SVP & Head of US Events and an elite live journalism team.

This is more than an administrative and operations role; it is a fast-paced command center position at the intersection of media, live production, and executive operations. You will turn complex logistical moving parts into seamless, world-class event experiences. If you thrive under the pressure of a breaking-news environment, take pride in hyper-organized workflows, and love experimenting with modern tech to solve problems faster, join us.

Your Responsibilities

  • Produce Flagship Event Materials: Draft, format, and distribute high-signal briefing packets for VIP speakers, moderators, and clients, alongside master run-of-show schedules.
  • Support the Execution of End-to-End Event Logistics: Lead venue research, assist with vendor sourcing and contracting, coordinate event shipments and collateral, and manage on-site setup and staffing on production days.
  • Pioneer AI Adoption: Integrate generative AI and workflow automation tools into daily operations—accelerating the drafting of speaker bios, summarizing pre-meeting research, automating calendar triggers, and synthesizing post-event feedback.
  • Architect Creative Solutions: Serve as an agile, on-the-fly problem solver who designs resourceful, out-of-the-box workarounds whenever live production curveballs, venue constraints, or last-minute scheduling changes arise.
  • Engine-Room Operations: Build, maintain, and elevate team-wide systems—including SOPs, shared Google Workspace drives, master event timelines, inventory trackers, and crisp meeting action items.
  • Executive & Team Support: Provide high-touch support to the SVP and event leaders, assisting with schedule coordination, executive inbox flow, client call preparation, and follow-ups.
  • Asset & Data Management: Organize post-event collateral, high-resolution photo libraries, attendee rosters, and key performance metrics to inform future event strategies.
  • Live Production Presence: Serve as a core on-site team member on event days (requires flexibility for early mornings, occasional evenings, and periodic domestic travel).Lead the preparation and maintenance of event materials, including client, speaker, and moderator briefing documents, day-of run show documents, and biographies
  • Some early morning, evening, and occasional travel may be required

What makes you qualified

  • 1–2 years of experience in event coordination, media, or executive assistance in a high-velocity environment (Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience)
  • Impeccable judgment, comfort with ambiguity, and a calm, customer-service-driven composure when live events move fast
  • Exceptional project management skills with the strongest attention to detail and an ability to manage multiple tasks, deadlines, and competing priorities
  • Strongest communication skills, both written and verbal

job.description:

We are building Semafor to enable world-class journalists to deliver reporting and insights with rigor in journalistic forms that ensure a new level of transparency. Want to join us? Read on.

About this Role

Semafor is seeking experienced professionals in strategic communications, corporate relations, journalism, protocol, or executive engagement to support our flagship live journalism events in a contract role, ranging from 20 hours/week to full-time. This role involves white-glove coordinating with VIP event participants (CEOs, C-Suite executives, government leaders and dignitaries), managing logistics, and providing editorial and programming support. You will work as an independent contributor while collaborating closely with our content, programming, and events teams. The ideal candidate is highly organized, independently motivated, and exceptionally responsive — someone who anticipates needs before being asked, and remains calm and professional under pressure.

While this is a remote role, there is an expectation of on-site staffing and participation at Semafor’s flagship events as needed. Preference to candidates based in Washington DC or New York.

Your Responsibilities

  • Serve as the dedicated point of contact for assigned high-touch speakers and participants, delivering a seamless end-to-end communication experience from confirmation through event completion

  • Maintain accurate, up-to-date tracking for each executive across platforms, and create thorough briefings and materials as needed
  • Work cross-functionally with editorial, content, events, and partner teams

  • Maintain online Slack availability Monday–Friday, 9am–5pm; attend weekly team meetings and provide timely updates; respond to all inbound executive communications within one business day

What Makes You Qualified

  • 5+ years of experience in strategic communications, corporate relations, executive engagement, client management, or related fields
  • Demonstrated track record of building high-level relationships with C-suite executives, ideally within Fortune 500 or global-scale organizations
  • Exceptional interpersonal skills and the ability to earn immediate trust with executive offices — handling sensitive schedules, correspondence, and VIP escalations with discretion and professionalism
  • Outstanding verbal and written communication, including the ability to craft compelling invitations and executive briefs; calm and clear under pressure
  • Strong independent work ethic and organizational skills; adept at managing complex executive portfolios, multi-stream deadlines, and multi-platform workflows without close supervision
  • Editorial fluency and knowledge of major business trends, with the ability to communicate programming details to CEO teams accurately and diplomatically
  • A passion for journalism and live events, with a commitment to delivering high-quality, white-glove experiences

job.description:
Who we are

Semafor is a global news platform for an increasingly complex world in which consumers are overwhelmed by too many news sources and unsure what to trust. The Role

Semafor is seeking an Accounts Payable and T&E Manager to own end-to-end accounts payable operations and travel and expense management for the Finance team. The ideal candidate is an experienced accounts payable and expense professional who can manage the full payables lifecycle from vendor onboarding through payment application, serve as an administrator of our expense platform, and play a customer service role in supporting our employees with their travel. The successful candidate will be comfortable working independently and as part of a team, with the ability to adapt to changing priorities in a fast paced, high energy environment, and the desire to be on the ground floor of a rapidly growing startup.

This position is full-time and based out of Semafor’s New York office with the option to work remotely on Fridays.

What You’ll Do:

  • Own the end-to-end accounts payable process, from vendor onboarding through payment processing and payment application, ensuring proper account and dimension coding for accurate financial reporting.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for all vendor interactions, resolving vendor inquiries and issues, and partnering with management to ensure timely, accurate vendor payments.
  • Manage annual 1099 filings and other required tax documentation, ensuring accurate vendor tax records (e.g., W-9s) and timely IRS reporting
  • Ensure compliance with global tax/regulatory requirements (including VAT as applicable)
  • Manage our virtual card platform, including card issuance, controls, and reconciliation.
  • Oversee end-to-end T&E processing, exception handling, and reimbursements in accordance with company policy.
  • Serve as a super user of the expense platform, providing training and proactive troubleshooting support to employees.
  • Assist employees with travel arrangements and regularly audit and report on T&E trends, recommending process improvements.
  • Maintain organized, up-to-date files for vendor agreements and SOWs for contractors, ensuring documentation is complete and easily accessible for reference and audit purposes
  • Monitor our vendor spend and assist management with identifying cost savings, contract renewals and duplication
  • Assist with month-end close, including account reconciliations, AP and T&E accruals
  • Provide assistance with ad hoc projects and other initiatives aimed at improving the financial performance of the business.

Where This Role Can Grow

  • Champion the launch of our new expense platform, Emburse Enterprise, shaping how Semafor manages travel and expenses for years to come.
  • Own the build-out of a new virtual card platform from the ground up, designing the controls and processes that will scale with the company.
  • Help optimize our global payments processes as Semafor's footprint continues to expand into new markets.
  • Grow into a trusted resource on travel, guiding the team through complex arrangements and uncovering meaningful savings along the way.

What You Offer

  • Associate’s or Bachelor’s Degree in Finance, Accounting, or related field from an accredited university or college.
  • 4+ years of experience in accounts payable and travel & expense management.
  • Knowledge of basic accounting principles and an eagerness to learn
  • Experience implementing a new expense platform is a plus.
  • Experience managing a virtual card platform.
  • Excellent Microsoft Office Skills with a strong emphasis on Excel.
  • Bill.com or other payment platform experience is a plus.
  • Strong attention to detail, proven organizational and time management skills.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills and works well in a team environment.
  • Ability to handle confidential information with discretion.

job.title: Campaign Strategist
job.description: The Campaign Strategist supports the successful execution of linear and digital advertising campaigns across Sinclair's portfolio. This role serves as a key operational partner to Sales, Planning, Account Management, Traffic, Finance, and Marketing teams, ensuring campaigns are launched accurately, delivered successfully, and managed efficiently from order entry through completion. The ideal candidate is organized, detail-oriented, proactive, and comfortable managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced media environment. Key Responsibilities: Campaign Execution & Management Support post-sale campaign execution across linear, digital, social, podcast, and owned-and-operated platforms. Coordinate campaign setup, trafficking, flighting, inventory allocation, and fulfillment activities. Monitor campaign delivery, pacing, and performance, proactively identifying and resolving issues. Maintain accurate campaign, advertiser, inventory, and order information across company systems. Support make-goods, liability management, inventory adjustments, and campaign documentation. Sales Support & Account Coordination Serve as a primary operational resource for Account Executives, Planners, Account Managers, and internal stakeholders. Provide timely campaign updates, status reporting, and issue resolution. Respond to campaign-related inquiries and support client service efforts through proactive communication and follow-through. Partner cross-functionally with Sales, Planning, Traffic, Finance, Marketing, and Operations teams to ensure campaign success. Support discrepancy resolution, billing validation, and monthly reporting processes. Assist with inventory management, revenue tracking, and quarterly readiness activities. Help ensure campaign commitments, reporting, and documentation are accurate and complete. Prepare and deliver post-campaign MSA reporting packages, ensuring accuracy and timely distribution to internal teams and clients. Qualifications Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience preferred. 2–4 years of experience in advertising operations, campaign management, media planning, sales support, traffic, account management, or a related field. Understanding of linear and digital advertising workflows and campaign execution. Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills with exceptional attention to detail. Proficiency in Excel and experience working with reporting, inventory management, and campaign tracking. Experience with advertising and workflow platforms such as GAM, Broadway, JIRA, Teams, Megaphone, Sprout, Smartsheet, or similar tools preferred. Excellent communication skills and ability to manage multiple priorities in a deadline-driven environment. The base hourly compensation range for this role is $22.60 to $26.57 per hour. In addition, this role may be eligible for a quartely bonus, which would be awarded based on individual and company performance. Final compensation for this role will be determined by various factors such as a candidates’ relevant work experience, skills, certifications, and geographic location. Full time positions are eligible for benefits that include participation in a retirement plan, life and disability insurance, health, dental and vision plans, flexible spending accounts, sick leave, vacation time, personal time, parental leave and employee stock purchase plan. job.title: Chief Engineer
job.description: Sinclair's content technology is central to operational excellence and to connecting audiences with trusted news across broadcast, cable, streaming, and digital platforms. TNND is seeking an experienced, technology-focused Chief Engineer to lead engineering for its national news production operation. This role owns the reliability, performance, scalability, and lifecycle of TNND's live-production and media systems. The Chief Engineer leads the engineering team and turns operational needs into dependable workflows in partnership with editorial, production, operations, and Corporate technology teams. Networking, enterprise monitoring, cybersecurity, and shared-infrastructure decisions are Corporate-led; the Chief Engineer supplies broadcast requirements, supports implementation, and keeps TNND systems aligned with those standards. The successful candidate combines hands-on engineering depth with calm incident leadership, disciplined planning, and a service-oriented approach to daily live news. Key Responsibilities Engineering Leadership and Operational Ownership • Own the end-to-end technical health and operational readiness of TNND's production environment, with direct accountability for reliable daily live output across an extended and variable schedule. • Lead, develop, schedule, and set priorities for engineering staff and technical support coverage; establish clear escalation paths and ensure appropriate on-call response for critical operations. • Serve as TNND's senior engineering subject-matter expert and incident leader, coordinating rapid restoration, clear stakeholder communication, and follow-through during high-pressure production events. • Partner with editorial, production, operations, Corporate IT, digital, cybersecurity, facilities, and distribution teams to align technical systems with newsroom priorities; serve as TNND's broadcast liaison for Corporate-led networking, monitoring, security, and shared infrastructure. • Translate business and production requirements into documented architectures, standards, operating procedures, project plans, lifecycle roadmaps, and budget recommendations. Live Production and Control-Room Systems • Engineer, maintain, and support the integrated control-room ecosystem, including cameras and robotics, production switchers, automated production control, real-time graphics, studio displays, audio consoles and processing, intercom/IFB, teleprompters, tally, routing, multiviewers, sync/reference, video servers, record/playback, encoders/decoders, and contribution/distribution interfaces. • Administer and optimize Ross OverDrive automated production control for live news, including show and template configuration, rundown execution, device control, graphics/audio/robotics coordination, NRCS/MOS integration, operator workflows, recalls/macros, and tested manual fallback procedures. • Support Ross XPression Tessera/Tessera One and related XPression workflows for pixel-accurate, synchronized content across studio displays and video walls, including region mapping, real-time graphics and data, external video inputs, signal timing, playout control, and recovery procedures. • Validate software, firmware, control, graphics, and workflow changes in a test or rehearsal process before air; maintain approved configuration baselines and rollback plans. • Work directly with directors, producers, operators, editors, and graphics teams to improve repeatability while preserving the flexibility required for breaking news and late rundown changes. Newsroom, Media, and Distribution Workflows • Maintain dependable integrations among the newsroom computer system (NRCS), MOS-connected tools, ingest, editing, media asset management, shared storage, archive, graphics, playout, and distribution systems. • Support live feeds, file-based media, remote contributors, streaming, and broadcast contribution/distribution workflows, including metadata, timing, caption/data paths, and SCTE signaling where applicable. • Partner with content and operations teams to strengthen editing, live-production, field-gathering, remote-production, and multi-platform publishing workflows without compromising on-air reliability. Broadcast Systems and Corporate Technology Integration • Serve as the broadcast liaison to Corporate-managed technology services: define operational requirements and support implementation and troubleshooting of LAN/WAN connectivity, VLANs, QoS, multicast, routing, DNS/DHCP, secure remote access, identity, and time synchronization under Corporate architecture and policy. • Support TNND's current baseband SDI and compressed-IP media workflows, maintaining practical knowledge of applicable contribution, distribution, audio-over-IP, and production protocols such as NDI, SRT/RIST, and AES67/Dante where deployed. • Administer broadcast-specific Windows, macOS, and Linux systems and applications, coordinating shared-infrastructure changes involving virtualization, storage, databases, cloud services where applicable, patching, backups, access control, endpoint protection, and security hardening with Corporate IT and cybersecurity. • Create and maintain accurate signal-flow drawings, network diagrams, rack elevations, system inventories, configuration records, credentials-handling procedures, and support documentation. Monitoring, Reliability, Redundancy, and Disaster Recovery • Maintain broadcast-facing monitoring and use Corporate-approved enterprise monitoring, telemetry, logging, alarming, and reporting tools so engineering and operations have appropriate visibility into system health, quality, and service status. • Design and maintain redundancy for critical workflows; define recovery priorities with stakeholders; document and regularly test failover, backup, restore, and disaster-recovery procedures. • Lead incident, problem, and change management for production technology, including root-cause analysis, corrective actions, maintenance windows, risk communication, and post-incident learning. • Manage preventive maintenance, lifecycle replacement, spares, warranties, software support, service contracts, and vendor escalation to reduce avoidable outages and technical debt. Projects, Vendors, Budget, and Team Development • Assess business needs, evaluate solutions and vendors, develop technical requirements, and lead design, procurement, installation, commissioning, documentation, acceptance testing, and operational handoff for capital and workflow projects. • Develop and manage engineering budgets, forecasts, purchase planning, and expense tracking; present clear options, risks, and lifecycle implications to leadership. • Build strong vendor and corporate-technology relationships, manage escalations, and ensure that work performed by integrators and contractors meets TNND's technical and operational standards. • Coach engineers and technical users, create cross-training and coverage plans, and promote consistent troubleshooting, documentation, safety, and change-control practices. Required Qualifications • Five or more years of progressive experience in television news engineering, broadcast production technology, or an equivalent live-media environment, including demonstrated technical leadership. • Hands-on experience administering or supporting Ross OverDrive automated production control in a live-news environment, including rundown/NRCS integration, device control, show configuration, and troubleshooting under air-critical conditions. • Working expertise with Ross XPression Tessera or Tessera One and XPression-based graphics/display workflows, including multi-display playout, synchronization, signal flow, and operational recovery. • Broad control-room engineering experience with cameras, audio and video systems, production switchers, graphics, routing, multiviewers, intercom, playback/record systems, encoders/decoders, monitoring, and computing infrastructure. • Strong knowledge of broadcast signal flow, baseband and compressed-IP media, shared storage, media workflows, and structured troubleshooting, plus sufficient networking and monitoring knowledge to support TNND workflows and collaborate with Corporate technology teams. • Proficiency supporting Windows, macOS, and Linux platforms and diagnosing hardware, software, network, and workflow failures. • Demonstrated ability to analyze complex operational problems, make sound decisions under pressure, communicate clearly with technical and nontechnical stakeholders, and carry corrective work through completion. • Associate degree or higher in information technology, electronics, computer science, broadcast engineering, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and directly relevant experience. • A collaborative, service-oriented leadership style and a consistent commitment to quality, reliability, documentation, and continuous improvement. Preferred Qualifications • Experience with additional Ross platforms such as XPression, DashBoard/CustomPanels, Carbonite or Acuity production switchers, Ultrix/Ultriscape routing and multiviewing, openGear, or Ross Platform Manager. • Experience with MOS/NRCS integrations, Avid editing and media workflows, media asset management, shared storage, newsroom playout, and multi-platform distribution. • Experience with Amazon Web Services (AWS) and other cloud-native services supporting all-cloud broadcast or media workflows. • Experience partnering with Corporate IT and cybersecurity on access, patching, centralized monitoring, endpoint protection, and secure vendor access for broadcast systems. • Familiarity with applicable FCC requirements, video streaming protocols, SCTE signaling, caption/data workflows, and emerging broadcast standards. • Relevant Avid (including ACSR), SBE, or comparable broadcast-technology certification. Work Expectations • Ability to work a flexible schedule and participate in on-call support, including early mornings, evenings, weekends, holidays, and breaking-news coverage as operational needs require. • Ability to work in control rooms, studios, equipment rooms, offices, and other technical spaces and to safely lift and move computers and equipment generally weighing less than 50 pounds, with reasonable accommodation as applicable. The base salary compensation range for this role is $130,000 to $150,000. Final compensation for this role will be determined by various factors such as a candidates’ relevant work experience, skills, certifications, and geographic location. Full time positions are eligible for benefits that include participation in a retirement plan, life and disability insurance, health, dental and vision plans, flexible spending accounts, sick leave, vacation time, personal time, parental leave and employee stock purchase plan. job.title: Content Creator
job.description: We’re a fast-moving, idea-sparking, deadline-crushing content team embedded inside one of the most dynamic entertainment companies in the country. On the Agile Content Creation Engagement Team (ACCET), we develop branded content, commercial creative, and social-first video that connects — emotionally and instantly. We are looking for a Content Creator to join our group! Our mission? Bring bold ideas to life across every screen. Whether we’re building campaigns for clients, developing killer creative for digital platforms, or producing memorable branded moments, our content doesn’t just fill space — it makes noise. WHAT YOU’LL DO: As a Content Creator, you’ll concept, write, shoot, and edit creative that stops thumbs, turns heads, and drives action. You’ll collaborate with a passionate crew of makers who understand that great storytelling is part emotion, part strategy, and all hustle. YOUR DAILY PLAYLIST: • Produce scroll-stopping, channel-agnostic content for TV, social, web, and wherever audiences are paying attention. • Partner with digital strategists and creative leads to develop work that aligns with brand goals and audience needs. • Write scripts, shoot footage, and edit everything from fast-turn social reels to longer-form branded videos. • Work directly with internal teams and external clients to bring visions to life. • Manage asset distribution across the network and track deliverables through Adobe Workfront. WHAT YOU BRING TO THE STAGE: • A passion for visual storytelling with a marketing mindset. • Mastery of Adobe Creative Cloud — especially Premiere Pro, After Effects, Photoshop, and Illustrator. • Camera skills and lighting savvy that make your footage shine. • A collaborative spirit with the confidence to lead a concept or run a solo shoot. • A portfolio that proves you can do the job — and push it further. job.title: Digital Content Coordinator
job.description: At Sinclair Broadcast Group, our mission is to connect people with content everywhere – and a core part of this mission involves social media. To help fulfill this mission, we’re seeking a sharp and highly motivated Coordinator of Digital Content to join our growing Regional Content teams. Success in this role requires an equally creative and analytical brain as you will be supporting your team in a variety of functions from creative development to content creation to digital publishing to content performance reporting. Responsibilities include, but are not limited to: Monitor assigned stations social handles to ensure adherence to publishing recommendations in terms of copy, cadence, and creative Prepare recurring content performance reports, and work with your team to synthesize the data to formulate strategic content plans aimed at growing each station’s audience and increasing engagement Create and distribute recurring competitive content reports with the goal of putting our stations at the forefront of digital innovation Track social media trends, and actively contribute content recommendations to your team for potential execution by the stations Create low-lift content for distribution across all social platforms as needed. Post trending content across station social media platforms as needed. Troubleshoot any and all issues stations experience within the Sinclair digital ecosystem and with all social platforms. Any other duties as assigned pertaining to social/digital content. job.title: Master Control Operator
job.description: Sinclair’s content technology is at the core of our operational excellence. We thrive on innovation and a passion for connecting people with the best local news and sports content. As we grow our content offerings and expand our broadcast, cable, and digital distribution channels, we are embracing modern technologies to fuel that growth. We are excited by the promise of cloud-first approaches and artificial intelligence in media systems. Sinclair believes that flexibility and agility will address rapidly changing media environments and we are confident that great people and great technology equal great solutions. The role of Master Control Operator is responsible for operating the multi-channel and multi-brand control point for Sinclair Television Stations located in Columbus, OH. Duties include, but are not limited to, Live event operations, graphics insertion, playlist manipulation, and monitoring on-air quality of the TV Station to ensure all content airs accurately and reflects the traffic and programming schedules. Additional responsibilities include but are not limited to: Understand and follow standard operating procedures for various networks, including high profile live events and disaster recovery. Modification and verification of playlists for current and future broadcast times. Manipulate playlist for the different “join in progress” scenarios. Consistently monitor on-air material and communicate any discrepancies to Managers. Consistently ensure that playlist information and media content are accurate, which may include but is not limited to: SOM/EOM of segments Database Information Audio specifications Video specifications Secondary events (GPI,SCTE104 and Graphic Insertion) Content Closed Captioning Active Format Descriptor. Ensure proper video routing. Record, Ingest and Prepare content for playout. Monitor equipment for performance / device failures. Capture and document network processes such as timing of log elements, program run times and on air discrepancies. Setup and review content prior to scheduled airtime. Communicate effectively with Managers and Operators to ensure a smooth transition between shifts. Performs other duties as assigned. Understand and follow departmental policies. Qualifications: Minimum 1 Year experience in Master Control Operations functions. Experience in Local TV Station Operations. (A PLUS) Experience in Switching Live Local News and Sporting Events. (A PLUS) Must have great attention to detail and ability to multitask, monitoring multiple playlists and video monitors simultaneously. General understanding of industry regulations and standards for video, audio, captioning and loudness. Understanding of broadcast technology such as switchers, server playout, automation systems, waveform monitors and rasterizers. Ability to communicate effectively, work under stress and perform as part of a team. Aptitude for operating electronic equipment and the capability to learn specialized applications. Experience with Systems and Hardware for Content Ingest, Playout and Distribution. Knowledge of Amagi CLOUDPORT Automation system. (A PLUS) Available to work any shift in a 24/7 Operation as well as holidays and weekends. Knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite. job.title: Media Manager (Input)
job.description: Are you a strategic operations leader who thrives in fast-paced, high-volume environments? Do you enjoy turning complex workflows into clear, efficient systems—and helping teams perform at their best through change? The Agile Creative Content Engagement Team (ACCET) is seeking an experienced Media Manager (Input) to lead and continuously improve centralized input operations across multiple markets. This is a highly visible leadership role responsible not only for daily execution, but for setting the operational direction that improves efficiency, consistency, capacity, and service across the organization. As Media Manager (Input), you will lead Senior Log Coordinators and Log Coordinators responsible for contracts, traffic, copy, reporting, and daily log execution. You will serve as the strategic operational connection between leadership, stations, output teams, and production partners—ensuring the work is prioritized, resources are used effectively, issues are resolved quickly, and processes evolve as the business grows. The ideal candidate is equal parts people leader, process strategist, and problem-solver: someone who can manage today’s operational needs while building smarter, more scalable ways of working for tomorrow. What You Will Do: Lead day-to-day execution for centralized input and log coordination teams across multiple markets, ensuring quality, accuracy, and on-time delivery. Establish clear priorities, operating rhythms, escalation paths, and accountability standards that keep work moving effectively in a fast-paced environment. Lead, coach, and develop Senior Log Coordinators and Log Coordinators, creating a high-performing team grounded in collaboration, ownership, and continuous improvement. Own staffing allocation, workload balancing, capacity planning, and coverage strategies to ensure the team can meet changing business needs. Oversee contracts, traffic, copy, reporting, inventory-related workflows, and other input functions to maintain operational continuity and accuracy. Analyze workflows, performance metrics, recurring issues, and team capacity to identify bottlenecks and implement practical, measurable improvements. Design and refine standardized processes, documentation, and best practices that reduce unnecessary variation and improve consistency across markets. Partner closely with ACCET leadership, Output teams, production, station stakeholders, and cross-functional partners to align workflows with broader business priorities. Translate operational needs into clear process solutions, helping shape system enhancements, automation opportunities, and future workflow modernization. Lead resolution of complex operational issues, balancing urgency with thoughtful decision-making and clear communication. Support major initiatives, new workflows, and organizational changes by developing scalable implementation plans and guiding teams through adoption. Build a culture of continuous improvement where team members are encouraged to identify opportunities, share knowledge, and help strengthen the operation. This Role is for you if: You are a strategic, hands-on leader who can see both the daily operational details and the larger business opportunity. You have a strong track record of improving workflows, building structure, and leading teams through change. You are comfortable making decisions, setting priorities, and resolving escalations in a high-volume, deadline-driven environment. You know how to use data, metrics, and team feedback to identify inefficiencies and improve performance. You are an effective coach who sets clear expectations, develops talent, and creates accountability without losing the human side of leadership. You communicate clearly and confidently with team members, senior leaders, and cross-functional partners. You are highly organized, adaptable, and able to manage multiple priorities without losing sight of quality or customer service. You are energized by building scalable systems and finding better ways to get work done. Experience with OSI, broadcast traffic systems, media operations, or multi-market workflows is strongly preferred. Broadcast television, media operations, traffic, or related operational leadership experience is preferred. Why You’ll Love It Here: Lead a growing centralized operation with the opportunity to directly shape how work is done across the organization. Drive meaningful improvements that make teams more efficient, consistent, and prepared to scale. Partner with a collaborative leadership team focused on innovation, operational excellence, and shared success. Build systems and processes that have a visible, organization-wide impact. job.title: Multimedia Journalist (MMJ)
job.description: KVII/KVIH is looking for a Multi-Media Journalist with a starting salary of $50,000 ($24.04/hr)! We are seeking a driven, curious, and community-minded journalist who understands that advocacy journalism is not a side project for us — it is who we are. This position is for someone who wants to do more than cover the news of the day. We are looking for a storyteller who is committed to asking tough questions, holding the powerful accountable, giving a voice to the voiceless, and following stories until they lead to answers, action, or change. Our best journalism identifies problems in the communities we serve and pushes for solutions. The ideal candidate is a self-starter who can enterprise impactful local stories, develop strong sources, shoot and edit compelling video, and write clearly for broadcast and digital platforms. You should be comfortable working independently, turning daily content under deadline, and digging deeper when a story demands more context, follow-up, or accountability. Responsibilities include: Covering daily news, breaking news, and enterprise stories across the Texas Panhandle and surrounding communities Pitching and producing advocacy-focused stories that identify community concerns, expose problems, and seek meaningful responses Shooting, writing, editing, and presenting stories for television, digital, and social platforms Developing sources and building trust with viewers, community members, and local leaders Following up on stories to make sure questions are answered and concerns are not forgotten Using social media and digital tools to find stories, engage audiences, and expand the reach of our journalism Required skills and qualifications: Strong writing, storytelling, and news judgment Ability to shoot and edit video Comfortable reporting live and working under deadline pressure A commitment to accuracy, fairness, and ethical journalism A passion for local news and serving the community Strong communication and organizational skills A valid driver’s license and clean driving record Previous newsroom experience or a journalism degree is preferred, but we are most interested in candidates who are hungry to learn, eager to grow, and committed to making a difference through their reporting. Advocacy journalism is central to our mission. We believe local journalism should help people, demand accountability, and shine a light on issues that matter. We are looking for an MMJ who shares that purpose and wants their work to have impact. While applying online, please include a link to your online demo reel. job.title: Post Sale Account Manager
job.description: Role: Account Manager, Post-Sale Overview The Account Manager, Post Sale serves as the operational lead and post-sale project manager for AMP Media campaigns across video podcast, branded content, social, and talent-led programming. Acting as the campaign COO, this person ensures flawless execution, on-time delivery, and alignment across all internal and external teams. This role centers on project management, client communication, and campaign execution — not media planning, sales strategy, or reporting. The ideal candidate is highly organized, collaborative, and committed to delivering exceptional client experience and creative outcomes. Core Responsibilities 1. Campaign Execution & Project Management Oversee all post-sale campaign components, managing timelines, milestones, and deliverables across internal departments. Serve as the primary liaison for all creative assets (e.g., logos, brand style guides, talent materials), excluding media tagging and trafficking (handled by the Planning & Campaign Management team). Coordinate with AMPs internal production, corporate graphics, talent teams to ensure creative deliverables meet brand and platform standards. Lead weekly internal status meetings to track deliverables, identify blockers, and ensure campaign progress for all high touch campaigns. Maintain organized project documentation, timelines, and communication threads. 2. Client & Agency Communication Act as the main point of contact for clients and agencies post-sale, managing all communications related to creative execution, approvals, and deliverables. Build strong relationships with clients and agencies by providing proactive updates, solutions, and clear timelines. Manage client expectations and ensure alignment across all project elements. 3. Branded & Custom Content Coordination Manage the creation and approval process for branded integrations, talent-based executions, and social content. Coordinate live event integrations or other custom campaign activations. 5. Business Reviews & Client Deliverables Support the preparation and coordination of Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) for high-priority (“white glove”) clients alongside Account Executives. Strong client-facing and communication skills, with proven ability to manage multiple stakeholders. Exceptional organizational and time-management skills, with attention to detail and follow-through. Experience managing creative deliverables (audio, social, video, branded content). Familiarity with digital advertising and content production processes. Proficiency in project management or collaboration tools (e.g., Asana, Airtable, Smartsheet). Positive, team-oriented, and adaptable in a fast-paced, high-growth environment. job.title: Product Manager
job.description: The Product Manager owns the strategy, roadmap, prioritization, and lifecycle management for a portfolio of enterprise applications that includes both custom-developed solutions and third-party SaaS or packaged products. This role partners with business stakeholders, engineering teams, vendors, and support teams to deliver measurable business value, maintain reliable operations, and evolve products in line with user needs and enterprise priorities. Key Responsibilities Product Strategy and Roadmap: Define and maintain product vision, roadmaps, and outcome-based priorities for assigned applications. Balance new capabilities, technical debt, operational stability, compliance, and user experience. Stakeholder Partnership and Discovery: Engage business users and leaders to understand workflows, pain points, opportunities, and success measures. Translate insights into clear, actionable requirements and product decisions. Portfolio and Backlog Management: Own and prioritize the product backlog using business value, risk, effort, dependencies, and strategic alignment. Ensure planned work is sufficiently refined for delivery teams and stakeholders have transparent visibility into priorities. Custom Application Delivery: Work closely with internal development, QA, architecture, and delivery teams throughout discovery, design, development, testing, release, and adoption. Provide timely decisions and clarifications during Agile ceremonies. Third-Party Application Management: Lead the business and product relationship for third-party applications, including vendor coordination, release-impact assessment, roadmap alignment, support escalation, and evaluation of configuration or enhancement opportunities. Requirements and Product Artifacts: Create and maintain product requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, user experience mock-ups, release communications, and other artifacts needed to align delivery and business teams. Operational Ownership: Partner with production support and vendors to monitor service health, triage issues, communicate business impact, and prioritize corrective work. Help ensure a disciplined transition from delivery to sustainable support. Validation and Adoption: Plan and coordinate user acceptance testing, gather feedback, validate outcomes, and support rollout readiness, training, and adoption activities. Measurement and Continuous Improvement: Define and use product, operational, and adoption metrics to assess performance, identify trends, and drive continuous improvement. Required Experience and Skills Bachelor’s degree in information technology, business, computer science, or a related field; equivalent experience will be considered. Five or more years of product management, product ownership, business analysis, or comparable experience supporting enterprise applications. Experience managing a mix of custom-developed applications, integrations and third-party SaaS or packaged software. Strong ability to turn business needs into well-structured requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and product documentation. Demonstrated ability to prioritize competing demands using data, business value, risk, and operational impact. Working knowledge of Agile delivery practices, including backlog refinement, sprint planning, reviews, and retrospectives. Comfort working with software vendors on product roadmaps, support escalations, releases, and enhancement requests. Strong analytical, communication, facilitation, and stakeholder-management skills; able to lead through influence rather than formal authority. Ability to understand and troubleshoot complex software workflows and communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical audiences. A customer-focused, curious, adaptable approach and commitment to continuous learning and improvement. Preferred Qualifications Experience supporting enterprise business systems in a complex, multi-stakeholder organization. Experience with product analytics, service management, or application lifecycle management tools (Azure DevOps experience preferred). Experience coordinating Tier 2 support activities and working across internal delivery teams and external vendors. Other duties as assigned. This position is on site in Hunt Valley, MD. Candidates must be local or willing to commute. job.title: Regional Sales Assistant

job.title: Sales and Marketing Specialist
job.description: This Job Description May Cause Extreme Excitement and Career Growth At AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions, we believe a great workplace isn't just something we say — it's something you can feel when you join the team. Here, it's all about great collabs, ambition, and results but most importantly, we grow here, and we enjoy here. We're searching for that special someone — a driven, talented individual to join our innovative media sales team. In this role, you'll engage with new and existing clients and show them how our innovative media solutions can amplify their brands and deliver measurable success. If you're energized by building relationships, closing deals, and making an impact, we'd love to hear from you. Sound like the right fit? Check out the checklist below and if it sounds like you, hit "Apply Now" and let's chat. Your Day-to-Day (aka the Playbook) Help Brands Thrive: Join our media sales team and play a pivotal role in helping brands and companies grow. By identifying new opportunities, building strong client relationships, and delivering impactful solutions, you'll showcase how our multi-media content platforms and digital assets can drive meaningful results for our partners. Your focus will be on helping clients achieve their goals, ensuring that every campaign is a success. When our clients win, we win—and we believe in celebrating those victories together! Make Connections: Embrace your powers of persuasion and make every handshake and meeting count! Every interaction is a chance to build a genuine connection and show clients how we can help them succeed. You're not just selling; you're building partnerships. You're helping businesses find the right audience in the right place at the right time. When we say One Partner, Endless Possibilities, we mean it! Be A Trusted Guide: In this role, you'll connect with clients on a human level, understand their unique needs, and craft tailored sales and marketing solutions that deliver results. As their trusted advisor, you'll help them navigate the ever-evolving marketing landscape, ensuring every step of the journey is planned with care and precision. Shake Things Up: Bring your creativity and fresh ideas to the table! We're looking for someone who challenges the status quo, embraces innovation, and finds new ways to connect with our audience. Your contributions will help elevate our brand and drive meaningful results for your clients. Join us and Conquer the Media Landscape: You'll be part of a dedicated team of A1 media sales professionals, committed to achieving market leadership. Together, we amplify our impact, deliver exceptional outcomes, and help our clients succeed in ways that truly matter. Identify Emerging Opportunities: It's about being able to see what others can't, anticipating market shifts, analyzing data and predicting the next big thing. Your insights will position our clients and AMP for long-term success. What We're Looking For Proven Sales Ability (or an Unstoppable Desire to Learn) Whether you're a seasoned sales professional or just getting started, we value your drive, energy, and passion for achieving results. Strong Communication Skills: You're a natural at building relationships and communicating effectively. Proficiency with digital tools and applications is a must. A Passion for helping Others: You're committed to understanding clients' needs, providing top-notch customer service and making a difference. You're not just selling a product; you're providing a solution. A Competitive Spirit: Do you get a little boost when you achieve a goal (especially if it was a tough one)? We love that for you (and us)! We want someone who's driven to excel but also knows how to celebrate the victories (big and small) with their team. That drive makes you a valuable part of our organization. A Willingness to Grow: Do you thrive in environments where you're always learning something new? Excellent, you'll fit right in! The media world is constantly evolving, and the ability to learn, adapt, and embrace challenges in a fast-paced, digital-first environment is key. The Practical Stuff A valid driver's license, up-to-date insurance, and reliable transportation are necessary for connecting with clients in your community. Why Join AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions? / The Reasons You Should Hit "Apply Now" Serious Work, Seriously Cool People: Be part of a dynamic team that values creativity, collaboration, and fun! We are all for work that is rewarding. The Compensation Package: We offer a base salary, commission structure, and benefits package designed to support your success and well-being. Happy employees don't stage rebellions! ;) We Make a Real Difference (Not Just Talk About It): At AMP, we help local businesses thrive through advertising strategies that create tangible impacts. Our media sales specialist isn't just selling ads; they're the boots on the ground, making a real difference where it counts. (And yes, it feels pretty good.) Top-Notch Training and Support: We're not the kind of company that hires you and then disappears into the corporate abyss. We carefully select candidates for a cohort-based training program, where you'll join a group of sales professionals from all over the country. From onboarding to ongoing mentorship, we invest in your success with training programs that set you up for long-term growth. Career Growth Opportunities: We believe in investing in you. That's why you'll have access to training, mentorship, and career advancement opportunities to help you thrive. We are a leader in our industry, flexing our local charm and national muscle, providing you with options to amplify your career in your local market or join one of our AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions teams in another city. Comprehensive Media Education (We Are Your Power Source!): New to the industry? We've got you covered with training programs that turn curiosity into expertise. AMP is us. It's you. It isn't just a name; it's a mission. A promise to amplify our reach, amplify our innovation, and most importantly, amplify you. If you're ready to grow your career and help businesses achieve their goals, we'd love to hear from you. EEO AND INCLUSIVITY Sinclair is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and a drug free workplace. Employment practices will not be inﬂuenced or aﬀected by virtue of an applicant's or employee's race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, gender identity, and sexual orientation), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, military or veteran status or any other characteristic protected by law. The base salary compensation range for this role is $45,000 to $50,000. This position is also eligible to earn commissions, which are 2.2-14% of sales the employee closes that meet the definition of ‘earned’. Final compensation for this role will be determined by various factors such as a candidates’ relevant work experience, skills, certifications, and geographic location. Full time positions are eligible for benefits that include participation in a retirement plan, life and disability insurance, health, dental and vision plans, flexible spending accounts, sick leave, vacation time, personal time, parental leave, and employee stock purchase plan.

job.title: Senior Data Engineer
job.description: The Senior Data Engineer is a highly hands-on individual contributor responsible for building, operating, and improving Sinclair's enterprise data platform. This is a Snowflake-first engineering role: most of the work is performed within Snowflake and its native ecosystem. The role spans ingestion, integration, transformation, data modeling, data quality, observability, performance, cost optimization, and production support, with particular emphasis on Snowflake-native development and Snowflake Openflow. The ideal candidate has approximately five years of progressive data engineering experience with substantial Snowflake depth, strong SQL and Python skills, and a track record of delivering reliable, well-governed data solutions in a complex enterprise setting. This position is on-site in Hunt Valley, MD. Candidates must be local or willing to commute. Responsibilities Snowflake Engineering & Data Pipeline Development Design, build, test, deploy, and maintain production-grade data pipelines using Snowflake-native capabilities including Snowpipe, streams, tasks, stored procedures, and functions. Build scalable ELT patterns and bronze/silver/gold data models that make enterprise data reliable, reusable, and easy to consume. Develop SQL and Python solutions for transformation, automation, orchestration, validation, and operational workflows. Troubleshoot production issues, perform root-cause analysis, and implement durable, maintainable fixes. Snowflake Openflow & Enterprise Integrations Build, configure, operate, and troubleshoot Snowflake Openflow pipelines and connectors for enterprise data ingestion and replication. Develop and support integrations from relational databases, Oracle environments, traffic and operational systems, CRM platforms, and other enterprise sources. Implement API-based and vendor integrations using secure stages, external access integrations, authentication, and appropriate Snowflake ingestion patterns. Modernize legacy ETL by moving appropriate workloads to Openflow and Snowflake-native ELT patterns that improve reliability, maintainability, and efficiency. Data Quality, Reliability & Observability Build data quality and validation controls covering completeness, accuracy, freshness, reconciliation, and integration health. Develop monitoring and observability for ingestion, pipeline execution, data freshness, failures, and other operational conditions. Design pipelines for resilience, restartability, traceability, and maintainability, with clear operational ownership and documentation. Platform Engineering, Performance & Governance Work deeply with Snowflake databases, schemas, warehouses, stages, integrations, roles, and other platform objects required to deliver production data solutions. Optimize queries, pipelines, warehouses, and data structures for performance and cost using actual workload and usage patterns. Apply appropriate access controls, environment separation, data protection, auditability, and governance practices in partnership with Security and data owners. Identify technical debt, reliability risks, unnecessary spend, and opportunities to simplify or standardize solutions. Data Products & Engineering Collaboration Build governed data foundations for enterprise reporting, analytics, operational workflows, and emerging AI and data-product use cases. Develop reusable data assets that support analytics applications, semantic layers, agents, and other consumption patterns without duplicating business logic. Participate in technical design, code reviews, releases, production support, and continuous improvement; use Git, automated deployment, testing, and documentation practices. Collaborate with Data Engineering, BI, Data Science, Security, Infrastructure, Finance, and business stakeholders to deliver practical, supportable solutions. Required Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field; equivalent relevant experience will be considered. Approximately five or more years of progressive experience in data engineering, analytics engineering, or a closely related discipline. Deep, hands-on Snowflake experience building and supporting production data solutions in an enterprise environment. Strong SQL skills with experience in data modeling, ELT/ETL development, query optimization, and production troubleshooting. Hands-on experience with Snowflake-native capabilities such as Snowpipe, streams, tasks, stored procedures, and related engineering patterns. Experience building production integrations across multiple source systems and business domains, plus strong Python skills for engineering, automation, APIs, or Snowflake development. Experience with data quality, monitoring, observability, access controls, and governance in a production environment. Experience with Git-based source control, code review, deployment practices, and modern software engineering approaches; strong problem-solving, communication, documentation, and ownership skills. Preferred Qualifications Experience with Snowflake Openflow and NiFi-based connectors for enterprise data replication and integration. Snowflake certification such as SnowPro Core, Advanced Data Engineer, or Advanced Administrator. Experience modernizing legacy ETL platforms into Snowflake-native and Openflow architectures. Experience with Snowflake performance tuning, warehouse sizing, workload optimization, resource monitoring, cost management, data sharing, or secure data distribution. Experience with external access integrations, OAuth, API integrations, notification patterns, or data quality/operational observability solutions. Experience with enterprise financial, customer, CRM, advertising, traffic, media, audience, or operational data; familiarity with Snowflake Cortex or Snowflake Intelligence is a plus. Why Join Us This is an opportunity to do meaningful, hands-on data engineering at the center of an enterprise Snowflake environment that directly supports how the business operates, measures performance, serves customers, and makes decisions. You will work on real production data problems across Snowflake, Openflow, enterprise integrations, data quality, automation, and emerging AI capabilities. If you enjoy building things that work, taking ownership of production systems, solving complex data challenges, and continuously improving a modern data platform, this role is built for you. The base salary compensation range for this role is $102,000 to $136,000. Final compensation for this role will be determined by various factors such as a candidate’s relevant work experience, skills, certifications, and geographic location. Full time positions are eligible for benefits that include participation in a retirement plan, life and disability insurance, health, dental and vision plans, flexible spending accounts, 15 paid vacation days, 2 paid personal days, 9 paid holidays, 40 hours of paid sick leave, parental leave, and employee stock purchase plan. EEO AND INCLUSIVITY: Sinclair is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and a drug free workplace. job.title: Solutions Marketing Associate
job.description: The Solutions Marketing Associate helps Sales create more quality client conversations while delivering fast, polished support for everyday opportunities. This role sits closest to the front end of the sales funnel: helping sellers identify the right accounts, do their homework, personalize outreach, and turn established marketing materials into relevant client-facing presentations. For standard and smaller opportunities, typically $100K or less, the Associate uses existing positioning, narratives, templates, research, case studies, and proof points to efficiently build tailored sales materials without recreating strategy from scratch. At the prospecting stage, the Associate gives sellers the account intelligence and lead development support they need to earn more meetings. This role builds the intelligence and inputs behind outreach but does not conduct cold calling, prospecting outreach, or appointment setting. The north star is twofold: help Sales get into more of the right conversations, and help them show up to those conversations prepared. What You’ll Do Prospecting & Meeting Generation Support Identify and research target accounts that fit priority audiences, verticals, solutions, or seller territories. Build and maintain actionable lead and account lists with the context sellers need to prioritize outreach. Research target companies, key contacts, recent business developments, marketing activity, competitive context, and relevant signals that can create a reason to engage. Prepare concise account briefs and outreach inputs that help sellers personalize emails, calls, and meeting requests. Connect prospect needs and business signals to relevant Digital Remedy capabilities, proof points, content, and conversation starters. Partner with Sales on focused prospecting initiatives and campaigns designed to generate qualified meetings. Track which research, prospecting themes, and materials are helping sellers open doors and use those learnings to improve future support. Sales Presentations & Everyday Opportunity Support Support standard and smaller opportunities, typically $100K or less, by tailoring existing presentations and materials to the customer and opportunity. Build polished client-facing decks using established templates, positioning, solution narratives, case studies, research, and proof points. Quickly identify the most relevant existing materials instead of rebuilding presentations from scratch. Perform light account, category, audience, or competitive research when needed to make an established story more relevant. Ensure materials are accurate, on-brand, easy for sellers to present, and aligned with established messaging. Escalate opportunities that require original research, custom strategy, or a new problem-led narrative to the Solutions Marketing Analyst or Manager. Sales Alignment & Enablement Serve as a highly responsive day-to-day partner to Sales, understanding seller priorities, pipeline needs, and recurring friction points. Help sellers navigate available materials, case studies, research, and solution stories so they can self-serve effectively when appropriate. Capture recurring requests and content gaps and share them with the Solutions Marketing Manager and Product & Enablement team. Support broader sales and marketing initiatives that create demand, improve seller preparedness, or accelerate opportunities. What Success Looks Like Sellers have a consistent pipeline of well-researched accounts and stronger reasons to reach out. Prospecting support contributes to more qualified meetings and new sales conversations. Smaller and standard opportunities receive fast, polished, relevant presentation support without unnecessary custom development. Sales spends less time searching for materials and researching accounts and more time engaging customers. The Associate knows when to activate existing materials and when an opportunity should be escalated for deeper strategic support. What You Bring 1-3 years of experience in sales development, sales support, marketing, research, enablement, account planning, or a coordinator/associate role. Strong research instincts and genuine curiosity about companies, industries, buyers, and business challenges. Strong PowerPoint or Google Slides skills and good visual judgment. Ability to turn research into concise, usable seller talking points and outreach inputs. Excellent organization and ability to manage multiple fast-turn requests. A proactive, service-oriented mindset paired with the confidence to ask questions and recommend a better path when needed. Familiarity with CRM, prospecting, sales intelligence, and research tools is a plus. Interest in developing toward solutions marketing, insights, strategy, or sales enablement. Please note that this position is not eligible for visa sponsorship, including employer sponsorship for an H-1B visa, OPT-STEM employment, etc. Why Digital Remedy? We are in a high-growth phase, integrating innovative tech from recent acquisitions. You will have a seat at the table to influence our long-term technical strategy and help us "build and scale" for the future. job.title: Solutions Marketing Manager
job.description: The Solutions Marketing Manager leads the team responsible for turning customer challenges into insight-led, differentiated solutions. This role is both a people leader and a senior strategic partner to Sales, setting the standard for how the organization approaches complex opportunities, RFPs/RFIs, and high-priority client conversations. Rather than starting with a product or a predetermined activation, the Manager starts with the customer: What are they trying to accomplish? What does the market tell us? Which combination of capabilities can best address the challenge? And what is the most compelling story for why Digital Remedy can solve it? The Manager owns the strategic approach for the most complex opportunities while building a team and operating model that gives Sales the right level of support across the pipeline. What You’ll Do Lead Customer & Opportunity Strategy Partner with Sales on complex, strategic, and high-value opportunities to identify the underlying customer business and marketing challenge. Lead problem-led solution development that combines multiple products, audiences, platforms, media types, and services around specific customer needs. Define the strategic angle, narrative architecture, and recommendation for major pitches, RFPs, and RFIs. Challenge briefs and assumptions constructively when a stronger strategic approach can improve the opportunity. Translate customer objectives, audiences, KPIs, and market dynamics into clear strategic recommendations. Build Strategic Narratives & Solutions Develop executive-level client narratives that connect challenge, insight, strategy, solution, proof, and expected outcome. Ensure recommendations are integrated solutions rather than collections of disconnected capabilities. Lead custom research and insight development where it can materially strengthen the strategy. Simplify complex capabilities into persuasive stories for senior client and agency audiences. Lead quarterly business reviews for top strategic accounts, setting the standard for how the team frames performance, insight, and forward-looking recommendations that shape the client relationship. Lead the Solutions Marketing Team Manage, coach, and develop the Solutions Marketing Analyst and Solutions Marketing Associate. Establish intake, prioritization, routing, and quality standards so the team deploys strategic resources where they can have the greatest revenue impact. Create clear escalation paths from scalable sales support to custom strategy and executive-level opportunity support. Build the team’s skills in customer discovery, research, storytelling, strategic thinking, presentation development, and sales partnership. Measure team impact through pipeline support, meetings created, opportunity outcomes, turnaround time, and seller adoption, not presentation volume alone. Partner Across Marketing & Sales Work closely with the Marketing Manager, Product & Enablement to apply established positioning, messaging, GTM frameworks, proof points, and foundational materials to customer-specific opportunities. Provide feedback from live opportunities to Product & Enablement on recurring customer needs, competitive themes, content gaps, and emerging solution opportunities. Collaborate with Sales, Research, Product, Creative, and other subject-matter experts to assemble the right expertise around priority opportunities. Advocate for earlier Solutions Marketing involvement so the team helps shape recommendations rather than simply package decisions already made. What Success Looks Like Solutions Marketing is viewed by Sales as a strategic partner, not a production resource. Priority pitches and RFP/RFI responses lead with customer problems and insights rather than product capabilities. The team provides differentiated levels of support efficiently across the pipeline. Sellers bring Solutions Marketing into important opportunities earlier in the process. Team support contributes to stronger client conversations, pipeline progression, and revenue outcomes. What You Bring 5+ years of experience in solutions marketing, integrated marketing, media strategy, sales strategy, brand strategy, agency planning, or a related discipline. Demonstrated ability to translate complex business challenges into clear strategic recommendations and compelling narratives. Experience leading RFPs, RFIs, major pitches, or complex client proposals. Strong research, analytical, storytelling, and executive presentation skills. Ability to connect multiple products and capabilities into cohesive customer solutions. Strong commercial instincts and a collaborative, consultative approach to partnering with Sales. People management or demonstrated team leadership experience. Experience in media, advertising, agencies, ad tech, or B2B marketing is a plus. job.title: Weekend Meteorologist Reporter
job.description: WSYX/WTTE, the market-leading news operation in Central Ohio, is looking for a dynamic Weekend Meteorologist/Reporter to join our award-winning weather team. This isn't just a weekend weather job. We're looking for someone who understands that weather is one of the biggest drivers of audience engagement across television, streaming, digital, social media, and mobile platforms. You'll be responsible for delivering accurate, compelling forecasts while helping our newsroom own severe weather coverage, producing impactful weather-related stories, and reporting on issues that matter to the communities we serve. As part of our commitment to innovation, you'll also have access to Central Ohio's only augmented reality weather presentation system —a market-exclusive forecasting tool that allows our meteorologists to create immersive, visually compelling weathercasts that help viewers better understand the forecast and stay safe during high-impact weather. The ideal candidate is a strong communicator, confident in breaking weather situations, and passionate about serving our communities with clear, informative forecasting and compelling storytelling. What You'll Do Produce and present engaging weathercasts on ABC 6, FOX 28, streaming platforms, and digital channels. Utilize our market-exclusive augmented reality weather system to create innovative, immersive weather presentations that elevate storytelling and viewer understanding. Report from the field on weather events, breaking news, and enterprise stories that impact Central Ohio. Develop original weather-related and environmental stories that go beyond the daily forecast. Lead cross-functional initiatives with broad organizational visibility, establishing formal networks with senior business, legal, finance, product, policy, and operational decision-makers. Act as an authoritative external representative of the company, as appropriate, in proceedings, negotiations, regulatory engagements and other matters involving legal or reputational risk. T ypically requires a minimum of 8 years of applicable experience at a law firm or in-house legal department. Demonstrated experience leading critical, complex, or precedent-setting litigation and/or regulatory matters. Proven ability to advise senior leadership, influence key decision-makers and to drive enterprise legal strategy, objectives, and principles. Strong knowledge of civil procedure, regulatory investigations and dispute resolution strategies. Experience managing outside counsel and litigation budgets. Excellent legal research, writing, analytical and negotiation skills. Ability to manage multiple litigation matters simultaneously in a fast-paced environment. Strong business acumen and the ability to communicate legal risks effectively to business stakeholders. Background in handling class action lawsuits, intellectual property disputes, or government investigations; additional experience in rate court and Copyright Royalty Board Proceedings preferred. Proficiency with e-discovery tools and legal technology platforms. Experience with automation and/or AI tools such as ChatGPT, Gemini, etc. Familiarity with digital audio, streaming and/or entertainment businesses preferred. job.title: A&R Analyst - Sony Music Nashville
job.description:
About Sony Music Entertainment

At Sony Music Entertainment, we fuel the creative journey. We’ve played a pioneering role in music history, from the first-ever music label to the invention of the flat disc record. We’ve nurtured some of music’s most iconic artists and produced some of the most influential recordings of all time.

Today, we work in more than 70 countries, supporting a diverse roster of international superstars, developing and independent artists, and visionary creators. From our position at the intersection of music, entertainment, and technology, we bring imagination and expertise to the newest products and platforms, embrace new business models, employ breakthrough tools, and provide powerful insights that help our artists push creative boundaries and reach new audiences. In everything we do, we’re committed to artistic integrity, transparency, and entrepreneurship.

Sony Music Entertainment is a member of the Sony family of global companies.

As an A&R Analyst with Sony Music Nashville, you will have a central role in supporting our A&R team by providing important insights and data-driven evaluations on both rostered and undiscovered artists.

In this role, you will implement and manage data-driven methods to discover new artists, run daily reports to aid in artist discovery and analysis, construct statistical insights and predictive metrics, conduct research on artists and analyze new music – both signed and unsigned. This role is a unique opportunity to help the company discover our next superstars and help drive data-assisted decision making within the A&R team.

What you'll do:

  • Conduct research to evaluate new music and improve the A&R team’s understanding of new music metrics including social networking sites, data and analytics
  • Extract, prepare, analyze and present relevant music and social activity data to help identify new potential talent while also monitoring the marketplace and constructing new methods to draw insights from this data
  • Develop and implement new analytical processes, technologies and tools for use by the A&R team and other departments in support of trend identification, etc.
  • Regularly meet with A&R team to provide updates on activity and marketplace
  • Generate weekly reports and lead meetings to brief team on artists of interest
  • Work with internal teams as needed to create and troubleshoot queries, dashboards and other identification tools
  • Create artist-specific reports detailing audience growth and consumption relative to similar artists
  • Compile and monitor stream count and social media metrics for unsigned, undiscovered artists
  • Identify and interpret relevant data in the context of the current music landscape
  • Assess and summarize tendencies in consumption source across genres/subgenres
  • Proactively identify additional areas for analysis and identification of new artists
  • Deliver and present large data sets in a useful and meaningful way, by presenting key information across several methods and platforms to the broader Sony leadership team

Who you are:

  • At least two years of music or entertainment industry experience, with a demonstrated track record of using data to find new and emerging talent
  • A passionate new music listener with a strong knowledge of various genres of music with an emphasis on country format and ability to separate/identify commercially viable talent
  • A team player with an understanding of current tastes and trends of the market, preferably with prior experience interacting with recording artists and an understanding of artist lifestyle
  • A self-starter with exceptional communication skills, time management skills and an ability to prioritize and multi-task, work independently and with teammates
  • An independent thinker with strong computer skills including MS Office (Word, Excel & Outlook) and proven internet and data analytics capabilities, as well as a working knowledge of digital music space and social media
  • Available to attend evening showcases as well as ability to travel as needed
  • Knowledge of music monitoring platforms such as Music Connect, Mediabase and Indify

What we give you:

  • You join an inclusive, collaborative and global community where you have the opportunity to channel your passion every day

  • Voluntary benefits like company-paid identity theft protection and resources for pets, mental health and meditation resources, industry-leading fertility coverage, fully paid leave for childbirth or bonding, fully paid leave for caregivers, programs for loved ones with developmental disabilities and neurodiversity, subsidized back-up child and elder care, and reimbursement for adoption, surrogacy, tuition, and student loans
