You'll balance executive support, office operations, and special projects in a fast-paced, collaborative environment where no two days are the same. Success in this role comes from being highly organized, proactive, and adaptable, with exceptional communication skills, strong attention to detail, and a hospitality-first mindset. You'll anticipate needs, solve problems before they arise, and help foster a positive, efficient workplace that enables our team to do their best work.

What you'll do:

  • Provide Executive & Administrative Support
    Serve as the primary administrative partner to the Executive Leadership Team by managing calendars, coordinating meetings across multiple time zones, preparing agendas and materials, taking meeting notes to distribute to attendees, handling confidential information with discretion, and anticipating executive needs to ensure seamless day-to-day operations. Coordinate business travel, expense reporting, invoice processing, and corporate card reconciliations while supporting presentations, reports, data analysis, and other strategic administrative initiatives
  • Manage Executive Operations & Business Administration. Provide administrative support for operational projects to senior leadership, including process documentation, organizational planning and documentation, and cross-functional initiatives.
  • Manage Office Operations & Workplace Experience
    Oversee daily office operations to ensure an organized, efficient, and welcoming workplace. Manage office supplies, mail, facilities, showroom organization, vendor coordination, and new hire onboarding, including workspace setup, systems access, equipment, and orientation.
  • Plan & Execute Company Events
    Lead the planning and execution of company events, employee engagement activities, industry events, conferences, and special events. Manage budgets, vendor selection, logistics, contracts, and event execution to deliver high-quality experiences while maintaining cost efficiency.
  • Support Cross-Functional Teams & Continuous Improvement
    Provide administrative and operational support across departments during peak business periods, collaborating with leadership to improve processes, enhance workflows, and contribute to an efficient, collaborative workplace.

Who you are:

  • An organized administrative professional with 2+ years of experience supporting executives, teams, or office operations in a fast-paced environment.
  • Proactive and resourceful, with strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining exceptional attention to detail.
  • A strong communicator who builds positive relationships, exercises good judgment, and handles confidential information with professionalism and discretion.
  • A collaborative team player who enjoys supporting others, thrives in a dynamic environment, and is always willing to jump in where needed.
  • Detail-oriented and tech-savvy, with proficiency in Microsoft Office (particularly Outlook, Excel, and PowerPoint) and the ability to quickly learn tools such as Asana, Box, Concur, and other business applications.
  • Service-minded with a growth mindset, eager to take ownership, continuously improve processes, and contribute to creating a positive, organized, and engaging workplace culture

What we give you:

  • You join an inclusive, collaborative and global community where you have the opportunity to channel your passion every day
  • A modern office environment designed to foster productivity, creativity, and teamwork empowering you to bring your best
  • An attractive and comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, life & disability coverage, and 401K + employer matching
  • Voluntary benefits like company-paid identity theft protection and resources for pets, mental health and meditation resources, industry-leading fertility coverage, fully paid leave for childbirth or bonding, fully paid leave for caregivers, programs for loved ones with developmental disabilities and neurodiversity, subsidized back-up child and elder care, and reimbursement for adoption, surrogacy, tuition, and student loans
  • Investment in your professional growth and development enabling you to thrive in our vibrant community.

job.title: Assistant Manager - Video Partnerships
job.description:
We are looking for a Assistant Manager – Video Partnerships to drive the growth and monetization of our Catalogue across YouTube, Meta, Snapchat and other video platforms. The role will focus on identifying opportunities to extend the life of existing content through new video formats, recreations and content-led initiatives, while working closely with internal teams, artists, creators and vendors to drive audience growth and consumption.

What you'll do:

  • Own YouTube and video platform strategy for catalogue growth, driving views, engagement, audience and revenue.
  • Identify high-potential catalogue tracks and create new opportunities through recreations, remixes, edits, Shorts, lyric videos and other formats.
  • Build and manage a catalogue content pipeline, working with internal teams, creators and vendors from concept to execution.
  • Manage video recreations and edits, ensuring quality, timely delivery and alignment with creative direction.
  • Use platform analytics and dashboards to track performance, identify opportunities and provide actionable recommendations.
  • Drive content discoverability and performance through packaging, thumbnails, metadata, playlists, publishing and platform best practices.
  • Track music/video trends, creators and emerging formats to identify opportunities for Sony Music’s catalogue.
  • Manage multiple projects and work cross-functionally to execute and scale catalogue growth initiatives.
  • Manage and mentor team members.

Who you are:

  • 4–6 years of experience in digital content, YouTube, social media, music, or catalogue growth.
  • Experience in YouTube, digital media, music, entertainment or content marketing.
  • Strong hands-on knowledge of YouTube Studio and YouTube Analytics with the ability to interpret data and derive business insights.
  • Strong understanding of YouTube and social media video formats, including Shorts and vertical content.
  • Proven experience in channel growth, content strategy and digital audience development.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets and reporting.
  • Excellent communication, stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration skills.
  • Ability to independently own projects, manage teams/stakeholders and work in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong passion for music, entertainment, creators and digital content trends.

What we give you:

job.title: Associate Director, Audience Development - The Orchard
job.description:
About The Orchard:

The Orchard is a leading global music distributor and Artist & Label services company operating in 50+ markets worldwide. The Orchard empowers creators and businesses to grow and adapt in the dynamic global music industry. We specialize in being artist focused, blending industry expertise and technology, leveraging data to drive success, and providing streamlined digital and physical distribution solutions. The Orchard’s comprehensive artist & label services offerings include marketing, sync licensing, premium video services, transparent data analysis, advertising, rights management, radio promotion, D2C, and more.

The Orchard focuses on providing a comfortable, social, and engaging environment to encourage productivity and creativity.

We are seeking an experienced and innovative Associate Director of Audience Development to join our New York-based Marketing Strategy & Audience Development team. This role will lead the day-to-day strategy and hands-on execution of first-party fan data acquisition campaigns (email & SMS), with a particular focus on building high-intent email and SMS audiences that can be converted into e-commerce merchandise buyers & beyond.

Reporting to the Vice President, Audience Development, this role combines strategic thinking, hands-on campaign execution and data-driven performance optimization. You’ll leverage proprietary technology, paid and organic marketing channels, live events and third-party audience tools to deliver measurable growth for artists and label partners across multiple genres and career stages.

Please note: This is a hands-on role that will occasionally require evening or weekend work to support priority releases & live events.

What you'll do:

  • Office- first role, in office 4 days a week.

First-Party Data Acquisition Strategy

  • Partnering closely with our Marketing Strategists, you’ll lead the day-to-day development and execution of strategies that grow artists’ first-party fan audiences across email & SMS.
  • Use data to identify the right value exchange for each audience, including exclusive content, early merchandise access, contests, ticket presales, live-event activations and other fan experiences.
  • Develop scalable acquisition frameworks & benchmarks that can be adapted across artists, genres, & campaign types.
  • Partner closely with the Associate Director, Fan Engagement & CRM to ensure newly acquired fans enter CRM lifecycle journeys and receive a cohesive experience from initial sign-up through conversion and retention.

Campaign Execution & Optimization

  • Support our Marketing Strategists by owning the end-to-end execution of fan acquisition campaigns, including campaign planning, audience strategy, platform setup, landing pages, sign-up flows, testing, launch and performance reporting.
  • Collaborate with Marketing Strategy & Global Paid Media teams to develop and optimize impactful paid lead-generation campaigns across Meta, TikTok and other relevant platforms.
  • Establish testing frameworks and best practices across landing pages, forms, incentives, messaging and acquisition channels to improve both the volume and quality of acquired fans.

E-Commerce & Revenue Growth

  • Partner with D2C, CRM and Marketing Strategy teams to connect your acquisition campaigns to downstream product discovery, sales conversion and repeat-purchase opportunities.
  • Use transactional and behavioral data to identify the channels, campaigns and fan segments most likely to generate merchandise revenue.
  • Collaborate with the Associate Director, Fan Engagement & CRM to build clear handoff strategies that move newly acquired fans into personalized welcome, nurture and conversion journeys.
  • Collaborate with the Associate Director, Fan Engagement & CRM and Global Paid Media to evaluate acquisition performance beyond initial sign-up volume, using metrics such as cost per acquired fan, subscriber quality, engagement, first-purchase conversion, revenue per acquired fan and return on investment.

Audience Insights, Measurement & Reporting

  • Develop reporting frameworks that connect fan acquisition activity to downstream engagement, streaming, ticketing and e-commerce outcomes.
  • Define campaign KPIs and benchmarks across acquisition channels, markets, artists and campaign types.
  • Analyze fan behavior to identify high-value audience segments, acquisition sources and conversion patterns.
  • Translate performance data into clear, actionable recommendations for internal teams, artists and label partners.
  • Build case studies and best-practice guidance that can help scale successful acquisition strategies across the organization.

Tools, Technology & Innovation

  • Oversee the strategic use of proprietary and third-party audience acquisition tools, landing-page platforms and CRM integrations.
  • Identify opportunities to improve fan sign-up experiences, progressive data collection, audience segmentation, consent management and data enrichment.
  • Partner with Product, Design & Engineering teams to help guide the development of tools and features that improve first-party data acquisition and measurement.
  • Collaborate with Marketing Strategy, Relationship Management, Fan Engagement & CRM, Privacy and Product, Design & Engineering teams to ensure acquisition campaigns comply with global privacy and consent requirements.
  • Support the Vice President, Audience Development in evaluating and testing new fan acquisition technologies, platforms and partners.
  • Monitor emerging audience-development trends within music and across industries such as gaming, sports, television, film and retail.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Education

  • Partner with Relationship Management, Global Paid Media & Growth Strategy, Brand Marketing, Fan Engagement & CRM, D2C e-commerce and Marketing Strategy teams to integrate first-party data acquisition into artist campaigns.
  • Serve as an audience-development thought leader internally and as a trusted advisor to artist and label partners, providing best-practice guidance and data-driven recommendations.
  • Educate internal teams and clients on the role first-party fan data can play in driving long-term audience ownership and commercial growth.
  • Support the Vice President, Audience Development in educating marketers across global markets on acquisition strategies appropriate to their local audiences, platforms, cultures and privacy requirements.
  • Help establish repeatable processes that make audience acquisition a consistent component of priority artist and release campaigns.

Who you are:

  • 5+ years of audience development, digital marketing, fan acquisition, growth marketing or related experience within music, entertainment or another consumer-focused industry, including e-commerce experience.
  • Proven track record of growing first-party email and SMS audiences and connecting that growth to measurable business outcomes.
  • Hands-on experience developing and executing lead-generation campaigns across paid, organic, artist-owned and partner channels.
  • Experience with audience and marketing platforms such as Klaviyo, Laylo, Salesforce, Braze or similar tools, as well as e-commerce platforms like Shopify.
  • Understanding of conversion funnels, landing-page optimization, audience targeting, A/B testing and customer acquisition economics.
  • Deep understanding of first-party data strategy, including value exchange, audience segmentation, consent management and data privacy best practices such as GDPR and CCPA.
  • Strong analytical skills, with experience using dashboards and KPI reporting to evaluate acquisition quality and downstream conversion.
  • Excellent communicator and collaborator who can advise multiple stakeholders and translate complex audience strategies into clear, actionable plans.
  • Comfortable balancing strategic planning with detailed, hands-on campaign execution.
  • Passionate about music, fan behavior, e-commerce and the use of technology to build lasting artist-fan relationships.
  • Intrinsically motivated to find new and exciting ways to identify and acquire music fans, with a curious mindset and a strong desire to test, learn and scale successful approaches.
  • Comfortable working flexible hours when needed to support our partners, live events and high-priority releases.

What we give you:

  • You join an inclusive, collaborative and global community where you have the opportunity to channel your passion every day
  • A modern office environment designed to foster productivity, creativity, and teamwork empowering you to bring your best
  • An attractive and comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, life & disability coverage, and 401K + employer matching
  • Voluntary benefits like company-paid identity theft protection and resources for pets, mental health and meditation resources, industry-leading fertility coverage, fully paid leave for childbirth or bonding, fully paid leave for caregivers, programs for loved ones with developmental disabilities and neurodiversity, subsidized back-up child and elder care, and reimbursement for adoption, surrogacy, tuition, and student loans
  • Investment in your professional growth and development enabling you to thrive in our vibrant community.
  • The space to accelerate progress, positively disrupt, and create what happens next
  • Time off for a winter recess

The Orchard is committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all persons regardless of age, disability, national origin, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, veteran or military status, marital and civil partnership/union status, alienage or citizenship status, creed, genetic information or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

The anticipated annual base salary does not include any other compensation components or other benefits that an individual may be eligible for. The Orchard empowers creators and businesses to grow and adapt in the dynamic global music industry. We specialize in being artist focused, blending industry expertise and technology, leveraging data to drive success, and providing streamlined digital and physical distribution solutions. The Orchard’s comprehensive artist & label services offerings include marketing, sync licensing, premium video services, transparent data analysis, advertising, rights management, radio promotion, D2C, and more.

The Orchard focuses on providing a comfortable, social, and engaging environment to encourage productivity and creativity.

We are seeking a Relationship Manager candidate to play a key role in coordinating and managing tasks for artist and label campaigns, offering vital sales support, and overseeing the evaluation of services. Reporting into the Relationship Manager Lead based out of New York, NY. This role involves tracking campaigns and budgets, collecting key materials, and assisting with critical day-to-day responsibilities across the team. The ideal candidate will be adept at working cross-functionally between departments and within diverse systems. They are flexible and capable of handling multiple tasks efficiently.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

  • Relationship Management: Maintain close relationships with label day-to-day teams, ensuring clear communication and timely updates on project deliverables. Weekly visits to key clients.
  • Campaign Coordination: Ensure all departments are equipped with the necessary tools and support to execute campaign plans effectively.
  • Communication: Share regular updates with both internal and external parties on campaign progress, priority release schedules, and other key initiatives.
  • Project Management: Ensure plans and campaigns stay on track, responding quickly to action items and maintaining momentum.
  • Campaign Execution: Ensure campaigns are executed to the highest standard, maintaining a high level of service and attention to detail.
  • Data-Driven Decision Making: Use reports and data to adapt quickly to emerging trends and increased fan activity, adjusting campaigns as needed.
  • Goal Setting: Work with the Relationship Lead to build benchmarks and set campaign goals at the start of each project.
  • Artist & Campaign Insights: Stay informed on both high-performing and developing artists, identifying opportunities to increase visibility and performance.
  • Company Knowledge: Serve as a reliable, knowledgeable source about company processes, ensuring smooth campaign execution.
  • Catalog Optimization: Help optimize label catalogs, especially around key tentpole moments.
  • Problem-Solving & Flexibility: Be prepared to jump in and tackle problems as they arise. Find creative solutions to keep projects moving forward. Demonstrate flexibility and balance in support of label needs.
  • Performance Reporting: Regularly prepare high-level performance reports on label, artist, and campaign results for the team.

WHO YOU ARE:

  • Experience: Minimum of 5 years in project management or campaign coordination. Previous experience product managing directly with labels, third-party agencies, or artist management teams is preferred.
  • Analytical Skills: Proficiency in utilizing analytics tools to track and interpret release performance, trends, and metrics.

job.title: Business and Legal Affairs Manager, The Orchard
job.description:
Bei The Orchard ist ab sofort eine Position im Bereich Business and Legal Affairs zu besetzen – an unserem Standort Berlin. Als Volljurist:in unterstützt Du das Tagesgeschäft und die rechtlichen Anforderungen unseres Business- und Legal-Affairs-Teams.

The Orchard ist ein führendes Unternehmen für Musikvertrieb und Artist Services mit Sitz in New York und in 45 Märkten weltweit tätig – im Vertrieb unabhängiger Künstler:innen wie Bad Bunny, Gorillaz und Raye. Mit modernsten Abläufen und einem einzigartigen globalen Team arbeiten wir mit Labels jeder Größe zusammen und machen deren Musik und Videos bei Hunderten von digitalen und physischen Händlern rund um den Globus verfügbar.

Leidenschaft für Musik und die Musikbranche ist ein Muss. Mit Deinem professionellen und souveränen Auftreten baust Du starke Beziehungen zu Kolleg:innen und externen Kund:innen auf und pflegst diese. Dafür schaffen wir ein angenehmes, offenes und inspirierendes Umfeld, das Produktivität und Kreativität fördert.

Das Team von The Orchard trifft sich von Montag bis Donnerstag im Büro. Freitags wird in der Regel im Homeoffice gearbeitet.

Was du tun wirst:

  • Entwerfen, Verhandeln und Finalisieren von Vertriebsverträgen mit Labels und Künstler:innen.
  • Entwerfen, Verhandeln und Finalisieren von Musikverlags- und Merchandising-Verträgen.
  • Entwerfen, Verhandeln und Finalisieren von Vertragsänderungen, Abtretungen und Kündigungen nach Bedarf.
  • Unterstützung bei Mergers & Acquisitions im deutschen Markt.
  • Beratung der Business- und globalen Legal-Teams zu Fragestellungen des deutschen Rechts und der hiesigen Praxis.
  • Mitarbeit im globalen Legal-Team, um Stakeholder:innen vor Ort rechtlich zu beraten.
  • Mitwirkung bei der Erstellung, Optimierung und Aktualisierung von Standardvertragsmustern.
  • Mitverantwortung für die Bearbeitung und Beilegung rechtlicher Ansprüche.

Wer du bist:

  • Juristischer Abschluss und 2–4 Jahre Berufserfahrung in einer vergleichbaren Position und Branche.
  • Fundierte Kenntnisse des deutschen Musikrechts.
  • Erfahrung mit Vertriebsverträgen.
  • Ausgezeichnete mündliche und schriftliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten.
  • Ausgezeichnete Fähigkeiten in der Vertragsgestaltung.
  • Fundiertes Fachwissen in allen Facetten des Musikgeschäfts.
  • Ausgeprägtes Organisationstalent mit der Fähigkeit, eine Vielzahl von Projekten im Blick zu behalten, zu priorisieren und sich auf wechselnde Prioritäten einzustellen.
  • Ausgeprägt selbstständige Arbeitsweise und nachweisliche Erfahrung im erfolgreichen Abschluss von Deals.

English Translation:

The Orchard has an immediate opening in Business and Legal Affairs at our Berlin office. As a qualified lawyer, you will support the day-to-day legal needs and requirements of our Business and Legal Affairs team.

The Orchard is a leading music distribution and artist services company headquartered in New York and operating in 45 markets worldwide – distributing music from independent artists including Bad Bunny, Gorillaz, and Raye. With cutting-edge operations and an unparalleled global team, we partner with labels of all sizes to make their music and video available across hundreds of digital and physical retailers around the world.

A passion for music and the music industry is a must. Your professional and confident approach will enable you to build and maintain strong relationships with your colleagues and external clients. In turn, we provide a comfortable, social, and engaging environment that encourages productivity and creativity.

What You’ll Do:

  • Drafting, negotiating, and finalising label and artist distribution agreements.
  • Drafting, negotiating, and finalising music publishing and merchandising agreements.
  • Drafting, negotiating, and finalising amendments, assignments, and terminations as needed.
  • Assistance with mergers and acquisitions in the German market.
  • Advising the business and global legal teams on issues particular to German law and practice.
  • Working within the global legal team to provide in-territory legal advice to stakeholders.
  • Assisting to create, refine, and update standard contract forms.
  • Co-managing legal claim resolution processes.

Who You Are:

  • Law Degree and 2-4 years of experience in a similar position and industry.
  • Thorough knowledge of German music law.
  • Experience with distribution contracts.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Excellent drafting skills.
  • Specialised knowledge throughout all facets of the music business.
  • Highly organised with an ability to track and prioritise a high volume of projects and adjust to changing priorities.
  • Strong autonomous working style with a proven ability to close deals.

job.title: Business Solutions Architect - PDEGO
job.description:
About Sony Music Entertainment

At Sony Music Entertainment, we fuel the creative journey. We’ve played a pioneering role in music history, from the first-ever music label to the invention of the flat disc record. We’ve nurtured some of music’s most iconic artists and produced some of the most influential recordings of all time.

Today, we work in more than 70 countries, supporting a diverse roster of international superstars, developing and independent artists, and visionary creators. From our position at the intersection of music, entertainment, and technology, we bring imagination and expertise to the newest products and platforms, embrace new business models, employ breakthrough tools, and provide powerful insights that help our artists push creative boundaries and reach new audiences. In everything we do, we’re committed to artistic integrity, transparency, and entrepreneurship.

Sony Music Entertainment is a member of the Sony family of global companies.

Business Solutions partners with our label, marketing, and release planning teams to build the tools and workflows that help them run more effectively. We operate as a trusted internal partner, not an order-taking function. Our work is guided by three principles: Fail Fast: test ideas quickly, and don't let perfection get in the way of progress; Learn Quickly: treat every iteration as a chance to learn, document, and adapt; and Move Forward: keep the work, and the people we support, moving.

The Architect is our platform strategist and systems thinker: the person who ensures our business systems ecosystem scales cleanly as it grows, while staying close enough to the business to know why it needs to. This role owns the center of excellence: defining the guardrails, patterns, and integration standards that every Business Solutions Specialist builds on, while remaining hands-on and business-facing rather than operating purely as a back-office architect.

What you'll do:

  • Define and evolve platform architecture standards and development guardrails across our core business systems
  • Partner closely with the SVP, Engineering and backend engineering on API and integration architecture
  • Evaluate and help the team adopt adjacent tools (Zapier, Make, n8n, Pipedream, Salesforce, Zendesk, etc.) as workflows expand
  • Provide architectural guidance and escalation support to the Business Solutions Specialists across business units
  • Engage directly with senior stakeholders to understand cross-business-unit operations and the broader ecosystem
  • Own the technical roadmap for platform scalability and maintainability
  • Lead complex data migrations across multiple business units
  • Contribute hands-on scripting/development work (integration scripts, workflow extensions) as needed
  • Support scoping and discovery for complex, multi-BU initiatives
  • Document standards, patterns, and best practices for the team
  • Define the team's AI enablement strategy — the standards, playbooks, and success metrics Specialists use to drive sustained AI adoption within business units, including tools like Claude Cowork
  • Own governance guardrails for AI-enabled workflows in partnership with Legal, InfoSec, and Privacy, ensuring new automation and AI use cases meet enterprise compliance requirements
  • Define measures of success for the Business Solutions platform and AI enablement program; use adoption and usage data to evaluate outcomes and inform roadmap priorities

Who you are:

  • 8-12 years in solutions architecture, business systems architecture, or platform engineering, with substantial experience designing and scaling enterprise-grade no-code/low-code business systems, built to be secure, scalable, and well-governed, not just functional
  • Track record designing and scaling automation/workflow architecture across multiple business units or departments
  • Working proficiency in at least one scripting language (e.g., JavaScript, Python) for automation and integration work
  • Experience integrating no-code platforms with enterprise systems (CRM, ticketing, ERP) via APIs or middleware
  • Strong business acumen, able to translate business needs into technical architecture and back
  • Excellent stakeholder management; equally credible with engineers and business executives
  • A systems thinker and tool-agnostic problem solver, comfortable picking up new platforms as our stack evolves
  • Extensive A.I. experience implementing or using tools such as Claude Cowork, ChatGPT Work, Google Gemini
  • Experience building or leading a center of excellence, AI governance body, or platform governance function
  • Demonstrated ability to define measures of success and use data to evaluate outcomes and drive accountability
  • Experience working within enterprise environments with established governance, privacy, security, and compliance expectations
Nice to Have (not required)
  • Experience in music, media, or entertainment, particularly around rights, royalties, or metadata
  • Deep, hands-on Airtable expertise (our current core platform), including advanced automations and scripting extensions

What we give you:

  • You join an inclusive, collaborative and global community where you have the opportunity to channel your passion every day
  • A modern office environment designed to foster productivity, creativity, and teamwork empowering you to bring your best
  • An attractive and comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, life & disability coverage, and 401K + employer matching
  • Voluntary benefits like company-paid identity theft protection and resources for pets, mental health and meditation resources, industry-leading fertility coverage, fully paid leave for childbirth or bonding, fully paid leave for caregivers, programs for loved ones with developmental disabilities and neurodiversity, subsidized back-up child and elder care, and reimbursement for adoption, surrogacy, tuition, and student loans
  • Investment in your professional growth and development enabling you to thrive in our vibrant community.
  • The space to accelerate progress, positively disrupt, and create what happens next
  • Time off for a winter recess

job.description:
The Senior Executive / Manager, Catalogue Growth & Commercialization plays a hybrid role across catalogue operations and commercial growth for Sony Music Entertainment Malaysia. This role is responsible for backend catalogue ingestion, optimization and M&A-related due diligence support, while also driving opportunities across D2C, website, AVOD monetization, SEO, analytics and DSP/platform optimization. Success in this role means ensuring catalogue assets are operationally ready, commercially optimized and positioned to maximize long-tail audience growth and revenue.

What you'll do:

  • Works independently as well as closely with various departments within Malaysia, the Asia Pacific region and external partners to support both Catalogue/Ops and Commercial Growth priorities.
  • Manages backend catalogue ingestion, optimization and digital supply chain workflows for acquired, legacy and M&A-related assets, covering product registration, metadata validation, delivery, scheduling, quality control, digitisation and operational readiness across DSPs, video platforms and partner services.
  • Supports M&A evaluation and due diligence by reviewing sales and performance reports, validating catalogue data and coordinating asset submission requirements for potential acquisition opportunities, including audio, video, metadata, artwork, rights documentation and related historical materials where applicable.
  • Supports Sony Music Malaysia’s commercial growth initiatives across D2C and e-commerce for artist merchandise and physical products, website upkeep and optimisation, AVOD and channel monetisation, and wider catalogue commercialisation opportunities.
  • Analyses and optimizes performance across Spotify, YouTube, YouTube Music, AVOD and other partner services by improving metadata, release setup, content packaging, channel hygiene, discoverability and audience signals to strengthen algorithmic performance, engagement and revenue.
  • Tracks and reports catalogue, website, D2C and partner platform performance, supports SEO and discoverability improvements, and identifies actionable optimization opportunities to improve long-tail catalogue value and monetisation outcomes.
  • Assists the team in solving operational and platform issues when required, including metadata mismatches, DSP mapping issues, delivery issues, rights conflicts, YouTube blockage issues and other backend or optimization-related matters.

Who you are:

  • Bachelor’s degree in music business, digital business, marketing, e-commerce, media, analytics, business management or any related field is preferred.
  • At least 4-6 years of relevant work experience for Senior Executive level, or stronger experience for Manager level, across digital operations, catalogue management, digital marketing, e-commerce, analytics, SEO, AVOD or related commercial digital functions.
  • Strong understanding of digital music and video ecosystems, DSP servicing, metadata, platform workflows and catalogue optimization; familiarity with D2C, website management, SEO and analytics is an added advantage.
  • Able to review and interpret sales and performance data, with an understanding of discoverability drivers, partner platform best practices and optimization levers across Spotify, YouTube, YouTube Music, AVOD and similar services.
  • Extremely detail-oriented and organized, capable of managing multiple workflows and timelines, while being proactive, commercially aware, adaptable and confident working cross-functionally in a fast-moving environment.

job.description:
Rattaché(e) à la Direction des Opérations et du Commercial Physique, le/la Cheffe de projet V.M.I. est responsable du pilotage, du déploiement et de l'optimisation du dispositif de Vendor Managed Inventory (VMI) auprès des enseignes partenaires.

À ce titre, il/elle assure la gestion des stocks confiés, garantit la disponibilité des produits tout en optimisant les niveaux de stock, coordonne les différents intervenants internes et externes, et contribue au développement ainsi qu'à l'amélioration continue du modèle VMI afin d'en assurer la performance opérationnelle et économique.

Vos missions:

Optimiser les stocks et les approvisionnements

  • Administrer les stocks clients et organiser le réapprovisionnement afin de garantir la disponibilité produit sans surstock
  • Définir et ajuster les paramètres de réapprovisionnement (seuils, quantités, fréquences) en fonction des ventes et de la saisonnalité

Piloter la performance

  • Développer le chiffre d’affaires en analysant les indicateurs clés (taux de service, rotation, référencement)
  • Identifier et corriger les écarts de stock ou de facturation en lien avec les équipes finance et logistique

Amélioration continue

  • Contribuer activement à l'amélioration continue du système VMI (outils, process, indicateurs, I.A.)
  • Proposer et mettre en œuvre des actions correctives ou d'optimisation en concertation avec les équipes internes et les partenaires

Le profil que nous recherchons :

  • Vous avez une formation Bac+3 à Bac+5 en commerce, gestion, logistique ou supply chain
  • Vous maîtrisez Excel ainsi que les outils de gestion de stocks et de réapprovisionnement
  • Vous êtes à l'aise avec les mécanismes de facturation et de dépôt-vente en grande distribution
  • Vous avez le sens du contact et savez travailler en transversal avec des interlocuteurs variés (magasins, équipes commerciales, logistiques et financières)
  • Vous avez l’esprit d'analyse et êtes force de proposition pour l'amélioration continue
  • Vous avez la capacité à gérer les priorités sur un périmètre multi-enseignes

En intégrant Sony Music vous pourrez profiter de plusieurs avantages :

job.title: Chief of Staff F/H / NB
job.description:
Sony Music Entertainment, recherche un.e Chieff of Staff au sein de la Direction Générale.

Rattaché.e à la Présidente de Sony Music France, le.la Chief of Staff agit comme partenaire stratégique de la Direction Générale. Il.elle contribue à la définition, la coordination et l’exécution des priorités de l’entreprise et assure la liaison entre la Présidence, les équipes locales, les fonctions régionales et les interlocuteurs internationaux du groupe.

Grâce à sa capacité d’analyse, de structuration et de synthèse, il.elle accompagne la prise de décision sur les enjeux stratégiques de l’entreprise.

Il.elle pilote également des projets transverses visant à soutenir la croissance, la transformation et la performance de Sony Music France.

Dans le cadre de votre poste, vous participez aux missions suivantes :

Support à la Direction Générale et Gouvernance

  • Préparer les instances de gouvernance et les comités de direction.
  • Participer aux réunions stratégiques, assurer les synthèses, comptes rendus et le suivi des décisions.
  • Produire les analyses et reportings nécessaires à la prise de décision de la Présidence.
  • Préparer les supports de présentation destinés aux interlocuteurs internes et externes.
  • Assurer la coordination entre les différents départements de l’entreprise et les parties prenantes du groupe Sony Music.
  • Accompagner les équipes dirigeantes dans la préparation de sujets stratégiques à destination des instances locales, régionales et internationales.

Stratégie et développement

  • Contribuer à la définition et à l’exécution de la stratégie de Sony Music France.
  • Réaliser des études stratégiques, analyses de marché et veilles concurrentielles.
  • Identifier les opportunités de croissance, de diversification et d’innovation.
  • Être force de proposition sur les évolutions organisationnelles, les nouveaux modèles économiques et les initiatives de transformation.

Gestion de projets transverses

  • Piloter des projets stratégiques et opérationnels impliquant plusieurs départements (Labels, Marketing, Commercial, Digital, Finance, RH, IT, Supply Chain, etc.).
  • Structurer les feuilles de route, coordonner les parties prenantes et garantir l’exécution des plans d’action.
  • Accompagner les changements d’organisation, les optimisations de process et les projets de transformation.
  • Suivre les indicateurs de performance et mesurer l’impact des initiatives mises en œuvre.

Croissance externe et partenariats

  • Participer à l’identification et au sourcing d’opportunités de partenariats stratégiques, d’investissements ou d’acquisitions.
  • Aider à l’exécution de ces opportunités en collaboration avec les équipes Finance, M&A, Juridique et les équipes opérationnelles.
  • Aider à préparer les analyses, recommandations et documents nécessaires aux prises de décision.
  • Accompagner l’intégration et le suivi de projets stratégiques en lien avec les différents départements.

Performance et transformation

  • Concevoir et maintenir les tableaux de bord de pilotage de la performance.
  • Analyser les performances de l’entreprise et formuler des recommandations d’amélioration.
  • Accompagner la Direction dans la définition et le suivi des objectifs stratégiques.
  • Piloter des initiatives d’amélioration continue, d’automatisation et de transformation des process.
  • Assurer une veille sur les innovations susceptibles d’améliorer la performance et l’efficacité opérationnelle de l’entreprise.

Profil recherché :

  • Expérience professionnelle de plus de 3 ans en conseil en stratégie, banque d’affaires, fonds d’investissement ou fonctions similaires en corporate.
  • Excellentes capacités d’analyse, de synthèse et de résolution de problèmes.
  • Forte capacité à piloter des projets complexes dans un environnement dynamique.
  • Excellentes compétences rédactionnelles et de communication en français et en anglais.
  • Forte autonomie, rigueur et sens de la confidentialité.
  • Capacité à influencer des interlocuteurs de tous niveaux et à travailler en transverse.
  • Intérêt marqué pour l’industrie musicale, les médias, la technologie et les enjeux de transformation.

Compétences clés :

  • Gestion de projets complexes et coordination transverse.
  • Corporate development, partenariats et compréhension des enjeux M&A.

  • Communication écrite et orale de haut niveau, en français et en anglais.
  • Rigueur, autonomie, sens des priorités et excellence d’exécution.
  • Leadership, capacité d’influence et gestion de parties prenantes.
  • Maîtrise avancée de PowerPoint, Excel, Canva, Copilot.

job.title: College Marketing Representative, Atlanta - The Orchard
job.description:
About The Orchard

The Orchard is a leading full-service music distribution company operating in 48 markets worldwide and servicing top global independent artists and labels. With cutting-edge operations and an unparalleled global team, The Orchard partners with clients to provide full scale solutions across a variety of verticals. Championed by an exceptional community of music lovers and experts, The Orchard empowers creators to grow and evolve in the dynamic, global industry.

The Orchard focuses on providing a comfortable, social, and engaging environment to encourage productivity and creativity.

As a paid part‑time employee of The Orchard, you’ll serve as a key advocate for the artists we distribute. Each month, you’ll promote 10–20 artists through a mix of digital and in‑person marketing across your campus and college town. You’ll be a tastemaker in your community, collaborating with student organizations, local businesses, record stores, DJs, promoters, and more to build meaningful visibility for new releases and touring artists across a wide range of genres.

In this role, you’ll lead listening events, organize campus activations, and create social media content that directly supports our artists. You’ll gain hands-on experience in music marketing while staying ahead of the curve on emerging talent and new music, all while shaping how students in your market discover and engage with The Orchard’s roster.

What you'll do:

  • Organically create awareness of The Orchard’s artists by cultivating authentic relationships with key campus and local influencers including college radio, student organizations, newspapers, and community media to unlock opportunities for reviews, radio plays, interviews, and standout exposure.
  • Maintain a local social media presence that promotes the artists you’ll be working with, utilizing a mix of digital assets that are supplied to you and creating your own content to support The Orchard’s artists
  • Implement in-person marketing initiatives at record stores, lifestyle shops, and on campus
  • Research appropriate online sites, forums, and networks for the key 18-24yr old demographic for each artist
  • Research & attend local and campus events that will best facilitate the promotion of our artists
  • Attend our artists' shows to hand out promotional tools and get feedback from fans
  • Submit a detailed report on your marketing successes and initiatives for each campaign you run

Perks:

  • You will gain real world music industry experience that will be a great addition to your resume
  • You have the opportunity to express your creativity through your locally run social channels, in our team brainstorms, and in your concert/album reviews
  • You’ll have access to inside information that will improve your marketing outreach
  • You’ll receive free ticket(s) into our artists’ shows & possible meet and greet passes
  • You’ll build valuable relationships within your local music industry
  • + many more!

Who you are:

  • You are an Undergraduate Student currently enrolled in a 4 year university in Atlanta with a minimum of 2 years left prior to graduation
  • You are able to manage your own hours and be accountable for the work assigned to you
  • You have a passion for music, an understanding of how your peers discover and consume music, and a deep interest in music business & marketing
  • You have an understanding of social media marketing, you stay current on trends, and you have an active presence creating content on TikTok, Instagram, X, and YouTube
  • You have availability of 20 hours per week
  • You’re well-written, well-spoken, a team player, and an excellent communicator
  • You have transportation methods and live within 30 minutes of Atlanta
  • You have a flexible schedule for team conference calls and tour coverage

What We Give You

  • You join an inclusive, collaborative and global community where you have the opportunity to channel your passion every day
  • A modern office environment designed to foster productivity, creativity, and teamwork empowering you to bring your best
  • Opportunities to connect with our valuable resources, such as our Counsel of Equity & Progressive Action (CEPA), a group created by our employees tasked with developing and implementing innovative solutions to advance a globally-shared goal of ensuring fair and inclusive spaces for all
  • An attractive and comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, life & disability coverage, and 401K + employer matching
  • Voluntary benefits like company-paid identity theft protection and resources for pets, mental health and meditation resources, industry-leading fertility coverage, fully paid leave for childbirth or bonding, fully paid leave for caregivers, programs for loved ones with developmental disabilities and neurodiversity, subsidized back-up child and elder care, and reimbursement for adoption, surrogacy, tuition, and student loans
  • Investment in your professional growth and development enabling you to thrive in our vibrant community.
  • The space to accelerate progress, positively disrupt, and create what happens next
  • Time off for a winter recess

The Orchard is committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all persons regardless of age, disability, national origin, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, veteran or military status, marital and civil partnership/union status, alienage or citizenship status, creed, genetic information or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

job.title: Consultant - Product Designer
job.description:
As Product Designer – Fan Platform & D2C, you will work closely with our SaaS partner, UI/UX, Marketing, and Product teams to develop and enhance features across our fan platform StampEight. You'll translate user and business requirements into clear product specifications, help design and optimize Artist Pages and customer journeys, and support the launch of digital products and experiences across content, commerce, and fan engagement.   • Help design and optimize Artist Pages, fan journeys, and other platform experiences to improve usability, engagement, and conversion.
  • Create wireframes, user flows, and product documentation, ensuring features align with business objectives and user needs.
  • Coordinate with Marketing, CRM, Content, and Product teams to support feature launches and ensure a seamless customer experience.
  • Monitor platform performance, analyse user behaviour and feedback, and recommend improvements based on data and insights.
  • Gather business and user requirements and translate them into clear product specifications, user stories, and functional requirements.

  • Education: Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, Human-Computer Interaction (HCI), Design, or a related field. Certifications in Product Management, UX, or Agile are a plus.
  • Skills: Strong understanding of UI/UX principles, user journey mapping, wireframing (Figma or similar), product documentation (PRDs, user stories), Agile methodologies, and product analytics. Ability to translate business requirements into functional specifications and work effectively with cross-functional teams.

job.title: Coordinador, PX & Manejo Oficina, Costa Rica
job.description:
El Coordinador de Experiencia de las Personas (PX) y de Oficina (Consultor) proporcionará apoyo esencial al Socio Comercial de PX y al Presidente CAC en general en la gestión de diversos procesos relacionados con las personas y la administración de la oficina. Este rol se centra en asistir en la gestión del ciclo de vida del empleado desde la incorporación hasta la salida, el desarrollo del desempeño, las iniciativas de compromiso y el cumplimiento de las políticas de PX y la legislación laboral local, asegurando un entorno de trabajo positivo y colaborativo.

El rol contribuye a asegurar una experiencia consistente, justa y de calidad, impulsando el engagement, el desempeño, el desarrollo y la efectividad organizativa mediante prácticas centradas en las personas y basadas en datos.

Lo que haras:

  • Apoyo de Business Partnering
    • Actuar como primer punto de contacto (con supervisión) para consultas de gerentes y empleados/as dentro de su perímetro.
    • Dar soporte al/la PX Business Partner en el día a día de temas de personas, asegurando consistencia con políticas internas y prácticas laborales locales.
  • Ciclo de vida del empleado/a
    • Apoyar procesos de onboarding, seguimiento de periodo de prueba, movilidad interna y offboarding.
    • Coordinar y hacer seguimiento de hitos clave del ciclo de vida, garantizando una experiencia positiva y documentación en tiempo y forma.
    • Apoyar los procesos de incorporación, el seguimiento del período de prueba, la movilidad interna y las actividades de desvinculación.
    • Coordinar y hacer seguimiento de los hitos clave en el ciclo de vida del empleado, asegurando una documentación oportuna y una experiencia positiva para los empleados.
  • Desempeño y desarrollo
    • Apoyar los ciclos de desempeño (objetivos, seguimiento, evaluación): comunicación, coordinación de tiempos, soporte en herramientas y reporting.
    • Colaborar con el Socio de Negocios de PX para identificar necesidades de capacitación y coordinar acciones con The Learning Curator, Latin-Iberia o proveedores externos.
    • Asistir en el apoyo logístico para los ciclos de desempeño, incluyendo la programación de evaluaciones y el seguimiento de plazos.
  • Engagement y cultura
    • Liderar iniciativas de engagement y cultura, colaborando con y apoyando a los comités internos (p. ej., Comité de Cultura) y Comunicación.
    • Contribuir a la planificación y ejecución de acciones de experiencia alineadas con los valores de la compañía (GPP).
  • Procesos y políticas de People
    • Apoyar el despliegue de políticas, guías y actualizaciones de procesos; ayudar a que los managers comprendan y apliquen los criterios.
    • Mantener documentación de procesos y FAQs; proponer mejoras a partir de dudas recurrentes y feedback.
  • Datos y reporting
    • Recopilar y dar seguimiento a métricas de personas (movimientos de plantilla, ausencias, completitud de ciclos, acciones de engagement, etc.) bajo la guía del Socio de Negocios de PX.
    • Preparar reportes básicos e insights para el PXBP/PX Leadership; asegurar la calidad del dato en sistemas de RR. HH.
  • Relaciones laborales / Employee Relations (rol de apoyo)
    • Apoyar la gestión administrativa de casos (registro, documentación, seguimiento) o cualquier problema de gestión de rendimiento, bajo la guía del PXBP o equipo de People Relations.
    • Coordinar reuniones, comunicaciones y próximos pasos, manteniendo confidencialidad y cumplimiento normativo.
    • Apoyo en proyectos especiales ad hoc y en la administración según sea necesario.
  • Manejo de Oficina
    • Actuar como punto de contacto principal con el propietario del inmueble en relación con todos los asuntos pertinentes a la oficina.
    • Manejar contratos con proveedores, reparaciones y cumplimiento de normativas operacionales de la oficina.
    • Supervisar y coordinar la empresa de limpieza, asegurando el mantenimiento y limpieza general de la oficina, así como gestionar y dar seguimiento a los proveedores externos responsables de servicios y mantenimiento de la oficina.
    • Gestionar el envío y la recepción de correspondencia y paquetería, asegurando su correcta distribución y registro cuando sea necesario.

Quien eres:

  • 3 – 4 años de experiencia en RR. HH., People, Talent, People Ops o funciones similares.
  • Conocimiento intermedio de procesos de RR. HH.: ciclo de vida, desempeño, formación y reporting.
  • Capacidad para manejar información confidencial con rigor y discreción.
  • Organización y seguimiento: gestión de múltiples tareas, cumplimiento de plazos y control documental.
  • Orientación a datos: manejo de Excel/Google Sheets y capacidad de elaborar reportes básicos.
  • Comunicación clara y efectiva (oral y escrita) y capacidad para interactuar con distintos niveles de la organización.
  • Nivel de inglés: Fluidez en inglés (oral y escrita) requerida
  • Empatía y orientación a las personas; capacidad de escucha activa.
  • Proactividad y mentalidad de mejora continua.
  • Atención al detalle y sentido de la responsabilidad.
  • Capacidad para trabajar en equipo y colaborar en entornos cambiantes.
  • Resiliencia y buena gestión de la presión en periodos de alta actividad (ciclos, cambios, picos).
  • Mentalidad de servicio: buscar soluciones y facilitar el trabajo de managers y equipos.

Lo que te ofrezemos:

  • Un contrato temporal
  • Unirte a una comunidad inclusiva, colaborativa y global donde puedes canalizar tu pasión todos los días.
  • Un entorno de oficina moderno diseñado para fomentar la productividad, la creatividad y el trabajo en equipo, empoderándote para dar lo mejor de ti.
  • Inversión en tu crecimiento y desarrollo profesional, permitiéndote prosperar en nuestra comunidad vibrante.
  • Espacio para acelerar el progreso, generar impacto positivo y crear lo que viene después.
  • Una plataforma para impulsar el cambio positivo, con oportunidades para contribuir a nuestras iniciativas de impacto social, diversidad, equidad e inclusión

job.title: Corporate Development Manager
job.description:
Established in 1997, Sony Music Entertainment is an indirect wholly owned subsidiary of Sony Group Corporation, Japan, with a presence in over 100 countries through our affiliates. We have nurtured some of music's most iconic artists and produced some of the most influential recordings of all time.

Sony Music's Corporate Development team for Asia & the Middle East works across some of the highest-growth music markets in the world, and has been behind many of the region's most significant transactions. Our work spans M&A and minority investments in music and entertainment businesses, music IP catalogue acquisitions, and strategic joint ventures.

We're seeking a highly analytical Manager to join us, reporting to the VP, Corporate Development, Asia & Middle East. The ideal candidate brings a strong background in financial modeling, commercial analysis, and deal execution, with a genuine interest in music, entertainment, and media.

What you will do:

  • Financial Modeling: Build and own the financial models underpinning valuation and deal structuring.
  • Commercial Analysis: Conduct industry and competitor analysis to evaluate potential acquisition and investment targets, joint ventures, and strategic initiatives.
  • Due Diligence: Participate in all aspects of due diligence, including financial, tax, legal, and operational; coordinate with external advisors and cross-functional teams across Asia, London, and New York.
  • Deal Execution: Support the end-to-end deal process from initial assessment through closing.
  • Presentation: Draft investment memos to communicate with senior management, crafting compelling stories and presentations that convey complex information clearly and persuasively.
  • Internal Reporting: Maintain the regional deal pipeline and report on the performance of completed investments against the original investment thesis.

  • Bachelor's degree in finance, business, economics, engineering, or a quantitative discipline. MBA, CFA, or an equivalent advanced credential is a plus.
  • Minimum of five years' experience in corporate development, deal advisory, investment banking, private equity, venture capital, or a similar analytical role.
  • Exceptional analytical skills, with strong proficiency in financial modeling and a high level of accuracy and attention to detail.
  • Comfortable working with large datasets, such as digital sales and streaming reports, to support deal analysis. Advanced Excel is essential; Python, SQL, or experience using AI/LLM tools to accelerate analysis is a plus.
  • Ability to craft compelling stories and presentations to convey complex information clearly and persuasively.

Success in this role means turning artist vision into culturally relevant, data-informed campaigns that build strong artist brands and deliver measurable commercial impact.

What you will do:

Platform & Audience Growth
• Drive audience growth and fan engagement across key digital platforms including Spotify, YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, and X.
• Identify platform-specific opportunities to increase visibility, discovery, and conversion for releases and artist brands.
• Partner with internal and external teams to deliver compelling digital content, rollout assets, and channel activations.


Release Execution & Cross-Functional Collaboration
• Manage campaign execution from pre-release through post-release in close collaboration with marketing, commercial, creative, and artist teams.
• Ensure timelines, deliverables, and approvals are aligned to support smooth and timely release rollouts.
• Support artist-facing communication and day-to-day coordination to keep campaign priorities on track.

Performance Tracking & Insights
• Monitor campaign performance across streaming, social, and content metrics to evaluate effectiveness and optimize in real time.
• Provide clear reporting and actionable insights to improve future releases, audience strategy, and digital marketing impact.


Market & Consumer Insights
• Monitor digital trends, audience behavior, and competitor activity to identify new campaign opportunities.
• Use data and market insights to refine targeting, content strategy, and platform priorities for local releases.
• Stay close to music, culture, and fan communities to keep campaigns relevant and locally resonant.

Who you are:

• 4–6 years of experience in digital marketing, music, entertainment, or a related industry.
• Hands-on experience planning and executing digital campaigns across platforms such as Spotify, YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, and X.
• Strong understanding of audience growth, content strategy, and digital performance metrics including reach, engagement, and streaming results.
• Ability to manage multiple releases and campaign timelines while coordinating effectively with cross-functional teams and external partners.
• Clear communication skills, strong attention to detail, and a passion for music, artists, and local culture.
• Cross-functional collaboration and stakeholder management.
• Data-driven thinking and performance analysis.
• Strong organization, attention to detail, and project management.
• Strong execution of digital campaigns across local frontline releases.
• Growth in audience reach, fan engagement, and platform performance.
• On-time delivery of campaign assets, timelines, and release milestones.
• Effective collaboration with artists, internal teams, and external partners.

• You join an inclusive, collaborative and global community where you have the opportunity to fuel the creative journey

• A modern office environment designed to foster productivity, creativity, and teamwork

• We invest in your professional growth & development

• An excellent range of benefits, like private medical cover and life insurance.

job.title: Director A&R - AWAL
job.description:
About Sony Music Entertainment

At Sony Music Entertainment, we fuel the creative journey. We’ve played a pioneering role in music history, from the first-ever music label to the invention of the flat disc record. We’ve nurtured some of music’s most iconic artists and produced some of the most influential recordings of all time.

Today, we work in more than 70 countries, supporting a diverse roster of international superstars, developing and independent artists, and visionary creators. From our position at the intersection of music, entertainment, and technology, we bring imagination and expertise to the newest products and platforms, embrace new business models, employ breakthrough tools, and provide powerful insights that help our artists push creative boundaries and reach new audiences. In everything we do, we’re committed to artistic integrity, transparency, and entrepreneurship.

Sony Music Entertainment is a member of the Sony family of global companies.

The Director, A&R with AWAL will be responsible for finding and acquiring recording artists, songs and producers as well as leading artist development efforts for designated artists in their genre. This role will report directly to the SVP, Head of A&R, AWAL North America and can be in New York or Los Angeles.

What you'll do:

  • Find and acquire recording artists, songs and producers through demos, recordings and live performances.
  • Cultivate relationships with artists and representatives and negotiate deals.
  • Solicit producers and coordinate meetings with artists and producers.
  • Spearhead recording, mixing and mastering sessions.
  • Select singles and key tracks.
  • Act as liaison with artist, artist managers and art department regarding marketing concepts.

Who you are:

  • 6-8 years of experience in A&R and artist development.
  • Strong communication skills.
  • Strong artist relation skills.
  • Ability to multitask and juggle multiple projects throughout the day.
  • Ability to handle and defuse intense situations.
  • Ability to handle talent relations effectively.
  • Able to work across multiple departments successfully.
  • Ability to understand, manage and forecast budgets.
  • Travel is required as needed.
  • Must be willing and able to attend concerts, artist appearances, and photo and video shoots as requested.
  • Must be able to attend artist performances, recording sessions and rehearsals.

What we give you:

  • You join an inclusive, collaborative and global community where you have the opportunity to channel your passion every day
  • A modern office environment designed to foster productivity, creativity, and teamwork empowering you to bring your best
  • An attractive and comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, life & disability coverage, and 401K + employer matching
  • Voluntary benefits like company-paid identity theft protection and resources for pets, mental health and meditation resources, industry-leading fertility coverage, fully paid leave for childbirth or bonding, fully paid leave for caregivers, programs for loved ones with developmental disabilities and neurodiversity, subsidized back-up child and elder care, and reimbursement for adoption, surrogacy, tuition, and student loans
  • Investment in your professional growth and development enabling you to thrive in our vibrant community.
  • The space to accelerate progress, positively disrupt, and create what happens next
  • Time off for a winter recess

Sony Music is committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all persons regardless of age, disability, national origin, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, veteran or military status, marital and civil partnership/union status, alienage or citizenship status, creed, genetic information or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

In everything we do, we’re committed to artistic integrity, transparency, and entrepreneurship.

Sony Music Entertainment is a member of the Sony family of global companies.

As Director, Digital Media Planning with AWAL, you will support paid media strategy and campaign execution across multiple markets. This role will work closely with global artist marketing and audience development teams to plan, optimize, and analyze digital advertising campaigns that drive audience growth, engagement, and consumption for priority artists and releases. You will challenge traditional music marketing frameworks, blending data-driven insights with creative curiosity to ensure our artists consistently cut through the noise of a rapidly evolving digital landscape.

What you'll do:

  • Media Planning & Strategy
    • Develop paid media plans aligned with marketing priorities for artist campaigns, releases, and project initiatives.
    • Identify optimal platform mix, audience segment & targeting strategies, and budget allocation across digital channels.
    • Translate marketing objectives into performance-driven media strategies.
    • Design and analyze experiments using platform features (Spotify Marquee, YouTube Shorts, etc) to determine the most cost-effective ways to drive revenue and engagement.
  • Campaign Execution & Optimization
    • Collaborate with internal and external teams to identify and create campaign assets
    • Work with internal teams and agency partners to launch, manage, and optimize campaigns across platforms such as:
      • Meta (Instagram / Facebook)
      • TikTok
      • YouTube / Google
      • Snapchat
      • Programmatic and display platforms
      • Emerging platforms
    • Monitor performance and adjust campaigns to maximize reach, engagement, and conversion metrics.
  • Analytics & Reporting
    • Analyze the "full-funnel" fan experience and track how a fan moves from a TikTok discovery through a link click to a Spotify save to a merch or ticket purchase. Identify friction points and drop-offs in the conversion chain.
    • Track campaign performance and deliver actionable insights and reporting.
    • Analyze audience and platform data to refine targeting strategies and improve ROI.
    • Build performance dashboards and post-campaign recaps for key stakeholders.
  • Global Collaboration
    • Work with artist marketing teams in the US, UK and international to align media strategy with campaign goals including audience segmentation and targeting.
    • Coordinate with creative and audience development teams to ensure campaign cohesion.

Who you are:

  • 5+ years experience in digital media planning or performance marketing
  • Experience working with global advertising agencies across multiple genres
  • Experience running direct campaigns on Meta Ads Manager, Google Ads, TikTok Ads Manager, and YouTube
  • Strong analytical and reporting skills
  • Experience with music, entertainment, or creator-driven marketing campaigns preferred
  • Ability to manage multiple campaigns across different markets simultaneously

job.title: Director, Emerging Technology - Global Business Development
job.description:
About Sony Music Entertainment

At Sony Music Entertainment, we fuel the creative journey. We’ve played a pioneering role in music history, from the first-ever music label to the invention of the flat disc record. We’ve nurtured some of music’s most iconic artists and produced some of the most influential recordings of all time.

Today, we work in more than 70 countries, supporting a diverse roster of international superstars, developing and independent artists, and visionary creators. From our position at the intersection of music, entertainment, and technology, we bring imagination and expertise to the newest products and platforms, embrace new business models, employ breakthrough tools, and provide powerful insights that help our artists push creative boundaries and reach new audiences. In everything we do, we’re committed to artistic integrity, transparency, and entrepreneurship.

Sony Music Entertainment is a member of the Sony family of global companies.

Sony Music Entertainment (SME) is seeking a Director to join our Emerging Technology team. This role is central to SME's work to drive innovation and bring responsible AI solutions into real-world use across the organization.

The Director will operationalize SME’s emerging technology priorities by managing the end-to-end lifecycle for promising AI vendors and tools, from scouting and evaluation through pilots, rollout, and scaled adoption. Working alongside SME labels and external partners, this role will equip teams with new AI tools and skills while running creative and business R&D programs that explore emerging capabilities, surface insights, and reshape workflows.

What you'll do:

Vendor pipeline and evaluation

  • Source and maintain a pipeline of AI companies, tools, and models that address creative and business priorities.
  • Evaluate vendors using defined criteria and document findings to support decision-making.
  • Build and maintain working relationships with existing and emerging AI vendors, staying close on product roadmaps, performance, and implementation needs.

Rollout and adoption

  • Partner with internal teams to guide selected vendor engagements through contracting, security review, approvals, and launch logistics.
  • Execute structured rollouts of approved AI tools across the organization, including stakeholder coordination, user communication, training workshops, onboarding materials, and case studies. Adjust plans based on adoption signals and measured impact.
  • Serve as a go-to advisor on AI tools and maintain feedback loops with users, vendors, and stakeholders to communicate updates and best practices, help users get the most value, understand evolving needs, surface issues, and inform prioritization.
  • Cultivate internal communities of AI-forward practitioners to develop case studies and support pilots that transform workflows.

R&D programs

  • Lead day-to-day execution of R&D programs to accelerate innovation across content production, business operations, and consumer experiences.

Communication

  • Develop executive briefings and reports to highlight progress, insights, and opportunities.

Who you are:

  • Hands-on AI practitioner. You’re a power user of generative AI tools for content production and business workflows, strong in prompt engineering, conceptually grounded in how models are trained and fine-tuned, and ideally experienced with agentic workflows.
  • Active in the AI landscape. You track new models, tools, and vendors as they emerge and quickly assess what's real versus overhyped. You test tools constantly and have well-formed views on which ones actually deliver.
  • Proven execution operator. You've assessed startups or products, run pilots, managed scaled rollouts, and worked with partners to influence execution and product direction.
  • Strong collaborator and capability-builder. Equally comfortable with a quick tactical question or a sustained partnership to help a team unlock new ways of working with AI, with the relationship-building and cross-functional skills to drive lasting impact.
  • Structured but nimble operator. You bring real project management discipline (clear plans, owners, and follow-through) without becoming rigid as innovation work evolves. You deliver through trust and influence with cross-functional partners.
  • Responsible innovation operator. You bring enterprise innovation and change management experience, including enablement (training, onboarding materials, and internal communities). You take projects from concept through adoption while recognizing when they touch governance, policy, or rights considerations, and you raise those questions early.
  • Excellent communicator. You translate technical concepts and user feedback into compelling, actionable recommendations for leaders at every level.
  • Industry experience. Experience in music, media, or entertainment is preferred.

job.title: Director, Marketing Strategist, Nashville - The Orchard
job.description:
About The Orchard:

The Orchard is a leading global music distributor and Artist & Label services company operating in 50+ markets worldwide. The Orchard empowers creators and businesses to grow and adapt in the dynamic global music industry. We specialize in being artist focused, blending industry expertise and technology, leveraging data to drive success, and providing streamlined digital and physical distribution solutions. The Orchard’s comprehensive artist & label services offerings include marketing, sync licensing, premium video services, transparent data analysis, advertising, rights management, radio promotion, D2C, and more.

The Orchard focuses on providing a comfortable, social, and engaging environment to encourage productivity and creativity.

We are seeking an experienced, innovative, and results-driven Marketing Strategist to join our Nashville based team. You will lead best-in-class marketing initiatives for high-profile artist and label partners, owning end-to-end strategy development and execution across campaigns, data initiatives, and audience engagement efforts.

You’ll serve as a trusted advisor internally to stakeholders and externally to artists, managers, and labels using data-driven insights, creative acumen, and global market intelligence to drive measurable impact. You will manage cross-functional partnerships and help drive marketing innovation within the region.

The role reports into SVP, Nashville with functional reporting to Senior Director, Creative Marketing & Strategy (NYC).

Please note:

  • This role requires hands-on campaign execution with occasional late night and weekend support to fully support our clients.
  • While you will have cross-functional support from across the organization, this position does not have direct reports.

What you'll do:

  • Office- first role, in office 4 days a week.

Strategic Marketing

  • Lead the development and execution of integrated marketing strategies for priority artists & labels and releases across multiple markets and genres (country, americana, indie, hip-hop, phonk, metal & more).
  • Own campaign planning, rollout strategy, campaign execution & measurement - ensuring alignment with audience, platform, market trends and company and client KPI’s.

Client & Partner Management

  • Act as the marketing point of contact for assigned label and artist partners.
  • Provide strategic counsel and build deep relationships with managers, artists, labels and internal stakeholders to identify growth opportunities and drive long-term value.

Creative & Storytelling

  • Oversee the conceptualization and execution of unique, culturally resonant campaigns that break through the noise and resonate globally.
  • Drive innovation across content, audience development, digital strategy, creator marketing, D2C/e-commerce and fan engagement within 3rd party communities and owned 1st party data like email and SMS & more.

Performance Analytics & Optimization

  • Translate campaign data and audience insights into actionable strategy.
  • Monitor performance across platforms, identify key trends, and optimize ongoing and future efforts accordingly.
  • Present key results, learnings, and recommendations to senior stakeholders and partners.

Cross-Functional & Global Collaboration

  • Work closely with team Relationship Team leads, Paid Media, Creative Services, D2C, PDE, CRM, Channel Strategy, Audience Development teams and more to ensure campaign execution is timely, impactful, and aligned with overarching goals.
  • Partner with internal teams to leverage proprietary tools, fan data, and creative assets to drive audience growth and demand generation.

Innovation & Growth

  • Stay ahead of emerging marketing trends, platforms, and fan behaviors and integrate new approaches into campaign strategy.
  • Seek out and develop new opportunities for fan data acquisition, platform innovation, and monetization in partnership with Marketing Leads.

Leadership & Mentorship

  • Contribute to a culture of collaboration, accountability, and creative excellence.

Who you are:

  • 10+ years of experience in music marketing, brand strategy, or entertainment/media, with a strong track record of managing high-impact campaigns and working within cross-functional teams.
  • Deep understanding of the music ecosystem across digital platforms, streaming, social, live events, first party data and fan engagement channels.
  • A strategic thinker and creative problem-solver who thrives in a fast-paced, evolving environment and is comfortable managing a high volume of work.

What you'll do:

  • Execution and campaign setup across social, CTV, programmatic, and other ad platforms
  • Negotiate, plan, and implement traditional media programs through strategic collaborations with traditional channel partners (out-of-home, print, trade, radio, TV)
  • Collaborate with both the central media team and other departments (e.g., marketing, content, audience development, and analytics) to create cohesive strategies guided by key business outcomes
  • Utilize various internal and external tools to develop data-informed insights that provide the framework and approach for media strategies
  • Help create focused, creative, and breakthrough media plans that provide immediate impact as well as key learnings for the future
  • Develop and conduct key ad operation tasks engineered for media and business goal performance

Who you are:

  • Self-starter with a strong tolerance for high-volume, quick-turnaround work

  • Traditional media planning and strong negotiation skills across channels
  • Familiarity and applied knowledge of tracking, measurement, and tagging technologies and methodologies (e.g., pixels, events, integrations, and GTM)
  • Use of reporting, dashboard, and analytics tools (e.g., Adverity, Supermetrics, Looker Studio, and similar tools)
  • Proficiency with MS Office, Canva, Google tools, and other spreadsheet and presentation tools
  • Strong oral and written communication skills
  • Love and passion for music
  • Curious and forward-thinking about the state and future of media and its integration with music
